jobs.title: Barnehagelærer
jobs.description:
Vi har ledig 90% vikariatet som barnehagelærer med de yngste barna i Venstøp barnehage.

Vikariatet er todelt:

- 40% vikariat frem til mai 2027.

- 50% frem til 31.12.26, med muligheter for forlengelse.

 

Venstøp barnehage er en fire avdelingsbarnehage, som ligger landlig til nord for sentrum.

Vi er opptatt av å være mye ute, og bruker skog og mark i nærmiljøet som en viktig arena for lek, læring og opplevelser.

Gjennom vår satsing på språk og medvirkning arbeider vi for at alle barn skal oppleve å bli sett, hørt og verdsatt, slik at de kan delta aktivt i et inkluderende fellesskap.

 

Tilsetting ønskes så snart som mulig.

Vi oppfordrer kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke.


 


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Bidra til å planlegge, gjennomføre og evaluere det pedagogiske arbeidet i tett samarbeid med pedagogisk leder.
  • Motivere, inspirere og være en positiv bidragsgiver for at avdelingen og barnehagen når målene sine. 
  • Bidra til et godt samarbeid med foresatte, barn, andre instanser og kollegaer.
  • Delta aktivt for å skape et trygt og utviklende miljø for enkeltbarn og barnegruppen.
Kvalifikasjoner

Krav om:

  • Godkjent førskole/barnehagelærer eller annen 3-årig pedagogisk høgskoleutdanning m/videreutdanning i barnehagepedagogikk og småbarnspedagogikk.
  • Gode norskferdigheter, både skriftlig og muntlig.
  • Politiattest må fremlegges før tiltredelse.


    For at vi skal kunne vurdere om du er kvalifisert for stillingen og lønnsplassere deg, må relevant dokumentasjon (vitnemål og attester) lastes opp og legges ved søknaden.

    Gyldig politiattest må fremlegges før tiltredelse for stillinger som krever dette. 

    Personlige egenskaper
    • Selvstendig og strukturert.
    • Gode samarbeidsevner/relasjonsbygger.
    • Fleksibel og løsningsorientert.

     

    Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt.

    Vi tilbyr
    • Lønn etter gjeldende avtaleverk. 
    • Meget gode forsikrings- og pensjonsordninger.

     

    Vi tror at mangfold beriker våre arbeidsplasser og gjør oss bedre.

    Vi oppfordrer derfor kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke uavhengig av kjønn, alder, kulturell bakgrunn eller funksjonsevne.

    Skien er hovedstaden i Telemark og en av landets eldste byer med røtter tilbake til år 900 e. kr. Byen ligger sentralt plassert mellom fjord og fjell på Østlandet, og er en del av Grenland som til sammen har nærmere 100.000 innbyggere.

jobs.title: Pædagog søges til Holstedgaard
jobs.description:
Er du vores nye Kollega

Brænder du for at skabe meningsfulde relationer og understøtte mennesker i at leve det liv, de ønsker? Så er det måske dig, vi søger til vores engagerede medarbejdergruppe på Holstedgaard.

På Holstedgaard udvider vi vores personalegruppe og søger en pædagog, der gennem tillidsfulde relationer kan motivere, inddrage og samarbejde med vores beboere. Vi arbejder målrettet for, at beboerne oplever medbestemmelse, tryghed og et hjemligt miljø, hvor deres ønsker, behov og drømme er i centrum.

Vores botilbud er først og fremmest beboernes hjem. Da flere af vores beboere udover psykiske lidelser også har somatiske problemstillinger, yder vi en helhedsorienteret indsats. Som pædagog hos os skal du derfor forvente, at der også er perioder, hvor du skal deltage i og være ansvarlig for, at der udføres personlig pleje som en naturlig del af beboerens hverdag og trivsel.

Om Holstedgaard

Holstedgaard har 69 pladser fordelt på flere teams. Vi tilbyder både midlertidige og længerevarende ophold efter Servicelovens §§ 107 og 108 til borgere over 18 år. Målgruppen er mennesker med forskellige psykiatriske lidelser og ofte komplekse somatiske problemstillinger.

Vi er i gang med at implementere og forankre KRAP (Kognitiv, Ressourcefokuseret og Anerkendende Pædagogik), som danner rammen om vores faglige tilgang. Her arbejder vi med fokus på beboernes styrker, ressourcer og udviklingsmuligheder.

Stillingen indebærer dag- og aftenvagter samt arbejde hver anden weekend.

Vi søger en kollega, der:

  • Er uddannet pædagog eller har anden relevant socialpædagogisk uddannelse.

  • Er indstillet på at tage ansvar for og deltage i den personlige pleje og somatiske understøttelse af beboerne.

  • Har erfaring med eller interesse for det socialpædagogiske område, gerne inden for psykiatrien.

  • Arbejder fagligt reflekteret og kan omsætte teori og metode til praksis.

  • Kan dokumentere faglige indsatser og følge op på mål og delmål.

  • Er ansvarlig, fleksibel og kan bevare overblikket i en varieret hverdag.

  • Trives med både selvstændigt arbejde og samarbejde i mindre teams.

  • Værdsætter kollegial sparring, feedback og fælles refleksion.

  • Er initiativrig og ønsker at bidrage til den fortsatte udvikling af vores botilbud.

  • Har mod på at indgå i et læringsmiljø, hvor nysgerrighed, faglig udvikling og refleksion er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

  • Kørekort er ikke et krav, men vil være en fordel.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En engageret og fagligt stærk medarbejdergruppe med fokus på både socialpædagogiske og sundhedsfaglige indsatser.

  • En mangfoldig gruppe beboere, som bidrager til en spændende og meningsfuld hverdag.

  • En uformel og anerkendende arbejdskultur med plads til humor og fællesskab.

  • Indflydelse og medansvar i et teamsamarbejde under fortsat udvikling,med fokus på trivsel og arbejdsglæde.

  • Løbende supervision.

  • Sundhedsforsikring.

Praktiske oplysninger

  • Timetal: Stillingen er på 25-37 timer ugentligt med tiltrædelse snarest muligt.

  • Ansættelsesproces: Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat høre du ikke fra os er stillingen gået til anden side.

  • Straffeattest: Stillingen er omfattet af reglerne om indhentelse af straffeattest. Ansættelse kan først finde sted, når tilfredsstillende straffeattest foreligger.

  • GDPR: Vi behandler og opbevarer alle personoplysninger i overensstemmelse med gældende GDPR-regler.

Vil du vide mere?

Du er velkommen til at kontakte Ann-Sofie Hartvig på telefon 22757735.

Ansøgning og CV sendes til: ash@holstedgaard.dk

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja, Attendo Kalliohovi, Kuopio
jobs.description:
Lähihoitaja ikäihmisten pariin Attendo Kalliohoviin, Kuopioon – Olemme täällä sinua varten!

Attendo Kalliohovi on 32-paikkainen ympärivuorokautisen hoivan koti, jossa laadukas hoiva, turvallinen arki ja asukkaan hyvinvointi ovat kaiken toimintamme ytimessä. Meillä jokainen päivä sisältää yhdessä tekemistä ja iloa – liikumme, laulamme, tanssimme, askartelemme, ulkoilemme sekä toteutamme asukkaille merkityksellisiä hetkiä heidän toiveidensa mukaisesti.

Etsimme nyt lähihoitajaa määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen osaksi välittävää työyhteisöämme. Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden tehdä työtä, jolla on aidosti merkitystä – olla läsnä asukkaille, mahdollistaa hyviä hetkiä ja tukea heidän hyvinvointiaan joka päivä. Meillä pääset työskentelemään tiimissä, jossa autamme toisiamme ja arvostamme jokaisen osaamista. Jos haluat olla mukana luomassa ikäihmisille hyvää ja arvokasta arkea, toivotamme sinut lämpimästi tervetulleeksi joukkoomme

Me Attendolla olemme Matkalla kodiksi. Se merkitsee sitä, että haluamme olla ennen kaikkea koti ikäihmisille, vammaisille ja vammautuneille sekä mielenterveys- ja päihdekuntoutujille. Viimeisten vuosien aikana olemme onnistuneet johtamiseen, asiakaskokemukseen ja kohtaamisiin satsaamalla kasvattamaan niin läheis- ja asukastyytyväisyytemme kuin henkilöstötyytyväisyytemmekin historialliseen huippuun. Jokainen asukkaamme ansaitsee tulla kohdatuksi omana itsenään ja elää täyttä elämää. Attendolaisena olet tärkeä osa tätä tehtävää.

Mitä pääset lähihoitajana tekemään meillä?

* kartoitat asukkaiden voimavarat ja tuen tarpeet

* suunnittelet, toteutat ja arvioit hoitoa yhdessä tiimin kanssa

* huolehdit lääkehoidosta

* varmistat, että jokainen asukas saa elää hyvää, turvallista ja laadukasta arkea

Sinun työpanoksellasi on valtava merkitys – olet mukana luomassa ympäristöä, jossa ihmiset voivat aidosti hyvin.

Tehtävä kokoaikainen määräajalle 31.5.2027 saakka. Työ on 3-vuorotyötä ja työsuhteen aloituksen ajankohdasta voimme sopia kanssasi, toivomme kuitenkin että voit aloittaa työssäsi mahdollisimman pian.

Tutustu meidän arkeemme Instagramissa: @Attendo Kalliohovi [https://www.instagram.com/attendo_kalliohovi/]

Mitä edellytämme sinulta?

* Sosiaali- ja terveysalan perustutkintoa

* Tartuntatautilain 48§:n tarkoittama rokotussuoja asiakkaiden ja potilaiden suojaamiseksi koko työsuhteen voimassaoloajan ajaksi

* Hygieniapassi

* Sujuva suomen kielen taito, vähintään taso B1.1. suullinen ja kirjallinen

* Rikosrekisteriote tarkistetaan työsuhteen alkaessa

* Sote-ammattikortti eli varmennekortti

* Lääkeluvat tai valmius suorittaa ne työsuhteen alkaessa



Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Kuljemme rinnallasi
Attendolla esihenkilösi ei ole kaukana, vaan mukana arjessa – tukemassa ja kulkemassa rinnallasi. Meillä olet tärkeä osa moniammatillista tiimiä, joka tekee kodista kodin asukkaillemme.

Tuemme kehittymistäsi

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
About Volumental

Volumental is a FitTech™ company used by footwear brands and retailers, matching people with shoes that truly fit through 3D scanning and machine learning.

Our vision is "a world without sizes, where every body fits". We work with brands like New Balance, Red Wing, Fleet Feet, and Vivobarefoot across 3,000+ stores in 60 countries, with 60M+ foot scans collected, one of the world's largest datasets of its kind.

We've always been an AI company at our core. Today, that extends beyond the product into how we build, using AI agents and strong self-serve tooling to move faster from idea to production.

Where you fit in  Every scan in every one of those stores, and every recommendation we give, depends on infrastructure that has to work while a shopper is standing in front of a clerk. Our platform runs on Kubernetes on Google Cloud, is managed as code, is deployed through GitOps, and is observed through Grafana. What we’re looking for is someone who treats that platform as a product: one our developers can self-serve on, that holds up when things go wrong, and that is ready for new kinds of workloads.

This is a hands-on Platform Engineer role. Most days you'll be shipping and running infrastructure with Terraform, Helm and ArgoCD, keeping an eye on our systems through Grafana, and building tools in Go that let developers get what they need without waiting on anyone. You'll also spend time explaining technical tradeoffs and writing docs that others can act on.

AI is changing the industry, and we see it as an opportunity to empower people. By automating toil and mechanical tasks across the organisation, people can focus on the architectural, novel, and creative work. You will be right at the centre of this transformation, enabling not only yourself and your team’s work, but ensuring that the company can leverage AI and accelerate as a whole.

Things you'll do:

    

Ship and run production infrastructure on Kubernetes and GCP, managed as code with Terraform and deployed with Helm and ArgoCD

    

Define SLOs and build monitoring and alerting in Grafana that tells us when stores and shoppers are actually affected

    

Take part in on-call, lead incident response, and run postmortems that turn into real fixes

    

Build tools in Go that let developers self-serve on environments, deployments and access

    

Explain technical tradeoffs to engineers, product managers and leadership, and write documentation others can act on

    

Leverage AI agents to compress routine work, redirecting the time saved into reliability and platform improvements

    

Help strengthen how we handle access, secrets, certificates and image security alongside the wider team

We are excited about you because:

    

You have 3+ years of experience running production infrastructure in an SRE, DevOps or Platform role

    

You've been on-call for production systems on Kubernetes and a major cloud provider, ideally GCP, and have led incident response and postmortems

    

You can set up SLO-based monitoring and alerting, and you're comfortable managing infrastructure as code with Terraform

    

You write clean, maintainable, cloud-native code in at least one language such as Go or Python

    

You have solid systems knowledge and troubleshoot methodically across the stack

    

You're comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy finding the right problem and seeing it through

Bonus - Don't let these stop you from applying, but please let us know if you have experience with:

    

Deploying and running AI agent workloads and tool servers (such as MCP), with sandboxing, rate limiting and observability of agent actions

    

Security: identity and access management, authentication (OAuth/OIDC, SSO), certificate and TLS/mTLS management, secrets handling, network hardening, vulnerability management, and image hardening and scanning

    

Compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 or GDPR

    

Database operations and migrations

    

Running workloads across multiple cloud providers or regulated regions

What we can offer you:

    

Personal learning budget and access to coaching

    

Opportunity to work with a great team of 20+ nationalities in our English-speaking office

    

Occupational pension at ITP1 level

    

Flexible Public Holidays Policy

    

Options Program

    

Parental pay top-up

    

Wellness allowance

    

Flexible work policy (at least 3 days a week from our Stockholm office)

The monthly compensation range for this role in Stockholm is 52,000-66,000 SEK. Actual compensation will depend on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process.

This is a full-time position based at our Stockholm headquarters. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds! If this role excites you but you don't meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply - we'd love to hear from you.

Feel free to include a link to your GitHub or anything you've built or operated that you're proud of.

How we hire

We use generative AI to assist the people running our recruitment process, for example in preparing interviews. People are in the loop at every stage, and every decision about your application is made by a human.

Vi jaktar på ny forlagssjef til Samlaget. Dette er ei stilling som krev solid erfaring med tekstarbeid, brei kunnskap om forleggjarfaget og eit brennande engasjement for nynorsk språk. 

Vi ser etter ein god generalist på forleggjarfeltet, som er van med å balansere «børs og katedral». Stillinga krev eit marknadsorientert blikk og forretningsteft, og samstundes må forlagssjefen ha vilje og evne til å jobbe tett med nokre av landets fremste forfattarar med fokus på det litterære. Vedkommande må vere glad i å bruke og utvikle nettverket for å hente inn prosjekt og rekruttere forfattarar. 

Forlagssjefen er leiar for redaksjonen med ansvar for det redaksjonelle arbeidet og har personalansvar for tolv tilsette i avdelinga. Stillinga har budsjett- og resultatansvar for redaksjonen, og forlagssjefen står for den daglege leiinga av avdelinga. Stillinga rapporterer til forlagsdirektøren og inngår i leiargruppa. 
Arbeidsoppgåver Den viktigaste oppgåva til forlagssjefen blir å hente inn nye prosjekt, rekruttere forfattarar og etablere ein struktur for kontinuerleg idéutvikling. Vedkommande må derfor forstå marknaden og utviklinga i lese- og kjøpevanane til folk. 

Det er venta at forlagssjefen gjennom leiargruppa deltek aktivt i den langsiktige utviklinga av forlaget, med særskilt ansvar for den redaksjonelle utviklinga.  Andre oppgåver
  • gjennomføring av den overordna planen med vekt på dei redaksjonelle prioriteringane 
  • saman med marknadssjefen budsjettere og setje salsmål for enkelttitlar 
Vi ser for oss at relevante kandidatar har
  • solid forståing for det nynorske språkprosjektet og den nynorske kulturhistoria 
  • solid innsikt i forleggarfaget med utgivaransvar, ytringsfridom og etikk
  • leiarerfaring og evne til å skape samhald og godt samarbeid i kvardagen 
  • forståing for utfordringane i bransjen og den særeigne posisjonen til litteraturen i samfunnet

  • lønn etter avtale

Det Norske Samlaget er eit av Noregs eldste forlag, grunnlagt i 1868. Samlaget er organisert som ei stifting der overskotet av drifta blir reinvestert i forfattar- og forlagsutvikling. Samlaget gir ut litteratur på nynorsk. Redaksjonen er organisert i fire underredaksjonar: skjønnlitteratur, sakprosa, barn og unge og høgare utdanning. Forlaget publiserer også digitale ordbøker. jobs.title: Psykologspesialist/psykolog
jobs.description:
Avdeling for barn og unges psykiske helse (ABUP) tilbyr tjenester innenfor psykisk helsevern for barn og unge. Vår målgruppe er barn og ungdom under 18 år og deres familier. Abup har kliniske enheter i Arendal, Kristiansand og Lister. I tillegg til klinisk virksomhet drives det et betydelig forskningsarbeid.

Familieenheten har nå ledig en fast stilling som psykologspesialist/psykolog i Familieteamet. Enheten består i dag av tre team, Nevroteamet, Familieteamet og Spe- og småbarnsteamet.

1 x 100 % fast stilling som psykologspesialist/psykolog i Familieteamet. Tiltredelse etter avtale. 

Familieteamet har fagansvar for stemningslidelser 0-18 år, og eksternaliserende vansker. Teamet har ulike behandlingstilnærminger, har eget EFST team og fagansvar for friluftsterapi. 

Enheten holder for tiden på å implementere DBT-C som er et intensivt  behandlingstilbud for barn med store emosjonelle og adferdsmessige vansker. DBT-C teamet vil bli et matriseteam med behandlere fra alle team. Det er ønskelig at psykologspesialisten/psykologen som blir ansatt skal være med i utviklingen av behandlingstilbudet.  

Vi søker fortrinnsvis en psykologspesialist/psykolog med bred differensialdiagnostisk kompetanse og erfaring med utredning og behandling av barn, ungdom og familier.
Teamet er preget av tett tverrfaglig samarbeid, høy faglig kompetanse og et tydelig engasjement for utvikling av gode og helhetlige behandlingstilbud.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Utredning, diagnostisering og behandling innenfor fagfeltet psykisk helsevern for barn og unge
  • Psykolog arbeider i tverrfaglig team
  • Veiledning av foreldre og samarbeidspartnere
  • Tett samarbeid med førstelinjetjenesten, skole/PPT, Barnevernstjeneste, BUF etat og spesialisthelsetjenesten
  • Det er et krav at spesialist tar ansvar for vedtak etter Lov om psykisk helsevern
  • Spesialist må utføre spesialistoppgaver
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Norsk autorisasjon eller lisens som psykolog
  • Ønskelig med spesialist, fortrinnsvis i barne- og ungdomspsykologi
  • Erfaring fra psykisk helsearbeid med barn og unge er en fordel
  • God norsk skriftlig og muntlig framstillingsevne, samt ferdigheter i bruk av dataverktøy er nødvendig
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Ønskelig med erfaring med EFT/EFST
Personlige egenskaper
  • Vi ønsker en medarbeider som har evne til å arbeide målrettet og analytisk både i selvstendig arbeid og med bidrag til teamet/samarbeidspartnere
  • God systemforståelse, tilstedeværelse og engasjement
  • Evne til å både kunne jobbe selvstendig og i tverrfaglig team
  • Gode samarbeidsevner
  • Pålitelighet, fleksibilitet og god arbeidskapasitet
  • Trives med både utredning og behandlingsoppgaver
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt
Vi tilbyr
  • Spesialister i faste stillinger opparbeider rett til 4 måneder studiepermisjon hvert 5 år til enhver gjeldende overenskomst
  • Lønn etter overenskomst
  • Et team bestående av engasjerte og faglig dyktige kollegaer, samt et godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Mulighet for betalt videreutdanning/spesialisering etter avtale
  • Utfordrende og varierte arbeidsoppgaver
  • Veiledning, jfr. krav i spesialiseringsforløpet
  • En avdeling forankret i helseforetakets verdigrunnlag
  • En avdeling og klinikk i utvikling
  • P.t. fleksibel arbeidstid
  • Medlemskap i KLP, samt gruppe- og ulykkesforsikring
  • Stilling i en IA-bedrift

jobs.title: Senior FME and GIT consultant
jobs.description:
Senior FME & GIS Consultant – 3D Building Models (LOD1, LOD2, LOD2.5)

Role

On behalf of our client, we are looking for a senior FME and GIS consultant to work on system integration and 3D building models. You have solid, documented experience of FME and GIS, preferably at least 15 years. The work is performed remotely, although on-site presence may occasionally be needed for discussions.

Assignment

You will refine and further develop existing FME scripts used to generate building models at LOD1, LOD2 and LOD2.5. The workflow must be adapted to the database model of Gaida Primärkarta, moving away from the previous model in Geosecma Primärkarta. The assignment also includes upgrading to the current FME version and ArcGIS Pro environment.

BUILDINGID from BAL is to be introduced as the primary identifier throughout every step of the process. The solution must handle buildings made up of multiple building parts and support batch processing of multiple buildings. The models are to be delivered in separate feature classes for each LOD level and integrated with the existing 3D city model.

Expected deliverables

    An updated, tested and deployed FME workflow for generating 3D building models according to the conditions above
    A workflow adapted to the Gaida Primärkarta database model, the current FME version and the ArcGIS Pro environment
    A solution that is sustainable to maintain over the long term and well documented
    Complete technical documentation and knowledge transfer to the GIS and 3D team within the organisation

Mandatory requirements

    Documented experience of creating and processing 3D building models at LOD1, LOD2 and LOD2.5
    Experience of migrating and adapting solutions between different database models, and of handling identifiers and relationships in geodata processes
    Documented expert-level skills in FME Form and FME Flow, including development, troubleshooting and optimisation of advanced workflows
    Ability to produce solution documentation and carry out knowledge transfer
    Very good knowledge of ArcGIS Pro, geodatabases and handling of 3D geodata
    Very good communication skills in Swedish, spoken and written

Merits

    Experience of municipal geodata and GIS operations
    Experience of Gaida Primärkarta or a comparable base-map database
    Knowledge of BAL and the use of BUILDINGID in geodata processes
    Experience of integration between FME, ArcGIS Pro and 3D city models
    Previous experience of similar assignments in complex IT and GIS environments

Location and remote work

Remote work, with on-site attendance possible when needed for discussions.

jobs.title: Deployment Lead - ERP Solutions
jobs.description:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.

Who We Need

We are building industry-defining accounting and finance software. We are looking for an experienced Deployment Lead to guide complex customer implementations and help finance teams successfully transition onto Rillet.

This role is ideal for someone who has led ERP implementations and understands how to turn complex accounting and operational requirements into practical systems solutions. You may come from an ERP implementation firm, Big 4 finance transformation practice, systems consulting team, or a SaaS company serving finance organizations. You are comfortable owning multiple workstreams, advising senior stakeholders, and navigating the details of configuration, data migration, integrations, testing, and go-live.

You will combine strong implementation judgment with a customer-first mindset—bringing structure to ambiguity, identifying risks early, and keeping customers and internal teams moving toward a successful launch.

We’re primarily looking for teammates who are based near our New York City or San Francisco offices, or open to relocating. For this role, we’re also open to remote candidates based anywhere in the United States. Our hybrid schedule brings office-based team members together in person on Tuesdays and Thursdays, plus one additional flexible day each week. Some roles may spend more time in the office depending on the needs of the team.

What You'll Do

  • Lead key parts of customer onboarding and deployment, helping ensure a smooth and timely implementation experience

  • Partner with internal teams across Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to execute implementation plans and solve customer problems quickly

  • Learn and analyze client accounting and finance workflows, then translate those needs into clear requirements and practical solutions

  • Guide customers through onboarding, training, change management, and adoption

  • Support data migration, reconciliations, systems setup, and integration coordination

  • Track milestones, drive follow-through, and keep internal and external stakeholders aligned throughout the onboarding process

  • Identify risks early, escalate issues quickly, and help keep customer launches on track

  • Build trust with customers by being responsive, thoughtful, and solutions-oriented

  • Maintain clear documentation and provide regular status updates to customers and internal stakeholders

Who We're Looking For

  • 4–7 years in ERP implementation, systems consulting, or finance transformation (e.g., Big 4 or implementation firms)

  • Background in SaaS, high-growth technology companies, or implementation/consulting environments is strongly preferred

  • Hands-on ERP experience (NetSuite, SAP, Workday, etc.), including requirements, configuration, data migration, and go-live

  • Strong understanding of core accounting workflows (close, reconciliations, ASC 606) and how they translate into systems

  • Customer-facing with strong communication and stakeholder management skills

  • Systems-minded with solid project management skills; able to run multiple workstreams

  • Comfortable in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and highly detail-oriented

  • Experience working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams

The expected base salary range for this role varies by location:

Tier A: $100,000 – $150,000
Tier B: $100,000 – $140,000
Tier C: $100,000 – $130,000

Your compensation tier is based on your primary work location. You can view Rillet’s compensation zones here.

Final compensation within the applicable range will depend on factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and the scope of the role. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits.

 

Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam.

Life at Rillet

  • Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.

  • Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.

  • Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.

  • Zone A • $100K – $150K • Offers Equity
  • Zone B • $100K – $140K • Offers Equity
  • Zone C • $100K – $130K • Offers Equity

jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
About Plane

Plane's mission is to build the infrastructure the world's work runs on. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together.

 

Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 55,000+ stars, 5,000+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship.

 

Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules.

 

Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work.

 

Humans and agents

We believe the next decade of work will be done by humans and AI agents together. Not agents replacing people, and not a chat window bolted onto software built for humans clicking around, but both working in one system of action, where an agent's work is as visible and as accountable as a person's.

 

Most software treats AI as a feature. We treat agents as a kind of worker, and that changes what the system underneath has to be. Agents are only as good as the context they can see and the state they are allowed to change, so shared context, explicit state, durable history, and accountable action are not items on our roadmap. They are the product. Plane is built so that when an agent acts, the humans responsible can see what happened, why, and on whose authority, and the record survives.

 

This is what the infrastructure is for: making the future where humans and agents work together useful, legible, and fully within the organization's control. Every role at Plane is some part of building that.

 

About the role

Our largest customers do not buy Plane off the shelf. A bank wants it behind their firewall with SSO tied to their identity provider; a defense contractor wants it air-gapped with a migration plan from three legacy tools at once. You will own the technical architecture for these deployments before the contract is signed and after, translating what a customer's infrastructure and compliance team requires into a Plane deployment that actually holds up. You will work directly with sales on the largest deals we run and with engineering when a customer's requirements push past what we support today. This role exists because our regulated-industry customers ask questions our sales team cannot answer alone, and our engineers should not have to answer on every call.

 

What you'll do

  • Own the technical architecture for enterprise and regulated-industry deployments, from the first discovery call through a signed statement of work.

  • Design self-hosted and air-gapped Plane deployments that satisfy a specific customer's security review, not a generic best-practice checklist.

  • Run technical discovery with customers whose infrastructure and compliance teams will pick apart every answer you give, and be right often enough that they trust the next one.

  • Define the migration path when a customer moves off two or three existing tools at once, including what data does not survive the move and saying so up front.

  • Work daily with sales on live deals and with engineering when a customer's requirements expose a real gap in the product, carrying that gap back as a specific, scoped request rather than a vague one.

  • Answer the same security questionnaire in a slightly different format for the fourth time this month, because every regulated buyer's procurement process is its own small bureaucracy and none of them read each other's paperwork.

 

What you'll bring

  • You have designed and defended a technical architecture to a skeptical buyer, and you can walk us through one deal where the customer's own security or infrastructure team changed your design.

  • You understand self-hosted and on-premises deployment beyond a docker-compose file, including networking, SSO and identity federation, and what changes when a customer runs the software instead of you.

  • You can read a security questionnaire or compliance requirement and translate it into an actual deployment decision, not a reassurance.

  • You are comfortable being the technical voice on a sales call, including the parts where the answer is no or not yet.

  • You write technical documentation a customer's own engineers will actually follow, because you will not be in the room when they run it.

 

Nice to haves

  • You have worked pre-sales or post-sales in a solutions architecture, sales engineering, or technical account management role selling to regulated industries.

  • You have contributed to Plane, run it self-hosted, or maintained another open project people rely on.

  • You have shipped or supported deployments into banking, defense, healthcare, or air-gapped environments specifically.

  • You have opinions about how AI agents should be permissioned and audited in an enterprise environment, and can defend them.

 

Tech

  • Backend: Python/Django, Golang, Node.js, Postgres, Redis

  • Messaging: RabbitMQ, Kafka

  • Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, Rancher, self-hosted deployment via Docker and Helm

  • Identity: SAML, OIDC, SCIM

  • Everyday tools: GitHub, Plane (yes, we run on it), Figma, Slack

Why Plane?

Every company says it is different. We will try evidence instead.

 

The scope is real. We are a passion team serving companies of every size, including some of the largest in the world. Something you ship this month will run inside a Fortune 500 company and a 50-person startup in the same week, and you will hear from both.

 

The constraints make you better. Plane runs in our cloud, in customers' clouds, and on machines that will never touch the internet. Much of the work happens in the open, where the issues, the fixes, and the roadmap conversations are public. Building software that survives all of that is harder than building an ordinary SaaS product, and it is a better education than most companies can offer.

 

The people-and-agents future is being built here, in production. We think humans and AI agents will share one system of action for work. We are building that system now, for customers who already depend on it, and you will work on that problem directly whatever your role.

 

Your name is on the work. The teams are deeply connected enough that credit and responsibility both find you fast. That is some pressure. Mostly it is the fun part.

If that sounds like your kind of place, we would like to meet you.

 

Plane is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Our stack

  • Backend — a microservice architecture in NestJS and TypeScript, with Python and FastAPI for the AI agent services.

  • Data — MongoDB Atlas and Redis.

  • Event-driven — services coordinate over Pub/Sub rather than calling each other directly.

  • Infra — Kubernetes on GCP (GKE), deployed via ArgoCD.

  • Frontend — Angular in an Nx monorepo.

 

How we build

Small, well-factored services with clear boundaries. Tests are written alongside the code, not after it — they're what lets us move quickly without breaking things that handle money. Trunk-based CI/CD: you ship to production and own it, with observability and clean rollbacks. Lean frameworks, readable code.

We work on a wide spectrum of technical challenges from money movement to operational logistics (scheduling, bookings, access) mediated over event-driven systems, to building around AI agents in production that are capable of executing autonomously under the hood.

 

What we're looking for

  • You've built and operated production backend systems that real users depended on. We care about the scope you've owned and how you owned it.

  • First Class or high 2:1 (or international equivalent) in Computer Science or a relevant technical field.

  • Fluency in at least one backend language and framework. You don't need to arrive fluent in our stack: we hire engineers who've built production systems with any robust framework — NestJS/TypeScript, Java/Spring Boot, Go, Kotlin, C#/.NET or Ruby on Rails — and can ramp into TypeScript fast.

  • System design: where a service boundary belongs, what a design trades away, how services coordinate — events, queues, retries that are safe to repeat — and how it holds up once it's live.

  • Fundamentals: concurrency, HTTP and API design, auth, data modelling and transactions (document or relational), changing a live schema safely, and what happens when a call fails.

  • Tests: you treat tests as part of shipping, you work comfortably in a shared trunk, and you can quickly understand a large codebase you didn't write.

How you work

jobs.description:
View our much better version of this job spec on our careers page: https://juro.notion.site/...

 

***

 

THE KEY BITS

 

  • Location: We can currently only accept applications from candidates that are located and have long-term working rights in the UK.

  • Flexibility: We operate a choice-first work approach that lets you work fully remotely from Day One even if you’re near our London office hub.

  • Salary: We benchmarked £90,000 + equity at IC4 level in our progression framework for someone based in the UK. If you like the look of the role but the salary doesn’t match what you’re looking for, let us know in the application.

  • Interviews: 3 stages totalling around 3 hours over 2-3 weeks. See FAQ for detail.

  • Start date: As soon as you can start.

  • Reporting to: Keith Reid, Head of Product

  • More info: The FAQ below, juro.com/careers, our handbook or ask ----- anything.

 
 

HELP US HELP THE WORLD AGREE FASTER

Juro has big ambitions: to become the go-to platform for agreeing and managing contracts globally. And we'll need help doing it.

Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity.

 

Signing a contract is the easy part. Everything before it (multiple parties, several legal documents, opposing interests, a redlining process most companies still run through email attachments) is where contracting actually gets hard.

That's the part of Juro you'll own. It's the most ambitious area of the product and the one with the most room to change how contracting feels for the people doing it day to day.

We're not handing you a blank page. There's a roadmap in place and a team ready to build it. We want you shipping against it while you're forming your own view of the problem, then tell us which parts of it were wrong.

Every PM at Juro is hired to make product bets that pay out. Great means that:

  1. the bets you own deliver real outcomes for customers quickly, and

  2. those outcomes show up in revenue.

What you're here to do:

  • Ship against the contract workflow roadmap in your first few weeks.

  • Get close to the problem rapidly. Talk to customers and prospects yourself. Form your own view of the jobs to be done rather than inheriting ours.

  • It's an agentic flow where "good redline" depends on the customer's playbook rather than any fixed answer, so a lot of the work is deciding what good means with customers and then holding engineering to it. It spans your team and our Agentic team, so some of what you own won't sit neatly in one place.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with engineering, design and GTM to turn all of that into something people actually enjoy using.

  • Measure whether any of it worked and be honest when it didn't. Iterate or pivot when necessary.

Six months in, success looks like customers telling us unprompted that contracting in Juro got a lot more delightful and reaching for it in places they used to reach for Word.

 

We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits and choice-first work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub.

 
 

WHO WE LOOK FOR

 

Research shows that while men apply to jobs if they meet ~60% of criteria, women and those in traditionally under-represented groups tend to apply only if they check all boxes. So if you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

 

To succeed here:

Every Juror finds their balance across our four core principles — we hire, develop and celebrate people who live them every day.

Curious how you’d fit? Try our personality quiz to see how you map against our principles.

On top of that, you have been part of a journey where:

  • You've landed in a domain you knew nothing about and were making judgment calls within weeks. Ideally more than once.

  • You've owned something complex and multi-quarter from discovery through launch and iteration + were accountable when it slipped.

  • You've built for users you got to know directly, not through Sales or Customer Success. That means you've sat with them, watched them work and can tell us what they taught you.

  • You've worked shoulder to shoulder with GTM and engineering through launches + have been the trusted go-to person for them in past companies.

  • You understand why evals matter and how agentic loops work.*

  • You run your own discovery. Customer calls, prospect calls, synthesising messy qualitative input into a clear view of what to build.

  • You've brought ideas unprompted and built them without waiting for permission. Something small shipped in days beats a perfect spec written in weeks.

Bonus if:

  • You've owned the quality of an agentic system in production.

  • Legal tech or contracting experience.

  • You've worked on collaboration or multiplayer editing tools.

*What we care about is that you will dig into how a system actually behaves when you need to: work out why a flow is producing rubbish, go back and forth with engineers until it isn't. You don't need to have done this full time.

This job likely isn’t for you if:

  • You need someone to teach you the domain before you can be useful.

  • You'd rather run the process than talk to customers.

  • You think of AI as something the engineers deal with.

  • You treat design as a service that receives your specs. Here you'd decide what to build alongside a designer, not hand it over.

  • You want a settled team and a clean remit. Our product org will change, and some of your scope will cut across other teams.

  • You'd want to spend your first quarter rewriting the roadmap before shipping any of it.

  • You've been managing PMs and want to carry on doing that. This is hands-on.

 
 

OUR MISSION

Juro exists to help the world agree faster by making it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts.

Frustrated by the absurdly slow process of taking a contract from inception through to agreement, Juro co-founders Richard and Pavel thought there must be a better way. They set out in 2016 to build a flexible, collaborative platform that anyone could use to process a legal contract end-to-end in their browser.

Fast forward 8 years and we have helped our customers process 2 million contracts in over 85 countries. Some of the world’s fastest-growing businesses, like Deliveroo, Remote, and Trustpilot have relied on Juro to help them streamline routine contracts at scale across multiple years of their growth.

But our story is just beginning.‍ Read more about our vision for intelligent contract automation.

TechTorch Data Practice

Data Architect

Architect end-to-end products on a solid data foundation, with AI as a force multiplier.

Data Practice | Remote (Global) | Senior

About the Practice

TechTorch's Data Practice sits at the intersection of enterprise data and applied AI. We design and build AI-native systems that don't just analyze the past — they actively drive decisions. Our work spans data infrastructure and pipelines, intelligent automation, and full-stack AI applications across industries.

We work the way the best client-delivery teams now operate: small teams, deep ownership, no hand-offs at boundaries. We take problems from a client whiteboard to production, and we let AI do the heavy lifting wherever it earns its place.

The Role

As a Data Architect, you will be responsible for designing, deploying, and governing modern data architectures that support enterprise-scale analytics, reporting, and operational use cases. You’ll define how data is stored, integrated, accessed, and secured across systems — aligning data strategy with business priorities.

You will collaborate with both business and technology stakeholders to design scalable and efficient data platforms, define data modeling standards, and enable seamless integration across the enterprise. Your work will ensure data integrity, security, and usability, serving as a foundation for advanced analytics and AI initiatives.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and maintain enterprise data architecture, including models, flow diagrams, and integration frameworks

  • Define and enforce architecture standards, governance models, and documentation practices

  • Design scalable, flexible solutions that align with modern data warehousing and cloud-native best practices

  • Drive the design and implementation of data integration pipelines and APIs across systems

  • Lead efforts in data modeling, database design, and architecture optimization

  • Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and developers to ensure architectural consistency and performance

  • Mentor and provide technical direction to engineers on the Data Practice team, including full-stack engineers building applications on top of the data foundation

  • Oversee data quality, lineage, and security strategies across the organization

  • Provide guidance on big data technologies, ETL platforms, and modern cloud ecosystems

  • Support strategic decisions through architectural reviews, proofs of concept, and solution roadmaps

Who You Are

We’re looking for high-caliber professionals who meet the following criteria:

  • 7+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, or related roles in complex environments

  • Demonstrated experience designing robust technical solutions for clients or customers

  • Experience serving as a technical lead - mentoring, coaching, and setting technical direction for data engineers, analysts, and other technical resources

  • Strong background in data modeling (conceptual, logical, physical), warehousing (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery), and database design

  • Familiarity with modern data transformation practices (e.g., dbt) and dimensional modeling patterns, including Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)

  • Proficient in data modeling tools (e.g., ER/Studio, Erwin) and relational/NoSQL databases (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle, MongoDB)

  • Fluent with AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) as production accelerators, with the credibility to evaluate and coach engineers on how they use them

  • Skilled in applying AI/ML to complex data challenges, including designing architectures for generative AI and RAG solutions, and automating data pipelines

  • Experience with CRM and/or ERP ecosystems (e.g., Salesforce, NetSuite) and analyzing data to uncover quality issues, identify revenue leakage and/or drive operational efficiency

  • Knowledge of modern cloud data stacks (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP)

  • Hands-on experience with ETL/integration tools (e.g., Talend, Informatica)

  • Familiarity with building and/or designing reporting solutions for business stakeholders (e.g., Power BI, Tableau)

  • Comfortable contributing to business development activities such as supporting proposals, scoping projects, and growing accounts

  • Strategic mindset with a focus on business value, scalability, and performance

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders

  • Adaptable, collaborative, and continuously improving in a fast-paced delivery environment

Our Values

Our values reflect the DNA of the private equity-backed companies we serve — focused on speed, ownership, accountability, and results:

  • Client First – We focus relentlessly on delivering outcomes that create value for our clients

  • We, Not Me – We win together. Collaboration drives transformation at scale

  • Get Stuff Done – We execute with speed and precision — because in PE, time matters

  • AI First – We embed AI at the core, enabling scalable, high-leverage solutions

  • Own It – We take accountability for results, delivering on what we promise

  • Agile Mindset – We adapt quickly and proactively seek better ways to move forward

What We Offer

  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with high-performance expectations and autonomy.

  • Semi-annual team offsites — we come together in person at least twice a year to connect, recharge, and do the work that's better face-to-face.

  • A team that takes AI tooling seriously and expects you to integrate it into your work.

  • High-autonomy, high-ownership work across the full arc of real client problems.

  • Access to the full modern data and AI stack — no one-tool shops.

  • Exposure to top-tier private equity firms and their portfolio companies.

The work spans client delivery and internal accelerator development. You map the problem, structure the solution, and own the outcome from end to end. AI coding agents are central to how we build — not a novelty, but the daily layer that lets a small team cover a lot of ground.

  • AI-paired engineering — uses an agentic coding tool (Claude Code, Cursor, or comparable) as a genuine daily workflow accelerator, and can speak concretely to how.

Ways of Working

  • Comfortable in client-facing delivery — can represent TechTorch technically and translate between business and engineering.

  • Customer-first mindset — anchors decisions in what the stakeholder is actually trying to accomplish, and can move fluidly between the engineer's view and the business owner's in the same conversation.

Nice to Have

Standout differentiator — Commercial data fluency: Experience evaluating how commercial data flows across CRM (ideally Salesforce) and ERP (ideally NetSuite) from opportunity to order to invoice, with the ability to diagnose, document, and resolve inconsistencies.

jobs.title: Senior Privacy Specialist
jobs.description:
About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

About the role

We're hiring a Senior Privacy Specialist to be our privacy presence in the UK and EU as Fireworks scales its European footprint. We've achieved ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 42001, and SOC 2 Type II, and we operate active UK GDPR, EU GDPR, and CCPA programs.

You'll be our senior privacy point of contact for the UK and EU - the person who fields supervisory authority correspondence and owns the operational processes that keep our UK GDPR, EU GDPR, and Data Protection Act 2018 obligations met. You'll report to our Privacy Lead and work as part of a small global privacy team, with real autonomy over the UK/EU side of the program.

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role, and an advisory one. You'll be the privacy judgment in the room for the UK and EU: the person engineers, sales, and legal come to before they ship, sign, or answer.

Who this role is for

We're building a privacy function that punches well above its headcount. That shapes who succeeds here:

  • You've operated and built under ambiguity. You're used to being the one who owns it, and you've built structures where none existed rather than inheriting someone else's.

  • You build systems, not queues. You've used AI tooling, automation platforms, scripting, or workflow engines to take manual privacy work off the table - and you're excited to do more of that utilizing cutting-edge technology.

  • You take a project and finish it. You don't need prescriptive instructions or hand-holding - you spot what's broken, scope it, own it until completion, and socialize it within the organization.

  • You take extreme ownership. When something in your area goes wrong, you own it, fix it, and make sure it can't happen the same way twice - without waiting to be asked and without pointing fingers.

What you'll do

  • Act as our senior privacy point of contact for the UK and EU: first line for the ICO and EU supervisory authorities, handling regulator correspondence and inquiries with support from our Privacy Lead and Legal.

  • Be the standing privacy advisor for the region: guidance to product, engineering, GTM, and Legal on what UK/EU law permits, where the grey areas are, and what risk you're recommending we accept.

  • Own UK/EU data subject rights outcomes: statutory deadlines, scope and exemption decisions, edge cases, and the regional record.

  • Own cross-border transfer compliance: UK IDTA and Addendum, EU SCCs, adequacy analysis, and Transfer Impact Assessments for vendors, sub-processors, and intra-group flows.

  • Lead breach assessment and notification for UK/EU: triage, 72-hour notification decisions, regulator and data subject communications, and post-incident follow-through with Security and Legal.

  • Embed privacy-by-design into how we build: review new products, features, models, and vendors for privacy risk, and give engineering and product teams guidance they can act on.

  • Partner with our AI governance work on privacy in model training, fine-tuning, and inference - data minimization, purpose limitation, customer data handling, and emerging EU AI Act obligations.

  • Keep the UK/EU privacy notice and policy library accurate, practical, and aligned to what we actually do and our regulatory obligations.

  • Take on additional privacy projects as the program evolves; we're a growing team with dynamic priorities.

How the role will grow

As the program matures and our European footprint expands, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Regional ownership - take on privacy for additional jurisdictions as we enter new markets, and shape our approach to emerging regimes.

  • Advisory reach - become the privacy voice in the highest-stakes decisions: new markets, new product categories, regulator engagement, and AI Act readiness.

  • Program ownership - take a hand in setting program direction, roadmap, and strategy.

What we're looking for

  • 5-7 years of experience in privacy or data protection, with meaningful time in a tech, SaaS, or cloud company.

  • Deep, hands-on working knowledge of UK GDPR, EU GDPR, and the Data Protection Act 2018 - you've been a key player in a program complying with these regimes, not just worked on a small portion of one.

  • Experience as the sole or primary privacy owner for a region, product, or company; you're comfortable without a large team around you.

  • Track record running DPIAs and DSARs hands-on, and advising product and engineering teams on privacy-by-design.

  • Direct experience with international transfer mechanisms (UK IDTA, SCCs, adequacy, TIAs) and the judgment to apply them to real vendor and architecture decisions.

  • Some exposure to a supervisory authority - whether as a DPO, deputy, or otherwise.

  • Excellent communication; you work confidently across engineering, legal, sales, and executive audiences, and you can turn regulatory requirements into clear guidance.

  • Comfort with low-code automation and LLM-based tooling - enough to specify, evaluate, and get hands-on with the systems that run your program.

  • Based in the EU/UK with the right to work in those geographies.

Nice to have

  • Privacy certifications (CIPP/E, CIPM, CIPT, FIP).

  • Experience with privacy tooling (OneTrust, TrustArc, Transcend, DataGrail, Securiti, or similar) - especially if you've pushed one past its out-of-the-box limits.

  • Exposure to ISO 42001, AI/ML data governance, model training data considerations, or the EU AI Act.

  • Experience standing up a privacy function in-region at a growth-stage company.

Why Fireworks?

  • Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

  • Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

  • Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

  • Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
The Role

 

We're hiring Product Designers to help shape how enterprises understand, govern, and trust their AI agents.

 

Geordie is building category-defining tooling for agent visibility, governance, and risk. The design challenge is real: AI agent behaviour is complex, often opaque, and the stakes for our customers are high.

 

Our design team is small today; you'll report into our Head of Product Design and join two Product Designers. We have three development teams, growing to five, and we believe design works best embedded. You'll join one of those teams as its designer, working alongside its engineers and customers every day. Because we're still early, you'll also help set the foundation everything else is built on: the design language, the component library, and the patterns we use across the product. Our design team also looks after Geordie's brand, so you'll help shape how we show up beyond the product too, making sure brand and product feel like one coherent experience.

 

Design here isn't a layer applied at the end. We ship multiple times a day, and we actively encourage designers to use AI agents to write code and get closer to the product. We don't have Product Managers; design and engineering partner directly to figure out what to build. Our engineers are deeply product-minded, close to customers, and want to solve the right problem rather than ship to spec. Together you'll define problems, shape scope, and own outcomes. If you've ever wanted to own something end to end, this is it.

 

We also move fast. We ship multiple times a day, and we actively encourage designers to use AI agents to write code and get closer to the product. If you've ever wanted to own something end to end, this is it.

 
 
 
 

What You'll Do

 

Own the end-to-end design of core product experiences, from early concept through to shipped and iterated.

 

Help build Geordie's design system with the rest of the design team; the tokens, components, patterns, and documentation that everyone relies on, shaped by what your team needs.

 

Contribute to Geordie's brand; helping evolve our visual language, illustration, and assets so the product and brand tell one story.

 

Lead customer discovery and research; running interviews, identifying patterns, and bringing customer insight into every design decision.

 

Work directly with customers to test your thinking early and close the loop between insight and shipped product.

 

Collaborate daily with engineers; pairing, reviewing, and increasingly using AI tools to prototype and contribute to the codebase yourself.

 

Contribute to product direction: you will be in the room where decisions are made, not handed a spec to execute.

 

Keep a strong point of view on what good design looks like in a security and governance product; clear, trustworthy, and built for expert users.

 
 
 

What We're Looking For

 

The most important thing is that you care deeply about customers and can move fast without losing quality. You are a strong practitioner; you can go from whiteboard to high-fidelity quickly, and you know when each is appropriate.

 

You are comfortable with ambiguity. We are Series A, the product is evolving, and the domain of AI agent governance is genuinely new. You find that energising, not unsettling.

 

You have strong opinions about design systems and component architecture, and experience building or significantly contributing to one. You can articulate why decisions were made and defend them clearly.

 

You work well in a collaborative engineering culture. You are comfortable pair-designing with engineers, reviewing pull requests for design quality, and using AI tools to accelerate your own work.

 
 

Requirements

 

Significant experience as a product designer, with a portfolio that demonstrates complex UX problem-solving; not just polished visuals.

 

Experience designing highly complex B2B SaaS products, including data visualisation and data-dense interfaces; you can turn large volumes of information into something expert users can understand and act on.

 

Proven ability to work across the full design process: research, concept, detailed design, and handoff.

 

Strong product thinking; you can define the problem, question the brief, and help decide what to build, not just how it should look.

 

Strong communication and collaboration skills; you can align stakeholders, present work with clarity, and receive feedback well.

 

Comfortable working in a fast-moving, iterative environment where requirements evolve quickly.

 
 
 

Nice to Haves

 

Experience designing for security, developer, or enterprise SaaS products.

 

Familiarity with AI agent tooling, observability platforms, or data-dense interfaces.

 

Experience contributing to a design system, including tokens, components, and documentation.

 

Experience working on brand or visual identity, such as illustration, iconography, or marketing design.

 

Experience writing code, even basic frontend, or using AI tools to prototype in the browser.

 

Background working at an early-stage startup where you built things from scratch.

 
 
 

Why This Role

 

AI agents are changing how companies operate, and the question of how to govern them safely is only going to grow. Geordie is building the platform enterprises rely on to answer that question.

 

You will join at a point where design is still being defined. There is no legacy system to work around, no established playbook to follow; just a hard problem, a sharp team, and a genuine opportunity to shape how a new category is understood.

 

You will work with real customers, see the impact of your work quickly, and have the scope to grow as the company does.

 
 

Our Values

 

Solve What Matters

 

We listen intently and stay focused on what truly matters to our customers. If it doesn't help them navigate real-world agentic adoption and risk, it's probably not worth building.

 

Build, Learn, Iterate

 

We favour momentum over perfection; testing, learning, and evolving through action. It's how we move fast and get better, together.

 

Kind, Not Comfortable

 

We're honest, respectful, and unafraid to challenge each other. We believe doing great work should feel good, too. Kindness makes that possible.

 

A Platform for Your Best Work

 

We want this to be the most meaningful chapter of your career. Geordie is the place where you grow, lead and lift others, while building something that truly matters.

Recognised on the 2025 Forbes Cloud 100 list, ClickHouse is one of the most innovative and fast-growing private cloud companies. The AI/ML Engineering team builds and operates ClickHouse's AI and machine learning products end-to-end. This includes the Agentic Data Stack, AI Functions, chDB, the in-Console copilot, and the AI/ML partnerships that distribute them — together with the shared components and expertise that let every other ClickHouse team ship AI in the surfaces they own. Our team is looking for highly skilled and experienced software engineers to join us, who will be responsible for designing, building, and operating the products that make ClickHouse the platform of choice for agents and data scientists.

 

What you will do

What you will bring along

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

jobs.title: Driftsingeniør bygg
jobs.description:
Avdeling bygg i Lindesnes kommune søker en faglig sterk og engasjert driftsingeniør. Avdelingen er en del av enhet Teknisk drift som er organisert i matrise og består av fem avdelinger:

  • Bygg
  • Vei og grønt
  • Vann og avløp
  • Plan og prosjekt
  • Renhold

Stillingen inngår i driftsteamet i avdeling bygg, og har ansvar for drift og vedlikehold av en omfattende bygningsmasse bestående av formålsbygg og boliger.
Som driftsingeniør vil du ha en sentral rolle i å støtte arbeidsledere og byggdriftere i det daglige arbeidet. Stillingen skal bidra til strukturert oppfølging av drift og vedlikehold, videreutvikle systematikk i arbeidet og sikre at bygninger og tekniske anlegg følges opp i henhold til lover, forskrifter og interne rutiner.

Driftsingeniøren vil arbeide tett med leder og ha en sentral rolle i utviklingen av kommunens tekniske drift. Stillingen skal være et faglig bindeledd mellom ledelse, arbeidsledere og den operative driften, og bidra til at systemer, rutiner og arbeidsprosesser fungerer godt i praksis. En viktig del av stillingen vil være dialog og samarbeid med brukere av byggene vi forvalter. Arbeidet skal sikre stabil drift og bidra til en dokumentert og forsvarlig teknisk tilstand, slik at byggene oppfyller gjeldende krav til sikkerhet, funksjonalitet og vedlikehold. Dette skal understøttes av systematisk tilstandsvurdering og oppdaterte vedlikeholdsplaner. Arbeidshverdagen er variert og preget av både planlegging og oppfølging i drift. Vi søker deg som arbeider strukturert, er tydelig i faglige vurderinger og som evner å samarbeide på tvers – både internt og med brukere – for å sikre gode og praktiske løsninger.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Bistå leder med faglige vurderinger, prioriteringer, planlegging og utvikling av driften.
  • Implementere og videreutvikle kommunens nye FDVU-system.
  • Strukturere, kvalitetssikre og videreutvikle teknisk dokumentasjon og FDV-data.
  • Utarbeide og videreutvikle vedlikeholdsplaner, driftsrutiner, årshjul og internkontroll.
  • Følge opp planlagte drifts- og vedlikeholdsoppgaver og bidra til gode prioriteringer.
  • Være en faglig støtte for arbeidsledere og byggdriftere og bidra til at rutiner og systemer fungerer godt ute i driften.
  • Følge opp nye og eksisterende bygg, herunder det nye helsehuset, med fokus på god og effektiv drift.
  • Bidra til digitalisering, standardisering og kontinuerlig forbedring av arbeidsprosesser.
  • Bidra til god ressursutnyttelse, driftssikkerhet og langsiktig vedlikeholdsplanlegging.
  • Bidra til at kommunens bygg forvaltes og driftes i samsvar med gjeldende lover, forskrifter og interne rutiner.
Kvalifikasjoner

Kvalifikasjonskrav:

  • Bachelor byggetekniske fag, som bygg, elektro, brann ol. 
  • Erfaring fra drift, vedlikehold eller forvaltning av bygg
  • God forståelse for tekniske anlegg og bygningsdrift
  • Erfaring med FDVU-systemer og digitale verktøy 
  • Kjennskap til regelverk innen bygg, HMS og internkontroll
  • Gode norskkunnskaper, skriftlig og muntlig
  • Førerkort klasse B
Personlige egenskaper
  • Strukturert og systematisk arbeidsform
  • Ansvarsbevisst, selvstendig og ha god gjennomføringsevne
  • Evne til å følge opp flere oppgaver samtidig
  • Gode samarbeidsevner og evne til å kommunisere på tvers av fagmiljøer
  • Serviceinnstilt og løsningsorientert 
  • Evne til å veilede og støtte kollegaer
  • Har gode praktiske ferdigheter
  • Tydelig, selvgående og ansvarsbevisst
  • Bidrar positivt til arbeidsmiljøet

Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt.

Vi tilbyr
  • En viktig rolle i drift og utvikling av kommunens bygningsmasse
  • Et faglig sterkt miljø med gode samarbeidspartnere
  • Et inkluderende og godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Lønn etter avtale
