jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description:
Job Description

As a key member of our team, you'll design, develop, and maintain backend solutions for our Stores. Working in an agile environment, you'll collaborate with product managers, business and frontend engineers to deliver high-quality, scalable software, driving initiatives from problem definition through rollout. The ideal candidate is passionate about backend development, has a track record of driving technical initiatives and making the team around them better, proficient in C# and .Net



WHAT YOU’LL DO

In addition to the above, your role will involve:

    Technical Leadership & Ownership: Taking end-to-end ownership of key initiatives — from architecture and design through delivery — setting technical directions and making the trade-off calls that keep the team moving.
    Mentorship & Force Multiplication: Actively raising the technical level of the team through code reviews, pairing, and design discussions; unblocking colleagues and making the people around you more effective, not just shipping your own code.
    API Design: Shaping the design and implementation of APIs that facilitate seamless communication between the Mobile Application and backend, ensuring an efficient flow of data in the headless ecommerce environment.
    Azure Cloud: Leveraging your expertise in Azure Cloud services to enhance the scalability, reliability, and performance of our backend systems, ensuring a seamless integration with our headless ecommerce applications.



WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

At Store Lens, we work closely with Portfolio Brands and H&M Brand to design and provide technical solutions. We contribute to product development at every stage, from setting requirements to rollout and testing. From day one, we focus on improving by listening, building, and refining as we go. Even as we define requirements, we are already thinking ahead, using early designs, first developments, and new learnings to continuously make the product better.

We are curious, active listeners and hands-on doers.

Beyond your work with Store Lens, you will also be part of our Engineering/QA community, where you will have access to a network of experts, resources, and opportunities to grow.



WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for people with…

    Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience), and at least 5-8 years of experience as a Software Engineer with backend focus, including demonstrated experience leading technical initiatives, mentoring engineers, or acting as a technical lead on a team.
    Proficiency in C# and .NET.
    Proficiency in Azure concepts and native development using Azure functions.
    Experience in concept as Always up and message queuing.
    Experience of CI/ CD pipelines using Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions.
    Experience of containerization technologies like Kubernetes and Docker.
    Experience in Database (e.g. Cosmos Db).
    Experience in POS, Payment and Checkout area is a plus.
    Experience in SignalR is a plus.

And people who have:

    Continuous learning mindset to stay updated on emerging trends and technologies.
    Ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment and communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail A track record of conducting code reviews, identifying areas of improvement, and providing constructive feedback to maintain code quality and consistency across a team, not just their own work.
    Familiarity in backend testing with a focus on ensuring the reliability and performance of backend systems.
    Familiarity with Agile development.
    Comfort operating with ambiguity — able to take a loosely defined problem and shape it into a concrete technical plan.
    Excellent communication and collaboration skills.



WHO WE ARE

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.



WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE



We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, which is usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.



JOIN US

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

jobs.title: Yhdistelmäajoneuvonkuljettaja (Parola)
jobs.description:
Haemme yhdistelmäajoneuvonkuljettajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Parolaan!

Etsitkö monipuolista kuljettajan työtä, jossa päivät eivät toista itseään? Tässä tehtävässä pääset yhdistämään ajotyön ja käytännön tekemisen osana vakavaraisen alan yrityksen toimintaa.

Työssäsi kuljetat raskaan kaluston renkaita asiakkaille sekä noudat pinnoitettavia renkaita takaisin käsiteltäväksi. Lähtöpiste sijaitsee Parolassa, josta kuormat lastataan pääsääntöisesti lastauslaiturilta lastaajan avustuksella. Asiakaskohteissa työ on usein omatoimisempaa – renkaita puretaan pumppukärryn avulla, ja noudettavat renkaat voivat sijaita esimerkiksi piha-alueilla, halleissa tai varastoissa. Renkaat painavat noin 50 kg kappaleelta, joten työ edellyttää hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja reipasta työotetta.

Työ sisältää reissutyötä noin 2–3 päivänä viikossa. Yöpymisiä tulee säännöllisesti arkipäivinä, mutta viikonlopputyötä tehdään vain poikkeustapauksissa.

Toivomme sinulta

- CE-ajokorttia ja voimassa olevaa ammattipätevyyttä.

- Kokemusta yhdistelmäajoneuvon kuljettamisesta.

- Hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja valmiutta osallistua myös kuormien käsittelyyn.

- Itsenäistä työotetta, vastuullisuutta ja asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä.

- Tarjoamme sinulle

- Vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työn (40 h/viikko).


TES mukaisen palkan.

Varmat tunnit myös hiljaisempina jaksoina. Mikäli ajoa on tilapäisesti vähemmän, työaikaa täydennetään esimerkiksi varastotehtävillä – työtunnit eivät vähene.

Monipuolisen työn, jossa yhdistyvät ajaminen, asiakaskohtaamiset ja käytännön tekeminen.

Perehdytyksen sekä mukavan työyhteisön.

Jos viihdyt ratin takana, et kaihda fyysistä työtä ja arvostat vakituista työpaikkaa luotettavan työnantajan palveluksessa, tämä tehtävä voi olla juuri sinua varten. Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV mahdollisimman pian, sillä käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Sähköpostimme ovat muotoa etunimi.sukunimi@click-hp.fi. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Jan Kollin, Click Henkilöstöpalvelut, arkisin klo 9–16, puh. 050 411 0390.

jobs.title: HR-assistent
jobs.employer: HOCHTIEF Infrastructure GmbH Tyskland Sverige     Filial
jobs.description:
HR-Assistant

OL31 Rail Project, Vagnhärad, Sweden

Shape the future of Swedish infrastructure

HOCHTIEF is one of the world's leading infrastructure and construction groups, employing approximately 38,000 people worldwide. We deliver complex projects across a wide range of sectors, including roads, bridges, tunnels, railways, airports, ports, buildings, and both conventional and renewable energy. With operations across Europe, North America, and the Asia-Pacific region, HOCHTIEF combines engineering expertise with innovative and sustainable solutions to shape the infrastructure of the future.

We are currently looking for a collaborative HR Assistant to join the OL31 railway project in Vagnhärad. This is a role within one of Sweden's most important infrastructure projects, where safety, coordination and collaboration are critical to success.

About the Project

The OL31 Project forms part of the Ostlänken programme, one of Sweden's largest and most important railway infrastructure investments. Ostlänken is a new approximately 160-kilometre double-track railway connecting Järna and Linköping, designed to increase capacity, improve regional connectivity and support sustainable transport across Sweden.

The project involves complex civil engineering works, including tunnels, bridges, earthworks and rail infrastructure. Working on OL31 offers the opportunity to contribute to a landmark infrastructure programme while supporting the recruitment and development of a diverse, international project organization

About the Role

We are currently looking for a HR Assistant to join the OL31 railway project in Vagnhärad.

As an HR Assistant, you will support the HR function and managers with a wide range of administrative and operational HR tasks. This role is ideal for someone who is communicative, structured, service-minded, and enjoys working in a fast-paced project environment where attention to detail and good organization are essential.

You will play an important role in supporting onboarding activities, personnel administration, recruitment coordination, time reporting processes, and various employee-related matters across the project organization.

Key Responsibilities

    Support the HR department with daily administrative and operational HR activities.
    Maintain and update employee information and personnel records in various systems.
    Support recruitment activities, including interview scheduling, candidate communication, onboarding coordination, and collection of employment documentation.
    Assist with onboarding and offboarding processes.
    Act as a contact person for apartment providers and support accommodation administration for project employees.
    Support the administration and coordination of company vehicles and employee benefits.
    Collect, follow up, and compile time reporting documentation for the project.
    Manage ID06 card applications and follow up throughout the process.
    Provide administrative support to the HR team and Office Manager.
    Support and contribute to maintaining efficient processes and good internal service.

Your Profile

Mandatory Requirements

    Previous experience in administrative, HR Assistant, Coordinator, Recruitment, Personnel Administration, or support role.
    Experience working with onboarding processes, employee documentation, and general administrative follow-up.
    Strong administrative and organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
    Good understanding of administrative processes and the importance of structure, accuracy, and confidentiality.
    Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
    Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook, Excel, Word, and Teams.
    Comfortable working with different digital systems, time reporting systems, and new technologies.
    Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
    Service-oriented mindset and ability to work independently.
    Full-time availability on site in Vagnhärad.

Preferred Qualifications

    Experience working in an international project or matrix organization.
    Experience supporting recruitment activities and onboarding of new employees.
    Experience with personnel administration and HR-related documentation.
    Familiarity with ID06 administration and Swedish construction industry requirements.
    Experience with time reporting systems and administrative follow-up within project-based organizations.
    Experience from construction, infrastructure, engineering, or similar industries is considered an advantage.

Language Requirements

Fluent Swedish, preferably native-level or equivalent proficiency.

Professional English language skills, both written and spoken.

We Offer

    The opportunity to work on one of Sweden's largest and most complex infrastructure projects.
    An international working environment within a leading global construction company.
    Long-term project involvement with significant responsibility and influence.
    The chance to contribute to the development of critical rail infrastructure in Sweden.

Location

Vagnhärad, Sweden

Apply

If you have the qualifications, experience, and passion for creating a safe and successful construction environment, we would love to hear from you.

Get in touch with Nicole Granlund nicole.granlund@hochtief.se,

or apply directly at: https://hochtief.se/karriar/

Join HOCHTIEF and help build the infrastructure of tomorrow.

jobs.title: Gruppledare till Securitas Sala
jobs.description:
Företagsbeskrivning

Som landets största arbetsgivare i vår bransch kan vi erbjuda dig utvecklingsmöjligheter och variation som få andra företag kan. Vi strävar efter ett enhetligt ledarskap med balans mellan förväntningar och förutsättningar. Tillsammans hjälps vi åt att bygga högpresterande och engagerade team genom mångfald och inkludering. Som en nyckelperson hos oss har du möjligheten att skapa en balanserad och positiv kultur där medarbetarna får ta plats och coachas till att prestera på toppen av sin förmåga.

Securitas Sverige krigsplacerar sin personal. Detta innebär i korthet att du som anställd kommer, i händelse av krig, ha kvar din anställning och arbetsledas av Securitas.

Om rollen

Vill du göra skillnad i en roll där trygghet, samarbete och utveckling står i fokus?

Som gruppledare på Securitas får du vara med och skapa starka team, där ditt engagemang och din förmåga att leda med omtanke och tydlighet gör verklig skillnad – både för dina kollegor och våra kunder. Du har en samordnande funktion och är helt enkelt knuten som håller ihop kundens kontaktpersoner med din egen arbetsledning och kollegorna omkring dig.

Hos oss är ledarskap mer än att styra – det handlar om att inspirera, stötta och bygga tillit. Genom nära dialog med både medarbetare och kunder får du vara med och forma en trygg och hållbar arbetsmiljö där alla trivs och utvecklas.

Som skyddsvakt har du en avgörande roll i att upprätthålla säkerheten för verksamheter som är viktiga för Sverige. Du arbetar med utökade befogenheter, i nära samarbete med en av våra uppdragsgivare där du kommer vara stationerad. Du kommer att behöva fatta egna beslut i skarpa lägen, ha god uthållighet och ett stabilt omdöme. Därför söker vi en person som har förmågan att behålla lugnet när andra inte gör det – och är lojal mot de svenska intressena.

I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

    Leda och planera det dagliga arbetet för våra stationära och ronderande uppdrag på ett strukturerat och inkluderande sätt
    Vara delaktig i bemanningsoptimering
    Vara den lokala länken mellan kund och kollegor och säkerställa rätt insats utifrån uppdraget
    Se till att våra policys följs och att vi tillsammans upprätthåller hög kvalitet i vårt arbete

Vi söker dig som trivs med att ha en positiv påverkan på andra, och som vill utvecklas i en roll med både självständighet och stark lagkänsla. Du är trygg i dig själv, har lätt för att samarbeta och vill vara en del av en arbetsplats där vi stöttar varandra och delar vardagens utmaningar.

Hos oss är alla välkomna – vi vet att mångfald stärker oss som team och gör oss bättre i vårt uppdrag.

Kravspecifikation

För att vara aktuell för rollen ser vi att du uppfyller följande krav:

    Du är utbildad skyddsvakt
    Har yrkeserfarenhet från säkerhetsbranschen
    Har godkända betyg i svenska från första året i gymnasiet
    Svenskt medborgarskap
    B-körkort

Meriterande om du:

    har arbetat med liknande arbetsuppgifter tidigare
    har erfarenhet av arbetsledning
    har en giltig väktarutbildning
    har en ledarskapsutbildning (ex. Gruppledarutbildning)
    har erfarenhet från våra stödsystem (ex Tools, GSP)

Vi lägger stor vikt vid din personliga lämplighet för en ledande funktion.

Vad vi erbjuder

Vi är ett globalt företag med lokalt hjärta. Här får du möjlighet att påverka ditt närområde, växa och vara en viktig del i att skapa trygghet – för både dina medarbetare och samhället i stort.

Vi tror på balans mellan arbete och privatliv, på kompetensutveckling och på att olika bakgrunder och erfarenheter gör oss starkare. Vi värnar om mångfald och att spegla samhället via våra medarbetare - så för oss spelar det ingen roll vilken ålder, kön eller bakgrund du har. Är du rätt person för uppdraget ser vi fram emot att välkomna dig att bli en del av oss!  



Säkerhetsprövning

Observera att tjänsten är placerad i säkerhetsklass och innebär att du kommer att genomgå en säkerhetsprövning enligt Säkerhetsskyddslag (2018:585). För att utreda och bedöma om du uppfyller kraven för att bli godkänd enligt gällande regelverk kommer det genomföras säkerhetssamtal, bakgrundskontroll och registerkontroll. Bedömningen syftar till att utreda laglydnad, lämplighet, pålitlighet, lojalitet samt eventuella sårbarheter enligt Säkerhetspolisens föreskrifter och vägledningar. Uppgifter som inhämtas kan ex. komma från dig själv, öppna källor eller myndigheter. Vi tillämpar en helhetsbedömning om dig, din livssituation samt ekonomiska förhållanden vid prövning av din lämplighet.

I förekommande fall kan motsvarande kontroll göras av den som du sammanbor med, eller har en liknande relation med.

För att bli aktuell för tjänsten krävs därför (som lägst) att;

    Du/ni inte förekommer i Polismyndighetens olika register, ex misstankeregister, belastningsregister, osv.
    Du/ni har ordnad ekonomi; inte har betalningsanmärkningar, oreglerade skulder, förekommer hos inkassoföretag eller Kronofogden

Ytterligare information

Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vårt rekryteringsverktyg.

Har du frågor kring rollen eller rekryteringsprocessen är du välkommen att höra av dig till rekryterande chef: rickard.rasmussen@securitas.se, alternativt till veera.peippo@securitas.se vid rekryteringsrelaterade frågor.

    Tjänsten är på heltid dag med tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Vi tillämpar 6mån provanställning.
    Vi arbetar med urvalstester
    Vi kommunicerar i första hand via mail
    Sista ansökningsdag är 6 november 2026

För anställning inom Securitas Sverige AB krävs det att du har godkända betyg från första året i gymnasiet i svenska samt blir godkänd av Länsstyrelsen för anställning i auktoriserat bevakningsföretag enligt Lag (1974:191) om bevakningsföretag (den ansökan görs av Securitas).  Beroende på befattning kan även säkerhetsprövning enligt Säkerhetsskyddslag (2018:585) bli aktuell. För att utreda och bedöma om du uppfyller kraven för att bli godkänd enligt respektive författning sker en bakgrundskontroll. Bedömningen avser laglydnad, lämplighet, pålitlighet, lojalitet samt eventuella sårbarheter. Uppgifter som inhämtas kan ex. komma från dig själv, öppna källor eller myndigheter. Vi tillämpar en helhetsbedömning vid prövning av lämplighet för respektive befattning.

För de flesta roller krävs även B-körkort.

Lön och anställningsförhållanden baseras på kollektivavtal mellan arbetsgivarorganisationen Säkerhetsföretagen och Svenska Transportarbetareförbundet.

Mer info om Securitas som arbetsgivare och vår rekryteringsprocess hittar du på securitas.se

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Senior Developer to support the Green Energy Transition
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced software developer with a passion for building high-quality applications? Do you enjoy solving complex technical challenges and working closely with business experts to create solutions that support the efficient, reliable, and secure operation of the Nordic power grid? If you are looking to make an impact in supporting the green transition of the energy sector across Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark, you might be the person we are looking for.  

Join a fast-developing Nordic company and become a part of an agile environment where we develop innovative solutions. Nordic RCC is an important contributor to the green energy transition, supporting the Nordic transmission system operators in ensuring efficient and secure operations of the Nordic electricity power system.  

As part of our continued growth, Application Development is expanding significantly. We are strengthening our department with five Senior Developers and two Lead Developers, creating exciting opportunities to join a growing team and help shape the future of software development at Nordic RCC. 

Your role   

As a Senior Developer in Application Development, you will join a collaborative team of approximately 23 developers. Together, you will design, develop, and maintain internal applications that support our current and future business services. Working closely with product owners, architects, engineers, operators, and UX specialists, you will help translate business needs into robust technical solutions. 

You will be part of an application team that values sustainable solutions over quick fixes. We actively collaborate across applications and business services to identify common solutions, increase quality, and continuously improve the way we work. 

What you will do:

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust applications using C# and .NET. 

  • Write clean, maintainable, testable, and well-documented code following established design patterns and development standards. 

  • Transform complex engineering and operational requirements into effective software solutions by collaborating closely with architects, product owners, engineers, operators, and UX designers to build solutions that meet business and operational needs. 

  • Contribute to technical improvements, modernization efforts, and continuous optimization of existing applications. 

  • Participate in code reviews and help ensure high quality, reliability, and maintainability across solutions. 

  • Support troubleshooting and resolution of production issues. 

  • Serve as a technical role model within the team and mentor colleagues who are developing their technical skills. 

  • Stay current with new technologies, tools, and development practices relevant to Nordic RCC's technology landscape. 

Technology Stack:

  • Primary languages and frameworks  
    C#, .NET, SolidJS, JavaScript/TypeScript, Functional programming, Python  

  • Architecture, design patterns & integrations  
    Clean Architecture, SOLID, Event-driven Architecture, Message-driven Architecture, REST APIs 

  • Databases & Storage 
    Relational databases (SQL Server), NoSQL databases (MongoDB), GridFS, S3 

  • Infrastructure & Platform (on-prem)  
    Kubernetes (on-prem), Docker, Rancher, Prometheus/Grafana, ArgoCD, NginX  

  • Tooling and collaboration  
    Git, Visual Studio, VS Code, JetBrains Rider, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines 

We’re looking for someone with:  

  • Collaborative Mindset: You work closely with Application Architects, Product Owners, and fellow developers, contributing technical expertise, mentoring colleagues, and helping to ensure maintainable, scalable, and robust solutions. 

  • Technical Foundation: A degree in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, or a related field. 

  • Relevant Expertise: Experience developing enterprise-grade applications in C#/.NET, with a solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and modern development practices. 

  • Continuous Improvement: You identify opportunities to improve code quality, system reliability, team practices, and developer productivity. 

  • Nice to have: Experience working with functional programming, Clean Architecture principles, Azure DevOps, Kubernetes and Scrum processes.  

  • Energy Sector Knowledge: Familiarity with the power systems domain is a plus but not required.  

 
If you do not tick all the boxes, but think you could be a good match, don’t hesitate to apply for this position.   

What We Offer: A Flexible and Inclusive Workplace  

You will join a diverse organization of 23 nationalities, where inclusivity is celebrated, with more than 30% women on board (and a commitment to improving this balance). We are located in Copenhagen Towers office in Ørestad, with the flexibility to balance on-site and remote work 2 days a week.  

At Nordic RCC, we live by the values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency—values defined by our employees that shape how we collaborate and innovate. If you see yourself thriving in such an environment, we’d love to hear from you.  

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.   

Application deadline and contact information  

Please apply online (in English) no later than 15/11-2026. Interviews will be held on a rolling basis up until the right candidate has been found.  

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.  

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system. 

If you have any questions, please contact Pernille Yde Juul Hansen, Manager, Application Development pyh@nordic-rcc.net / +45 3092 3111

jobs.title: Doktorand i teknik och samhälle om rättsligt lärande och tillsynskompetens
jobs.description:
Lunds universitet grundades 1666 och rankas återkommande som ett av världens främsta lärosäten. Här finns omkring 46 000 studenter och 8 500 medarbetare i Lund, Helsingborg och Malmö. Vi förenas i vår strävan att förstå, förklara och förbättra vår värld och människors villkor.

Lunds universitet välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund och erfarenheter. Jämställdhet, lika villkor och mångfald är grundläggande principer för alla delar av vår verksamhet.

Beskrivning av verksamheten

Denna doktorandanställning ingår i REGULAIRE, ett europeiskt doktorandnätverk inom MSCA (Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions) som studerar hur reglering kan lära sig och anpassa sig i situationer där teknologier, risker och förväntningar förändras snabbt. Nätverket kommer att utbilda 15 doktorander som ska undersöka denna lärandeprocess ur olika perspektiv. De kommer att studera hur myndigheter identifierar tidiga signaler, utformar och testar insatser, utvärderar vad som fungerar samt delar resultat mellan organisationer.

REGULAIRE står för Regulatory Learning for the Governance of Transformative Technologies, och konsortiet leds av Tekniska universitetet i München (TUM). Samarbetet omfattar tekniska universitet, handelshögskolor, forskare inom samhällsvetenskap och juridik samt aktörer inom offentlig sektor.

Denna utlysning avser en doktorandanställning vid LTH, Lunds universitet. Forskningsmiljön vid LTH i Lund, som leds av Stefan Larsson, fokuserar på samhällsvetenskapligt orienterade men tvärvetenskapliga frågor kopplade till artificiell intelligens (AI), med anknutna forskare på både junior och senior nivå. Forskargruppen har sitt kontor på LTH:s campus och tillhör Institutionen för teknik och samhälle. Läs mer om forskargruppen i Lunds universitets forskningsportal.

Att vara doktorand

Som doktorand är du både antagen som student och anställd vid Lunds universitet.

Som forskarstuderande tränas du i ett vetenskapligt förhållningssätt. Det kan kort beskrivas som att du får övning i att tänka kritiskt och analytiskt, att du får lösa problem självständigt med hjälp av rätt metodval och du får en forskningsetisk medvetenhet. Dessutom ges möjlighet för dig som doktorand att arbeta med projekt, att utveckla dina ledaregenskaper och din pedagogiska förmåga. Under hela din studietid guidas du av handledare. Forskarstudierna avslutas med en avhandling och doktorsexamen.

Mer om att vara doktorand vid LTH på lth.se.

Ämnes- och projektbeskrivning

Forskarutbildningsämnet teknik och samhälle omfattar fler- och tvärvetenskapliga studier om teknikens roll, samspel, reglering och betydelse för samhällets olika delar. Forskningen innefattar både kvalitativa och kvantitativa studier, och kännetecknas ofta av en mångfald av metoder och teorier.

Regulatorisk eller rättslig flexibilitet kan bistå lagstiftningen att hålla jämna steg med snabbt framväxande teknologier, men samtidigt riskerar den utmana lagstiftningens förutsägbarhet. Detta doktorandprojekt undersöker hur dessa två sidor möts genom att analysera om, eller på vilket sätt, som flexibilitetsmekanismer, delegeringar, skyldigheter och uppförandekoder påverkar framförallt tillsynsmyndigheter i deras roll och relation till bl.a. lagstiftare, EU-kommissionen, eller andra relevanta aktörer.

Arbetsuppgifter

Du kommer framförallt att ägna dig åt din forskarutbildning, vilket innefattar såväl deltagande i forskningsprojekt som forskarutbildningskurser, seminarier och konferenser.

Du kommer att kartlägga tillsynsmyndigheters kompetens, organisation och metoder i utvalda jurisdiktioner, med AI-förordningen (AI Act) som utgångspunkt för jämförelsen. Genom dokumentanalyser, intervjuer och processpårning kommer du att undersöka hur beslut om utformning påverkar förutsägbarheten för företag och skyddet för medborgare.

Ur ett kritiskt perspektiv kommer arbetet att analysera flexibilitetsmekanismer och deras implikationer för styrning och tillsyn. Det kan ta sin utgångspunkt i tillsynspraxis och jämförande fallstudier samt bidra till ett ramverk för att bedöma tillsynskapacitet. Projektet kommer även att sträva efter att omsätta forskningsresultaten i vägledning om hur regulatorisk flexibilitet kan förenas med framsynthet utan att den rättsliga förutsägbarheten urholkas. Projektet erbjuder en fokuserad ingång till forskning relaterad till rätt och samhälle, styrning av AI samt studiet av teknikorienterad tillsyn.

Anställningen omfattar även en tre månader lång sektorsöverskridande utstationering i ett annat land.

Arbetsuppgifterna innefattar:

    Förfina forskningsfrågorna och forskningsdesignen tillsammans med handledargruppen samt ta fram underlag för etikprövning, datahantering och öppen vetenskap.
    Samla in, hantera och analysera forskningsdata med hjälp av de metoder som har godkänts för projektet.
    Färdigställa en doktorsavhandling samt relaterade forskningsresultat inom ramen för forskarutbildningen och REGULAIRE:s forskningsplan.
    Delta i lokala och nätverksövergripande utbildningsinsatser, doktorandaktiviteter, nätverksutvärderingar, spridning av forskningsresultat och samverkan med praktiker. Detta inkluderar tre sommarskolor med internat samt månatliga seminarier för utveckling och diskussion av forskningsartiklar.
    Genomföra den planerade tre månader långa sektorsöverskridande utstationeringen hos en partnerorganisation inom REGULAIRE-nätverket.
    I arbetsuppgifterna kan det även komma att ingå medverkan i undervisning och annat institutionsarbete (dock max 20 % av arbetstiden).

Kvalifikationer

För att kunna antas och anställas som doktorand behöver du uppfylla kraven nedan.

Behörighetskrav

Grundläggande behörighet till utbildning på forskarnivå uppfyller du som har:

    avlagd examen på avancerad nivå eller
    fullgjorda kursfordringar om minst 240 högskolepoäng, varav minst 60 högskolepoäng på avancerad nivå eller
    på något annat sätt förvärvat i huvudsak motsvarande kunskaper.

Särskild behörighet för Teknik och samhälle uppfyller du som har:

    30 högskolepoäng på avancerad nivå med relevans för ämnesområdet.

Läs annonsen i sin helhet på rekryteringsplattformen Varbi där du också ansöker.

jobs.title: Flexible Brand Ambassador, London Stations (Commission Based)
jobs.description:
💙 About Bounce...

Bounce is building cloud storage for the physical world, starting with the largest global luggage storage network in existence. Bounce’s marketplace connects travelers with 30,000+ small business locations worldwide for hyper-local short term baggage storage. With more locations globally than Burger King, and more locations in New York City than Starbucks, Bounce has served 3M+ users and stored 10M+ bags, and paid over $10M to small business partners.

To achieve this, Bounce is a fast-paced and scrappy team. We believe that experimentation fuels innovation, so we move quickly, testing new ideas and adapting in real time. If you’re ready to make an impact in a high-energy, close-knit, and collaborative environment - Bounce is the place where you can move fast, think big, and shape the future of travel. Join us as we make the world a lighter, more accessible place! Bounce has been named the Inc5000’s fastest-growing travel company in the USA in 2024 and is proudly backed by leading Silicon Valley investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, General Catalyst, and Sapphire. (Learn more about Bounce's Series B HERE and also learn about our Japan Expansion HERE)

About the role...

Travellers drag their bags around London all day because they don't know there's another option. Bounce is looking for four Scouts/ Brand Ambassadors, two at King's Cross and two at Victoria, to tell them that option exists.

Bounce is the world's largest luggage storage network, with hundreds of locations in London and over 1.1 million bags stored in the city alone. Travellers book on their phone, drop their bags at a local shop or hotel, and get on with their day.

This is a self-employed, commission-only role. You earn 40% of the storage value of every booking that comes through your code, and you keep it whether or not the customer uses the discount. For example:

What an hour could look like (illustrative, not guaranteed):

  • You speak to around 30 travellers

  • 5 of them book (about 1 in 6)

  • The average booking is three bags for the day, which earns you £5.40

  • 5 bookings × £5.40 = £27 for the hour

Where you come in…

  • Positioned around King's Cross or Victoria station and talk to travellers who are dragging suitcases around London

  • Wear Bounce branded gear with your own QR code on it: travellers scan it, book a spot and get 10% off

  • Find people with bags, help them get rid of them for the day, and get paid for it

  • Decide when you go out and for how long, with no fixed schedule or minimum commitment

  • Get set up with your own referral code, QR code, payout account and Bounce branded kit

  • Start with a briefing on what to say, which spots work, and what to steer clear of

  • Get commission paid out through our affiliate system, straight to your bank

Your profile…

  • You're happy starting conversations with strangers all day

  • You're warm and quick on your feet, and travellers trust you inside five seconds

  • Confident English. A second language is a real advantage, especially Spanish, Italian, French, Arabic or Mandarin

  • Right to work in the UK, registered as self-employed or happy to register

  • Self-motivated. Nobody is standing over you, so what you earn is down to what you put in

  • Bonus experience, not a requirement: street sales, promotion, fundraising or tour guiding experience

  • Good to know: this is a self-employed, commission-only arrangement, not employment.

jobs.title: Screening and Escalations Senior Payment Analyst
jobs.description:
Trust unlocks our greatest potential.

For decades, the clearing of payments remained unchanged and unchallenged. We asked, what if there was a better way? What if we could make banking infrastructure faster, safer, more reliable, and easier to access for all? Here is where you can think radically and responsibly to find the best solution.

What happens when you know you’re inherently trusted? Trust creates safety. Safety encourages you to be brave, to challenge, to fail, to try new things and to execute. At ClearBank everything revolves around trust. We’re not expected to earn it, but we are expected not to break it. We’re trusted to own it. To solve issues in the moment. To know a good risk when we see one, and the judgement to know that ‘can’ doesn’t always mean you ‘should’.

What you can expect:

ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank.

If that excites you, how about joining our 1st line Financial Crime Operations team as a Screening and Escalations Senior Payment Analyst? Reporting into the Senior Manager, FCO Screening & Escalations you will be responsible for the oversight and investigation system-generated payment screening alerts. You’ll act as a subject matter expert for payment screening across our client base. You’ll also have an excellent understanding of financial crime typologies and detection methods and share this knowledge with Analysts within the team.

This role is critical in ensuring our compliance with anti-money laundering (AML) regulations and protecting the integrity of our financial systems. You’ll be raising concerns and providing ideas, engaging with clients, and making informed decisions with your sound knowledge of payment services; excellent technical and regulatory knowledge across financial crime and sanctions within the UK and EEA, including reporting requirements, and you’ll have a firm understanding of how to identify and mitigate risks within a business.

Your role includes:

  • Assessing internal and external intelligence to identify financial crime risk and escalate as appropriate. Where relevant you will raise internal Suspicious Activity Reports (iSARs)

  • Ensuring all investigations and processes comply with relevant AML laws and regulations

  • Acting as a first point of escalation for Payment Screening Analysts

  • Managing escalations and senior management conversations in both first and second lines of defence

  • Allocating tasks, assisting in oversight and prioritisation to ensure any deadlines are met

  • Staying up to date on the latest AML trends, emerging typologies and best practices to enhance the effectiveness of our screening systems

  • Following ClearBank procedures & standards, raising and escalating relevant reports where required to ensure compliance with relevant AML laws and regulation

  • Solid and demonstrated experience in AML, financial crime investigations, or a related field

  • Strong knowledge across all forms of sanctions typologies e.g. Trade Sanctions, dual use goods, Personal and Professional enablers, payments involving complex structures

  • Good knowledge of sectors such as money remittance, electronic money, and cryptocurrency firms would be beneficial

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate and negotiate with key/senior stakeholders

  • Familiarity with screening and monitoring software/tools, and proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.

  • In-depth knowledge of AML regulations and guidelines

  • Strong ethical standards and integrity in handling sensitive information

  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team

  • A recognised AML / Sanctions / Fraud qualification is desirable but not essential

Regretfully we are not able to sponsor applicants for immigration purposes at the current time.

What makes a great ClearBank team member? Does this sound like you?

  • You focus on solutions and positive outcomes, thinking radically and responsibly to find the best result for our customers, your colleagues and the bank;

If this sounds like you then we encourage you to dust off that CV and apply!

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Physics-Adapted Numerical Methods
jobs.description:
Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Physics-Adapted Numerical Methods

The Department of Computer Science, Electrical Engineering and Mathematical Sciences at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences, has a vacancy for a postdoctoral research fellow in numerical mathematics for a period of 3 years.
 
About the postdoctoral project:

The postdoctoral position is part of the project “Physics-Adapted Numerical Methods for Two-Phase Flow” (PANum) funded by the Research Council of Norway. The project is a joint collaboration between Western Norway University of Applied Sciences and Hasselt University in Belgium.

In PANum the goal is to formulate and implement mathematical methods that are not only robust, efficient and have a low numerical error, but that also guarantee that important physical properties are fulfilled in the numerical solution. Ultimately, PANum will lead to a computational algorithm that reliably simulates two-phase flow.

The postdoctoral project will be part of developing and analyzing relevant numerical methods and implement them in an open-source framework that will be made openly available for others to use. This will be relevant for example for CO2 storage and design of fuel cells. 


Research environment:

The PANum project is situated in the Engineering Computing research group at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences, and in the computational mathematics group (CMAT) at Hasselt University. Both groups focus strongly on numerical analysis and mathematical modelling. The prospective postdoctoral researcher will work in close collaboration with Carina Bringedal and Erlend Storvik from Engineering Computing, Jochen Schütz from CMAT, as well as the current PhD and master students connected to the PANum project.

 

Postdoctoral research fellows receive an annual work expense funding which can be used for conference participation, research visits, and equipment. The place of employment is campus Bergen or campus Førde. 


Qualifications:

Criteria for appointment to the position of postdoctoral fellow are regulated in Forskrift til universitets- og høyskoleloven.

Applicants must have earned a PhD degree in computer science, simulation science, applied mathematics or in a closely related field, or have submitted the PhD thesis before the application deadline. The PhD must have been awarded within 6 weeks after the application deadline. The scientific profile of qualified candidates must be within numerical methods for ODEs and PDEs.

 

A solid background in both the following fields is required:

  • Numerical analysis for ODEs and PDEs
  • Scientific programming using Python, MATLAB, C++, Julia, or similar

Furthermore, experience within:

  • collaborative code development and usage of version control tools like git
  • asymptotic methods, like two-scale asymptotic expansions or matched asymptotic expansions, for PDEs

will be considered an advantage when candidates are ranked. 

In addition to the required educational and scientific background, the following criteria will be evaluated:

  • Quality and relevance of PhD thesis
  • Quality and relevance of publications
  • Ability to work in intersection of theoretical and applied research
  • Ability to collaborate, lead the writing of research papers, ability to initiate and advance research, and research and scientific leadership potential
  • Oral and written good communication skills in English.

 

Career plan:

The person appointed shall, together with the institute, prepare a career plan that specifies the skills the postdoctoral researcher is to acquire. Competence goals shall be set both for the postdoctoral project and for any other career‑advancing work included in the position. The postdoctoral researcher will have access to career guidance.


Application procedure:

Applications will be evaluated by an expert panel of three members.

Applicants are asked to submit their application and CV online. Please use the link “Apply for this job” (“Søk stillingen”).

The following documentation should be uploaded as an attachment to the online application: 

  • A brief cover letter (max one page) including a description of research interests and motivation for working within the current project. The cover letter should include a detailed justification of your qualifications in relation to the listed requirements.
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and a complete list of academic publications)
  • PhD thesis
  • Transcripts and diplomas of bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degrees. If you have not yet been awarded your PhD degree, please submit a statement from your institution confirming the submission of the PhD thesis.
  • Copies of up to 5 selected academic publications
  • Names and contact details of 2 references (names, relation to candidate, email and telephone number).

Short-listed candidates might be required to give a research presentation, in addition to an interview. 

 

If the documents submitted are not in a Scandinavian language or in English, the applicants must submit certified translations of these. It is required that the applicant encloses a recognition document showing that their degree is equivalent to a Norwegian bachelor’s degree, master’s degree, or PhD. You can read more about applying for recognition of foreign higher education here.

 

The Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir) offers an automatic recognition document for certain degrees from selected countries. If the applicant’s degree is covered by the automatic recognition, it will be sufficient to attach this document. Read more about automatic recognition here.

 

As the HK-dir application process may take some time it is recommended to apply to HK-dir as soon as possible. If you have not received a recognition document from HK- dir within the application deadline, please enclose documentation from HK-dir showing that they have received your application.

 

Applicants should note that the evaluation will be based on the documentation submitted electronically via Jobbnorge within the submission deadline. The applicants are responsible for ensuring that all the documentation is submitted before the closing date. Applications cannot be sent by e-mail or to individuals at HVL.


Salary and benefits:

Exciting and stimulating work as part of a strong international academic environment.


An open and inclusive work environment with dedicated colleagues Favourable terms in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund.

The position as postdoctoral researcher is paid according to the Government's salary regulation, in position code 1352.


There is a compulsory 2 % deduction to the pension fund (see http://www.spk.no/en for more information). The successful applicant must comply with the guidelines that apply to the position at any time.


General information:

The appointment will be made in accordance with the regulations for State employees Law in Norway ("Lov om statens ansatte"). Organizational changes and changes in the duties and responsibilities associated with the position must be expected.

State employment shall reflect the multiplicity of the population at large to the highest possible degree. Western Norway University of Applied Sciences therefore aims to achieve a balanced age and gender composition and the recruitment of persons with diverse backgrounds.

Information about the applicants may be made public even though the applicant has requested not to be named in the list of applicants. The applicant will be notified if his/her request is not respected.

Short-listed applicants will be called in for an interview.

Employed on condition that you are granted a work and residence permit (must be considered individually).


Western Norway University of Applied Sciences is subjected to The Export Control Regulation. The regulation will be applied in the processing of the applications.


Contacts:

1) Professor Carina Bringedal, project leader of PANum

phone: +47 55 58 79 76, e-mail: carina.bringedal@hvl.no 

2) Associate Professor Therese B. Sjursen, assistant department leader

phone: +47 97 14 46 69 , e-mail: Therese.Berge.Sjursen@hvl.no 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

With about 17,500 students, Western Norway University of Applied Sciences is one of the largest higher education institutions in Norway. A broad range of academic programmes are offered at Bachelor, Master and PhD levels, spread out on five campuses Førde, Sogndal, Bergen, Stord og Haugesund.

Our ambition is to build stronger and more solid academic and research environments that will interact nationally and internationally. The aim is to become a recognized actor on the international higher education arena. Increased international cooperation and engagement in externally funded projects will work towards this goal.

The Department of Computer Science, Electrical Engineering and Mathematical Sciences has a strong academic and research environment, offering programmes at bachelor’s, master’s and PhD levels. The department has around 1,100 students and more than 120 staff members, and plays a key role in advancing technologies for digitalisation and the green transition.

We offer education across our campuses in Førde, Bergen and Haugesund, with six study programmes in computer science and electrical engineering, and teaching contributions in mathematics, statistics and physics.

The department hosts active research groups in areas such as software engineering, artificial intelligence, robotics, human-computer interaction and sensor networks, and collaborates closely with industry and public sector partners.

jobs.title: Nanofabrication Engineer
jobs.description:
SCALINQ develops next-generation quantum technologies. We are now looking for an experienced Nanofabrication Engineer who wants to help transform cutting-edge research into real-world quantum hardware.

The role As a Nanofabrication Engineer, you will play a key role in developing and optimizing fabrication processes for next-generation quantum hardware. Your primary focus will be hands-on nanofabrication and process development in advanced cleanroom environments, taking processes from concept through implementation and continuous improvement.

In addition, you will contribute to device design, characterization, experimentation, and data analysis. While you will work with technologies that enable quantum computing, prior experience in quantum technologies is not required.

Your work will include:

    

Nanofabrication in cleanroom facilities

    

Process development and optimization

    

Device modelling and design

    

Characterization and measurement of fabricated devices

    

Data analysis and troubleshooting

    

Collaboration with multidisciplinary engineering teams

    

Planning and executing experiments

You will have significant ownership of your work and the opportunity to influence both technical direction and process development.

What we offer At SCALINQ, you'll join an ambitious and international team working at the forefront of quantum technology. You'll contribute to the development of next-generation quantum hardware while collaborating with experts across multiple disciplines.

We offer a collaborative environment where curiosity, initiative, and technical excellence are valued. You'll take ownership of your work, have a direct impact on our technology and future growth, and contribute to building new processes and capabilities in a fast-growing deep-tech company.

Who you are  You are a curious and driven engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and turning ideas into practical solutions. With a structured and analytical mindset, you take ownership of your work and are comfortable working independently while collaborating across disciplines.

You thrive in a fast-moving environment where initiative, adaptability, and continuous improvement are highly valued. You are motivated by ambitious goals and enjoy contributing to the development of advanced technologies.

We welcome candidates with backgrounds in nanofabrication, microfabrication, semiconductor processing, MEMS, photonics, or other advanced hardware development environments. Prior experience in quantum technologies is not required.

About SCALINQ SCALINQ develops state-of-the-art cryogenic hardware and enabling technologies for scalable quantum computing systems. Our products are designed to solve some of the most demanding challenges in quantum computing, helping researchers and industry leaders build more powerful and scalable quantum systems.

At SCALINQ, we combine cutting-edge research with practical engineering to create commercially viable products. We believe our success comes from the diversity, expertise, and dedication of our people.

Requirements

    

MSc with several years of relevant industry experience, or a PhD in a relevant field

    

Strong experience in nanofabrication, microfabrication, semiconductor processing, or related technologies

    

Experience in hardware development environments

    

Fluent English (written and spoken)

Nice to have

    

Superconducting devices or quantum technologies

    

High-frequency or analog hardware development

    

Development of fabrication processes from concept to implementation

    

MyFab cleanroom certifications/licenses

Ready to help shape the future of quantum computing? We look forward to your application.



Application deadline: 30 September, 2026

Start date: By agreement

Position: Full-time

Location: Gothenburg

Platsa is managing the recruitment process for this position. If selected, you will be employed directly by SCALINQ. If you have any questions regarding the role, please contact:

Evelina Löfberg evelina.lofberg@platsa.se

jobs.title: SiS LVM-Hem Hessleby söker dig behandlingspedagog vaken nattjänst
jobs.description:
Statens institutionsstyrelse, SiS, är en myndighet som ansvarar för individuellt anpassad tvångsvård för ungdomar med komplex psykosocial problematik och för vuxna med missbruk. SiS verkställer även sluten ungdomsvård. Det gör vi på ungdomshem och hem för vuxna med missbruk, över hela landet. Hos oss på SiS blir ditt arbetsliv en spännande utmaning. Oavsett var i vår organisation du arbetar, eller vilken tjänst du har, hjälper du till att skapa livsviktig förändring.



SiS LVM-hem Hessleby som ligger i vacker skogsmiljö strax utanför Mariannelund tar emot män med alkohol-, narkotika- eller blandmissbruk. Vi har särskild kompetens för att ta emot klienter med psykisk ohälsa eller ett utåtagerande beteende. Vi har i uppdrag att bedriva vård för klienter med särskilda vårdbehov.



Arbetsbeskrivning

Vill du vara med och skapa den livsviktiga förändringen för utsatta människor? Då är jobbet som behandlingspedagog hos SiS en meningsfull utmaning. Som behandlingspedagog arbetar du i team tillsammans med behandlingsassistenter och behandlingssamordnare och tillsammans ansvarar ni för att de ungdomar och klienter som bor hos oss får den trygghet, vård och behandling som de behöver. Vi möter ofta människor i kris, vilket innebär att du jobbar med kvalificerat omvårdnads-och motivationsarbete och med att vara ett stöd i vardagen. Med stöd av dina kunskaper inom vård- och behandlingsarbete bidrar du aktivt till att behandlingsplaner fullföljs. Dokumentation är en viktig del av ditt arbete, och bidrar bland annat till rättssäkerhet, planering och uppföljning av vår verksamhet. Du bidrar till att säkerheten upprätthålls enligt våra rutiner och du medverkar till att vardagen flyter på med skolgång, städning, matlagning med mera. Kontaktmannaskap är också en av dina arbetsuppgifter. I arbetet kan det även ingå att vara handledare åt nya medarbetare och praktikanter. Det här är ett arbete för dig som ser en positiv utmaning i att få arbeta med utsatta människor i en svår livssituation. Jobbet är många gånger krävande men också stimulerande, glädjefyllt och omväxlande.

Vår vision är att vara en plats för förändring och det genomsyrar vårt bemötande, vårt engagemang och vårt förhållningssätt.

Arbetstiden är enligt schema vaken nattjänstgöring.

Som ny medarbetare kommer du att genomgå SiS grundutbildning på 10 veckor. I utbildningen varvas teori med en handledd introduktion och utbildningen rustar dig för behandlarrollen i SiS verksamhet.

Kvalifikationer

För att lyckas i ditt arbete har du en grundmurad positiv människosyn. Du är motiverad att hjälpa människor i en utsatt livssituation och du delar SiS värdegrund, att vara en plats för förändring. Vidare har du en god förmåga att skapa engagemang och delaktighet hos våra ungdomar. Som person är du trygg i dig själv och har lätt för att skapa relation med ungdomar likväl som med övriga i personalgruppen. Du har en god kommunikativ förmåga och kan behålla ditt lugn även i pressade situationer. Du har lätt för att samarbeta med andra och du kan hantera konflikter på ett konstruktivt sätt.

Du ska också ha:

    Examen från 2-årig eftergymnasial utbildning vid folkhögskola eller yrkeshögskola (KY/YH) med inriktning mot socialt/pedagogiskt behandlingsarbete eller utbildning från högskola som vi bedömer likvärdig
    B- körkort
    God svenska i tal och skrift

På SiS månar vi om ett gott medarbetarskap. Det innebär att du som medarbetare tar ansvar för ditt arbete, bidrar till utveckling och medverkar till ett gott samarbete. Läs mer om https://www.stat-inst.se/jobba-hos-oss/medarbetarskap-och-ledarskap/.

Anställning:

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på deltid 77,90 % och inleds med sex månaders provanställning. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.



Ansökan:

Välkommen att registrera din ansökan i vårt rekryteringsverktyg senast den 261030



SiS arbetar aktivt mot all form av diskriminering och välkomnar alla sökande.



För arbete på våra institutioner gör SiS registerkontroll innan anställning.



Inför rekryteringsarbetet har Statens institutionsstyrelse tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.



OBS! Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ska du inte söka via rekryteringssystemet. Kontakta i stället den som står som kontaktperson i annonsen.

jobs.title: Praktisk superhelt søkes til vårt co-op team! 🎮💛 (BPA - tilkallingsvikar)
jobs.employer: PRIMA ASSISTANSE AS AVD OSLO OG ROMERIKE
jobs.description:
Er du typen som liker å få ting gjort, har et godt hjerte og kanskje ikke sier nei til en runde Minecraft eller R.E.P.O? Da kan det hende vi har en ledig plass på laget vårt!

Vi søker nå BPA-assistenter som kan hjelpe oss med å få hverdagen til å gå litt lettere rundt. I første omgang trenger vi hovedsakelig hjelp med praktiske oppgaver i hjemmet, men på sikt håper vi at du også kan bli en trygg og god støtte for min 13 år gamle datter.

Vi søker i første omgang tilkallingsvikarer, men det kan etter hvert bli mulighet for en liten fast stilling på noen timer i uken.

Litt om oss 💛

Vi er en liten familie på Ensjø i Oslo, hvor hverdagen av og til kan føles som et spill med litt for mange aktive quests samtidig.

Datteren min er 13 år og har blant annet autisme og ADHD. Hun er kreativ, morsom, smart og full av interesser, men har også utfordringer som gjør at hun trenger mye støtte og tilrettelegging i hverdagen.

Noen dager er det overskudd til aktiviteter og nye eventyr. Andre dager er det viktigste å få lade batteriene og skjerme seg fra en verden som kan bli litt overveldende.

Hun har allerede en BPA som hovedsakelig jobber direkte med henne. Nå ønsker vi å utvide teamet med noen som i første omgang kan ta seg av de praktiske oppgavene rundt oss, slik at vi får mer tid og overskudd til det som betyr mest.

Dine quests

I starten vil oppgavene dine først og fremst være praktiske, som for eksempel:

  • Rydding og rengjøring i hjemmet
  • Klesvask, bretting og organisering
  • Matlaging og enkel forberedelse av måltider
  • Handling og andre nødvendige ærender
  • Andre praktiske gjøremål som gjør hverdagen enklere

Du trenger altså ikke å være ekspert på barn, diagnoser eller Minecraft for å gjøre en kjempeviktig jobb hos oss!

På sikt ønsker vi likevel at du skal kunne bli bedre kjent med datteren min og hjelpe henne mer direkte i hverdagen.

Dette vil skje gradvis og i hennes tempo. Trygghet og relasjoner bygges ikke på én dag, og det er helt greit.

Etter hvert kan oppgavene derfor også innebære:

  • Gaming, kreative aktiviteter eller andre hyggelige ting sammen
  • Støtte til rutiner og daglige gjøremål
  • Motivasjon, veiledning og hjelp til å mestre små og store utfordringer
  • Å være en trygg, rolig voksen som kan bidra når hverdagen blir vanskelig
Bonus XP: Felles interesser! 🎮

Datteren min liker blant annet Minecraft, gaming, tegning, crafting, Dungeons & Dragons, dyr, historie og bøker.

Du trenger absolutt ikke dele alle interessene hennes, men det er en stor fordel om dere har noe til felles, særlig hvis du liker gaming.

Kanskje er du en erfaren Minecrafter? Kanskje liker du fantasy, brettspill eller kreative prosjekter? Eller kanskje er du bare nysgjerrig og åpen for å lære?

Alt dette er bonuspoeng!

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi er ikke ute etter en perfekt CV eller en bestemt utdanning. Vi ser først og fremst etter et godt menneske som passer inn hos oss.

Vi tror du vil trives hvis du:

  • Er pålitelig, selvstendig og ser hva som trenger å gjøres
  • Trives med praktiske oppgaver og ikke er redd for å ta i et tak
  • Er varm, tålmodig og har godt humør
  • Har forståelse for at enkelte dager kan være litt uforutsigbare
  • Respekterer grenser og lar relasjoner utvikle seg naturlig
  • Kan jobbe selvstendig, men også samarbeide godt med oss andre
  • Gjerne har interesse for gaming eller noe annet datteren min liker

Har du erfaring fra BPA, arbeid med barn og unge, autisme, ADHD eller lignende, er det selvfølgelig kjempefint!

Men erfaring er ikke et krav. Du får opplæringen og veiledningen du trenger, og personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt.

Hva får du hos oss? 💛

Jeg er arbeidsleder og opptatt av at assistentene våre skal trives, bli hørt og føle seg trygge i jobben.

Hos oss får du:

  • En meningsfull jobb hvor du virkelig gjør en forskjell
  • En variert arbeidsdag med både selvstendige oppgaver og menneskelig kontakt
  • God opplæring og støtte underveis
  • Muligheten til å bli en del av et lite og hyggelig team
  • Verdifull erfaring med BPA og tilrettelegging i hverdagen
  • Lønn etter tariff, kurs og kontaktperson gjennom Prima Assistanse

Og kanskje viktigst av alt: Du får være med på å gi en familie litt mer pusterom i hverdagen. Det betyr mer enn du kanskje tror.

Arbeidstider

Her blir ingen uker helt like! Vaktene vil være på både hverdager og i helger, med arbeid på dagtid og ettermiddag/kveld. Vi har varierende behov og setter derfor stor pris på deg som kan bidra når det trengs.

Oppstart er ønskelig så snart som mulig.

Ready to join the party? 🎮

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Send oss gjerne en søknad; også om du er usikker på om du har den rette bakgrunnen.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg! 💛

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: HCC Architect (IT), Tampere
jobs.description:
About the role

As an Hybrid Cloud Computing Architect specializing in cloud and database technologies, you will play a key role in transforming on-premises databases towards public cloud and autonomous database services, designing scalable, secure, and cost-conscious solutions.

You are offered
A permanent, full-time position within a forward-thinking global IT organization, offering hybrid remote work options, professional growth in cutting-edge cloud technologies, and a collaborative team environment.

Work tasks

In this role, you will lead the database modernization journey, collaborating with global teams and suppliers to architect secure, scalable cloud-native database solutions.
- Take architectural responsibility for cloud and database solutions, including security, performance, and integrations
- Support the transformation of on-premises database environments towards public cloud and autonomous database services
- Develop and design new database and cloud-based data platform services, improving usability and maintainability
- Contribute to cloud migration planning, database modernization, and architecture reviews with application teams
- Collaborate with the Chief Architect to support roadmap development and long-term technology direction
- Align business roadmaps with database and cloud technology roadmaps, considering capacity, security, and cost
- Support external BUILD development and ensure smooth, well-documented handovers to RUN operations

We are looking for

- Strong understanding of database technologies, such as Oracle and SQL Server
- Good knowledge of cloud infrastructure concepts, public cloud services, and migration approaches
- Experience or strong interest in autonomous database services and managed database platforms
- Basic knowledge of project management and agile methodologies
- Experience in supplier management and collaborating with technology vendors and application teams

It is meritorious if you have
- Understanding of performance optimization, security compliance, and lifecycle management
- Ability to translate business requirements into practical architectural roadmaps
- Excellent communication and coordination skills in a global environment

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work. We will tell more about our client company in the interview stages.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Vil du assistere en aktiv mamma?
jobs.description:
Hvem skal du jobbe med ? 

Jeg er en rullende mamma i starten av trettiårene som søker nye assistenter i ordningen min. Jeg bor sentralt i Lier og har behov for assistanse i hverdagen. Det er varierte dager med både vanlige huslige oppgaver og ulike aktiviteter.

Hvem er du ?

Nå ser jeg etter deg som kunne tenke deg å jobbe som brukerstyrt personlig assistent hos meg. At du er sporty og tar ting litt på sparket er et stort pluss. Jeg er veldig gira på å få brukt sitskien og sykkelen min, men trenger alltid ledsager med.

Det er ingen formelle krav til utdanning, all nødvendig opplæring vil bli gitt. Men det er viktig for meg at kjemien mellom oss stemmer.

Stillinger:

Dette er en deltidsstilling, og akkurat nå trenger jeg noen som kan jobbe faste vakter.

Har også behov for flere tilkallingsvikarer.

Min ideelle assistent er:

  • Løsningsorientert

  • Strukturert

  • Fleksibel

  • Tålmodig

  • Punktlig

  • Ser mine behov og handler selvstendig

  • Må kunne jobbe med barn

Stillingen krever gode norskkunnskaper. Førerkort og mulighet til å disponere bil (mot kompensasjon) er en bonus, men ikke et krav.

Det krever ingen forkunnskaper, men om du har relevant erfaring fra service eller omsorgsyrker er det et pluss. All nødvendig opplæring vil bli gitt om du får tilbud om jobb.

Vi behandler alle søknader fortløpende.


Hvorfor skal du velge Humana?

Hos Humana er du mer enn bare en ansatt. Vi er opptatt av din trivsel, og du får god oppfølging fra dag én. Du blir en del av et støttende assistent-team, og vi tilbyr både veiledning og kurs for at du skal lykkes i jobben.

Dette er noe av det du får ved å jobbe hos oss:

  • Tarifflønn, ansiennitetsregulert

  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

  • Veiledning og opplæring

  • Assistentkurs i regi av Humana Omsorg og Assistanse

  • Egen app for håndbøker og rutiner

  • Rabatter hos bl.a. SATS

  • Attraktive rabatter med fordelsprogrammet Visma LogBuy

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

Vi er et av Norges største private helseforetak, og vi arbeider etter visjonen, Alle har rett til et godt liv.

jobs.title: Fencing Operative
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
We are seeking reliable and hardworking Fencing Operatives to join our fencing team. The successful candidates will work as part of a 2–3 person fencing crew, carrying out a wide range of fencing projects throughout County Kerry. The role will suit someone with previous fencing experience, but candidates with a strong construction, agricultural or practical background will also be considered. Full training can be provided. We are looking for people who are physically fit, practical and willing to work outdoors in a demanding environment. Previous fencing experience is an advantage, but the right attitude, reliability and willingness to learn are equally important. Key Responsibilities The fencing operative will be involved in a wide range of fencing and associated work, including: Agricultural stock fencing. Electric fencing. Post-and-rail fencing. Timber fencing. Deer fencing. Mesh and wire fencing. Installation of gates and gate systems. Fence repairs and maintenance. Setting out fence lines. Digging and installing fence posts. Installing concrete and timber posts. Straining and tensioning wire. Fixing mesh, wire and rails. Using hand and power tools. Removing existing fencing where required. Site preparation and clean-up where required by the particular job. Loading, unloading and handling fencing materials. Maintaining a clean and safe working area. Working safely and efficiently as part of a fencing crew. Following instructions provided by the office and supervisors. Working to the required standard and completing jobs efficiently. Working Environment The majority of the work is outdoors and can involve challenging ground conditions and changing weather. The role is physically demanding and requires the operative to spend most of the working day on their feet, carrying materials, digging, installing posts and using hand and power tools. The successful candidate must be comfortable working outdoors and carrying out physically demanding work on farms, construction sites, commercial properties, forestry areas and other locations. Working Hours Normal working hours are: Monday–Friday, 8:00am–5:00pm The role is primarily Monday to Friday, with no regular weekend work expected. The company base is in Castleisland, County Kerry. Transport will be provided from the base to work sites as required. Tools & Equipment All necessary fencing tools and equipment will be provided by the company. The majority of the work will involve hand tools and standard fencing equipment, although there are opportunities for employees who wish to develop their skills in machinery operation. Experience operating equipment such as: Post drivers Mini diggers Tractors Augers Other construction or agricultural machinery would be an advantage but is not essential. Experience & Qualifications Previous professional fencing experience is preferred. However, candidates with experience in: Agricultural work General construction

jobs.title: Procurement Development Manager
jobs.description:
Do you thrive in transformation environments and have the leadership capability to take procurement to the next level? We are looking for a Procurement Development Manager who will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of procurement within a leading international energy company.

About the Role

As Procurement Development Manager, you will own and deliver the Procurement Development roadmap, leading a multi-year transformation agenda across our global organization. You will work closely with senior leaders and business stakeholders to establish world-class procurement practices, strengthen organizational capabilities, and ensure procurement is recognized as a strategic business partner.

This is a unique opportunity to lead a global procurement transformation journey in a company that is actively contributing to the energy transition and helping build a more sustainable future. You will be responsible for driving procurement excellence across processes, governance, digitalization, capability building, ESG, and supplier management while influencing stakeholders across multiple countries, cultures, and business functions.

The position can be based in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Baar or Cressier depending on preferred location.

Key responsibilities

    Standardize and continuously improve Source-to-Pay (S2P) processes and governance across the organization.
    Design and implement best-practice procurement policies, frameworks, and playbooks that can be applied across countries, legal entities, and categories.
    Develop and maintain procurement tools strategy, including solutions such as eSourcing, Contract Lifecycle Management, supplier portals, and analytics platforms.
    Establish common procurement data standards, KPI frameworks, and performance reporting structures to enable global transparency and comparability.
    Drive change management and adoption of new tools, processes, and ways of working across Procurement, Finance, Operations, and the wider business.
    Lead and inspire a highly diverse and international team, creating a culture of growth, collaboration, courage, and continuous improvement.

We offer

At VAROPreem, you will join a welcoming and collaborative workplace where trust, personal responsibility, and professional development are highly valued. As the energy sector undergoes its most significant transformation in decades, you will have the opportunity to contribute to both today's energy needs and tomorrow's more sustainable solutions.

We offer a high degree of autonomy and encourage employees to take initiative, challenge established ways of working, and help shape the future of our business.

About you

You are a strategic and transformational leader who thrives on challenging the status quo and translating vision into tangible business results. You combine deep procurement expertise with strong commercial acumen, a data-driven mindset, and exceptional relationship-building skills.

You are confident influencing senior stakeholders and navigating complex environments, while remaining pragmatic, collaborative, and focused on bringing people along the transformation journey. With your leadership experience and ability to inspire others, you create engagement, build high-performing teams, and drive sustainable change across international organizations.

Requirements

We believe you bring:

    Extensive experience within procurement, procurement development, organizational development, transformation, or functional excellence.
    Proven success leading large-scale, multi-year transformation programs across international organizations.
    Strong Source-to-Pay (S2P) expertise with practical experience in process design, optimization, and implementation.
    Excellent change management and stakeholder engagement skills.
    Experience working closely with executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
    A commercial mindset and the ability to identify opportunities that create business value.
    Experience from energy, oil & gas, refining, chemicals, manufacturing, infrastructure or other regulated and asset- intensive industries is highly desirable.
    Experience implementing or optimizing procurement technology platforms and digital procurement solutions.
    Fluent in English
    French and Swedish language skills are considered an advantage.

Next steps

We look forward to receiving your application as soon as possible, but no later than 28 October 2026. Applying is easy – simply submit your CV or link your LinkedIn profile and answer a few screening questions. If you choose to apply with your LinkedIn profile and progress in the process, you will be asked to provide a CV at a later stage.

To ensure an objective and fair selection process, we use assessment tests as part of our recruitment process. As we apply continuous selection, the role may be filled before the application deadline.

If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact Hiring manager Camilla Dimberg, camilla.dimberg@varopreem.se or Recruitment Partner Jennie Lundqvist, jennie.lundqvist@varopreem.se.

As VAROPreem operates within critical infrastructure, a background screening as well as alcohol and drug testing will be conducted prior to any employment offer. During the interview process, candidates must be able to present a valid form of identification, such as a passport or national identity card, alternatively a population registration certificate together with a valid driving licence.

As parts of VAROPreem’s operations are subject to security-sensitive regulations, a security clearance, including a background check through official registers, may be required depending on the position. Any such security screening will be conducted in accordance with the provisions of the Swedish Security Protection Act.

The union contact person can be found here.

Welcome with your application!
