jobs.title: Städspecialist till Hemfrid Norrköping
jobs.description:
HEMFRID SÖKER STÄDARE I NORRKÖPING – VILL DU GÖRA SKILLNAD VARJE DAG?

Tycker du om att skapa ordning, ge service i toppklass och göra människors vardag lite enklare? Då kan du vara den vi söker.

Hos Hemfrid får du mer än bara ett jobb – du blir en del av Sveriges ledande företag inom hemstädning och ett härligt, internationellt team där gemenskap, kvalitet och utveckling står i fokus. Varje dag hjälper vi våra kunder att få mer tid över till det som betyder mest för dem.

Därför trivs våra medarbetare hos oss

Vi vill att du ska känna dig trygg, uppskattad och ha goda möjligheter att utvecklas. Därför erbjuder vi:

• Kollektivavtal och trygga anställningsvillkor • Milersättning mellan kunder för dig som använder egen bil i tjänsten • Betald restid mellan kunderna • Försäkringar (sjukdom, ansvar och tjänstepension) • Friskvårdsbidrag på 2 400 kr per år • Gratis mobilabonnemang • Kostnadsfri utbildning i hemstädning och vidareutbildningar inom service och städning • Stöd från Field Lead/Buddy – en kontaktperson som hjälper dig i ditt arbete • Teamträffar och gemensamma aktiviteter • Möjlighet att utvecklas i ett växande företag

Om rollen

Som städare hos Hemfrid hjälper du våra kunder att få ett rent, trivsamt och välkomnande hem. Du arbetar både självständigt och tillsammans med kollegor, möter olika människor och får en varierad arbetsdag där ingen dag är den andra lik.

Vi ser till att du får utbildning, stöd och rätt verktyg för att lyckas från första dagen.

Vem är du?

Vi tror att du:

• Tycker om att ge god service och skapa nöjda kunder • Är noggrann, ansvarstagande och positiv • Trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och i team • Vill lära dig nytt och utvecklas i din yrkesroll • Talar svenska eller engelska • Kan arbeta vardagar mellan kl. 08.00–17.00 • Är flexibel och tycker om att arbeta hos olika kunder

Det är extra meriterande om du har:

• B-körkort och egen bil • Erfarenhet från städning, service eller liknande yrken

Bli en del av Hemfrid

Hos oss får du möjligheten att arbeta i ett företag som värdesätter kvalitet, omtanke och medarbetarnas välmående. Vi letar efter människor med rätt inställning – resten hjälper vi dig med.

Ansök redan idag och ta nästa steg i din karriär.

Läs mer och skicka in din ansökan via Hemfrids karriärsida.

Har du frågor? Kontakta oss gärna på hr@hemfrid.se.

Vi ser fram emot att välkomna dig till Hemfrid i Norrköping.

HEMFRID IS LOOKING FOR CLEANERS IN NORRKÖPING – DO YOU WANT TO MAKE A DIFFERENCE EVERY DAY?

Do you enjoy creating order, delivering excellent service, and making everyday life easier for others? Then you might be the person we are looking for.

At Hemfrid, you will get more than just a job – you will become part of Sweden's leading home cleaning company and join a friendly, international team where community, quality, and personal development are at the heart of everything we do. Every day, we help our customers create more time for what matters most to them.

Why Our Employees Enjoy Working at Hemfrid

We want you to feel secure, appreciated, and supported in your professional growth. That's why we offer:

• Collective agreement and secure employment conditions • Mileage reimbursement between customers for those using their own car for work • Paid travel time between customers • Insurance coverage (health, liability, and occupational pension) • Wellness allowance of SEK 2,400 per year • Free mobile phone subscription • Free training in home cleaning and ongoing development opportunities in cleaning and customer service • Support from a Field Lead/Buddy – a dedicated contact person who helps you succeed in your role • Team gatherings and social events • Opportunities for growth within a successful and expanding company

About the Role

As a cleaner at Hemfrid, you will help our customers maintain clean, comfortable, and welcoming homes. You will work independently as well as alongside colleagues, meet a variety of people, and enjoy a diverse workday where no two days are the same.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - (Media SRE)
jobs.description:
Meet the Team

The Collaboration Technology Group is redefining the future of teamwork, building services that connect people effortlessly across devices, locations and time zones.

Our team in Stockholm builds, runs, and continuously improves the core media platform services behind Cisco’s collaboration products, operating at global scale across numerous datacentres. We’re a passionate, collaborative team focused on real-time media reliability, innovation, and engineering excellence.

Your Impact

As a Software Engineer in our Stockholm Webex Media (WxMedia) & SRE organization, you will bring new real-time media features to life and drive resolution for high-impact media platform escalations. You will combine Site Reliability Engineering practices with real-time media streaming architectures and modern agentic AI (reusable Skills, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and LLM tooling) to transform how we monitor, diagnose, and auto-remediate global media services handling billions of audio and video minutes.

What You'll Do

    Media Escalations & Real-Time Reliability: Lead deep-dive troubleshooting for complex WxMedia platform issues, investigating packet loss, jitter, latency, audio/video degradation, and SIP/WebRTC signaling failures across hybrid cloud and bare-metal environments.
    Real-Time Media Delivery: Bring new real-time media features to life based on product requirements, ensuring high performance, scalability, and seamless global routing.
    Technical Design & Architecture: Design and implement high-resilience software systems for AI-assisted observability, automated incident response, and self-healing cloud media infrastructure.
    Agentic Workflows & Tooling: Design, build, and maintain production-grade AI agents, MCP tool integrations, and deterministic evaluation pipelines for automated operational decision support.
    Telemetry & Insights: Implement ingestion and correlation pipelines across distributed logs, metrics, OpenTelemetry traces, change events, and runbooks to accelerate Mean Time to Detection (MTTD) and Resolution (MTTR).
    Safe Production Automation: Develop proactive anomaly detection and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) remediation workflows with meticulous safety, security, and quality guardrails.
    Reliability & Scalability Engineering: Partner with application and infrastructure teams to define SLIs/SLOs, handle error budgets, and lead investigation post-incident reviews (PIRs).
    Mentorship & Collaboration: Mentor mid-level and junior engineers, conduct thorough code reviews, establish engineering standards, and drive operational excellence across global development and operations teams.
    Cross-Team Delivery: Manage priorities and timelines, communicate progress clearly, and work across teams to turn production needs into reliable software and AI-assisted capabilities.

Minimum Qualifications

    Bachelor’s degree + 8years of related experience, Master’s + 6 years, or PhD + 3 years in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
    Consistent record as a Senior / Lead SRE or Software Engineer delivering distributed, high-availability SaaS or media platforms at scale.
    Experience with media streaming and relevant protocols for real-time applications (e.g., RTP/RTCP, SRTP, WebRTC, SIP, SDP, RTSP, or HLS/DASH).
    Strong proficiency in Python, Go, C++, or Java with experience designing microservices, APIs, and production automation.
    Deep experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and container orchestration in large-scale multi-cluster environments.
    Experience in SRE practices: SLI/SLO design, observability platforms (metrics/logs/traces), incident management, and automated root cause analysis (RCA).

Preferred Qualifications

    Experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud).
    Experience with close-to-real-time systems and performance-sensitive code paths.
    Comfort with incremental development, testing, and A/B testing in production.
    Steers AI effectively via context and prompt design.
    Experience building LLM pipelines, AI Agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers/clients, RAG architectures, and evaluation frameworks.
    Experience with OpenTelemetry (OTel), Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, ThousandEyes, or distributed tracing systems.
    Expertise in Terraform/IaC and GitOps/CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Harness).
    Experience implementing responsible AI guardrails, deterministic fallback logic, and policy-driven remediation engines.
    Experience with streaming and data platforms (Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch/Vector DBs).
    Collabhiring

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.title: Marksäkerhetsingenjör - Esrange Space Center
jobs.description:
Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular. With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more.

Would you like to help develop a workplace where people, technology, and space come together? At SSC Space, you will have the opportunity to contribute to something that truly makes a difference – Help Earth Benefit from Space.

We are now looking for a Ground Safety Engineer who shares our values – Customer Passion, Care, Collaboration, Curiosity, and Courage – and wants to play an important role in our continued growth and development within space technology and launch operations.

REQUIREMENTS

Do you want a job where safety and space truly come together? As a Ground Safety Engineer in our Launch Team, you will play a key role in making our rocket and balloon launch campaigns possible.

In this position, you will work closely with the operational team and have a clear purpose: to ensure a safe and secure environment during our campaigns. Your responsibilities will span the entire process - from planning and preparation to being present during launch operations.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Planning, assessing risks, and preparing ground safety activities ahead of campaigns.
    Participating operationally during rocket and balloon launch campaigns.
    Maintaining and further developing the systems and equipment used during launch operations.
    Contributing to the continuous improvement of safety routines and working practices.

At SSC Space, you will receive comprehensive onboarding and training to enable you to take responsibility for ground safety during our campaigns. This is a unique opportunity to combine technology, safety, and hands-on work in an environment unlike any other in the world.

The role also involves operational work on-site during rocket and balloon campaigns, requiring flexibility in both working methods and working hours.

RESPONSIBILITIES

To succeed in this role, we believe you are someone who thrives in a dynamic environment. You are flexible, solution-oriented, and comfortable quickly shifting your focus when circumstances require it. You have a strong technical interest and a safety mindset that comes naturally to you.

We would like you to have:

    A degree in Engineering or equivalent experience within a relevant technical field.
    Experience in safety-related work, risk assessments, or working in environments where safety is a key priority.
    A good understanding of safe working practices and operational procedures.
    Proficiency in both Swedish and English, spoken and written.
    The ability to work flexible hours during campaign periods.

Most importantly, we value your attitude and your willingness to contribute to a safe and successful team environment.

BENEFITS

We offer you

    A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.
    An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.
    An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.

Additional benefits

    In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.
    Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.
    Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.
    Convenient staff transportation between Kiruna and Esrange Space Center at a subsidized cost, making commuting easier for employees based in the Kiruna area.
    Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.
    Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance.

LOCATION

This is a full-time position based at Esrange Space Center outside Kiruna, where you will work at the heart of our operations. The role is primarily site-based, although remote work may be possible in exceptional circumstances. During our rocket and balloon campaigns, you will take an active part in operations, which may occasionally require work outside regular office hours or at other locations.

  

FURTHER INFORMATION

For questions regarding employment terms or union-related matters, you are welcome to contact our union representatives: Sveriges Ingenjörer: SverigesIngenjorer-AF@sscspace.com Unionen: unionen@sscspace.com

NEXT STEP

If this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process. When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process.

Please note that a background check and security interview will be conducted as part of the recruitment process prior to employment.



WE HELP EARTH BENEFIT FROM SPACE

SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space.

With local presence on all continents and about 800 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions.

We help Earth benefit from Space. Learn more at sscspace.com

1 plats(er).


Vill du arbeta med identitet och åtkomst i en stor och komplex IT-miljö där säker och tillförlitlig digitalisering gör konkret nytta för både verksamhet och invånare? Hos oss får du arbeta med ett område som är centralt för en säker, effektiv och användarvänlig digital verksamhet. Du blir en del av ett kompetent team där vi tillsammans utvecklar och förvaltar lösningar som ska fungera för många olika verksamheter, system och användargrupper. Låter detta intressant? Välkommen med din ansökan!

Till enheten Teknikplattform söker vi nu en till kollega. Enheten består av sexton personer och har i uppgift att tillhandahålla och utveckla en gemensam teknisk plattform. Beskrivning av arbetsuppgifter

    Federationsuppsättningar i Microsoft Entra ID och Nexus Digital Access Component.

    Arbete med Identity provider/Service provider (IDP/SP).
    Arbete med identitetslivscykel och automatiserad provisionering för kommunens användare och system.
    Arbete med autentisering, auktorisering och Single Sign-On (SSO).
    Arbete med Microsoft 365 inklusive Azure och tjänster.
    Omsätta verksamhetens behov till hållbara tekniska lösningar.
    Medverka vid projektinförande.
    Dokumentera lösningar och tekniska vägval.
    Följa utvecklingen inom IAM och bidra till att våra tekniska lösningar och arbetssätt utvecklas över tid.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som har högskoleutbildning inom it eller annan relevant utbildning i kombination med erfarenhet i närtid som arbetsgivaren bedömer som relevant för tjänsten.

Till den här rollen är det ett krav att du har:

    Erfarenhet inom it-infrastrukturområdet, med fokus på IDP/SP (Identity provider/Service provider), identitets- och behörighetshantering (IAM) samt säkerhetslösningar.
    Erfarenhet av villkorsstyrd åtkomst (Conditional Access, CA) och hantering av privilegierad åtkomst (Privileged Access, PA).

Vi ser det som meriterande om du har:

jobs.title: Kunnossapitoinsinööri, Vantaan Energia
jobs.description:
Haemme asiakkaallemme Vantaan Energialle kahta kunnossapitoinsinööriä vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.

Olemme yksi Pohjoismaiden johtavista kaupunkienergiayhtiöistä ja Suomen suurin jätteen energiahyödyntäjä. Tuotamme ja toimitamme lämpöä ja sähköä sekä tarjoamme näihin liittyviä palveluita. Ratkaisemme asiakkaidemme haasteita varmistamalla, että energia kiertää mahdollisimman tehokkaasti. Kehitämme jatkuvasti uutta, jotta vantaalaisilla olisi tarjolla edullista, toimitusvarmaa ja yhä vähäpäästöisempää energiaa sekä siihen liittyviä palveluita nyt ja tulevaisuudessa. Kunnianhimoisten suunnitelmiemme ydin on osaava, motivoitunutja hyvinvoiva henkilöstömme, josta huolehtiminen on meille ykkösasia. www.vantaanenergia.fi

Tehtävä

Tehtävät sijoittuvat korkealämpötilalaitokselle (HWP) ja jätevoimala 2-laitokselle. Kunnossapitoinsinöörinä vastaat oman laitoksesi kunnossapitotoiminnan johtamisesta, kehittämisestä ja toimintavarmuudesta. Kyseessä on vastuullinen ja monipuolinen asiantuntija-sekä esihenkilörooli, jossa toimit oman laitoksen kunnossapidon vetäjänä. Tavoitteenasi on varmistaa laitoksen turvallinen, tehokas ja häiriötön toiminta sekä tuotanto-omaisuuden pitkäjänteinen kehittäminen.

Tehtävässä toimit kunnossapidon tiimin esihenkilönä sekä vastaat ulkoistenpalveluntarjoajien ja alihankkijoiden ohjauksesta. Osallistut myös kunnossapidon budjetointiin, investointien suunnitteluun sekä kehityshankkeisiin yhteistyössä tuotannon, käytön ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

- oman laitoksen kunnossapitotoiminnan sekä tiimin johtaminen ja kehittäminen
- tuotantolaitoksen käytettävyyden, turvallisuuden ja toimintavarmuuden varmistaminen
- kunnossapidon pitkän tähtäimen suunnittelu ja kehitystyö
- kunnossapidon budjetointiin osallistuminen sekä kustannusten seuranta
- hankintojen, kilpailutusten ja ulkoisten palveluiden koordinointi
- kunnossapidon KPI-mittareiden ja tunnuslukujen seuranta sekä kehittäminen
- alihankkijoiden työn ohjaus ja valvonta
- yhteistyö tuotannon, käytön, omaisuudenhallinnan sekä muiden sidosryhmien kanssa
- lakisääteisten velvollisuuksien ja turvallisuusvaatimusten noudattamisen varmistaminen.

Tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden ottaa kokonaisvastuun oman energiantuotantolaitoksen kunnossapidosta osana vakavaraista ja tulevaisuuteen katsovaa energia-alan yritystä. Pääset työskentelemään keskeisessä roolissa, jossa vaikutat suoraan laitoksen suorituskykyyn, turvallisuuteen ja kehitykseen.

Saat tueksesi kokeneen organisaation, osaavat kollegat sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa asiantuntijuuttasi ja johtamisosaamistasi energia-alan mielenkiintoisimpien tehtävien parissa.

Toivomme sinulta

- soveltuvaa teknistä korkeakoulututkintoa esim. kone- tai energiatekniikka (insinööri tai DI)
- usean vuoden kokemusta kunnossapitotehtävistä prosessiteollisuudessa
- voimalaitos-, energia- tai kaukolämpötekniikan tuntemusta
- ymmärrystä kunnossapidon menetelmistä ja kehittämisestä
- hyviä yhteistyö-, vuorovaikutus- ja johtamistaitoja ja valmiuksia toimia esihenkilötehtävistä
- kehitysmyönteistä, suunnitelmallista ja oma-aloitteista työotetta
- sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa sekä hyvää englannin kielen taitoa
- hankinta- ja kilpailutusosaaminen katsotaan eduksi
- kiinteiden polttoaineiden tuntemus katsotaan eduksi.

Työsuhde on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva ja solmitaan suoraan Vantaan Energia Oy:n kanssa.Barona toimii rekrytointikumppanina.

Oletko sinä uusi energia-alan huipputekijä?

Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian oheisen linkin kautta. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja tehtävät täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan. Tietosuojasyistä emme vastaanota hakemuksia sähköpostitse tai WhatsAppin kautta.

Tehtävässä työskentely edellyttää hyväksyttyä turvallisuusselvitystä, työhöntulotarkastusta sekä huumausainetestausta. Nämä toteutetaan valituille henkilöille ennen työsuhteen alkamista.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Katri Hyppänen, Seniorikonsultti, Barona Teknisetasiantuntijat p. 050 439 9785 ma-to klo 10-14.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Hverdagen består av utstrakt kundekontakt både ansikt til ansikt og pr. telefon og mail. Vi leverer en service hvor kundens behov alltid er i fokus. Videre er du også ansvarlig for at våre leiebiler er klargjort og vasket i henhold til vår standard. Du har også ansvar for produkter (barneseter, skistativ mm), skaderegistrering, oppfølging av service. Logistikk, kundeservice, salg og klargjøring er kjernen i hverdagen.

  • Oversikt og kontroll på skader, servicestatus

  • Yte utmerket kundeservice i alle situasjoner

  • Presentasjon og innsalg av våre produkter til kunde på en best mulig måte

  • Håndtere telefon og epost henvendelser

  • Klargjøring av utleiebiler (vask mm)

  • Rapportering og annet forefallende kontorarbeid

Som kombinert utleierepresentant er du den våre kunder møter hver dag. Du representerer Sixt Bilutleie og er genuint opptatt av service og trives med kundekontakt. Vi stiller høye krav til våre produkter og hvordan vi presenterer disse, med ett ønske om å overgå kundens forventinger. Du har også ansvar for standarden på produktet vi leverer. Hverdagen styres av kundens behov, og din evne til å arbeide hurtig og nøyaktig er avgjørende for den kvalitet vi leverer. Ved å levere en premium opplevelse, er du med å bygge Norges beste bilutleiekjede.

Hvem er du?

  • Du har førerkort klasse B

  • Du har plettfri vandel (politiattest kreves)

  • Du er serviceinnstilt og god med mennesker

  • Du trives med salg

  • Du arbeider strukturert og håndterer logistikk effektivt i en hektisk og stadig skiftende arbeidshverdag.

  • Du behersker norsk og engelsk, muntlig og skriftlig

  • Du har gode datakunnskaper, gjerne Microsoft Office

Hva tilbyr vi?

Hos Sixt blir du en del av et selskap som vokser, og som vet at gode kundeopplevelser starter med dyktige medarbeidere.

• En aktiv og variert arbeidshverdag sentralt i Oslo sentrum
• Et godt arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte kolleger
• Grundig opplæring og tydelige rammer
• Reelle utviklingsmuligheter for den som vil mer

Klar for å bli en del av Sixt? Vi vurderer søknader fortløpende, søk i dag.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sixt Bilutleie er en internasjonal bilutleiekjede med 4500 utleiestasjoner i 118 land.  Sixt er verdens største BMW kunde og er kjent for å tilby premium biler i hele verden. Sixt er en premium utleiekjede med sterkt fokus på service, kvalitet og sikkerhet.  I Norge har vi 70 utleveringssteder og er til stede på alle de store flyplassene. Sixt i Norge har mer enn 50 års erfaring med mobilitet, og har drevet en landsdekkende kjede i 20 år. Det er Autoleie AS konsernet som har franchise rettighetene for Sixt i Norge, og har hovedkontor i Kristiansand. Konsernet er opptatt av å drive en sunn drift og har levert bransjens beste resultater de siste årene.

jobs.title: Barselsvikar søges til køkkenet på Agerskov Ungdomsskole
jobs.description:
Har du lyst til at lave god, hjemmelavet mad til en masse dejlige unge mennesker? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

På Agerskov Ungdomsskole søger vi en barselsvikar til vores køkken. Vi laver hver dag mad til vores elever, og vi går op i at maden både er hjemmelavet, sund, varieret og lækker. Vi bager selv, laver stor og spændende salatbar og prøver hele tiden at finde på nye retter, som vores unge mennesker har lyst til at spise.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil bl.a. være:

- Madlavning fra bunden

- Bagning af brød og andet godt

- Klargøring og vedligeholdelse af vores salatbar

- Opvask og rengøring

- Praktiske opgaver i køkkenet

- Weekendvager

Du kommer til at blive en del af vores køkkenteam, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen, men du skal også kunne tage ansvar og arbejde selvstændigt, når det er nødvendigt.

Arbejdstid

Stillingen er et barselsvikariatet på 37 timer i ugen startende hurtigst muligt. Ansættelsesperioden aftales endeligt ved ansættelsen.

Hvem er du?

Vi forstiller os, at du:

-Elsker at lave mad og har lyst til lave mad til mange

-Er positiv, fleksibel og har godt humør

-Kan arbejde selvstændigt og sammen med andre

-Har lyst til at være en del af livet på en efterskole med unge mennesker

-Ikke er bange for at tage fat, når der er travlt

-Gerne en uddannelse inden for køkken, ernæring og gastronomi- men det vigtigste er, at du har erfaring, engagement og lyst til jobbet

Hos os er der ikke to dage der er ens, og du kommer til at arbejde tæt på både elever og kolleger. Vi syntes selv, at vi har en rigtig dejlig arbejdsplads, hvor der er plads til grin, kreativitet og gode ideer- samtidig med at vi tager vores mad og arbejde seriøst.

Har du lyst til at blive en del af vores køkken på Agerskov Ungdomsskole, så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send din ansøgning til: koekken@agerskovungdomsskole.dk

Ansøgningsfrist 21.10.26

Samtaler afholdes i uge 44

jobs.title: Embedded electronics and integration engineer
jobs.description:
**Role summary**

You are a hands-on electronics engineer focused on fast build–assemble–test–integrate cycles for reference models and NRE projects. Your work shortens iteration loops and increases throughput across multiple customer deliveries, ensuring hardware modules are built and validated reliably.

**What youll do**

- Assemble and bring up PCBs and modules; validate electrical and optical subsystems against defined checks and acceptance criteria.Debug hardware issues efficiently (power, signals, timing, communication, sensor behavior) and document findings and fixes.

- Support integration with firmware/software teams, including effective data sharing on interfaces such as UART/SPI/I²C, timing coordination, power modes, and logging/telemetry.

- Maintain practical test setups and measurement pipelines: fixtures, rigs, scripts, checklists, build documentation, and bench discipline to ensure repeatable results and smooth transfer to manufacturing.

- Interact with manufacturing and component partners to support builds, resolve issues, and improve build quality and consistency.

- Contribute to next-generation hardware concepts through component evaluations, sensor/illumination experiments, and new integration approaches — improving delivery speed and reducing rework across NRE and customer builds.


**What we expect**

- Strong hands-on competence in embedded electronics: PCB/module assembly, bring-up, debugging, and systematic fault isolation.

- Comfort with lab instrumentation and measurement workflows (e.g., oscilloscopes, power supplies, multimeters; building reliable test routines).

- Practical understanding of embedded interfaces and system integration constraints (UART/SPI/I²C, timing, power, signal integrity at a working level).

- Documentation discipline: you leave behind clear build notes, checklists, and test procedures others can repeat.

- Ability to work independently in a small team, prioritize effectively, and unblock others quickly.

- Experience with optical/IR components, cameras, illumination, or sensor systems is a plus.

- Embedded programming experience (including FPGA-adjacent and HDL work) is a plus, but not required.


**What we offer**

- A core role in building and validating real hardware in a deep-tech company shipping demanding sensing systems.

- Direct impact on delivery speed, reliability, and customer success; close collaboration with the founders and the core engineering team.

- Variety of work across reference designs, customer NRE builds, and next-generation prototypes.

- Competitive compensation aligned with experience; potential equity participation depending on role seniority and responsibilities.

- A culture that values technical rigor, clear communication, and practical execution over bureaucracy.

- Comprehensive health-care package, gym access


**Details**

Reporting to: Chief Technology Officer

Location: Joensuu, Finland, on-site work

Travel: Infrequent

Work authorization: Relocation assistance provided

**Send or submit your CV and portfolio.**

jobs.title: Vi søker utleieansvarlig til vår avdeling i Bergen
jobs.description:
Ramudden Norge AS er en helhetsleverandør innen sikkerhet på arbeidsplassen, med spesialkompetanse på løsninger for trafikkerte miljøer. Vi leverer utstyr, tjenester og kunnskap som bidrar til å skape trygge arbeidsplasser hver eneste dag.  

Vi ser nå etter en engasjert og dyktig kollega til et ettårig vikariat ved vår avdeling i Bergen. Vi ønsker å få vår nye kollega på plass så snart som mulig, og for den rette kandidaten kan det også være muligheter videre etter endt vikariat.

Som utleieansvarlig får du en variert arbeidshverdag der kundekontakt, utleie og koordinering går hånd i hånd med praktiske oppgaver på lageret. Du blir en viktig del av den daglige driften, og vi ser etter deg som liker å ta ansvar, holde oversikt og bidra til god flyt i en tidvis hektisk hverdag. Samtidig er du en lagspiller som samarbeider godt med de rundt deg og har sikkerhet og kvalitet i fokus.

 

Hva vil du jobbe med?  

De viktigste arbeidsoppgavene dine: 

  • Mottak, lasting og lossing av varer
  • Plukking, pakking og klargjøring av utstyr til prosjekter
  • Sørge for god orden og struktur på lageret
  • Ansvar for utleie, inkludert oppfølging av kunder, sjekklister og fakturering
  • Samhandle med kolleger, sjåfører og øvrige avdelinger
  • Daglig bruk av truck og hjullaster
  • Montering av varsling og sikringsutstyr ved arbeid på og langs vei

 

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som trives med ansvar og har evne til å holde oversikt i en variert og tidvis hektisk arbeidshverdag. Du følger opp oppgaver, prioriterer når det er mye som skjer og trives med å koordinere arbeidet på lageret.

Hos oss er samarbeid en viktig del av hverdagen. Vi håper derfor du er en kollega som bidrar positivt, hjelper til der det trengs og er opptatt av å skape en god arbeidshverdag sammen med menneskene rundt deg.

For å lykkes i rollen tror vi at du:

  • Jobber strukturert og nøyaktig
  • Er selvgående og løsningsorientert
  • Trives i dialog med både kunder og kolleger
  • Har et tydelig fokus på sikkerhet i arbeidshverdagen

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Kompetansebevis M4 – Hjullaster
  • Gyldig truckførerbevis T1-T4
  • Bestå APV 1 og 3 (ikke et krav før ansettelse)
  • Gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig
  • Er komfortabel med bruk av digitale verktøy i arbeidshverdagen

Det er en fordel om du også har:

  • Erfaring fra lignende rolle eller relevant bransje
  • Førerkort klasse BE og CE

 

Hvorfor velge oss?

Hos oss blir du en del av et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte kolleger som samarbeider godt, deler kunnskap og har det hyggelig sammen på jobb. Du får en variert rolle med ansvar og mulighet til å bli en viktig del av den daglige driften ved avdelingen og bidra til et viktig sikkerhetsarbeid på og langs veiene.

Vi tilbyr:

  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser
  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med hjelpsomme og trivelige kollegaer
  • En trygg arbeidsplass i et selskap som setter kvalitet og sikkerhet først

 

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Da håper vi du sender oss en søknad. Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

 

Søknadsfrist: 30.10.26 – Vi vurderer søknader og tar kontakt med aktuelle kandidater fortløpende.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ramudden Norge er en del av Ramudden Global med over 5 000 medarbeidere og 1 milliard euro i omsetning. Selskapet har hovedkontor i Gävle i Sverige, og består av over 70 avdelinger i 13 land fordelt på 2 kontinenter. Konsernets misjon er å bringe folk hjem trygt hver dag (To get people home safely every day). Ramudden i Norge har vokst siden starten i 2009 og spesielt etter 2015. I dag består selskapet av 13 forskjellige avdelinger fra Steinkjer i nord til Lindesnes i sør. Vi er drøyt 500 medarbeidere og omsetningen nærmer seg 500 millioner kroner, med store ambisjoner om å vokse enda mer. Ramudden leverer sikkerhetstjenester i og rundt veinettet og på byggeplasser i Norge, blant annet rådgivning, utleie av sikkerhetsutstyr, opplæring av personell, og tjenesteleveranser som f.eks. montering av utstyr og trafikkdirigering.

jobs.title: Leiar med hjarte for menneske og blikk for utvikling?
jobs.description:
I Klepp kommune arbeider me kvar dag for at barn og unge skal oppleva tryggleik, meistring og gode oppvekstvilkår. No søkjer me ein leiar som vil vera med å forma framtidas barnevern saman med dyktige medarbeidarar og sterke samarbeidspartnarar.

Me ser etter deg som veit at gode resultat blir skapte gjennom menneske. Du byggjer relasjonar, skapar tillit og får folk til å veksa. Samstundes er du fagleg trygg, strukturert og oppteken av kvalitet i arbeidet.

Dette er ei stilling for deg som ønskjer å utvikla, utfordra og skapa.

Kvifor Klepp?

  • Fordi du får høve til å leia ein teneste med stor betydning for mange menneske.
  • Fordi du får arbeida saman med kompetente og engasjerte kollegaer.
  • Her får du vera med på noko større enn deg sjølv - bidra i samhandling med andre til å gjera Klepp til ein kommune kor det er godt å veksa opp.

Bli med og skap gode oppvekstvilkår i Klepp kommune!

Me trur på krafta i gode relasjonar - gjer du det same, håpar me å høyra frå deg.

Søk i dag, og bli med på laget!


Arbeidsoppgåver

Barnevernstenesta i Klepp er ein viktig del av kommunen sitt samla arbeid for barn, unge og familiar. Me samarbeider tett med helsestasjon, barnehagar, skular,  PPT og fleire andre tenester for å finna gode løysingar rundt barnet.

Som leiar får du ansvar for å:

  • skapa retning og samhandling i tenesta
  • vidareutvikla ein kultur prega av tillit, læring og fagleg kvalitet
  • leggja til rette for at medarbeidarane lukkast og utviklar seg
  • sikra god drift, kvalitet og utvikling
  • styrkja samarbeidet med familiar, samarbeidspartnarar og kommunen elles
Kvalifikasjonar
  • Barnevernfagleg utdanning på masternivå, alternativ annen relevant utdanning på tilsvarande nivå (jfr § 15.6 lov om barnevern)
  • Relevant bachelorutdanning med erfaring frå barnevern og/evt  relevant vidareutdanning (jfr § 15.6 lov om barnevern)
  • Leiarutdanning, eller vilje til å ta dette
  • Leiarerfaring med dokumentert kapasitet til å leia menneske og utvikla fagmiljø
  • God forståing av lovverk, fagleg standardar og offentleg forvaltning
  • God munnleg og skriftleg framstillingsevne på norsk
Personlege eigenskapar

Du er først og fremst ein trygg, relasjonell leiar. Du ser menneska rundt deg og veit korleis du byggjer sterke lag. Samstudes trivst du med ansvar, tek gode avgjerder og står støtt når det krevst.

Du:
- byggjer tillit gjennom handlingar og kommunikasjon
- motiverer og utviklar medarbeidarar
- skapar engasjement og felles retning
- arbeider systematisk og målretta
- har fagleg integritet og høge ambisjonar på vegne av barna
- ser samanhengar og samarbeider godt på tvers av fag og tenester

Me tilbyr
  • Ei meiningsfull leiarstilling med stor samfunnsverdi
  • Dyktige og engasjerte medarbeidarar
  • Eit sterkt tverrfagleg miljø med fokus på tidleg innsats og samordna tenester
  • Konkurransedyktige løns- og arbeidsvilkår

Etsimme kotipalvelun asiakkaillemme Mikkelin ja lähikuntien alueelle itsenäiseen työskentelyyn pystyvää, hyvät ihmissuhdetaidot omaavaa, vastuullista hoitajaa. Kokemus vammaistyöstä katsotaan eduksi, koska pääpaino työssä sijoittuu vammaispalveluasiakkaisiin.

jobs.title: Would you like to combine your engineering studies with practical experience in project management and learn how technical solutions and business priorities come together?
jobs.description:
Would you like to combine your engineering studies with practical experience in project management and learn how technical solutions and business priorities come together?


At Gram Equipment, we develop and deliver equipment for industrial ice cream production worldwide. We are looking for an engineering student to join our Project Management team in Kolding, either as an intern or a student worker.


You will work alongside experienced colleagues and gain insight into how we coordinate projects, from technical requirements and planning to delivery. Along the way, you will learn how mechanical solutions, customer expectations, budgets and deadlines influence project decisions.


What you will be doing

You will support our project managers in their daily work, with tasks adapted to your skills, interests and study requirements. Your tasks may include:

  • Supporting project planning and following up on milestones, deadlines and outstanding actions.
  • Preparing and updating project documentation, status reports and meeting materials.
  • Participating in project meetings and following up on agreed actions.
  • Helping coordinate activities across Engineering, Sales, Production, Installation and Service.
  • Supporting the follow-up on project costs, changes and risks.
  • Contributing ideas to improve project processes and ways of working.


As you develop your understanding of our projects, you will have the opportunity to take responsibility for defined tasks with guidance from the team.


Who we are looking for

You are studying Mechanical Engineering, Global Business Engineering or a related engineering programme. You have a good understanding of mechanical principles and an interest in the business side of engineering, particularly how technical decisions affect costs, delivery and customer value.

We also imagine that you:

  • Are curious about project management and eager to apply your knowledge in practice.
  • Work in a structured way and follow through on your tasks.
  • Enjoy collaborating with people across different functions.
  • Take initiative and ask questions when you need input.
  • Communicate clearly in English, both spoken and written.

You do not need previous project management experience. What matters is your willingness to learn and contribute.


What we offer

You will gain practical experience in an international engineering company, with support and feedback from experienced project managers. You will work on real projects and develop your technical, commercial and coordination skills.


Our main office in Kolding offers an informal working environment with dedicated colleagues.


Looking for an internship? We will agree on the duration, scope and learning objectives in line with your study programme.

Looking for a student job? We will agree on working hours that fit in with your studies, with flexibility during exam periods.


Interested?

Please send your CV and a short application explaining your motivation. Let us know whether you are interested in an internship, a student job or either option, and include your preferred start date and availability.


We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Social- og sundhedshjælper søges til primær dagvagt på et kristent friplejehjem i Løsning
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at skabe et kristent friplejehjem, der føles som et HJEM? – Og samtidig være en del af et fællesskab, hvor faglighed, omsorg og værdier går hånd i hånd?

Løsning Friplejehjem åbnede i juni 2026 med 30 boliger. Vi er godt i gang med at skabe et hjem fyldt med liv, nærvær og fællesskab – og vi søger nu en engageret og omsorgsfuld social- og sundhedshjælper, som har lyst til at blive en del af vores team.

Stillingen er primært i dagvagt, men du skal være indstillet på, at der efter behov kan forekomme enkelte aftenvagter.

Hos os får du mulighed for at være med til at præge hverdagen, kulturen og fællesskabet på et nyt friplejehjem, hvor vi ønsker at gøre en positiv forskel for vores beboere – hver eneste dag.

Et hjem med mennesket i centrum

På Løsning Friplejehjem arbejder vi ud fra et kristent menneskesyn, hvor næstekærlighed, respekt, værdighed og omsorg er grundlæggende værdier.

Vi tror på, at et plejehjem først og fremmest skal være et HJEM. Et sted, hvor beboerne oplever tryghed, selvbestemmelse og livsglæde, og hvor der er plads til både fællesskab og individuelle ønsker og behov.

Vi ønsker at skabe en hverdag, hvor vi ikke blot løser plejeopgaver, men ser det hele menneske og har blik for de små øjeblikke, der gør livet værdifuldt.

Vi søger dig, der:

  • Er uddannet social- og sundhedshjælper.

  • Brænder for at skabe en tryg, værdig og meningsfuld hverdag for ældre mennesker.

  • Møder beboere, pårørende og kollegaer med respekt, varme og et positivt menneskesyn.

  • Er fagligt engageret, ansvarsbevidst og kan arbejde selvstændigt.

  • Værdsætter et godt kollegialt samarbejde og bidrager aktivt til et positivt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Er fleksibel og omstillingsparat – og trives med en hverdag, hvor vi hjælper hinanden på tværs.

  • Har lyst til at tage medansvar for udviklingen af vores fælles praksis og kultur.

  • Kan se dig selv arbejde ud fra vores værdigrundlag og omsætte det til handling i hverdagen.

Vi tilbyder dig:

  • En arbejdsplads, hvor værdierne ikke blot står på papir, men skal kunne mærkes i hverdagen.

  • En stilling primært i dagvagt med enkelte aftenvagter efter behov.

  • Mulighed for indflydelse på arbejdsgange, kultur og udviklingen af vores friplejehjem.

  • Et engageret kollegialt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og løfter i flok.

  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på høj faglighed, trivsel og arbejdsglæde.

  • En nærværende ledelse med fokus på dialog, tillid og frihed under ansvar.

  • En hverdag, hvor der er plads til humor, forskellighed og gode idéer.

  • Mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel i beboernes liv.

Vil du være en del af vores fællesskab?

Vi søger en kollega, som har hjertet på rette sted, og som har lyst til at være med til at skabe et hjem, hvor både beboere, pårørende og medarbejdere føler sig velkomne, set og værdsat.

Vi tror på, at den bedste ældrepleje skabes i fællesskab – gennem faglighed, nærvær, engagement og respekt for det enkelte menneske.

Har du lyst til at være med? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig!

Arbejdstid og ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er primært i dagvagt, men du skal være indstillet på, at der efter behov kan forekomme enkelte aftenvagter.

Du indgår i et fast weekendrul med 5 arbejdsweekender over 12 uger.

jobs.title: Agentic Product Manager
jobs.description:
About us:

Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.

Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.

Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you.

About the role:

We’re looking for a hands-on and strategically minded Product Manager to take the reins of our assistant surfaces and agent harness at DeepJudge. You’ll play a critical role in shaping the present and future of our platform by driving immediate impact across our go-to-market priorities while also thinking deeply about where we go next.

This is an opportunity to lead product in a high-caliber environment where you're empowered to innovate, move fast, and deliver real value to legal professionals at some of the most sophisticated law firms and legal departments in the world. This is an on-site role based in Zurich. You will report to the Head of Product.

We’re not building another AI wrapper. We’re building a product with real depth, differentiated by data access, search engine expertise, and deep customer understanding. Chat is quickly becoming the interface of choice, and we’re now moving towards long-horizon agentic tasks – right at the cutting edge of what’s proven in the market. We’re looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity, is energized by the opportunity to create, and knows how to “cook from scratch” — not just follow the norm.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own product strategy, roadmap and execution across our Agentic Surfaces and Harness, powering DeepJudge’s advanced AI reasoning features, with a strong focus on prioritization, user impact, and business value

  • Evolve our chat interface to make sure the user experience is the best fit for our target use cases

  • Prioritize feature requests across customers, vertical product areas and new strategic initiatives, balancing short-term go-to-market optimization with long-term discovery and strategic vision

  • Evolve our evaluation datasets and infrastructure to continuously improve our ability to take launch decisions with confidence

  • Assess the speed, quality and cost profile of model or harness changes and drive decision-making across tech and product leadership

  • Proactively identify new technologies and follow the latest agentic AI trends to drive efficiency and performance of complex, long-horizon tasks

  • Work directly with engineering leads to define and ship high-quality features fast

  • Collaborate with Design and Product Marketing to craft delightful and intuitive user experiences

  • Engage deeply with customers and prospects to gather insights, validate ideas, and translate feedback into roadmap priorities – combining direct feedback with scaled usage analysis to understand how our products are used, and sharing those learnings across the organization

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that drive adoption, engagement, and measurable value for our users

  • Take ownership of product decision-making across our agentic product area

You're a great fit if you:

  • Have strong product instincts and 5+ years of experience in digital product management, with a track record of building and launching impactful B2B SaaS products

  • Have hands-on experience building and shipping agentic applications and RAG systems – going beyond basic chatbot or AI workflow features

  • Have a deep understanding of agent evaluation techniques and have built or evolved evaluation datasets and processes before

  • Are familiar with the latest agentic AI trends and concepts – and keep following them

  • Are comfortable leading in a dynamic, fast-paced environment — from writing specs to running discovery calls to shipping fast

  • Think holistically about user problems, systems, and long-term platform value

  • Are humble, curious, and opinionated in the right ways — you seek input but aren’t afraid to take a stand

  • Don’t just follow frameworks or "best practices" — you know when to break them

  • Are energized by having a lot of ownership and working closely with smart, mission-driven teammates

  • Are able to work on-site from our Zurich office

  • Bonus: You have legal domain familiarity, or experience in search and knowledge management, agentic search and data retrieval, or LegalTech – or you’ve worked in/with law firms, legal departments, or regulated industries

What you can look forward to:

  • A high-impact role in shaping a product and company with huge potential

  • The chance to work on the cutting edge of long-horizon agentic AI, applied to real-world legal work

  • A strong, technical, and collaborative team that’s serious about building great software

  • A culture that encourages experimentation, curiosity, and thoughtful decision-making

Submit your application by October 16th. Our team will review all candidates after the closing date and reach out regarding next steps.

At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If this role excites you, but you feel you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a great fit.

jobs.title: Head of Crypto
jobs.description:
About us

Traditional banking has never really given people control over their financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. Same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. Getting there takes leaders who own outcomes across teams, not just tasks, and set the tone for refusing the “someone else will fix this” culture. If that's how you lead, you'll fit right in.

What you'll be doing

As the Head of Crypto, you will be the driving force behind a brand new, core pillar of Satispay's expansion into the cryptocurrency and Web3 space. We already have a high-potential strategy in place—your mission is to take the reins, execute it flawlessly, adapt it when necessary, and expand upon it wherever possible.

Given the strategic importance of this initiative to Satispay, you will work with a high degree of autonomy and have direct, frequent touchpoints with the Satispay founding team to align on execution, team scaling, and long-term vision.

Here’s what that looks like in practice:

  • Hire & Build Your Team: Identify talent needs, recruit, and structure a dedicated, high-performing cross-functional team from the ground up to bring Satispay's crypto vertical to life.

  • Execution & Strategic Evolution: Take ownership of our existing crypto roadmap. Drive its execution to deliver immediate impact, while continuously evaluating the market to make necessary adjustments and expand our offerings when new opportunities arise.

  • Executive Collaboration: Partner directly with the founders and C-level executives to ensure the crypto rollout continuously aligns with the company's ultimate mission to simplify everyday finance.

  • Product Development: Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of our crypto products—from infrastructure setup and go-to-market strategy to launch and continuous optimization.

  • Regulatory Navigation: Work in lockstep with the Compliance and Legal teams to ensure all products align perfectly with evolving European regulations (such as MiCA) and safeguarding standards.

  • Strategic Partnerships: Identify and establish crucial relationships with key players in the crypto ecosystem, including exchanges, custodians, liquidity providers, and blockchain networks.

You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership.

What we're looking for

We are seeking for an execution-focused, and product-minded leader with a deep passion for digital assets that matches our company culture.

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience in crypto/Web3 initiatives at a regulated Fintech, exchange, or crypto-native company.

  • Team Building: experience hiring, managing, and scaling specialized, high-performing teams in a fast-paced tech or financial environment.

  • Master of Execution: ability to take a high-level strategy and turn it into shipped products, scaling operations effectively from the ground up.

  • Industry & Market Expertise: Deep, technical understanding of blockchain architecture, crypto market dynamics, digital wallets, custody solutions, and Web3 infrastructure.

  • Regulatory Awareness: Solid knowledge of the European crypto regulatory landscape (e.g., MiCA, AML/KYC for digital assets) and a history of launching products within a strict compliance framework.

  • Strategic Adaptability: Ability to balance bold expansion with stringent risk management

  • Communication & Influence: Excellent ability to align internal and external stakeholders, translating complex crypto concepts into clear, actionable business updates for the founding team.

  • Language Proficiency: You are completely fluent in English. Knowledge of Italian is considered a plus.

We recognise that exceptional leadership comes in many forms. If you believe you have the vision, experience, and drive to help us shape the future of money, we encourage you to apply. We value the unique perspectives and strengths that exceptional leaders bring, even if their experience doesn't align with every listed requirement.

Why this is your place

This is a unique opportunity to leverage your experience and leadership to make a profound impact on a company poised for significant future growth. We operate on a principle of reciprocity: significant strategic impacts are met with meaningful rewards and opportunities.

  • Drive transformative impact. Lead critical functions and initiatives that directly contribute to our mission and impact millions of users and businesses.

  • Operate in high-growth. Thrive in a dynamic, fast-moving environment that demands bravery, resilience, and rapid, decisive action at scale. Experience the excitement of navigating growth where change is constant and the customer base/services are rapidly expanding.

  • Significant equity participation. Directly share in Satispay's success through a competitive Stock Option Plan designed to reward leadership and contribution to company growth and raise the bar for collective success.

  • Lead exceptional teams. Build, mentor, and collaborate with high-performing teams in a culture of ownership, collective success, and continuous improvement fueled by feedback. You will learn from the best and lead alongside founders who are hands-on.

CareAbout: how we support your impact

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world.

That’s why we created CareAbout:

  • ❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.

  • 💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.

  • ⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.

  • 🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy, flexible working hours.

  • 👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin.

Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs!


Learn more about us

Curious what it's actually like here? Our values and pillars shape how we work every day: explore them here.

jobs.title: Tilkallingsvikarer
jobs.description:
Om stillingen

Vi er en klinikk på spesialisthelsetjenestenivå som drifter i samarbeid med og på oppdrag fra Helse Vest. Pasienter henvises for behandling av rusavhengighet og psykiske lidelser. Som ansatt er du med å ivareta mennesker i sårbare og utfordrende livssituasjoner, så de kan oppleve trygghet og nå sine mål.

Vi trenger flere tilkallingsvikarer som kan jobbe både ved planlagt fravær som ferie og kurs, og på kort varsel på grunn av sykdom. Vi ser spesielt etter noen som kan jobbe på dagtid i hverdagene, men også på kveld, natt og helg, samt høytider som jul og påske. Skriv gjerne noe om din tilgjengelighet i søknaden.

Arbeidsoppgaver
Miljøarbeid i våre to døgnavdelinger; Deltagelse i aktiviteter, veiledning i daglige gjøremål og støttende tilstedeværelse inn mot pasientgruppen m.m. For sykepleier/vernepleier er det i tillegg medisinskfaglige arbeidsoppgaver i døgnklinikkene. 


Kvalifikasjoner og personlige egenskaper

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Det er ikke krav til formalkompetanse, men sykepleiere og vernepleiere oppfordres til å søke. Arbeidsoppgavene tilpasses søkers kvalifikasjoner. 
  • Engasjement for vår pasientgruppe
  • Erfaring fra miljøterapi og/eller rus og psykiatri er en fordel, men ikke et krav.
  • Førerkort klasse B, fortrinnsvis manuelt gir. Klinikken disponerer egne biler.

Personlige egenskaper

  • Personlig trygghet 
  • Fleksibilitet
  • Gode samarbeidsevner

Vi tilbyr
  • Vi kan tilby et godt arbeidsmiljø og tverrfaglig samarbeid
  • En arbeidsplass i hyggelige omgivelser på Kalfaret i Bergens bykjerne 
  • Lønn følger tariff for spesialisthelsetjenesten.

Virksomheten er en del av stiftelsen CRUX som er en ideell, landsomfattende og diakonal aktør innen helse- og sosialfeltet.

Stiftelsen CRUX tilbyr tjenester innen: 

  • Barnevern
  • Psykisk helsevern
  • Rus- og avhengighetsbehandling
  • Tilbud til aktive rusmiddelavhengige
  • Oppfølging etter soning og behandling
  • Aktivitetssenter for mennesker med utviklingshemming
  • Akutt overnattingstilbud til bostedsløse barnefamilier

Vårt formål er å avdekke hjelpebehov i befolkningen og bidra med tiltak for å bedre livskvaliteten for mennesker som trenger det.

I CRUX er vi medvandrere som står opp for mennesker i sårbare og utfordrende livssituasjoner, slik at de kan oppleve trygghet og nå sine mål. 

Med over 600 ansatte og rundt 170 frivillige medarbeidere er vi til stede fra Tromsø til Kristiansand. Virksomheten er preget av høy faglig kvalitet og en tydelig verdiprofil. 

Som ideell stiftelse går eventuelle overskudd tilbake til utvikling og drift av virksomheten.

jobs.title: Varastopäällikkö
jobs.description:
**Etsimme varastopäällikköä kehittämään ja johtamaan varastomme toimintaa**

Sun Effects Oy on suunnittelu- ja tuotantotalo, joka lisäksi vuokraa laadukasta tapahtumakalustoa ja maahantuo valaisinlaitteita.

**Valo-, nosto- ja ripustuskaluston** (rigging) lisäksi varastoimme **lavastus- ja somistemateriaalia**, joka ei aina sovellu tavanomaiseen lavavarastointiin. Jokainen kalustoryhmä vaatii oman tapansa säilyttää, pakata ja käsitellä – ja juuri siinä tarvitsemme sinun osaamistasi.

**Varastopäällikkönä** pyörität varaston arkea, johdat pientä tiimiä käytännönläheisesti ja ymmärrät kaluston liiketoiminnallisen potentiaalin. Toivomme, että sinulla on kokemuksen lisäksi omaa näkemystä varastonhallinnasta: miten tilaa, sijainteja, tavaravirtoja ja työvaiheita järjestetään niin, että kalusto löytyy, pysyy kunnossa ja liikkuu sujuvasti. Keikkojen pakkaamisesta ja purkamisesta huolehtivat yleensä projekteille palkatut teknikot.

**Tehtävässäsi**

· **Johdat varaston päivittäistä toimintaa** – keräilyt, lähtö- ja paluutarkastukset, kaluston kunnossapito ja huoltojen ohjaus, inventaariot sekä varaston järjestys, turvallisuus ja erilaisille kalustoryhmille sopivat säilytys- ja pakkausratkaisut.

· **Hallitset tavaravirrat** – varastomme kautta kulkevat myös maahantuomiemme valaisinlaitteiden lähetykset sekä päivittäiset pakettilähetykset ja -vastaanotot. Huolehdit, että saapuvat ja lähtevät toimitukset kirjataan, tarkastetaan ja lähetetään ajallaan.

· **Toimit esihenkilönä** varaston tuntityöntekijöille ja tarpeen mukaan työskenteleville freelancereille: suunnittelet työvuorot, perehdytät, jaat työt ja huolehdit, että jokainen tietää mitä tehdään ja miksi.

· **Varmistat riittävät resurssit -** buukkaat apuvoimia tarpeen mukaan huomioiden kiirehuiput ja loma-ajat.

· **Kehität vuokraustoiminnan tuloksellisuutta** – seuraat kaluston käyttöastetta ja kuntoa, tuot näkemystä hankintoihin ja hinnoitteluun, huolehdit että vauriot, puutteet ja lisätyöt kirjataan ja laskutetaan, ja palvelet vuokra-asiakkaita noudoissa ja palautuksissa.

· **Koordinoit logistiikkaa** - vastaat kuormien suunnittelusta ja kommunikoit sujuvasti tuotannon, myynnin ja logistiikkakumppaniemme kanssa kuljetusaikatauluista

· **Kehität varaston toimintaa** – sinulla on näkemystä prosessien, Rentmanin hyödyntämisen, viivakoodi-/RFID-merkintöjen, työturvallisuuden ja tilankäytön kehittämiseen.

· **Toimit kiinteässä yhteistyössä** huollon, tuottajien ja myynnin kanssa ja tuot varaston näkökulman mukaan jo projektien suunnitteluvaiheessa.

**Toivomme sinulta**

· **Ymmärrystä keikka-alan rytmistä ja halua oppia**, mitä kalusto vaatii. Kokemus tapahtuma-, AV-, valo-, ääni- tai vuokraamoalalta on plussaa, mutta ei välttämätöntä.

· **Esihenkilö- tai työnjohtokokemusta**, mieluiten myös vaihtuvista keikkatyöntekijöistä.

· **Kaupallista silmää** - näet kaluston pääomana, joka hyvin hoidettuna ja oikein käytettynä tuottaa.

· **Kokemusta varastonhallinta- tai vuokrausjärjestelmistä** – käytämme Rentmania, jonka tuntemus on etu.

· **Järjestelmällisyyttä ja kykyä hahmottaa isoja kokonaisuuksia** – organisoit, ennakoit ja siedät painetta. Pidät langat käsissäsi, vaikka samaan aikaan on käynnissä useita tuotantoja, vuokrauksia ja toimituksia.

· **Selkeää viestintää** suomeksi ja englanniksi.

· **Sujuvia perustaitoja toimisto-ohjelmista** (esim. Microsoft 365 tai Google Workspace)

· **B-ajokorttia ja työturvallisuuskorttia.**

**Katsomme eduksi**

· Kokemus prosessien kehittämisestä

· Trukinajotaito

· C-ajokortti ja kuormansidonnan osaaminen

· Kokemus kuljetusten tai alihankkijoiden koordinoinnista ja kustannusseurannasta

**Tarjoamme**

· Keskeisen roolin kasvavassa tapahtuma-alan yrityksessä, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten varasto ja vuokraus toimivat

· Vakituisen, kokoaikaisen työn monipuolisten tehtävien parissa mielenkiintoisella toimialalla

· Palkka: 3300-3800 eur/kk kokemuksen ja osaamisen mukaan

· Edut: liikunta- ja kulttuurietu, työterveyshuolto, puhelinetu

Työpaikka sijaitsee Helsingin Roihupellossa. Työajat painottuvat arkipäiviin, mutta alan luonteen mukaisesti työ vaatii ajoittain joustoa iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin.

jobs.title: Associate Professor in Population Genetics and Plant Breeding
jobs.employer: NORGES MILJØ- OG BIOVITENSKAPELIGE UNIVERSITET (NMBU) CAMPUS ÅS
jobs.description:
About the position

Be part of the future with NMBU!

The Department of Plant Sciences (IPV), Faculty of Biosciences, at the Norwegian University of Life Sciences (NMBU) has a vacancy for a permanent 100% position as Associate Professor in Population Genetics and Plant Breeding.

We are looking for an ambitious researcher and dedicated educator to strengthen NMBU's internationally recognized research and education in plant genetics, population genetics, and plant breeding with a focus on forage crops. This position represents a strategic investment in one of the department's core academic disciplines and will play a key role in educating the next generation of plant breeders and geneticists while advancing research that contributes to sustainable agriculture and future food security.

The successful candidate is expected to establish an internationally competitive research group within population genetics and plant breeding, with particular emphasis on quantitative genetics, breeding methodologies, genomics, genetic diversity, and the breeding of outcrossing crops. As part of our academic team, you will teach and supervise Bachelor, Master, and PhD students, contribute to attracting competitive national and international research funding, and strengthen collaborations with breeding companies, research institutes, and universities in Norway and abroad. 

You will play a leading role in further developing our educational portfolio within genetics and plant breeding and contribute to innovative teaching methods and student-active learning.

The successful candidate will become part of a highly interdisciplinary research environment with close collaboration across the Department of Plant Sciences, the Faculty of Biosciences, and other faculties at NMBU. The position also offers opportunities to contribute to interdisciplinary initiatives in population genetics, genomics, breeding methodologies, and climate-resilient agriculture, supporting both plant and animal science communities.

We are proud to educate highly skilled graduates and to conduct research with a strong societal impact. We are looking for candidates who combine scientific excellence with a passion for teaching, collaboration, and innovation. We look forward to welcoming a new colleague who will help shape the future of genetics and plant breeding at NMBU.


Main tasks

The successful candidate is expected to

  • Conduct research of the highest international standard and strengthen research in population genetics, genomics, genomic selection, breeding methodologies, and climate-resilient crop development.
  • Publish regularly in peer-reviewed international journals.
  • Contribute to both basic and applied research.
  • Secure external funding from national and international funding agencies, including Horizon Europe and the Research Council of Norway.
  • Supervise PhD, MSc and BSc students.
  • Contribute to innovation and collaboration with industry and breeding organization. 
  • Network and collaborate within and outside NMBU and actively participate in interdisciplinary research initiatives across NMBU.
  • Contribute to the strategic development of plant genetics and breeding activities at the department.
  • Develop and deliver high-quality teaching in population genetics, plant breeding, quantitative genetics, genomics, and bioinformatics for plant breeding across Bachelor's, Master's, and PhD programmes.
  • Contribute to educational excellence through student supervision, curriculum development, pedagogical innovation, and the implementation of research-based teaching and modern digital learning approaches.
  • Conduct administrative tasks and other joint tasks at the faculty in collaboration with colleagues and students.

Competence

All qualifications below are required for the position, unless it is specified that they are considered an advantage. 

Academic qualifications:

  • A PhD in Plant Breeding, Population Genetics, Plant Science, or other fields related to the described position.
  • Ability to develop and lead internationally recognized research within the subject area.
  • Competence and experience with genetic research on forage crops.
  • Experience in planning and conducting field experiments.
  • Documented research output / publication record such as international peer-reviewed publications in relevant scientific journals, books, and research reports within population genetics and plant breeding.
  • Experience with research relevant to Nordic agricultural conditions is considered an advantage
  • Experience with research leadership is considered as an advantage

Educational qualifications (documented):

  • Pedagogical education completed separate program at minimum 200 hours*.
  • Teaching experience from higher education.
  • Supervision experience.
  • Basic teaching skills in planning, implementing, evaluating and development of own teaching and supervision.
  • Experience with educational leadership is considered an advantage.

    *Those who do not meet the educational qualification at the time of employment shall be required to meet them within two years of employment.

Applied knowledge, among others

  • Experience with dissemination is considered an advantage.
  • Experience with industry collaboration is considered as an advantage.

Management, committees and boards and administration, among others

  • Experience with management, committees and boards and administration is considered an advantage.

Special qualifications, among others

  • Good written and oral communication skills in a Norwegian (or another Scandinavian language) and English is a prerequisite for performing the duties of the position.

Personal qualities, among others

  • Outstanding collaborative and communicative skills both to the scientific community and to a broader community.
  • Strong, professional commitment to excellence in teaching.
  • Ability to realize scientific synergies between individual researchers and research groups.
  • Strong potential for independent thinking displaying initiative and careful creative thought.
  • Experience with building and maintaining a productive and energized research group.

Remuneration and further information

The position is placed in position code 1011 Associate Professor (NOK 720 000 – 1 100 000) depending on qualifications. For particularly well-qualified applicants, a higher salary may be considered. Seniority promotion in the position. 

Interested in learning more about the position? We are happy to tell you more about life on campus. Contact Section leader and researcher Sahameh Shafiee, tel:  +4767232769, (e-mail: sahameh.shafiee@nmbu.no). 

General information for applicants


Application

Send application electronically via the link "Apply for this job" at the top of this page. 

Application Deadline: : November 6, 2026

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge's CV form and not just included as an attachment. This is in order to be able to comply with the regulations in the Public Administration Act §15.

The following must be included in the application:

  • Short application text about your motivation
  • Reflective statement (3–6 pages) addressing your reflections on the requirements of the position (see the job advertisement).
  • Academic CV, diplomas and certificates
  • Completed template for documentation of competence, link to template here.
  • List of publications. Attach up to 15 scientific works that, according to assessment, are central to the production. If it is difficult to identify personal efforts in joint work, a brief account of your part of the work must be attached.

NMBU has developed a matrix for assessing qualifications, which provides examples of results/competence, documentation, and reflection for all areas of the competence profile. We encourage you to familiarize yourself with the matrix and use it when applying for the position. See this page for more information on how to document your qualifications and write a reflection note.

Documents that cannot be sent electronically are sent in triplicate by ordinary mail marked still.nr. 26/09329 to NMBU, Faculty of Biosciences, P.O. Box 5003, NO-1432 Ås, within 06.11.2026.

Please note that the report from the expert committee will be sent to all applicants.


About The Faculty of Biosciences

The Faculty of Biosciences (BIOVIT) aims to shape the future of food and bioproduction through teaching and research in biology and sustainable production and use of plants, livestock and fish. The faculty has a large project portfolio and an annual turnover of approximately NOK 250 million. 

BIOVIT is organized into seven research groups: Genome Biology, Breeding, Genetics and Food Production Systems, Ruminant Nutrition and Physiology, Ethology and Animal Welfare, Nutrition and Physiology for Monogastric Animals, Plant Biology, Sustainable Food Systems and Integrated Plant Protection, and Genetics, Evolution and Sustainable Plant Production. Additionally, the faculty has seven research support and laboratory units.

BIOVIT is responsible for bachelor’s and master’s programs in aquaculture, biology, animal science, and plant science, as well as English-language master’s programs in Agroecology, Plant Sciences, Feed Manufacturing Technology, and Genome Sciences. BIOVIT also offers Ph.D. programs in animal science and plant science. Currently, the faculty has about 550 bachelor’s and master’s students and 90 Ph.D. students. BIOVIT employs approximately 230 staff members and has its own faculty administration.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

NMBU will contribute to securing the future of life through outstanding research, education, communication and innovation. We have the country's most satisfied university students, who receive research-based education in a unique student environment. Our graduates gain a high level of competence in interdisciplinary collaboration and are popular in the labor market.

NMBU has internationally leading research environments in several subjects. Together with our partners in society and business, we contribute to solving some of the biggest societal challenges of our time. We focus on innovation, communication and entrepreneurship because we believe these challenges are best solved with joint efforts. We believe that a good working environment is characterized by diversity.If necessary, workplace adaptations will be made for persons with disabilities. More information about NMBU is available at www.nmbu.no/en

jobs.description:
IN SHORT

Are you a versatile problem-solver who wants to write software that impacts the physical world? As a Full Stack Software Engineer (100%) in Zurich, you will be at the core of our operations, building systems that touch everything from warehouse automation to customer-facing smart fridges.


YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Take ownership of warehouse and supplier web apps used daily for inbound processing, picking, labeling, and inventory.
  • Develop and maintain our internal back-office tool, including the backend and GraphQL API that runs menus, deliveries, inventory, and customer sites.
  • Manage the service connecting automated picking lanes to the rest of the system to ensure uninterrupted warehouse operations.
  • Maintain and update the Point of Sale Android app running on hundreds of fridges, managing the release process for the entire fleet.
  • Integrate and support payment systems (Card, TWINT), our ERP, and other partner integrations.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation to debug live issues directly alongside the operations team.
  • Visit the warehouse on-site to test changes and gather feedback from the people actually using the software.
  • Translate vague problems from non-technical colleagues into shipped solutions without needing them broken down first.
  • Own production deployments, managing logs, alerts, and careful rollouts with clear rollback plans.
  • Break down larger features, review other engineers' pull requests, and proactively maintain system health through upgrades, testing, and cleanup.


YOUR PROFILE

  • Proven production experience in at least one typed backend language (such as C#, Java, Kotlin, Go, or TypeScript) and one modern frontend framework.
  • Track record of successfully owning software in production, including on-call duties, debugging from logs, and resolving live issues while users wait.
  • Familiarity with or willingness to dive into C#, TypeScript, Android, and Kotlin.
  • Prior exposure to hardware, IoT, edge devices, payments, logistics, retail operations, or Odoo environments is highly advantageous.
  • Demonstrated ability to dive into unfamiliar tech stacks, learn quickly, and ship reliable code.
  • Strong passion for collaborating directly with end-users, including warehouse and operations staff, rather than exclusively with other engineers.
  • High degree of curiosity and a proactive mindset to take full ownership of problems from end to end.
  • Fluent English communication skills (written and spoken); knowledge of German or French is a plus.
  • Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.
  • Valid work permit or Swiss passport.


OUR BENEFITS

  • Lots of delicious food, just a few steps away from your desk - we make your gastronomic dreams come true
  • Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team, thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine
  • 5 weeks holiday per year, as well as the chance to buy an extra week of vacation 
  • Two full weeks of ‘work from anywhere’ per year to bring more variety to your work day
  • We care about your future with an above-mandatory pension fund
  • New parents get 16 or 3 weeks, respectively, of fully paid parental leave. We also support the return to work by making a generous financial contribution to childcare until the child reaches kindergarten age.
  • We encourage our employees to use public transport by covering your half-fare travelcard
  • Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outing
  • Stay active and healthy with our weekly sports sessions
 
Does this sound like the job for you? We can't wait to learn more about you! APPLY NOW with your complete documents in either German or English.


ABOUT US

FELFEL is all about good food and coffee in the workplace: we help Swiss employers become masters of hospitality. 
With our smart fridge ‘FELFEL’ and delicious barista coffee ‘Gavetti’, we enable companies to provide their employees with first-class, ultra-fresh food and drinks throughout the day. Whether hearty and traditional, modern and vegan or high in protein - our weekly changing menu ensures that all employees always have something to be excited about ;).

FELFEL is a family business that was founded in 2013. Today, we take care of around 1000 locations in Switzerland, and have 150 employees across our offices in Lausanne, Zurich and New York.
