jobs.title: Skønne Frederik i Farum mangler sin voksenven. Så søger du et deltidsarbejde, hvor hyggelige cykelture er i højsædet så se her!
jobs.description:
Måske er du uddannet socialpædagog, pædagog eller har masser af erfaring med børn med særlige behov. Og kan du betegne dig selv som værende moden, med en mental robusthed, og trives med en fast struktur så se her!

Om Frederik                                             

Frederik er 8 år gammel men grundet hans kognitive udfordringer er han sammenligning med et barn på 1,5. Han har diagnoserne infantil autisme og mental retardering i sværere grad. Derudover har Frederik ADHD og har ikke et talesprog. Frederik er en sød og kærlig dreng som hurtigt viser tillid til de personer han omgås. Kvag hans diagnoser er Frederik meget afhængig af en fast struktur, rutiner og forudsigelighed, så det er et krav at du som hjælper har erfaring indenfor området og kan bidrage til en struktureret og forudsigelig dag. 

 

Om opgaven 

Opgaven går ud på at aflaste forældrene i eftermiddagstimerne, hvor en stor del af dette er, at hjælpe Frederik ud på sin faste daglige tur ud af huset, på en fast rute i det naturskønne område omkring familiens hjem. Til turen som varer ca. en time, har familien en el dreven ladcykel til formålet. 

Derudover holder Frederik også af at hoppe på familiens trampolin i haven, så du skal som hjælper også bruge tid på trampolinen, sammen med ham. Det er vigtigt at du er klar på at Frederik skal overvåges hele tiden og have hjælp til det meste i løbet af dagen, inklusiv eventuel hjælp til bleskift.. Familien vil stå for grundig oplæring af alle opgaver omkring Frederik, da det er vigtigt for dem at du som hjælper føler dig tryg og du vil derfor blive budt indenfor i et kærligt og omsorgsfuldt hjem. 

Hvem er du?

Du skal være i stand til at skabe de trygge rammer og forudsigelighed som Frederik har behov for. Have et kærligt sind, let til smil og sidst men ikke mindst, lyst til at være fysisk aktiv på de daglige cykelture året rundt som jobbet kræver. Kan du sige ja til disse ting, vil du blive budt indenfor hos en kærlig, rummelig familie hvor du vil gøre en kæmpe forskel.

Timerne

Stillingen er på 18 timer om måneden fordelt på 1 til 2 vagter om ugen om eftermiddagen i hverdage fra ca. kl. 14.00 og 3-4 timer per vagt som planlægges med familien. Der vil på sigt når der er dannet en solid tryg relation imellem Frederik, hans familie og dig være mulighed for flere timer, hvor disse også kan placeres om natten.               

                                
 Hvem er Olivia Danmark ? 

  • Vi står for kvalitet, viden og dedikation og arbejder med det daglig. 
  • Vi tror på ordentlighed i alt det, vi gør 
  • Vi arbejder med at vi meningsfuldt forskellige
  • Vi tager ansvar og skaber løsninger – hver dag


  Løn og vilkår

Som ansat hos Olivia Danmark er du sikret Løn og ansættelsesvilkår som følger overenskomst med FOA, og fastsættes ud fra dine kvalifikationer og erfaring.

Ansøgning og kontakt 

Ansøg stillingen hurtigst muligt eller inden deadline. Vi kalder løbende til samtale, så skriv gerne til os i dag.   

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte Charlotte Bay Wedebye på mail charlotte.wedebye@oliviadanmark.dk 

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Rengøringsassistent til Teknisk Drift og Anlæg
jobs.description:
Teknisk Drift og Anlæg søger en rengøringsassistent til rengøringsafdelingen i en fast stilling.
Rengøringsafdelingen er på 40 rengøringsassistenter, som foretager rengøring af skoler, institutioner, administration m.m.
Rengøringen foregår i hele Struer Kommune, men alle har faste arbejdsområder.
 
Vi står og mangler en rengøringsassistent til institutionsrengøring i Struer Kommune.

Vi søger en ansvarsbevidst rengøringsassistent, der trives med at arbejde selvstændigt.

Arbejdet er morgenrengøring fra kl. 5.00 og på 35,50 timer om ugen i en fast stilling.
 
Struer Kommune er en røgfri arbejdsplads, så der er ikke tilladt at ryge i arbejdstiden.
 
En tilfredsstillende straffeattest og en ren børneattest er en forudsætning.
 
Kørekort er påkrævet.
 
Tiltrædelse: 23. oktober 2026.

Ansøgninger modtages kun via link.
 
Har du spørgsmål er du velkommen til at ringe til afdelingsleder for rengøringen Tine Stage tlf.nr. 41150382.
 

Hvem er vi?
I Struer Kommune er det opgaven, der sætter holdet. Det er din faglighed og gode dømmekraft, der skal være fundamentet for det samspil, du skaber med borgeren og virksomhederne.
Sammen skaber vi stærke partnerskaber og er fælles om at udvikle fremtidens velfærd. Men hvad er fremtidens velfærd? Vi har ikke svarene alene. Derfor skal vi have medarbejdere, der sætter spørgsmålstegn og borgere og virksomheder, som udfordrer. Vi stiller krav til os selv, men vi forventer ligeledes noget af borgerne og virksomhederne. Gode løsninger kommer, når alle bidrager til fællesskabet. 

Læs mere om Struer Kommune

Lydens By
Vi er Lydens By. Lyden er en inspirationskilde til nye projekter og initiativer, der kan realisere kommunens vækstpotentialer og styrkepositioner til et lokalsamfund, som mennesker har lyst til at besøge, arbejde og bo i.

For os er det naturligt, at vores byudvikling tager udgangspunkt i lyd, og vores kunstværker bruger lyden aktivt. Vi arbejder med, hvordan lyd påvirker livskvaliteten positivt hos demente, indlæring hos børn eller fraværet af lyd skaber arbejdsglæde.

Lyd er i vores DNA.

Læs mere om vores visioner og strategier.


Går du med flyttetanker?
Du har lyst til at søge ovenstående stilling, men er lidt i tvivl om, hvilke muligheder du har for at flytte til? Måske er det nødvendigt, at din partner også finder job i området? Struer Kommune har en Tilflytterservice, hvor du eller din partner ganske gratis og uforpligtende kan få direkte og personlig hjælp, hvis du går med overvejelser om at flytte til Struer. Kontakt Tilflytterservice på tilflytterservice@struer.dk eller 96 84 87 94. 

Du er også velkommen til at søge inspiration på www.flyttilstruer.dk

At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, design, QA, and sales, and work with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence the evolution of our platform to meet our customer’s needs.

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and maintain backend services for the distributed streaming platform that powers the foundation for Camunda 8’s orchestration capabilities, ensuring durability, high availability, and horizontal scalability.

  • Lead medium‑to‑large engineering initiatives (3+ months) end‑to‑end: partner with Product to translate business problems into technical requirements, write solution designs, draft and maintain project plans, and drive timely, high‑quality delivery.

  • Help mature our disaster recovery and resilience story, including implementing and evolving an online backup/restore API and contributing to improved multi‑region and multi‑tenant capabilities for our cloud offering.

  • Design and implement developer and operator tooling that makes it easier to understand, troubleshoot, and safely operate a complex distributed system in production environments.

  • Improve engineering effectiveness by collaborating with DevOps and other Core Application teams on CI, testing, and local development workflows to reduce PR time‑to‑merge and the overhead of working on multiple features in parallel.

  • Participate in L3 support and on‑call rotations, partnering closely with Support and SRE to investigate and resolve complex, performance‑sensitive production issues, and feeding what you learn back into our product and platform.

What You Will Bring to the Role:

Must Haves:

  • 7+ years of professional experience as a software engineer, with a strong focus on backend systems and/or distributed systems.

  • Proven experience leading medium‑to‑large engineering initiatives (roughly 3+ months), breaking down ambiguous problems, writing clear solution designs and project plans, coordinating with multiple teams, and driving predictable delivery.

  • Hands‑on experience building and maintaining highly concurrent, data‑intensive software, with a deep understanding of low‑level network and disk I/O (for example, throughput, latency, backpressure, batching, and failure modes).

  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously and navigate ambiguity – you are comfortable taking on problems you haven’t solved before, breaking them down into concrete steps, and driving them to completion with minimal supervision.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in a remote‑first environment: you tailor explanations to your audience, translate business requirements into actionable technical work with Product, and help teams reach clear, decisive outcomes with minimal churn.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience building workflow automation or process orchestration software.

  • Experience with distributed systems algorithms or protocols such as Raft, Paxos, SWIM, and/or CRDTs.

  • Strong familiarity with the observability pillars (logging, metrics, tracing) and how to integrate observability into the development and incident lifecycle, ideally including experience with L3 support and on‑call.

  • Deep knowledge of the Java Virtual Machine, especially its memory model and performance characteristics in highly concurrent, data‑intensive workloads.

jobs.title: People & Production Manager - Material & Delivery
jobs.description:
Are you ready to lead a major production organisation and play a key role in shaping the future of one of Sweden's leading manufacturing businesses? At DOVISTA, you'll have the opportunity to drive operational excellence, develop leaders and make a lasting impact in an international industrial environment.

<img src="https://sae3ndp007.blob.core.windows.net/swe/4aa67c38-b348-4a74-81f8-9b8225ef9e06.jpg">

Your Opportunity

We are looking for a strong people and operations manager to take responsibility for our Material & Delivery operations, a critical part of our window manufacturing business. Leading approximately 200 employees through a team of six first-line managers and two process developers, you will play a key role in driving performance, strengthening the organisation and ensuring operational excellence across the organisation.

This role offers the opportunity to take responsibility for a large production area and make a significant impact on people, culture and operational performance. Whether you currently manage a production department, a manufacturing unit, or a sizeable operational team, you are motivated by driving results through others and developing strong leadership teams.

You will work closely with our Senior Director, Head of Operations Sweden, and be part of the production management team, contributing to both strategic direction and operational execution. This is a visible leadership position with significant responsibility and the opportunity to make a lasting impact on people, performance and culture. With around 600 colleagues at our Edsbyn site, you'll join a growing team in a company that's shaping the future.

Who You Are

You have a solid background in manufacturing or industrial operations and a track record of creating results through people, structure and continuous improvement. You are comfortable taking responsibility for a larger operation, setting clear expectations, and creating accountability at all levels of the organisation. Just as important, you know how to engage people, develop talent and build a culture where performance and collaboration go hand in hand.

We believe you have:

    Proven experience from a manufacturing or industrial environment.
    Experience building strong teams and creating results through others
    A track record of driving operational improvements and delivering results
    Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
    A university degree in engineering, production, operations, or a related field, or equivalent experience gained through a successful leadership career in manufacturing.
    Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken
    To be considered for this position, you must hold a permanent work permit in Sweden.

Why Edsbyn?

Choosing to live and work in Edsbyn means embracing balance. You'll find proximity to nature, space for family life, and a welcoming community - all while making a real impact in a globally connected business. For the right person, this role offers a rare combination of significant leadership responsibility, long-term career opportunities, and a high quality of life in one of Sweden's most scenic regions.

Application

This recruitment is managed in collaboration with Jefferson Wells. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Recruitment Consultant Marjo Carlson at +46 70 377 06 64 or marjo.carlson@jeffersonwells.se.

Please submit your CV and a cover letter explaining your interest in the position and how your background, experience, and qualifications make you a strong fit for the role.

Please note that we do not accept applications via email. To be considered for this position, all applications must be submitted through our recruitment system.

Apply as soon as possible, but no later than 2026-10-17.  Selection is ongoing, and the position may be filled before the application deadline.

About DOVISTA

DOVISTA is a leading European provider of vertical windows and exterior doors. With 13 distinctive brands and approximately 7,000 employees across 10 markets, the Group is locally strong and internationally connected, driven by a shared purpose to bring daylight and fresh air into people's everyday lives.

DOVISTA is built on a heritage rooted in Danish design, an entrepreneurial mindset and industry knowledge dating back to 1941. The company is part of the VKR Group and is wholly owned by VKR Holding A/S, a family- and foundation-owned company that includes a grant-giving Employee Foundation. Together, the VKR Group employs approximately 17,600 people in 38 countries.

About DOVISTA Sweden

DOVISTA Sweden brings together well-known brands such as Svenska Fönster, Mockfjärds Fönster, and VELFAC with local experts within a strong international group.

With approximately 700 employees, we are one of Sweden's leading window manufacturers. Together, we develop sustainable, high-quality solutions with a focus on our customers and the future.

jobs.title: Food Business Leader
jobs.description:
Inter IKEA Group connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and ensures alignment of the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce, and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone.

With our desirable and sustainable offer, Food is an essential part of the IKEA experience and our Swedish heritage. It is a strong reason for customers to visit, stay longer, and return more often. Food is often also a starting point to connect with the IKEA Brand. It shall always be convenient for customers to enjoy our accessible food offer in different store formats and at every meeting point – always with a focus on families with children.

This role is positioned in Commercial team within the Food RA structure, reporting to the Commercial Manager. You will lead the business by setting the preconditions for successful consumer and customer meetings. You drive growth by maximizing the commercial positioning, performance, and business opportunities of both the existing range and the new products and solutions under development.

Our team is based in Älmhult. We believe that your presence with the team and working the majority of the time in the workplace is important.  

We are looking to hire 4 colleagues.

Job Description

As a Food Business Leader, you will be responsible for the end-to-end commercial business result and commercial direction of the assigned business and range scope, including global, regional and market-specific range. You will own the commercial content and priority of the Range Matrix, lead the commercial relationship with assigned anchor markets and bring one ranked commercial agenda into portfolio governance. Together with the Product Developer and Product Sourcing Leader, you will contribute to early joint direction setting by connecting customer and market needs with product possibilities and supplier capabilities.

On a typical working day, you will:

    Be responsible for the commercial business result for the assigned scope, including growth, profitability, affordability, positioning, relevance and range performance.  
    Be responsible for the commercial content and priorities, based on customer, retail, market, competitor and performance insights.  
    Define the customer proposition for the scope, including occasion, emotional value, price perception and desired customer response.  
    Act as main speaking partner for assigned reference markets and primary commercial contact for the scope across all markets, including relevant Market Operations Forums.  
    Bring one prioritized commercial agenda into portfolio governance, aligned with the Range Direction and supported by fact-based business cases.  
    Set the early direction and co-create the business brief with the Product Developer and Product Sourcing Leader, defining what the business needs and why.  
    Represent the full commercial teamat agreed development milestones, decision gates and performance reviews.  
    Responsible for pricing, improves and running range, including reference sales price, affordability, customer value and required profitability.  
    Responsible for commercial decisions, business cases and investment priorities for certifications and voluntary standards. Quality and Compliance own verification and legal compliance.  
    Monitor business and range performance, act on deviations and align Retail and development partners on corrective actions.

Qualifications

The role as a Food Business Leader requires you to have:

    High knowledge of the IKEA Vision, Business Idea, Culture and Values, with a good understanding of the IKEA business model, strategic landscape and ways of working.
    Deep knowledge of the assigned Food business and range scope, including customer needs, market differences, competitors, commercial performance, growth opportunities and range/product development.
    High knowledge of commercial business leadership and how data, insights, business cases and scenario analysis support decisions across the value chain.
    Strong business and commercial leadership, with the ability to take accountability for results, set priorities, make trade-offs and translate insights into clear commercial direction and business cases.
    Strong ability to understand the total business picture, connect strategic direction with tactical and operational priorities, and draw systematic conclusions from performance, financial and market data.
    Strong ability to lead, influence and build trust across a complex matrix, align stakeholders around common outcomes, communicate direction clearly and navigate ambiguity and change without formal authority.
    Passion of creating profitable growth, affordability and a relevant offer for the many people, taking end-to-end ownership from insight to results.
    Motivation by building strong relationships and working across countries, cultures, functions and organisational boundaries towards common business outcomes.
    Curiousity about changes in society, customer behaviour, markets and competitors, and motivated by challenging existing solutions and leading in a changing environment.

Additional information

We welcome your application!

We look forward to receiving your application by 18th of October at the latest. Apply by submitting your CV - please note that we do not ask for a cover letter in this recruitment process. Instead, you will have the opportunity to tell us more about you and your experience through the screening questions in the application system.  

We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we might start interviewing early.

If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, or if you have a special need that requires accommodation in the recruitment process, feel free to contact the Recruiter Bence Denes.

jobs.title: IT-Manager
jobs.description:
SantaPark Arctic World on matkailu ja elämysalan yritys, jonka toiminnan ytimessä ovat ainutlaatuiset elämykset, lämminhenkinen palvelu ja intohimo erinomaisuuteen. Konserniimme kuuluvat SantaPark – Christmas Theme Park, Santa Claus Secret Forest – Joulukka, Arctic TreeHouse Hotel, Rakas Restaurant & Bar, Hidden Arctic Cloud Villas, AINO Private Island sekä Lapland Luxury DMC.

Tavoitteenamme on luoda vieraillemme elinikäisiä muistoja. Haluamme tarjota myös henkilöstöllemme innostavan työympäristön, jossa on mahdollisuus oppia, kehittyä ja rakentaa yhdessä jotakin ainutlaatuista.

Etsimme kokenutta ja kehittämishenkistä IT Manageria vastaamaan konsernimme IT-ympäristön toimivuudesta, turvallisuudesta ja jatkuvasta kehittämisestä. Tehtävässä yhdistyvät IT-kokonaisuuksien hallinta, kehitysprojektit ja käytännönläheinen ongelmanratkaisu. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä konsernin CTO, ulkoisen IT-palvelukumppanin ja liiketoimintayksiköidemme kanssa varmistaen, että teknologiset ratkaisumme tukevat sujuvaa arkea ja korkeatasoista asiakaskokemusta.

**Keskeiset vastuualueesi:**

- Konsernin IT-ympäristön, järjestelmien, laitteiden ja infrastruktuurin hallinta ja kehittäminen

- IT-strategian toteuttaminen, IT-budjetin seuranta ja kehityshankkeiden koordinointi

- Tietoturvan, tietosuojan ja järjestelmien toimintavarmuuden varmistaminen

- IT-palvelukumppaneiden, toimittajasuhteiden ja palvelutasojen hallinta

- Järjestelmäkäyttöönottojen, integraatioiden ja muiden IT-projektien johtaminen

- Henkilöstön IT-tuen sujuvuuden varmistaminen sekä vaativampien teknisten haasteiden ratkaiseminen


**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Etsimme oma-aloitteista ja ratkaisukeskeistä IT-alan ammattilaista, joka hallitsee laajoja kokonaisuuksia ja tarttuu tarvittaessa myös käytännön tekemiseen.

Odotamme sinulta:

- Soveltuvaa IT-alan koulutusta tai vastaavaa työkokemuksen kautta hankittua osaamista

- Vahvaa kokemusta IT-ympäristöjen hallinnasta ja kehittämisestä sekä vastuullisista IT-tehtävistä

- Hyvää osaamista verkoista, pilvipalveluista, tietoturvasta ja liiketoimintajärjestelmistä

- Kokemusta IT-projektien johtamisesta, toimittajayhteistyöstä ja kustannusten hallinnasta

- Itsenäistä ja kehittämisorientoitunutta työotetta sekä hyviä yhteistyö- ja ongelmanratkaisutaitoja

- Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa


Arvostamme kokemusta matkailu-, majoitus- tai palvelualalta sekä ymmärrystä sesonkiluonteisen liiketoiminnan erityispiirteistä.

**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**

- Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän ainutlaatuisessa matkailualan konsernissa

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa konsernin IT-ratkaisuihin ja kehittää toimintaa pitkäjänteisesti

- Itsenäisen roolin ja tiivistä yhteistyötä eri liiketoimintojen, johdon ja IT-asiantuntijoiden kanssa

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi ja kasvaa ammatillisesti

- Innostavan ja yhteistyöhenkisen työyhteisön sekä SantaPark Arctic Worldin henkilöstöedut


Tehtävä on kokoaikainen ja vakituinen, ja työskentelypaikkasi sijaitsee Rovaniemellä. Työhön sisältyy liikkumista konsernin eri toimipisteiden välillä. Raportoit tehtävässä talousjohtajallemme.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Lähetä hakemuksesi ansioluetteloineen viimeistään 26.10.2026 - Odotamme innolla kuulevamme sinusta!

jobs.title: Chip Ecosystem Partnership and Funding Manager, The position is a Senior Advisor at TEK Innovation
jobs.description:
Do you want to help facilitate and grow the semiconductor and chip ecosystem in Denmark and beyond, working with the leading researchers in the field, and to turn potential into opportunities, partnerships and projects? Then this job could be for you.  

About the position 

SDU Microelectronics at TEK, headed by professor Farshad Moradi, is part of the Danish Chips Competence Centre (DkCCC) - the new Danish hub for chip technology and your strategic platform. The position offers an opportunity to play a central role in strengthening Denmark’s chip ecosystem and to help connect the ecosystem with fast-growing application areas such as drones, robotics, sensors and autonomous systems, where advanced chip technology is becoming increasingly critical for performance, reliability, energy efficiency and future innovation. 

You will work closely with SDU researchers, DkCCC partners, Danish universities, companies, incubators, industry organizations, funding advisers and European chip networks. Learn more here www.dkccc.eu 

The position involves regular travel within Denmark and occasional travel elsewhere in Europe. 

Your main responsibilities will include:  

  • Identifying relevant national and European funding opportunities in chip technology, semiconductor development, and chip-enabled applications. 

  • Developing and maintaining a strategic pipeline of funding calls, project ideas and potential consortium partners. 

  • Engaging proactively with Danish start-ups, SMEs and established companies to understand their technological needs and funding requirements. 

  • Connecting companies with relevant researchers, facilities and competencies at SDU and other Danish universities. 

  • Helping companies and researchers translate technical and business ideas into fundable project concepts. 

  • Initiating and facilitating Danish and European consortia for chip-related funding calls and identifying opportunities to join existing consortia. 

  • Promoting Danish chip competencies and contribute to the visibility and strategic development of DkCCC.  

  • Supporting the full process of funding applications, from project objectives and facilitating consortiums, to coordinating proposals with partners and funding advisers. 

  • Building relationships with key stakeholders, organizing activities, and events supporting the ecosystem.   

Your profile 
You have a relevant master's degree, for example within engineering or natural sciences, business development or innovation management, economics or business administration, European studies or public policy, research and innovation management, or another relevant field. 

You have documented experience in one or more of the following: 

  • National or European research and innovation funding 

  • Development of collaborative funding proposals 

  • Consortium building and partner identification 

  • University–industry collaboration or innovation/business development 

  • Supporting start-ups, SMEs or deep-tech companies 

  • Stakeholder management and professional networking 

We are looking for a colleague who: 

  • Is proactive and comfortable initiating contact with companies, researchers and potential partners.  

  • Is a strong relationship builder who can establish trust across organizational and disciplinary boundaries 

  • Understands both commercial needs and academic interests and can structure complex consortium-development processes, while maintaining momentum towards a deadline 

  • Communicates clearly with different stakeholders, technical, academia and experts, business 

  • Works independently and is persistent and solution oriented, while also contributing actively to a team 

Experience with semiconductors, microelectronics, integrated circuits, quantum technologies, photonics, sensors or other deep-tech fields is a significant advantage — though you don't need to be a chip designer. What matters more is your ability to grasp technology-based opportunities, engage technical specialists, and turn complex ideas into fundable partnerships. Knowledge of European research and innovation programs, including EU Chips Act calls, is also an advantage. 

What we offer 

  • Become part of SDU’s growing environment for microelectronics and chip technology. 

  • Build partnerships that may lead to new products, technologies, companies, and investments. 

  • Work directly with promising Danish start-ups, companies and research environments. 

  • Help create new university–industry collaborations. 

  • Develop national and European networks within a strategically important technology area. 

  • Influence the formation of projects from their earliest stages.  

  • Collaborate with leading researchers and industry specialists, in an international and interdisciplinary environment. 

  • A role with considerable independence and the opportunity to shape the methods, networks, and activities used to identify funding opportunities and develop consortia. 

Your organizational home will be TEK Innovation, the research support and innovation unit at TEK, where you will have colleagues with similar jobs, supporting emerging ecosystems, as well as funding advisors and project managers. Your academic home with SDU Microelectronics, where you will work closely with professor Farshad Moradi and his team.  

For further information about the position, please contact: 

Thit Juul Hvid, Head of TEK Innovation, The Technical Faculty at The University of Southern Denmark tjuul@tek.sdu.dk 

Professor Farshad Moradi, SDU Microelectronics, The Technical faculty at The University of Southern Denmark at moradi@sdu.dk  

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support. 

The application deadline is November 1, 2026 at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST).

First Interview: week 46, second interview, week 47.

The startdate will be January 1, 2027, or at the earliest convenience.

Salary and employment terms:  

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”. 

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application must include cover letter, CV and exam certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All documents must be in English and PDF format.  All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected.  

You can only apply for the position at – https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu. 

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

jobs.title: Barneverntenesta
jobs.description:
Vil du bruke juridisk kompetanse i eit fagfelt der gode rettslege vurderingar har stor betydning for barn og familiar?

Øygarden barnevernteneste søkjer ein engasjert og fagleg trygg juridisk rådgivar som ønskjer å bidra til god kvalitet, god rettstryggleik og vidare utvikling av tenesta.

Stillinga er eit vikariat som går fram til januar 2028.

Som juridisk rådgivar hos oss vil du arbeide tett med leiarar og tilsette i barneverntenesta. Du vil få ei sentral rolle i å sikre god forvaltningspraksis og forsvarleg sakshandsaming, samstundes som du får høve til å bidra aktivt i fag- og tenesteutvikling.

Vi ser etter deg som trivst i skjeringspunktet mellom juss, fag og menneske, og som evnar å gjere komplekse juridiske problemstillingar forståelege og anvendelege i praksis.

Er du ein som:

  • er engasjert i barn og familiar og har respekt for menneske i krevjande livssituasjonar?
  • er oppteken av rettstryggleik og god offentleg forvaltning?
  • trivst med komplekse juridiske problemstillingar?
  • er nøyaktig, strukturert og løysingsorientert?
  • likar å samarbeide og dele kompetansen din med andre?
  • ønskjer å bidra til utvikling – ikkje berre forvalte dagens praksis?

Då ønskjer vi deg med på laget vårt!

Om barneverntenesta

Barneverntenesta  i Øygarden er organisert saman med Familihjelpa, Familiehelsehjelpa og Lærings- og inkluderingssenteret. Tenesta omfattar om lag 60 stillingar og er organisert i fleire fagteam.

Vi arbeider målretta med kvalitet, rettstryggleik og utvikling av tenestene våre.

Landsbymodellen er ein sentral del av utviklingsarbeidet vårt. Med utgangspunkt i tanken om at det trengst ein heil landsby for å oppdra eit barn, arbeider vi for å setje barnet og barnet sine behov i sentrum og mobilisere ressursane rundt barnet og familien.

Familie, nettverk, kommunale tenester og andre samarbeidspartnarar er viktige ressursar i arbeidet med å skape tryggleik og varige endringar for barn og unge. Gjennom Landsbymetodikken ønskjer vi også å styrkje samhandlinga mellom tenestene, slik at barn og familiar opplever meir heilskaplege og koordinerte tenester.

Som juridisk rådgivar vil du vere ein viktig del av dette utviklingsarbeidet. Du skal bidra til at fagleg utvikling og nye arbeidsmåtar skjer innanfor gjeldande rettslege rammer, og at omsynet til barnet, rettstryggleik og forsvarleg sakshandsaming vert ivareteke.

 

Arbeidsoppgåver:

Som juridisk rådgivar vil du ha varierte arbeidsoppgåver og arbeide tett på den faglege verksemda i barneverntenesta og den daglege drifta. Arbeidsoppgåvene vil mellom anna vere:

  • Sakshandsaming og klagebehandling etter barnevernslova og anna relevant regelverk
  • Handsaming av krav om innsyn
  • Juridisk rådgiving og rettleiing til leiarar og tilsette
  • Juridisk bistand i faglege vurderingar og beslutningsprosessar
  • Bidra til å sikre god forvaltningspraksis, rettstryggleik og forsvarleg saksbehandling
  • Bidra i internkontroll, kvalitetsarbeid og avvikshandtering
  • Utvikling og kvalitetssikring av rutinar og prosedyrar
  • Undervisning og opplæring av tilsette innan relevante juridiske tema
  • Bidra med juridisk kompetanse i fag- og tenesteutvikling, mellom anna i vidareutviklinga av Landsbymodellen/Landsbymetodikken

Arbeidsoppgåvene vert i hovudsak utførte innanfor fleksibel arbeidstid. Arbeid på ettermiddag må påreknas, særleg i samband med akuttarbeid. Den juridiske rådgivaren vil ha eit fagleg fellesskap med kommuneadvokaten. Kommuneadvokaten vil vere ein sentral samarbeidspartnar og bidra med juridisk rettleiing og fagleg støtte.

Kvalifikasjonar:Må ha:
  • Juridisk embetseksamen eller master i rettsvitskap
  • God juridisk metodeforståing og evne til å gjere sjølvstendige juridiske vurderingar
  • God munnleg og skriftleg framstillingsevne på norsk
  • Førarkort klasse B
Ønskjeleg med:
  • Erfaring frå barnevernsfeltet eller anna relevant offentleg forvaltning
  • Kunnskap om forvaltningsrett og offentleg saksbehandling
  • Erfaring med juridisk rådgiving og rettleiing
  • God digital kompetanse
Personlege eigenskapar:
  • Er fagleg trygg, nøyaktig og kvalitetsmedviten
  • Har god rolleforståing og høg etisk bevisstheit
  • Møter barn, familiar og samarbeidspartnarar med respekt og forståing
  • Har gode analytiske evner og trivst med komplekse problemstillingar
  • Arbeidar strukturert og klarer å prioritere når fleire oppgåver og lovpålagde fristar skal handterast samtidig
  • Kan arbeide sjølvstendig, samtidig som du trivst med samarbeid og tverrfagleg arbeid
  • Kommuniserar juridiske vurderingar på ein tydeleg og forståeleg måte
  • Er fleksibel og løysingsorientert
  • Er nysgjerrig på andre sine perspektiv og bidreg positivt inn i faglege drøftingar
  • Ønskjer å bidra til eit trygt, inkluderande og utviklingsorientert arbeidsmiljø

Personleg eignaheit vil bli tillagt stor vekt.

Anna:
  • Gyldig politiattest må leggjast fram før tiltreding
Vi tilbyr:
  • Ei spennande juriststilling innanfor eit viktig samfunnsoppdrag
  • Varierte og fagleg utfordrande arbeidsoppgåver
  • Tett samarbeid og fagleg rettleiing frå kommuneadvokaten
  • Eit kompetent og engasjert fagmiljø
  • Høve til å påverke og bidra i utviklinga av barneverntenesta
  • Erfaring frå eit rettsområde der juridiske vurderingar har stor betydning for barn og familiar
  • Gode moglegheiter for fagleg og personleg utvikling
  • Fleksitidsordning
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordningar
Kontakt:

For meir informasjon om stillinga ta kontakt med:

Einingsleiar Hege Gundersen
Telefon: 934 84 846
E-post: Hege.Gundersen@oygarden.kommune.no

Øygarden kommune ønskjer eit arbeidsmiljø prega av mangfald, og at våre medarbeidarar i størst mogleg grad skal spegla mangfaldet i befolkninga. Vi oppmodar alle som er kvalifiserte til å søkja jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, eller minoritetsbakgrunn. Som IA-verksemd ønskjer kommunen å leggja til rette for arbeidsforholda dersom du har behov for det.

Etter utløpet til søknadsfristen, vert det sett opp ei offentleg søkjarliste med namn, alder, stilling eller yrkestittel og bustads- eller arbeidskommune for kvar søkjar. Det kan gjerast unntak frå innsyn for opplysningar om ein søkjar dersom vedkomande sjølv ber om det. Opplysningar om ein søkjar, kan verta offentlege sjølv om søkjaren har bede om ikkje å vert ført opp på søkjarlista. Dersom oppmodinga ikkje vert teken til følgje, vert søkjaren varsla om dette. Ved vurderinga av om ei slik oppmoding skal takast til følgje, skal det leggjast vekt på om det knyter seg særleg offentleg interesse til stillinga.


Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Øygarden kommune er den nest største kommunen i Vestland fylke med om lag 40 700 innbyggjarar og om lag 2 800 tilsette. Straume er kommunesenter (ca. 15 minutt køyring frå Bergen) med kommunedelsenter på Rong, Ågotnes og i Skogsskiftet. Administrasjonsspråket i Øygarden er nynorsk. Øygarden kommune har sett seg som mål å vera ein framtidsretta og kunnskapsbasert samfunnsutviklar med fortrinn innanfor energi, teknologi og marine ressursar. Kommunen skal løfta fram viktige verdiar som felles kultur, språk og identitet. Vi har ambisjonar om å vera ein handlekraftig og effektiv organisasjon med god leiing, høg kompetanse og kvalitet.

jobs.title: HEMFRID HALMSTAD SÖKER FLEXIBEL SERVICETEAMARE i VARBERG
jobs.description:
HEMFRID SÖKER EN FLEXIBEL SERVICETEAMARE I VARBERG

Har du erfarenhet av städning och tycker om att arbeta med kvalitet och service? Är du flexibel och trivs med varierande arbetsdagar? Hos Hemfrid får du möjlighet att kombinera praktiskt arbete med ansvar och stöd till kollegor.

Vi söker nu en flexibel serviceteamare till Varberg med omnejd. Som serviceteamare har du en varierad roll där du både utför olika typer av städuppdrag och bidrar till att våra kunder får en hög och jämn kvalitet. Du arbetar nära Area Manager och Field Lead och blir en viktig del av teamet ute på fältet.

Vad erbjuder vi?

    

En tjänst på 75 %

    

Kollektivavtal och trygga anställningsvillkor

    

Fast månadslön – samma lön varje månad

    

Milersättning mellan kunder för dig som kör egen bil i tjänsten

    

Betald restid mellan kunder

    

Försäkringar (sjukdom, ansvar och tjänstepension)

    

Friskvårdsbidrag på 2 400 kr per år

    

Gratis mobilabonnemang

    

Kostnadsfri utbildning i hemstädning samt vidareutbildningar inom service och städning

    

Teamträffar och gemensamma aktiviteter

Om rollen

Som serviceteamare hjälper du till att säkerställa kvaliteten i våra uppdrag och fungerar som ett stöd för både kunder och medarbetare.

Dina arbetsuppgifter kan bland annat vara:

    

Startstädningar

    

Storstädningar

    

Fönsterputs

    

Vikariepass

    

Kvalitetskontroller

    

Introduktion av nya medarbetare vid behov

    

Nyckelhantering vid behov

Du arbetar i Varberg med omnejd. Eftersom rollen innebär varierande arbetsuppgifter söker vi dig som är flexibel och kan anpassa dig efter verksamhetens behov.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av hemstädning och som är van vid att arbeta med kvalitet och service. Du är trygg i dina arbetsuppgifter och tar ansvar för att arbetet blir utfört på ett noggrant och professionellt sätt.

Vi ser gärna att du:

    

Är flexibel och trivs med varierande arbetsdagar

    

Är noggrann och kvalitetsmedveten

    

Är ansvarstagande och självgående

    

Har ett professionellt och serviceinriktat bemötande

    

Trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och i team

    

Är lösningsorienterad och har lätt för att anpassa dig

    

Vill utvecklas och ta mer ansvar

    

Har möjlighet att arbeta i Varberg med omnejd

Erfarenhet av storstädning, flyttstädning eller fönsterputs är meriterande.

Ansök redan idag!

Läs mer om oss och våra lediga tjänster på www.hemfrid.se/karriar och skicka in din ansökan.

Har du frågor? Kontakta oss gärna på hr@hemfrid.se.

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

HEMFRID IS LOOKING FOR A FLEXIBLE SERVICE TEAM MEMBER IN VARBERG

Do you have experience in cleaning and enjoy working with quality and customer service? Are you flexible and comfortable with varied working days? At Hemfrid, you will have the opportunity to combine hands-on work with responsibility and support for your colleagues.

We are now looking for a flexible Service Team Member in Varberg and the surrounding areas. As a Service Team Member, you will have a varied role where you carry out different types of cleaning assignments while helping ensure a consistently high level of service for our customers. You will work closely with the Area Manager and Field Lead and become an important part of the team in the field.

What do we offer?

    

A 75% position

    

Collective agreement and secure employment conditions

    

Fixed monthly salary – the same salary every month

    

Mileage compensation when using your own car for work

    

Paid travel time between customers

    

Insurance (health, liability and occupational pension)

    

Wellness allowance of SEK 2,400 per year

    

Free mobile subscription

    

Free training in home cleaning and continued professional development

    

Team meetings and social activities

About the role

As a Service Team Member, you help maintain the quality of our assignments and provide support to both customers and colleagues.

Your responsibilities may include:

    

Initial cleanings

    

Deep cleanings

    

Window cleaning

    

Covering shifts when needed

    

Quality inspections

    

Introducing new employees when needed

    

Key handling when required

You will work in Varberg and the surrounding areas. Since the role involves varied assignments, we are looking for someone who is flexible and able to adapt to the needs of the business.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for someone with experience in home cleaning who is comfortable working with quality and customer service. You are confident in your work and take responsibility for delivering thorough and professional results.

We believe you are:

    

Flexible and comfortable with varied working days

    

Detail-oriented and quality-focused

    

Responsible and self-driven

    

Professional and service-minded

    

Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team

    

Solution-oriented and adaptable

    

Motivated to develop and take on more responsibility

    

Able to work in Varberg and the surrounding areas

Experience in deep cleaning, move-out cleaning or window cleaning is an advantage.

Apply today!

Learn more about us and our vacancies at www.hemfrid.se/karriar and submit your application.

If you have any questions, feel free to contact us at hr@hemfrid.se.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Myyjä, S-market Kommila, Varkaus
jobs.description:
Primary location:
VARKAUS

S-MARKET KOMMILA etsii nyt MYYJÄÄ vakituiseen osa-aikaiseen työsuhteeseen - ihan tavallisiin töihin, harvinaisen mukavien työkavereiden joukkoon

Sopimustunnit: 15 t/vk
Työt alkavat: sopimuksen mukaan marraskuussa

Marketpäällikkö Suvi kertoo työskentelystä Kommilassa näin: Meille asiakaskokemus, työyhteisön kanssa #yhdessä tekeminen ja myymälän kehittäminen ovat ykkösjuttuja. Meillä pääset tekemään laajasti erilaisia kaupan alan tehtäviä asiakaspalvelusta ja hyllytyksestä aina S-kaupat-tilausten tekemiseen.

Myyjänä päiväsi kuluvat vaihtelevassa rytmissä asiakaspalvelun, kassatyön, kuorman purun ja hyllytyksen parissa. Tehtäviisi kuuluu myös S-kaupat-tilausten keräilyä sekä hävikin ja saatavuuden hallintaa. Perehdytämme sinut monipuolisesti koko kaupan tehtäviin. Työ on liikkuvaa ja nopeatempoista, joten päivät kuluvat vauhdilla eikä tekeminen käy yksitoikkoiseksi.

Tämä työ sopii sinulle, jos nautit asiakaskohtaamisista ja ihmisten kanssa työskentelystä. Kohtaat asiakkaat aidosti ja palveluhenkisesti sekä haluat auttaa niin asiakkaita kuin työkavereitakin onnistumaan. Kaupan vaihtelevassa arjessa työ edellyttää kykyä hallita useita asioita samanaikaisesti ja priorisoida tekemistä. Arvostamme reipasta ja huolellista työotetta, uteliasta asennetta sekä halua oppia jatkuvasti uutta. Työ on vuorotyötä, ja vuorot sijoittuvat noin klo 5-22 välille, joten työskentely eri vuoroissa onnistuu sinulta.

Edellytämme sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.
Arvostamme aiempaa työkokemusta kaupan alalta.

Mitä se ihan tavallinen työ meillä on
- Henkilökuntaetuja: alennuksia ruoasta, juomasta, meikeistä, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista, pankkipalveluista ja monesta muusta mukavasta asiasta.
- Epassin etuja: jopa 250 € arvosta vuodessa.
- Rahaa: tuntipalkka on kokemuksesta riippuen 11,16 €/t–14,93 €/t. Lisät maksetaan kaupan alan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti.
- Tulospalkkaus: mahdollisuus ansaita ylimääräinen jopa 2 kuukauden palkka vuodessa.
- Työpaikka, johon on kiva tulla ja olla. Ei tarvitse olla yhtä iloista perhettä, mutta älä ylläty, jos työkavereista tulee ihan vaan kavereita.
- Mahdollisuus vaihtaa tehtäviä tai alaa, jos itse haluat.

Työtä kuvataan usein korulauseilla, mutta meidän mielestämme tavallisuudessa ei ole mitään pahaa. Me Osuuskauppa PeeÄssällä sanomme olevamme ihan tavallisissa töissä - eikä se tarkoita tylsää porukkaa, päinvastoin. Työ on hyvää ja sujuvaa arkea, jossa teemme muiden arjesta, ja välillä juhlastakin, vähän parempaa. Ja joskus juhlitaan itsekin. Jos työpaikkailmoitusten kliseet kyllästyttävät, tule meille ihan tavallisiin töihin.

Jos ihan tavallinen työ hyvässä porukassa kuulostaa sinun jutultasi, hae mukaan jo tänään.

Hakuaika päättyy: 23.10.2026.

Lisätietoja: Marketpäällikkö Suvi Kuivisto, suvi.kuivisto@sok.fi, puh. 050 387 9482

Osuuskauppa PeeÄssä on yli 136 000 asiakasomistajan omistama palvelualan yritys Pohjois-Savossa. Tavoitteenamme on olla Parhaan Elämän Edelläkävijä Savossa. Meille se tarkoittaa merkityksellistä työtä, reilua työnantajuutta ja arjen sujuvuutta. Olemme ylpeitä siitä, että voimme tuottaa osuustoiminnallista hyötyä ja kehittää sitä jatkuvasti arvojemme mukaisesti: #tunteella, #toimeliaasti, #ylpeästi ja #yhdessä.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Mission Operations Services
jobs.description:
Loft Orbital is looking for a Backend Engineer to join our Mission Operations Services (MOS) team. MOS owns the backend services that let Loft operators and customers command, monitor, and automate our satellite fleet through Cockpit, our mission control system. You’ll help build and scale the microservices that sit between ground and flight software, turning high-level intent into safe, reliable on-orbit operations.
 
You’ll work across multiple satellite platforms and collaborate closely with backend, flight software, embedded systems, test, and satellite operations teams. This is a hands-on engineering role where you’ll both build new systems and help debug live missions. We also offer SatDevOps training, so you don’t just write the tools - you actually use them to operate spacecraft.
 
If you’re excited about building backend systems that directly control satellites - and you like the idea of both shipping code and helping fly missions - we’d love to hear from you.

About this Role
  • Design and build backend tools for operations: services that power passes, autopilots, activities, and day‑to‑day satellite operations.
  • Handle commands and telemetry across multiple satellite buses and ground segment providers, with a strong focus on safety, robustness, and observability.
  • Write production backend code in Python, owning services end‑to‑end from design and implementation through deployment and maintenance.

jobs.title: Site Manager – Interior Construction (Data Centre)
jobs.description:
Site Manager – Interior Construction (Data Centre)

About the Position

Mono Rakennus Oy is recruiting two experienced Site Managers for our data centre construction projects in Mäntsälä and Pori, Finland.

We are looking for professionals with strong technical knowledge and hands-on experience in interior construction and fit-out works, particularly Sandwich elements, drywall partitions, internal wall systems, suspended ceilings, structural ceilings (TATE-ceiling) and finishing works.

The successful candidates will be responsible for managing daily site operations, supervising construction teams, coordinating with the main contractor, and ensuring that all works are completed safely, efficiently, and according to project requirements.

Key Responsibilities

- Manage and supervise daily interior construction and fit-out activities.

- Coordinate installation works, including drywall partitions, internal wall systems, suspended ceilings, doors, and finishing works.

- Plan and allocate manpower, materials, tools, and equipment.

- Monitor construction progress and ensure compliance with project schedules.

- Supervise construction workers and subcontractors.

- Coordinate daily activities with the main contractor and other trades.

- Review construction drawings, technical specifications, and installation requirements.

- Conduct quality inspections and ensure compliance with project standards.

- Ensure compliance with site HSE requirements, RAMS, and safe working procedures.

- Prepare daily and weekly progress reports, including manpower allocation and completed quantities.

- Participate in site coordination and progress meetings.

- Identify potential delays and implement practical solutions.


Requirements

- **Currently residing in Finland.**

- **Valid right to work in Finland (work permit, where applicable).**

- **Minimum 3 years of construction site management experience in Finland.**

- Proven experience in interior construction and fit-out works.

- Strong knowledge of drywall systems, internal partitions, suspended ceilings, and finishing works.

- Ability to read and interpret construction drawings and technical documentation.

- Experience managing construction teams and coordinating multiple activities.

- Good understanding of Finnish construction practices, quality standards, and occupational safety regulations.

- Strong organisational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to work independently and take responsibility for site operations.

- Good command of English.

- Valid Occupational Safety Card (Työturvallisuuskortti).

- Category B driving licence.


Considered an Advantage

- Previous experience in data centre construction projects.

- Experience working with international main contractors.

- Relevant qualification in construction engineering or construction management.

- Finnish language skills.


What We Offer

- Opportunity to work on large-scale data centre construction projects in Finland.

- A responsible and independent position within a growing construction company.

- Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.

- Professional and international working environment.

- Opportunities for professional development and continued employment on future projects.


How to Apply

Please send your CV in English and salary expectation, including a brief description of your previous construction site management experience in Finland, particularly in interior construction and fit-out projects, to the following email address.

Info@monorakennus Oy

Please do not apply if you are outside of Finland we are not supporting visa or residence permit.

Please indicate your preferred working location (Mäntsälä or Pori) in your application.

**Only candidates who meet the mandatory requirements will be considered.**

jobs.title: Vi søger 2 produktionsmedarbejdere til dag- og aftenhold i Hillerød
jobs.description:
Opstart mandag den 12. oktober 2026 – mulighed for forlængelse

På vegne af en af vores kunder i Hillerød søger FIRMAVIKAR to stabile og arbejdsomme produktionsmedarbejdere til et midlertidigt vikariat med opstart mandag den 12. oktober.

Vi søger én medarbejder til dagholdet og én til aftenholdet.

Der er i første omgang tale om et vikariat på 2–3 uger, men der er gode muligheder for forlængelse i yderligere 3–4 uger.

Du bliver en del af produktionen hos vores kunde i Hillerød, hvor dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil være fyldning og håndtering af sække med forskellige materialer.

Sækkene kan veje op til 20 kg, og arbejdet kræver derfor, at du er fysisk robust og trives med en aktiv arbejdsdag.

Du vil få den nødvendige instruktion i arbejdsopgaverne ved opstart.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Fyldning og håndtering af sække på op til 20 kg

  • Håndtering og flytning af materialer

  • Praktiske produktionsopgaver efter instruktion

  • Sikre orden og ryddelighed i arbejdsområdet

  • Øvrige forefaldende opgaver i produktionen

Vi forventer, at du

  • Er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og klar til at tage fat

  • Har en god fysik og kan håndtere fysisk krævende arbejde

  • Arbejder effektivt og grundigt

  • Kan arbejde både selvstændigt og sammen med andre

  • Har en positiv indstilling og er fleksibel i forhold til arbejdsopgaverne

Erfaring fra produktion, lager eller lignende fysisk arbejde er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du er mødestabil, arbejdsom og har lyst til opgaven.

Daghold – 1 medarbejder

Fredag: Kl. 07.15–14.00

Aftenhold – 1 medarbejder

Mandag–torsdag: Kl. 14.15–23.00
Fredag: Kl. 13.00–19.45

Det er vigtigt, at du kan arbejde i hele den angivne periode og møde til tiden.

  • Et fuldtidsvikariat med hurtig opstart

  • Fast arbejdstid på enten dag- eller aftenhold

  • Et praktisk job med en aktiv arbejdsdag

  • En forventet ansættelsesperiode på 2–3 uger

  • Gode muligheder for forlængelse i yderligere 3–4 uger

  • Ansættelse gennem FIRMAVIKAR

Arbejdssted og opstart

Arbejdsadresse: Hammersholt Erhvervspark, 3400 Hillerød

Opstart: Mandag den 12. oktober 2026

Varighed: 2–3 uger med mulighed for forlængelse i yderligere 3–4 uger.

Ansøgning

Er du interesseret i stillingen, og har du mulighed for at starte allerede mandag den 12. oktober, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

jobs.description:
Vil du ha en variert og meningsfull arbeidshverdag der du gjør en forskjell for andre?

Hjemmetjenesten på Hemnesberget søker en engasjert sykepleier eller vernepleier til en fast stilling i 80-100 %. Hos oss får du en spennende og aktiv arbeidshverdag hvor du bidrar til at innbyggerne våre kan bo trygt og selvstendig i egne hjem så lenge som mulig. Vi er stolte av å tilby et godt fagmiljø, dyktige kollegaer og en arbeidsplass preget av tillit, mestring og høy faglig kvalitet. Stillingen inngår i dag- og aftenturnus, med arbeid gjennomsnittlig hver tredje helg. Det må også påregnes vakter ved andre avdelinger ved behov.

I Hemnes kommune er vi opptatt av at nye medarbeidere skal få en trygg og god start. Derfor får du minimum 10 opplæringsvakter, egen mentor og systematisk oppfølging gjennom vårt mentorprogram. Vi legger til rette for faglig utvikling og at du skal føle deg godt ivaretatt fra første arbeidsdag.

Som nyansatt hos oss får du i tillegg et rekrutteringstillegg på 40 000 kroner utover tariff, som en del av vår satsing på å tiltrekke og beholde dyktige fagpersoner.

Bli en del av et fagmiljø som setter mennesket i sentrum – vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

    • Klinisk vurdering, observasjon, dokumentasjon og tiltak.

    • Vurdering av behov for velferdsteknologiske/ digitale løsninger hjemme hos pasienter
    • Være opptatt av gode pasientforløp og gode overganger 
    • Delta i utviklingsarbeid og prosjekter
    • Delta  i veiledning og opplæring av kollegaer/elever.
    Kvalifikasjoner
    • Norsk autorisert sykepleier eller autorisert vernepeleier
    • Førerkort klasse B, manuell gir
    • Gode norsk kunnskaper, både skriftlig og muntlig (minimum nivå B2)
    Personlige egenskaper
    • Trygg og selvstendig i din egen fagutøvelse
    • Løsningsorientert og fleksibel i en variert hverdag
    • God relasjonsbygger som kommuniserer godt med pasienter, pårørende og kollegaer
    • Positiv bidragsyter i et godt arbeidsmiljø
    Vi tilbyr
    • Rekrutteringstillegg  40 000,- over tariff 
    • Tilsetting på gjeldende vilkår medlemskap i KLP med 2% pensjonsinnskudd.
    • Mulighet for faglig utvikling og kompetanseheving.
    • En variert arbeidsdag med engasjerte og dyktige medarbeidere.
    • Godt arbeidsmiljø med fokus på fag

    • Mentorordning

jobs.title: VI SØGER MASKINFØRER TIL RØDOVRE
jobs.description:
VI SØGER MASKINFØRER TIL RØDOVRE

Er du en erfaren maskinfører, der kan betjene både gravemaskine og gummihjulslæsser? Så har vi jobbet til dig!

Vi søger en dygtig og mødestabil medarbejder til en virksomhed i Rødovre, hvor du bliver en del af den daglige drift inden for affaldshåndtering og genanvendelse.

Dine arbejdsopgaver:

✅ Betjening af ca. 22 tons gravemaskine til at føde virksomhedens neddeler.

✅ Betjening af gummihjulslæsser til håndtering, bunkning og læsning af sorterede affaldsfraktioner.

✅ Intern kørsel med lastbil/containerbil og håndtering af 36 m³ maxi-containere.

✅ Diverse praktiske opgaver i forbindelse med den daglige drift.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har erfaring med større gravemaskiner og gummihjulslæssere.

  • Har erfaring med maskinkørsel, gerne fra affalds- eller genanvendelsesbranchen.

  • Har kørekort til lastbil (kategori C) og relevante maskinførerbeviser.

  • Er ansvarsbevidst, fleksibel og mødestabil.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samarbejde med kolleger.

Arbejdssted: Rødovre

Er du interesseret?

Kontakt os på 70 60 50 96 for at høre mere om jobbet.

jobs.title: Warehouse Manager, Galderma
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Warehouse Manager to lead and develop warehouse operations at Galderma's manufacturing site in Uppsala.

This is an important leadership role within our Supply Chain organisation, where you will be responsible for ensuring efficient, reliable, and compliant warehouse operations that support manufacturing and site logistics. You will lead a team working across multiple shifts and play a key role in creating an environment where safety, quality, performance, and continuous improvement are part of everyday operations.

Working closely with colleagues in Manufacturing, Planning, Quality, Facilities Management, and Global Warehousing, you will help ensure a seamless flow of materials and contribute to the success of our manufacturing operations.

Your mission

As Warehouse Manager, you will be responsible for the overall performance of the warehouse operation, ensuring the right priorities, resources, and ways of working are in place to support the site's manufacturing activities.

Success in this role is built on leadership. You will coach and develop your team, provide clear direction, and create the conditions for people to perform at their best. You lead by example, foster accountability, and build a culture where quality, safety, and continuous improvement are embedded in the way the team operates every day.

A key part of the role is driving operational excellence through robust processes and strong execution. You will continuously improve warehouse procedures, optimise performance, and ensure a high level of audit readiness through well-established ways of working rather than short-term preparations.



Key responsibilities

· Lead, coach, and develop warehouse supervisors and teams, creating a safe, engaged, and high-performing organisation.

· Oversee and coordinate all warehouse operations, ensuring efficient, reliable, and compliant support to manufacturing and logistics activities.

· Drive operational excellence through continuous improvement initiatives, LEAN principles, and data-driven decision-making.

· Monitor performance through KPIs, identify opportunities for improvement, and implement sustainable solutions that enhance productivity, quality, and service.

· Ensure compliance with applicable quality standards, SOPs, safety requirements, and regulatory expectations while maintaining a high level of audit readiness.

· Build strong relationships and collaborate closely with stakeholders across Manufacturing, Planning, Quality, Facilities Management, and Global Warehousing.

· Manage relationships with logistics service providers (LSPs) to ensure consistent service quality and operational performance.

· Lead cross-functional projects, manage operational risks, and act as the local subject matter expert for warehouse operations.



Your profile

You are a confident and approachable leader who enjoys being close to the operation while maintaining a broader strategic perspective. You communicate clearly, build trust through transparency, and create an environment where people feel supported, accountable, and empowered to succeed.

We believe you bring:

· Experience managing warehouse operations, preferably within manufacturing, pharmaceutical, life sciences, or other regulated industries.

· Proven leadership experience, including leading teams and developing people in an operational environment.

· Strong knowledge of warehouse operations, logistics processes, and inventory management.

· Experience working with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and ERP systems, preferably M3.

· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn data into practical improvements.

· Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English.

· A hands-on leadership style combined with the ability to prioritise, make decisions, and drive change.

· The ability to build strong relationships and collaborate effectively across functions and organisational levels.



The following are considered advantageous:

    Experience from the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry.
    Education in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
    Experience working in a GMP-regulated environment and supporting external audits.



Location and information

This position is based on-site in Uppsala, Sweden. Due to the nature of the role and the responsibility for the warehouse operation, a regular on-site presence is required.

Why Galderma

At Galderma, you'll have the opportunity to work in a science-driven, innovative, and collaborative environment where quality and patient impact are at the center of everything we do. You'll join a team of talented colleagues and play an important role in supporting the continued growth of our biologics and protein-based portfolio.

Is this your next opportunity

We at Perido are now looking for a Technical Property Manager to join our client's team, an exciting and forward-thinking company in the automotive industry. The position is based in Gothenburg.

Key Responsibilities

    Manage and coordinate day-to-day property operations, including incidents, service requests, and inspections of facilities and outdoor areas to ensure safety, functionality, and regulatory compliance
    Plan, coordinate, and follow up on preventive and corrective maintenance, repairs, renovations, refurbishments, and facility upgrades

You have a technical understanding of property operations and enjoy taking responsibility for ensuring that facilities function efficiently. You are comfortable coordinating contractors and suppliers, following up on projects and budgets, and maintaining high standards of safety and quality. With strong communication and organizational skills, you build effective working relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners, while continuously looking for opportunities to improve processes and facility operations.

We look forward to reading your application! For this position, we only accept applications in English.

    Experience working with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel

    Ability to manage multiple activities simultaneously and respond effectively to operational disruptions and emergencies
    A valid Category B driver's licence

Advantageous:

Contract type and hours

Full-time consulting assignment until 2027-12-31, with the possibility of extension. Start asap.

Let us help you take the next step in your career

Our vision is to ensure that everyone thrives and feels engaged at work. With us, you will find a wide variety of assignments, where you can either be employed directly by a company or work as a consultant through Perido. We are one of Sweden’s largest consulting firms for professionals, which gives you many opportunities. As a consultant, you become an important part of our organization and contribute your expertise within our clients’ organizations. Read more about us at Perido: https://perido.se/om-oss/

You can find answers to most questions or concerns at perido.se/vanliga-fragor/. If you still cannot find what you are looking for, you are welcome to contact us at fraga@perido.se. jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Developer to MittVaccin
jobs.description:
Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions supports health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries.

Since 2012, MittVaccin has been a pioneer in digital vaccination services for residents and healthcare providers across Sweden. As part of Cambio since 2020, we continue to drive innovation that improves access to vaccinations and supports safe, efficient vaccination management. Today, MittVaccin is Sweden’s leading vaccination platform, trusted by 14 regions, 100+ municipalities, and 400+ healthcare providers nationwide. Since 2026, we have also expanded into Finland, marking the beginning of our international growth journey.

The position

As a Fullstack Developer, you will play a key role in developing MittVaccin, Sweden's leading digital vaccination platform. Working closely with developers, architects, and product owners, you will design and build modern, scalable solutions with a primary focus on backend development and infrastructure.

This is a hands-on role where you will contribute to everything from architecture and new product development to operations and performance optimization. Rather than maintaining legacy systems, you will help modernize and shape the future of digital vaccination services.

Joining a small, agile team with high autonomy and ownership, you will have a direct impact on products that support healthcare providers and improve public health across Sweden and beyond.

About you

You are passionate about finding the best solutions for our customers, have a pedagogical approach, and find it interesting to deepen your understanding of various healthcare processes and needs—translating them into technical solutions. You work independently with strong self-motivation but also thrive when collaborating with your team members or customers.

Requirements 

    

5+ years of experience as a full-stack developer

    

Strong proficiency in SQL (including stored programs, views, and performance optimization)

    

Extensive knowledge of PHP and PHPUnit, including object-oriented frameworks

    

Experience with JavaScript and React or similar libraries

    

Knowledge of API design and development

    

Experience working with Linux-based application operations, including server maintenance, upgrades, security management, infrastructure-related tasks, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.

    

Experience in requirements gathering, architecture/design, and development infrastructure like Git and pipeline

    

Solid experience working with agile methodologies, such as Scrum and Kanban

    

Ability to communicate fluently in Swedish, as it is required for daily communication.

It's a bonus if you have

    

Experience with Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Apache, MySQL, Redis, Docker, Ansible, or similar technologies used in application operations and infrastructure management.

    

Experience with clustered environments and load balancing for web applications

    

Experience with API technologies such as SOAP and REST and Sweden’s national/regional technical services from Inera (national service architecture) and e-Hälsomyndigheten (NDI)

    

Experience using standards and reference models for healthcare informatics and interoperability, such as FHIR, OpenEHR, Snomed-CT, ICD and related regulatory frameworks for information management

    

Experience working with IT/development in healthcare, giving you an understanding of the laws and regulations that impact system design

    

Experience in utilizing various AI tools and techniques in analysis, design, coding and testing

Place of employment: Stockholm

Scope: Full-time, hybrid work model (three days per week in-office)

Form of employment: Permanent employment, 6 months trial period

Additional Information: The role involves access to sensitive information, therefore a background check will be conducted on the final candidate.

We review applications and conduct interviews on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible via the link.

We look forward to receiving your application!

CAMBIO- FOR A HEALTHIER TOMORROW

Welcome to a company where healthcare is improved every day. Here you will work with leading technology in a collaborative, trusting and empowering environment where your contribution will be appreciated and celebrated. In our caring culture you will have the opportunity to pursue different paths of professional growth. Seize the opportunity to do the most important work of your life. Read more about us here!

A healthier tomorrow also means taking care of those who make it possible -explore our employee benefits
