jobs.title: Chef, Lapland Hotels SnowVillage, Kittilä
jobs.description:
StaffPoint is looking for CHEFS for the winter season 2026–2027 at Lapland Hotels SnowVillage.

Every year in November, a unique frozen experience is built in Lainio, covering an area of about 2 hectares. It features stunning ice sculptures, an ice restaurant and an ice bar. Reception and kitchen facilities, however, are warmly housed within log walls. The SnowVillage attracts around 80,000 visitors annually and its theme changes every year. Located near the Levi and Ylläs ski resorts, the location ensures a vibrant winter season. The distance is approx. 45 km from Levi, 30 km from Äkäslompolo, and 15 km from Ylläsjärvi.

The position includes duties in both à la carte and buffet kitchen operations. Employment is scheduled to begin on 23 November 2026 and continue until approximately 4 April 2027. Full-time work is available, with 112.5 hours per three-week period. The employment contract will be signed between the employee and StaffPoint. Please note that the Lapland Hotels chain is a smoke-free workplace.

What we require:

- EU citizenship/passport or a valid working permit for Finland

- Minimum of two years' experience of working in a kitchen as a chef

- Creativity, initiative, and a positive attitude that is reflected in your way of working

- Finnish Hygiene certificate (We can provide assistance with applying for a certificate)

- Strong understanding of food safety and kitchen procedures

What we offer:

- A lively and international work environment

- Staffpoint and Lapland Hotels personnel benefits

- A great, close-knit team that many employees return to season after season

- The possibility of accommodation through Lapland Hotels

- Salary based on your experience, at least in accordance with the Finnish collective agreement for the hospitality industry (Marava TES)

Accommodation is located approximately 15 km from the workplace, so having your own car or a valid driving licence will be considered an advantage.

How to apply:

Add your CV to your application to speed up the recruitment process! Please note that if you are applying with a friend, both applicants must submit their own application. If you meet our standards, you will first receive an invitation to a video interview and a Refapp request for recommendations.

Submit your job application and we'll see you in magical Lapland!

Please note that we do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. All applications should be submitted through our website.


Lapland Hotels

Lapland Hotels & Safaris Oy offers northern experiences for all senses. It consists of Finland's largest private hotel chain Lapland Hotels, the Nordic region's largest program service company Lapland Safaris, and Lapland Ski Resorts. The entire group employs a total of about 1,950 people.

Lapland Hotels includes 20 hotels, over 2,600 rooms and apartments, and more than 11,000 restaurant seats throughout Finland: in Ylläs, Levi, Saariselkä, Rovaniemi, Olos, Luosto, Kilpisjärvi, Pallas, and Hetta, as well as in Helsinki, Tampere, Oulu, Kuopio, and Kartano & Spa Hotel Haikko in Porvoo.

Lapland Safaris offers unique nature activities in Lapland's five locations: Rovaniemi, Ylläs, Saariselkä, Levi, and Luosto. An essential part of the safari selection is dog sledding experiences, which are provided by Lapland Husky Safaris, a member of the same tourism group. The company is the largest operator in its field in Finland and has four kennels in Rovaniemi, Luosto, Saariselkä, and Muonio. Lapland Ski Resorts consists of five ski resorts located in Ylläs, Luosto, Olos, Pallas, and Rovaniemi

Email: pohjoinen@staffpoint.fi

jobs.title: Sykepleier
jobs.description:
Om stillingen 

Hjemmetjenesten Nord består av tre avdelinger, Øvre, Nedre og Nordsia. Vi har 2 ledige sykepleierstillinger i 100% fast. 

Er du interessert i en lavere stillingsbrøk, kan du også søke.

Vi tilbyr 2 delt turnus med langvakter hver 4. helg. Det er frivillig å jobbe langvakter og det er mulig og komme med innspill til turnus. Ta gjerne kontakt ved spørsmål.

Det er ca 20 ansatte per avdeling hvor 6 er sykepleiere. Sykepleierne hos oss jobber i team,  vi har fagsykepleier, palliativ sykepleier og kreftsykepleier knyttet til avdelingene våre. 


Kvalifikasjoner og personlige egenskaper

Kvalifikasjoner 

  • Norsk autorisasjon som sykepleier. 
  • Har generell god digital kompetanse og kan tilegne deg fagsystemer som benyttes i Bodø kommune. 
  • Krav til god norsk skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne. 

Personlige egenskaper 

  • Ser din sykepleierrolle i samspill med andre kollegaer i avdelingen.
  • Gode samarbeidsevner og evne til å arbeide i team.
  • Evne til fleksibilitet, nytenkning og initiativtaking.
  • Kan jobbe selvstendig, ha god fremdrift i arbeidet, er strukturert og målrettet.
  • Trives i et aktiv og effektivt arbeidsmiljø, med fokus på kvalitetsforbedring.

Det legges stor vekt på personlig egnethet og motivasjon for stillingen.


Arbeidsoppgavene vil være:
  • Nødvendig helsehjelp, bistand under stell, pleie, medisinsk behandling og dokumentasjon etter gjeldende lovverk.
  • Observere, vurdere og iverksette nødvendige tiltak.
  • Samarbeide med pårørende og samhandle med interne og eksterne instanser. 
  • Sykepleierfaglig ansvar for avdelingen.
  • Delta i utvikling av egen arbeidsplass, samt delta i veiledning og opplæring av kollegaer og studenter.
  • Kjenne til og etterleve rutiner i gjeldende kvalitetssystem.

Vi kan tilby deg: 
  • Lønn etter gjeldene tariffavtale.
  • Et variert arbeid og et positivt arbeidsmiljø
  • Opplæring, veiledning og faglig utvikling.
  • Gunstige pensjonsordninger.
  • Mentorordning 
  • 2 delt ferie  

Annet

Aktuelle søkere vil bli invitert til intervju .

Dokumentasjon på utdanning og praksis legges ved søknaden. 

Får du tilbud om stillingen må gyldig politiattest leveres til leder/tjenestested. jf. Kommunal helse- og omsorgstjenestelov § 5-4 og  Helsepersonelloven § 20 a.  (skal ikke vedlegges søknaden).

Søkere må benytte elektronisk søknadsskjema.

Arbeidsplassene i Bodø kommune skal preges av mangfold, og våre ansatte skal gjenspeile byens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn.  

Bodø kommune legger vekt på å tilrettelegge arbeidsforholdene dersom du har behov for det. 

Fast ansatte i Bodø kommune med fortrinnsrett som overtallig, avklart omplasseringskandidat på bakgrunn av helse eller som ønsker å øke sin stillingsandel oppfordres til å søke.

Ditt navn kan bli offentliggjort, selv om du ber om å ikke bli oppført på søkerlisten. Dette blir du i så fall varslet om.

For alle stillinger gjelder de regler som går fram av lover, reglement og gjeldende tariffavtale.

Ved første gangs ansettelse i kommunen gjelder en prøvetid på 6 måneder.

Søknad, CV og vedlegg sendes via lenke på denne siden. Har du spørsmål om elektronisk utfylling av CV kan Jobbnorge kontaktes på tlf. 75 54 22 20.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bodø er den ultimate kombinasjonen av kultur og natur. Vi er  lokalisert midt mellom storslåtte naturperler i regionen rundt. Vi er uredde, har trua, er gode på samhandling og utvikler nye og smarte løsninger.

Våre medarbeidere får det til å skje. En jobb i kommunen er en jobb med mening, hvor det du gjør betyr noe for innbyggerne – og gjør Bodø til et godt sted å leve.

jobs.title: Engineer, Mechanics
jobs.description:
Join us, become part of our **#Fastemsians** work community and grow to be a future professional. Read more and come catch your dream job!

We are looking for an **Engineer, Mechanics** to join our Service Products Delivery team in Tampere. As an Engineer, Mechanics you will contribute to our Service Products deliveries and design according to our customers needs and Fastems long-term experience. This position will allow you to participate in a wide range of different Service deliveries to keep our installed base functioning.

As part of the Service Products Delivery team, you will work collaborating on diverse Service Product deliveries and supporting our local Service organizations and customers all around the world. Service Products are critical end-of-life components that will be upgraded to the latest technology, and the risk of an unexpected breakdown will be minimized. Service Products delivery team is also responsible for delivering different kinds of smaller system modifications and – changes.

The team consists of approx. 14 skilled professionals: delivery managers, electrical engineers and software developers, and together, as a team, we make sure that our customers worldwide are fully supported. We are working tightly as a team and help and support for the mechanical engineer is also available within our company from highly skilled colleagues from different teams.

As an expert in your field, your work contains designing Fastems products and systems modifications in customer deliveries so that the results of the deliveries meet the specifications, standards of quality, budget, and schedule. This includes thinking of possible new design solutions, creating models, manufacturing drawings, and schematics.A large part of the work contains supporting global Service functions relating to mechanical solutions and designs and participating in the Service Product development. Fastems value a unique culture where innovation and enabling development are important and supported in eachrole. We guarantee a flexible and relaxed atmosphere and work environment, where it is possible to develop ones skills and passion in agile ways.

**We expect you to have:**

- MSc or BSc in mechanical engineering

- A few years of experience in design work

- Up to date knowledge of manufacturing technologies

- Good communication and teamwork skills


- Experience of mechanical engineering tools (SolidWorks)

- Basics of strength calculations (with e.g. SolidWorks Simulation)

- Fluent skills in English and Finnish, both written and oral


**As a benefit for the applicant we consider:**

- Experience of industrial robotics and automation systems

- Experience of hydraulic and pneumatic systems and components

- Experience from other engineering softwares (Visual Components, Aton)


- Experience of other technical calculations


As a person you are self-driven, systematic and genuinely interested in technology. You want to keep quality as a priority in your daily work. You naturally maintain an open and positive atmosphere in a team.

**We can offer you:**

- A chance to work in the heart of development and robotics to shape the future of manufacturing industry

- Fastems strong company culture expressed through our **values**

- Career and development opportunities

- International work atmosphere and global activities

- Flexible working hours and possibility to work partly remotely

- Good employment benefits, such as culture benefit and lunch benefit at the office


**Interested in joining #fastemsians?**

Send your application together with your CV and salary request **by October 25th at the latest.** Please note that even though the application deadline is not reached, we may proceed with interviews and make a hire as soon as a suitable candidate is identified.

jobs.title: Kock
jobs.description:
**Kock**

Park Alandia Hotell är ett hotell med 90 rum. I hotellet finns Park Restaurang & Bar med 70 sittplatser i restaurangen och 60 platser i baren. Här finns även en konferens- och festvåning och snyggaste poolen i stan! Skön live musik spelas fredag-lördag året om.

Park Alandia Hotell är ett familjeägt bolag där laganda, att ha kul på jobbet och att brinna för det man gör står i fokus. Hos oss jobbar 24 personer året runt och nu behöver vi förstärkning av en kock till vår restaurang och bar. I Restaurangen och baren arbetar vi alla tillsammans som ett team mot gemensamma mål och vår ambition är att varje gäst ska trivas och få en härlig upplevelse hos oss. Vi serverar a la carte, konferenslunch och bistro. Det är med stolthet vi serverar god mat och dryck och vi kan från hösten 2026 även stoltsera med vårt egna bryggeri.

**Dina arbetsuppgifter**

Vi söker dig som har stor noggrannhet och tycker om att laga god mat från grunden. Arbetsuppgifterna består av följande:

- A la carte

- Konferenslunch

- Bistro

- Följa vår egenkontrollplan

- Övriga förekommande köksuppgifter

- Beställningar


**Personliga egenskaper**

Som medarbetare hos oss behöver du vara serviceinriktad och alltid sträva efter att ge våra gäster den bästa helhetsupplevelsen. Som person är du positiv, ansvarstagande, stresstålig, har lätt för att samarbeta och har förståelse för att alla arbetskamrater är värdefulla. Du har god struktur i ditt arbete samt ordning och reda runt om dig.

**Kvalifikationskrav**

Du behöver ha köksutbildning eller några års erfarenhet av tidigare arbete med tillagning av a la carte/bistro. Hygienpass är ett krav och vi önskar att du kan svenska eller engelska. Du bör vara minst 20 år fyllda.

**Varaktighet**

Tjänsten är en tillsvidare anställning. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Köksjobbet är skiftesarbete med ett rullande arbetsschema med främst kvällspass under veckans alla dagar.

**Lön**

Lön enligt överenskommelse

Vi ser framemot att läsa din ansökan och hoppas du skickar in den tillsammans med din CV redan idag till jobb@parkalandia.com. Sista ansökningsdag är den 31.10.2026, men intervjuer kommer att ske löpande och platsen kan bli tillsatta innan sista ansökningsdag. Har du frågor kontakta köksmästare Rune på telefon 018-14130.

jobs.title: SAP Industry Solution Advisor (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben

Deine täglichen Aufgaben:

  • Du gestaltest Kundentermine, Workshops und Angebotsphasen in unseren Fokusbranchen Industrial Manufacturing, High Tech, Defence und Automotive
  • Du identifizierst die geschäftlichen und prozessualen Herausforderungen unserer Kunden in der diskreten Fertigung und leitest daraus passende Ansatzpunkte ab.
  • Du führst Gespräche mit Fach- und IT-Entscheidern und übersetzt Anforderungen in überzeugende SAP-Lösungsbilder.
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Beratungsteams klare Presales-Storylines, Präsentationen und Lösungsszenarien.
  • Du zeigst auf, wie SAP S/4HANA und digitale Technologien Produktions- und Supply-Chain-Prozesse wirksam unterstützen können.
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung in komplexen Vertriebs- und Transformationssituationen und bringst Markt-, Branchen- und Kundenimpulse aktiv ein.



Dein Profil

Die Anforderungen:

  • Du verfügst über ein tiefes Verständnis der Prozesse in der diskreten Fertigung und kennst die Anforderungen produzierender Unternehmen.
  • Du bringst Erfahrung in mindestens einer unserer Fokusbranchen mit: Industrial Manufacturing, High Tech, Defense oder Automotive.
  • Du hast fundierte SAP-Erfahrung aus der Beratung oder aus einem Industrieunternehmen und bewegst dich sicher in Transformationskontexten.
  • Du verstehst die Zusammenhänge zwischen Produktion, Supply Chain, Digitalisierung und SAP S/4HANA.
  • Du hast idealerweise bereits als Projektleiter:in, Teilprojektleiter:in oder Stream Lead Verantwortung übernommen.
  • Du kannst komplexe Anforderungen strukturiert erfassen, in verständliche Lösungsszenarien übersetzen und diese sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch vermitteln.


Warum wir?

Was Du unter anderem von uns erwarten kannst:

  • Attraktives Gehalt
  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem wachstumsstarken Unternehmen
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Homeoffice-Option
  • Angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre und gute Führungskultur (kaum messbare Mitarbeiterfluktuation)
  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Firmenwagen und moderne IT-Ausstattung
  • Fachliche und persönliche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
Lerne ein Unternehmen kennen, in dem Menschen gut und gerne zusammenarbeiten – und finde hier weitere Benefits, die wir dir bieten.
Du erkennst dich in der Beschreibung wieder? Dann zögere nicht und nimm am besten noch heute Kontakt auf. Gerne können wir uns über diese Stelle und deine Möglichkeiten bei GAMBIT unterhalten.
Wir erwarten nicht, dass alle Kandidat:innen in allen genannten Bereichen gleich qualifiziert sind. Nenn uns daher gerne weitere, hier nicht genannte Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen, über die du verfügst und die für diese Stelle möglicherweise relevant sein könnten.
Ganz besonders wichtig ist uns, dass unsere Mitarbeiter:innen unser Verständnis von Arbeit und Zusammenarbeit teilen. Denn Arbeit ist für uns mehr als nur ein Job, Zusammenarbeit mehr als nur ein Nebeneinander. Wir legen Wert auf einen respektvollen, wertschätzenden Umgang, Fairness und einen offenen Dialog.

  • Serviceinnstilling og evne til å skape trygghet og gode kunderelasjoner

Vi tilbyr konkurransedyktige betingelser, grundig opplæring og et trivelig arbeidsmiljø med varierte og spennende arbeidsoppgaver. Stillingen er et engasjement gjennom bemanningsbyrå, med gode muligheter for faglig utvikling og et tett samarbeid med vår oppdragsgiver.

- Loistavia vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja, sekä kykyä toimia hektisessä työympäristössä

- Oma-aloitteisuutta sekä valmiutta itsenäiseen työhön

Carpenter tarjoaa hyvät työskentelyolosuhteet kansainvälisessä yrityksessä. Tulet täydentämään nykyistä kunnossapito-organisaatiota, ja saat erinomaiset mahdollisuudet kehittyä työtehtävissäsi.

Som min assistent blir du en viktig støtte i hverdagen min og en verdifull ressurs for familien min. Du vil få en variert rolle som kombinerer lek, aktivitet, praktisk bistand og medisinske oppgaver.

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. Vi jobber alltid ut ifra disse verdiene:

jobs.title: Developer Relations Manager
jobs.description:
About Gladia

Gladia builds the audio AI infrastructure behind the new generation of voice products. Our mission is to give every voice platform true conversational intelligence — the audio infrastructure that understands every conversation, turning voice into the world's most valuable data layer.

Our API turns real-world conversational audio into accurate, structured, real-time output — powered by our proprietary Solaria ASR, across 100+ languages, with industry-leading latency.

Hundreds of companies build their voice products on Gladia — from meeting assistants and voice agents to sales-enablement and contact-center platforms. We started in Paris, our growth is developer-led and heavily US-driven (and we're going after the US market hard).

Headquartered in vibrant tech hubs like Paris and New York City, Gladia has been by OVH Groupe — Europe's leading cloud provider — and now operates as a fully autonomous brand and company within the Group.

We're guided by four values:

  • Honest — Say the real thing, kindly.

  • Smart — Work smart, ship fast.

  • Builders — Own your scope, build to last.

  • Caring — Support people, take pride in the craft.

The role

 

Gladia's growth is developer-led: most of our customers first meet us through our API, our docs, and other developers. As our Developer Relations Manager, you make sure that first contact turns into a successful build — and that what developers tell us makes it back into the product.

You'll be the public face of Gladia for developers building voice products — meeting assistants, voice agents, contact-center and sales-enablement platforms — with a strong focus on the US market. You'll work closely with product, engineering, and marketing, and you'll be measured on outcomes (adoption, activation, retention).

We want someone who understands what developers are trying to build, helps them get there faster, and builds lasting relationships with the community.

What you'll do

  • Own developer engagement end-to-end: understand developer needs, remove friction, and help them build successfully with Gladia

  • Create high-impact technical content — tutorials, demos, sample apps, blog posts, videos, talks, and docs contributions — that solves real problems and drives adoption

  • Represent Gladia at conferences, meetups, hackathons, customer events, and in online communities

  • Build and nurture relationships with developers, partners, and community leaders across the voice AI ecosystem

  • Be the voice of the community internally: turn developer feedback into clear, actionable input for product, engineering, and marketing

  • Design and run scalable DevRel programs: events, ambassador programs, partnerships, and community channels

  • Define and track DevRel metrics — adoption, activation, retention, community health — and use them to decide where to invest

  • Continuously raise the bar on developer experience, from first API call to production

Who you are

  • 3+ years in developer relations or developer advocacy, ideally for an API or infrastructure product

  • Technical enough to build demos and sample apps yourself and to talk credibly with engineers

  • Excellent public speaker and writer, comfortable across formats (stage, video, written, live coding)

  • Experience building and engaging technical communities, online and in person

  • Good judgment, tact, and humor when handling complex or sensitive community situations

  • Autonomous and organized: you set your own priorities and manage several in parallel

  • Fluent English

Bonus points

  • Experience leading a DevRel or community program (not only contributing to one)

  • Prior hands-on software engineering experience

  • Familiarity with speech, audio, or AI/ML APIs

  • Experience with open source projects and culture

  • An existing network in developer communities and on social platforms

What We Offer

  • This role is ideally based in Paris where you can work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking budget.

  • A health insurance (100% coverage) and a pension contract with SideCare for you & your family

  • Flexible vacation policy

  • Lunch vouchers (approx. 200€/month)

  • An allowance of 360 euros/year for your sports activities

  • An allowance of 300 euros for your workstation

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal.

Backed by $70M (Series A) from top funds and senior leaders at OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace, Mistral, DeepMind, and others, White Circle processes 100M+ API calls monthly and fine-tunes and trains its own LLMs to run faster and cheaper than open or proprietary models.

  • 3+ years training large-scale multimodal models.

  • Relocation to Paris or London (hybrid) required.

Bonus

  • Audio signal processing fundamentals – spectrograms, mel features, noise reduction.

  • MoE architecture experience.

We offer

  • Competitive salary + equity.

jobs.title: Global Head of AI Deployment & Partner Delivery
jobs.description:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

Dust is hiring a Head of AI Deployment & Partner Delivery to make high-impact Dust deployments repeatable at scale.

When customers deploy Dust well, AI agents become part of how their teams work every day. Your job is to make that happen consistently, whether a deployment is led by Dust or by a trusted partner. You will lead our most complex customer deployments, turn what works, technically and organizationally, into clear playbooks, and build the partner delivery capacity that lets more customers succeed with Dust in 2027 and beyond.

This is a player-coach leadership role. You will lead and grow Dust’s global AI Deployment team, stay directly involved in our most important deployments, and build the methods, standards, and partner network that allow delivery to scale without depending on you for every engagement.

You will work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering to connect what customers want to achieve with how deployments are planned, delivered, and measured.

This is a chance to define how an AI-native company delivers transformation: what an exceptional deployment looks like, how value is measured, and how partners become delivery teams our customers trust.

What you’ll do

Lead and grow the global AI Deployment team

  • Lead Dust’s existing global AI Deployment team and set its direction, priorities, and standards.

  • Hire and develop deployment leaders and practitioners as customer demand grows.

  • Shape roles, career paths, and coverage across regions, customer segments, and deployment types.

  • Coach the team through complex customer situations and hold a consistently high bar for the work.

  • Set up the operating rhythms, capacity planning, and reporting the function needs to scale.

Define how Dust deployments are delivered

  • Build one deployment method, from discovery through handoff, that Dust and partner teams can both follow to the same standard.

  • Define which deployments Dust should lead, which a partner can deliver well, and how work moves between the two.

  • Set clear entry and exit criteria and go-live readiness checks, and track delivery health: time to first value, go-live quality, and customer satisfaction.

  • Run regular delivery reviews, spot at-risk engagements early, and bring the right Dust and partner people together quickly when a deployment is blocked.

  • Turn lessons from each engagement into reusable playbooks, templates, and reference architectures, and recurring friction into clear input for Product and Engineering.

Lead AI transformation with strategic customers

  • Personally lead complex, high-priority, and first-of-their-kind deployments, from scoping to lasting adoption, bringing in Solutions Engineering, Product, and Engineering when complexity or risk calls for it.

  • Help customer leaders define what AI transformation means for their organization: map how teams work today and identify the workflows where agents can create the most value.

  • Align executives, IT, security, and business teams on goals, use cases, and success measures, with a baseline before launch and measured impact after.

  • Design change programs for each deployment: executive sponsorship, communication plans, role-based enablement, and clear adoption milestones.

  • Develop AI operators and champions inside customer teams, and help customers update ways of working, governance, and ownership so agents become part of how teams operate.

  • Track adoption after launch, act quickly when teams aren’t changing how they work, and hand off to Customer Success with a clear picture of what comes next.

Build a high-quality partner delivery network

  • Work with Partnerships to assess partners’ delivery capability, technical depth, and customer readiness.

  • Start with a small, carefully selected group of partner practitioners and grow capacity as quality is proven.

  • Co-create onboarding, training, certification, and train-the-trainer programs so partners can develop their own Dust experts.

  • Co-deliver early partner engagements, then help partners progress toward delivering independently, leading adoption, not just implementation.

  • Ensure customers experience Dust and its partners as one aligned team, with clear responsibilities on every engagement.

Requirements

  • You have at least 6 years of experience leading and developing customer-facing deployment or delivery teams, ideally across multiple regions or customer segments and through periods of fast change.

  • You have led complex enterprise deployments or transformation programs and delivered measurable customer outcomes.

  • You have built or significantly improved a deployment methodology, professional services model, or delivery function, adding the structure needed to scale without unnecessary process.

  • You have led organizational change alongside technology rollouts, and built champion networks or adoption plans that changed how teams work after the project ended.

    You don’t need to be a machine-learning engineer. Beyond that, we care more about evidence that you have built high-performing delivery systems than about a perfect sequence of titles.

  • You understand how systems integrators, consultancies, and implementation partners staff, deliver, and grow a practice, and you have built enablement or certification programs that created lasting capability in teams you didn’t manage.

  • You have turned around engagements at risk from scope, staffing, technical complexity, or stakeholder misalignment, and you know when to standardize, when to adapt, and when to reset.

  • You are credible with customer executives, partner leaders, and technical practitioners, and you communicate clearly with all of them.

  • You are a hands-on, low-ego leader with a builder’s instinct: you would rather solve the problem than hand off a recommendation.

  • You are comfortable traveling to customers and partners when it matters most.

AI and technical credibility

  • Advise customers on where AI agents can create meaningful value and where they can’t yet, and explain why to technical teams, business leaders, and executives.

  • Understand how agents work in practice: prompting, context, tool use, retrieval, evaluations, reliability, and cost.

  • Challenge a deployment plan’s assumptions about integrations, data connectors, authentication, permissions, security, and production readiness, and discuss the trade-offs with engineers.

  • Design evaluation approaches that connect AI performance to customer and business outcomes.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

jobs.description:
🏨 The Company

Resilience Care, a leading player in remote medical monitoring and a partner in clinical research, is a French company founded in 2021 with a single mission: to provide better care.

Our company offers remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology, and psychiatry, based on the collection of ePROs combined with AI technologies. These solutions rely on a monitoring platform for healthcare professionals—enabling the early detection of side effects for continuous and proactive care—and a mobile app for patients, empowering them to measure and manage their symptoms using tailored resources.

Our solutions optimize patient care, continuously enrich our understanding of patients throughout their healthcare journey, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring, and in-depth analysis of real-world data. Today, our solutions are deployed in routine care for 35,000 patients across more than 200 healthcare facilities, as well as within the framework of around twenty academic and industrial clinical trials.

Through this, we put data at the service of healthcare and therapeutic innovation, driven by the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine.

📝 Your Role

In a few words

Within QARA, you oversee Good Clinical Practice compliance across Resilience’s sponsored studies and studies conducted with pharmaceutical partners. You combine clinical quality, data integrity and system qualification, working closely with the teams running studies and building data workflows.

Your impact

You help keep studies inspection-ready, data reliable and traceable, and compliance embedded in everyday work. Your role is to safeguard the framework and help teams apply it, rather than produce the data yourself.

Your day-to-day work

  • Oversee study GCP compliance, manage deviations and corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and conduct quality and Trial Master File (TMF) reviews.

  • Maintain inspection readiness and support CRO oversight in line with ICH E6(R3).

  • Qualify systems, assess test environments and review data extractions, audit trails and Data Management Plans.

  • Work with Data and Clinical teams to build compliance into data workflows from the outset.

  • Maintain clinical quality procedures, train teams and monitor regulatory developments.

This is not a site-monitoring, data-engineering, study-project-management or routine clinical data-production role.

✨ Your Team

Here, we don’t work in silos. You’ll join an agile structure where compliance is truly a team sport:

  • Your Manager: Yasmine, the guardian of regulatory compliance for our medical devices. She will share her strategic vision of the healthcare sector with you and will be your go-to for the most sensitive decisions.

  • Your core team: A trio of passionate experts. They’re your daily contacts for everything related to the quality management system, technical files, and audit preparation.

  • The team’s little extra: A unique context where safety, clinical, and regulatory aspects come together to better serve patients, led by a team that combines rigor and kindness.

You join QARA and report directly to Yasmine. You work with Clinical Operations, Clinical Scientists, Data and Translational Research, as well as the DPO, CROs and pharmaceutical partners.

👤 Candidate Profile

⚙️ You are the right person if you know how to

  • Apply ICH E6(R3), Annex 11 and 21 CFR Part 11 to clinical studies and systems.

  • Manage deviations, CAPAs, audits and inspection preparation, beyond data cleaning alone.

  • Qualify systems using CSV/CSQ approaches and apply ALCOA+ principles.

  • Work with EDC systems and ePRO/eCOA solutions, translating their requirements into practical controls.

  • Communicate and write fluently in English.

🙂 You are the right person if you have

  • A rigorous approach that takes operational constraints into account.

  • Practical judgement to turn requirements into workable processes.

  • The ability to influence and train colleagues rather than impose rules.

  • Confidence working across clinical and technical teams and with external partners.

📃 You are the right person if you have already

  • Gained at least five years of relevant experience in Clinical Data Management and GCP compliance within a pharmaceutical company or CRO.

  • Handled clinical quality topics such as deviations, audits, inspections or procedures.

  • Contributed to computerised system qualification.

  • Worked with EDC systems, such as Medidata Rave, Veeva or Oracle, and ePRO/eCOA solutions.

It’s a plus if you

  • Understand pipelines, ETL and databases, without needing to be a developer.

  • Know CDISC standards for regulatory submissions.

  • Want to move from data production to compliance oversight and help build quality practices.

💛 Why join us?

  • Contribute to reliable studies and data that support clinical research in oncology.

  • Combine clinical quality, data integrity and collaboration with technical teams.

  • Work remotely from France and meet colleagues at internal company events.

🤝 Recruitment Process

  1. Initial conversation with Elena.

  2. Interview with Yasmine, your future manager.

  3. Case study with Sarah and Yasmine from QARA.

  4. Team conversation with Nicoleta, Bertille and Alric.

  5. Strategic interview with Raph.

🏨 L'entreprise

Resilience Care, acteur majeur de la télésurveillance médicale et partenaire de la recherche clinique, est une société française fondée en 2021 avec une mission : mieux soigner.

Notre entreprise propose des solutions de télésurveillance en oncologie, gastro-entérologie et psychiatrie, basées sur la collecte d'ePRO associées à des techniques d'IA. Elles s'appuient sur une plateforme de suivi pour les professionnels de santé, permettant une détection précoce des effets secondaires pour une prise en charge continue et anticipée, et une application mobile pour les patients, permettant de mesurer et gérer leurs symptômes grâce à des ressources adaptées.

Nos solutions permettent d'optimiser les prises en charge, d'enrichir la compréhension des patients en continu pendant leur parcours de soin et d'accélérer la recherche clinique grâce à la collecte, la structuration et l'analyse fine des données de vie réelle. Elles sont aujourd'hui déployées en routine auprès de 35 000 patients, dans plus de 200 établissements de santé, mais également dans le cadre d'une vingtaine d'études cliniques académiques et industrielles.

Nous mettons ainsi la donnée au service du soin et de l'innovation thérapeutique avec l'ambition de permettre à chaque patient de bénéficier d'une médecine personnalisée.

📝 Ton rôle

En quelques mots : tu incarnes la sécurité au quotidien auprès de toutes les équipes, en binôme avec notre Security Engineer. Ton terrain principal, c'est le produit : comprendre ce qu'on construit, analyser les risques au plus tôt, négocier ce qui doit l'être à l'intérieur des fonctionnalités, et faire aboutir les corrections avec ceux qui écrivent le code.

Ton impact : nos solutions sont utilisées en routine dans plus de 200 établissements de santé. La sécurité n'y est pas un sujet théorique : elle conditionne la confiance des soignants et la protection des données de patients. Tu construis une sécurité réellement effective, pas une sécurité de façade.

Ton quotidien :

  • Aller vers les équipes produit et engineering, comprendre ce qu'elles construisent et comment elles travaillent, et être la personne qu'on vient chercher spontanément.

  • Analyser la sécurité des projets et des fonctionnalités au plus tôt, et négocier les arbitrages qui comptent sans bloquer les livraisons.

  • Piloter la correction des vulnérabilités et des findings de pentest : priorisation par le risque réel, suivi jusqu'à la remise en état.

  • Mettre à disposition des équipes des techniques, des solutions et des process by design réellement adoptables.

  • Négocier des arbitrages de sécurité à l'intérieur du périmètre et des délais d'une fonctionnalité, sans bloquer la livraison.

  • Détecter, qualifier et traiter un incident de sécurité, puis en tirer des améliorations durables.

  • Échanger de façon crédible avec les équipes sur les fondamentaux de la sécurité applicative et cloud.

🙂 Tu es la bonne personne si tu as :

  • Une posture de partenaire : tu vas vers les équipes, écoutes leurs contraintes et construis la sécurité avec elles plutôt que contre elles.

  • Une communication claire, sans jargon, adaptée aux équipes produit comme aux équipes engineering.

  • Le goût de la gestion de projet, de la négociation et du travail transverse.

  • Une recherche de sécurité réellement effective : tu mesures l'adoption, sollicites du feedback et adaptes ce qui ne fonctionne pas.

  • De la polyvalence, de la rigueur et le réflexe de documenter ou d'escalader au bon moment.

📃 Tu es la bonne personne si tu as déjà :

  • Une formation d'ingénieur ou équivalent.

C'est un plus si tu :

Making preventive health the default for every human in Europe

 

The mission

At Lucis, we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the OS for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives. You can read more about who we are and how we work here.

 

The role

We’ve processed 200,000+ clinical tests across 4 countries with a team of 20. We’re growing 10% week over week. And we’re still early.

We’re looking for a mobile frontend engineer who treats the app as a craft, not a checklist. You care about the half-pixel, the spring curve on a transition, the way a screen feels in the hand, and you can build it. You own the mobile experience end-to-end in our monorepo, orchestrate AI to execute, and raise the bar for everyone around you.

You won’t spend your days writing boilerplate. You’ll write specs that agents execute, review AI-generated code with a critical eye, and make decisions that compound over time. This is what engineering looks like now. If that excites you, keep reading.

What we’re looking for: Mobile frontend, design engineering & world-class craft

A confirmed mobile engineer (8+ years) with exceptional craft and a real sensibility for design. You live in Expo and React Native, you care deeply about how the product feels, and you don’t wait for designs to be ready to propose something delightful. You have also experience building native experience. You think in interactions, motion, and detail.

You’ll own what members touch every day: onboarding, the core app surfaces, the moments that turn a first-time visitor into someone who trusts us with their health. Your work has to be delightful and reliable on real devices, for people who decide in minutes whether to trust us.

 
 

About you

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

 

You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You use AI the way others use a calculator: naturally, to go faster and think bigger.

 

You’ll fit in well if

  • You've shipped at least one product from 0→1 and felt the difference between writing code and building a system

  • You have 2 deep areas of expertise and can operate across the full stack when the situation demands it

  • You write specs before you write code — precise enough that an AI agent executes correctly on the first pass

  • You review AI-generated code with the same rigor you'd apply to a junior engineer's PR: edge cases, security gaps, design smell

  • You bias toward shipping. A good decision today beats a perfect one next week

We would not be a fit if

  • You need a clearly scoped role before you can operate

  • You measure output in lines of code written

  • You've only worked in large orgs with dedicated infra, QA, and platform teams

  • You optimize for stability over velocity

 

Our current stack

TypeScript monorepo · React Native · NestJS · PostgreSQL + Prisma · AWS (Terraform, Qovery) · GitHub Actions · Claude Code + Cursor

 

The process

  • Intro call (20 min): culture & role fit.

  • Technical interview (30 min)

  • At-home case study: hands-on project, delivery in 2 days.

  • Deep dive (90 min) and team chat (on-site)

  • Reference calls

 

How we work

We work together from our Paris hub. We’re passionate about what we’re building and believe the fastest way to create something exceptional is side by side. We’re open to relocation support for the right individuals, and we welcome missionaries who travel to work with us in Paris on a regular basis.

 

  • Rigor without ego: Audits, science, and code all deserve the same high bar.

  • Radical ownership: Feedback loops are short; everyone contributes to building the best version of Lucis.

  • Velocity over perfection: We ship daily and prefer a good decision today over a perfect one next week.

At Lucis, AI isn't just our product, it's our engine. 100% of our teams are equipped with the best AI agents. You have carte blanche to explore and automate everything that can be, so you can focus exclusively on high-value work.

jobs.title: Kundsupport
jobs.description:
Vill du göra karriär utomlands och samtidigt arbeta för ett välkänt och etablerat bolag? Trivs du i en internationell miljö där kundrelationer står i fokus? Härligt, då är det läge att läsa vidare!

I utkanten av Malaga, Fuengirola ligger vår prisbelönta kundservice som fått fina utmärkelser för vår goda service. Vi är ett snabbt växande bolag med höga ambitioner och mål. Idag är vi runt 300 medarbetare från åtta olika länder och på kontoret möts du av en energifull arbetsmiljö.

Hur ser din nya roll ut som kundservicemedarbetare för den svenska marknaden?

Hos oss är kunden i fokus! Ditt viktigaste uppdrag är att hjälpa våra kunder över telefon, chatt och mail med allt från fakturaärenden, tekniska frågor och bokning av service, till information om våra komponenter. Du lyssnar in vad kunden behöver hjälp med och erbjuder därefter den bästa tänkbara lösningen. Vi vill ha en långvarig positiv inverkan på våra kunders liv och vi är stolta över att kunna ge våra kunder en förstklassig service. I rollen samarbetar du med olika avdelningar, i ett högt tempo med flera ärenden i gång samtidigt. För att du ska få bästa möjliga start börjar du din karriär hos oss med en tre veckors gedigen introduktionsutbildning tillsammans med våra coacher. Utbildningen är givetvis betald.

Kundcentret har öppet på telefon måndag–fredag kl. 08.00–16.00. Chatten är öppen måndag–torsdag kl. 08.00–20.00 och fredag kl. 08.00–18.00. Du kommer att vara schemalagd 8 timmar per arbetspass.

Att flytta utomlands är spännande och lärorikt men kan också vara en stor förändring. För att göra flytten enklare, stöttar vi dig med att skaffa utländskt personnummer, socialförsäkring samt inskrivning på en spansk vårdcentral.

I vår matsal serveras, varje dag, gratis frukost och lunch till alla våra anställda. Vi erbjuder också friskvårdsbidrag och språkbidrag om du exempelvis vill läsa spanska. Utöver detta välkomnas du att delta i våra sociala evenemang och teamaktiviteter i soliga Spanien med cirka 300 soldagar årligen.

Vem söker vi efter?

Vi söker dig som har en positiv inställning och är duktig på att kommunicera. Du är flexibel och har lätt att anpassa dig till nya rutiner, situationer och arbetssätt. Vi ser att du är förbättringsvillig med viljan att alltid bli bättre på det du gör. Utöver detta ser vi att du har en god datavana och är van vid att hålla många bollar i luften samtidigt. Du behärskar både svenska och engelska i tal och skrift samt är prickfri i polisens belastningsregister. Det är starkt meriterande om du har tidigare erfarenhet av kundtjänstsupport via telefon och mail.

Det gör skillnad att arbeta på Sector Alarm - vi skapar säkrare hem och satsar på din utveckling.

Sector Alarm är en trygg arbetsplats där vi sätter en ära i att jobba nära våra medarbetare. När du arbetar för oss lovar vi att arbeta för dig. Vi kommer att skapa förutsättningar för att du ska lära dig nya saker och utveckla det som du redan är bra på. Vi har i Sverige blivit utsedda till Årets karriärföretag för elfte (!) året i rad och därmed har du goda möjligheter till att ta vidare steg i karriären.

Vi arbetar för en inkluderande arbetskultur och tar hand om samt stöttar varandra. Vi är öppna, ärliga och firar framgångar gemensamt – stora som små. Vi lyckas tillsammans.

Det vi gör, det är på riktigt – bli en del av vår resa och skapa säkrare hem och tryggare liv över hela Europa.

Vill du utvecklas och skapa tryggare liv? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

I din ansökan vill vi att du bifogar ditt CV, svarar på urvalsfrågorna samt skriver en motivering till varför du är intresserad av tjänsten och att arbeta hos oss. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mail.

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med placering på vårt kontor i Fuengirola, adressen är Calle Geranio 1, 29651, Fuengirola. En månads provanställning tillämpas.

Har du frågor om tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att ta kontakt med Talent Acquisition Specialist, Anna Avela på anna.avela@sectoralarm.se

Är du nyfiken på hur det är att jobba hos oss, ta gärna en titt på vårt konto @sectoralarmcs på Instagram.

Vi ser fram emot att lära känna dig!

jobs.title: Two-year Postdoctoral Position on Spintronics for Advanced Computing: Spintronic Device Fabrication, Characterization and Advanced Computing
jobs.description:
The Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a 2-year position as a postdoctoral researcher within spintronic computing. The position offers an exciting opportunity to advance spintronics through device physics, simulation, fabrication, experimental characterization, and integration of spintronic devices for advanced computing applications.

We are seeking a highly motivated candidate to investigate, design, fabricate, and characterize spintronic devices, with particular emphasis on Anisotropic Magnetoresistance (AMR), Giant Magnetoresistance (GMR), and Tunneling Magneto Resistance (TMR) devices. The work will combine magnetic and spintronic device physics, materials and multilayer structures, device fabrication, electrical measurement, modelling, and data analysis, with the aim of developing reliable spintronic technologies for advanced computing and emerging semiconductor applications.

The research will focus on understanding, controlling, and exploiting thermal fluctuations and stochastic switching in MTJs for physical entropy generation and energy-efficient computing, with particular emphasis on True Random Number Generators (TRNGs) and Stochastic Neural Accelerators (SNAs).

The successful candidate will work on the physics-based design, modelling, simulation, fabrication, and experimental characterization of spintronic devices and their integration into advanced computing systems. The position also includes a role in the Danish Chips Competence Center, where the candidate will contribute to connecting the Danish semiconductor and spintronics ecosystem with relevant EU pilot lines, facilitating collaboration, technology development, prototyping, and access to European semiconductor fabrication capabilities. The candidate will also contribute to preparing and writing research proposals and funding applications related to spintronics, semiconductor technologies, and advanced computing.

As a spintronic postdoc, you are expected to: 

  • Perform atomistic and micromagnetic simulations of s-MTJ structures and magnetization dynamics to investigate switching mechanisms, thermal activation, stochasticity, variability, and operating conditions relevant to TRNG and SNA applications.

  • Contribute to the electrical, magnetic, and transport characterization of fabricated AMR, GMR, and TMR devices, including resistance states, magnetoresistance, switching behaviour, current/voltage dependence, temperature dependence, and device-to-device variability, and correlate experimental results with modelling and simulation.

 

What we offer 

  • A stimulating research environment within SDU Microelectronics, a growing section integrating expertise in analog/digital IC design, spintronics, advanced computing, semiconductor technologies, and energy-efficient system architectures. 

  • Access to advanced facilities and infrastructure for spintronic device design, fabrication, electrical and magnetic characterization, and system prototyping, together with opportunities to collaborate with relevant Danish and European pilot-line and semiconductor facilities. 

  • Excellent opportunities for collaboration across SDU and with national and international academic and industrial partners in microelectronics, semiconductor technology, photonics, spintronics, and advanced computing, including activities connecting the Danish ecosystem with EU pilot lines.

  • An open and collaborative research culture within SDU’s Faculty of Engineering (TEK), The Mads Clausen Institute (MCI), promoting interdisciplinary innovation across electronics, materials science, semiconductor processing, spintronics, and artificial intelligence.

 

What we expect 

Applicants should hold a PhD in Electronic and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or a closely related field (the degree should have been completed within the last 6 years at most): 

  • Expertise in spintronics, magnetism, magnetic device physics, or related areas, with demonstrated experience in physics-based modelling and/or simulation of magnetic or spintronic devices. Experience with s-MTJ devices, stochastic magnetization dynamics, or thermal switching is highly desirable and electrical modeling of sMTJs using Verilog to be used in Cadense

  • Experience with experimental characterization of AMR, GMR, MTJ, or related spintronic devices, including electrical and magnetic measurements, resistance and magnetoresistance characterization, switching behaviour, and data analysis. Experience with pilot-line activities, technology transfer, or collaboration with semiconductor foundries is an advantage.

  • A strong research track record demonstrated through peer-reviewed publications and the ability to work effectively in collaborative research environments. Experience in writing research proposals, funding applications, or project plans is highly desirable.

jobs.title: Two-year Postdoc position on Spintronic Quantum-inspired Computing
jobs.description:
Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a 2-year Postdoctoral Researcher position within the newly funded QUANTRONIC – Spintronic Pseudo-Qubits for Room-Temperature Quantum Computing project, supported by the Villum Experiment programme of Villum Fonden.

We are seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to investigate a new class of spintronic pseudo-qubits (p-qubits) based on spin-orbit torque magnetic tunnel junctions (SOT-MTJs). The project explores whether engineered stochastic spintronic devices can reproduce key computational mechanisms associated with quantum systems - including superposition-like states, probability-amplitude-based interference, and entanglement-like correlations—without relying on fragile quantum coherence or cryogenic operation.

QUANTRONIC is a high-risk, high-gain research project positioned at the intersection of spintronics, probabilistic computing, quantum-inspired computing, nanoelectronics, and integrated circuit design. The central concept is a novel SOT-MTJ architecture designed to represent and manipulate probability amplitudes and to enable synchronization between multiple pseudo-qubits. The project will combine physics-based modelling, device design and fabrication, experimental characterization, and system-level demonstrations.

The successful candidate will work within SDU Microelectronics and collaborate closely with international partners, particularly INL – International Iberian Nanotechnology Laboratory, on the design and fabrication of spintronic devices.

The position is expected to start in February 2027, with the specific starting date to be agreed with the successful candidate.

 

As a Postdoctoral Researcher in QUANTRONIC, your key responsibilities will include:

  • Develop and refine physics-based compact models of SOT-MTJ-based pseudo-qubits, including stochastic switching and inter-device coupling.

  • Develop Verilog-A models and integrate them into circuit-level simulation environments such as Cadence.

  • Investigate the physical requirements for controlling probabilistic states and representing probability amplitudes in spintronic devices.

  • Collaborate with project partners on the design and fabrication of SOT-MTJ devices and arrays.

  • Experimentally characterize standalone devices and coupled arrays, including stochastic switching, synchronization, and entanglement-like correlations.

  • Investigate quantum-inspired gate operations and system-level demonstrations using networks of pseudo-qubits.

  • Contribute to proof-of-concept demonstrations, including integer factorization and other quantum-inspired computational problems.

  • Publish research results in high-quality international journals and conferences and contribute to the dissemination of project results.

  • Collaborate with researchers in spintronics, probabilistic computing, microelectronics, materials science, and quantum information.

 

What we offer

  • A unique opportunity to work on a high-risk, high-gain research concept exploring a new computational regime between classical probabilistic and quantum computing.

  • A stimulating research environment within SDU Microelectronics, a growing research section with expertise in spintronics, probabilistic computing, neuromorphic computing, analog/digital IC design, and emerging computing architectures.

  • Access to advanced facilities for electronic design, device characterization, measurement, and system prototyping.

  • Close collaboration with INL – International Iberian Nanotechnology Laboratory on spintronic device technology and fabrication.

  • An open, international, and collaborative research environment within SDU's Faculty of Engineering, supporting interdisciplinary research across electronics, physics, materials science, and computing.

  • Strong opportunities for developing an independent research profile in an emerging area of probabilistic and quantum-inspired hardware.

Applicants should hold a PhD in electronic engineering, electrical engineering, applied physics, nanotechnology, spintronics, or a closely related field.

The ideal candidate should have experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • Spintronics and magnetic devices, particularly MTJs, STT-MTJs, SOT-MTJs, or related technologies.

  • Physics-based modelling of nanoscale or magnetic devices.

  • Verilog-A, SPICE, and Cadence or comparable circuit/device simulation environments.

  • Experimental characterization of electronic, magnetic, or spintronic devices.

  • Stochastic or probabilistic computing systems.

Experience in micromagnetic simulation, magnetotransport measurements, nanofabrication, probabilistic computing, or quantum/quantum-inspired computing will be considered a strong advantage.

We are particularly interested in candidates who are enthusiastic about working across traditional disciplinary boundaries and are comfortable combining device physics, modelling, experimentation, and computing concepts.

The successful candidate should be able to work independently while contributing actively to an interdisciplinary and international research team. Excellent written and spoken English and strong communication skills are required.

jobs.title: PhD Position in High Performance Organic Photovoltaics
jobs.description:
The Centre for Advanced Photovoltaics and Thin-Film Energy Devices (SDU CAPE), Mads Clausen Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD position within the DFF funded project LuminOPV. The position is open from Dec. 1, 2026, and the specific start date will be agreed with the successful candidates. 

 

What we offer 

The PhD position is a part of the SDU CAPE research center at the Mads Clausen Institute, SDU, where we focus on designing, developing, and bringing forward new sustainable solar energy conversion and storage technologies, in particular new thin film solar cells and modules. The DFF LuminOPV project will explore aggregation-induced emission (AIE)-active molecular materials to control photophysical processes, molecular organization, and energy losses in organic photovoltaics. Complementary interface engineering and passivation strategies will be employed to optimize charge extraction, suppress interfacial defects, enhance operational stability, and facilitate scalable organic solar cells and modules. 

This PhD project focuses specifically on the design and development of AIE-active molecular materials for next-generation organic photovoltaics. The project will be part of the DFF1 project, and research stays abroad is part of the position. Most of your working time is devoted to your own research studies. As a PhD student you are expected to develop your own ideas and communicate scientific results in English. We offer a fully funded PhD position for the duration of three years. 

The successful applicant will be enrolled as a PhD student at the PhD School at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

What we expect 

Candidates who hold a master’s degree in a relevant field (chemistry, material science, physics, electrical engineering and similar). Preferred candidates have experience with some of the following: Organic synthesis, molecular photophysics, organic and/or hybrid semiconductors, thin films and interfaces, and organic photovoltaics. Due to the high cross-disciplinary nature of the work, the candidate is expected to have excellent collaboration skills. A very good capability of communicating scientific results in English, both orally and in writing is required.

 

Workplace description 

We are an international research center working in the field of green energy technologies (CAPE), and we are looking for a highly motivated PhD candidate to join our CAPE research center at University of Southern Denmark (SDU), campus Sønderborg, for developing next-generation sustainable and high-performance photovoltaics. We offer a modern, inclusive, international and interdisciplinary working environment with state-of-the-art facilities as well as a strong tradition of international collaboration. Our ambition is, to recruit, develop, and retain talented scholars committed to both academic excellence and departmental development.

Having a focus on green energy technologies - improving performance, device stability and up-scaling, the center has full access to an ISOS5 cleanroom and surface science laboratory facility for the preparation and characterization of thin films and photovoltaic devices, as well as a fully equipped Roll-to-Roll (R2R) facility for upscaling flexible devices. Our research center CAPE is a partner in various national and international research projects and networks that include collaboration partners from both academia and industry. 

 

Further information 

For information about the CAPE research center, please see https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/cape 

For information about the Mads Clausen Institute, please see www.sdu.dk/en/mci

Further information about this position is available from Associate Professor Vida Engmann, e-mail: engmann@mci.sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application. 

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • References may be included, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected.

Enrollment and employment terms

jobs.title: Barselsvikariat – Administrativ indkøbskoordinator
jobs.description:
Fourcom ApS søger en struktureret og serviceminded kollega til et spændende barselsvikariat, hvor du får en central rolle i samspillet mellem indkøb, produktion og salg.

Har du sans for struktur, koordinering og god leverandørkontakt? Trives du med at have mange bolde i luften og samtidig sikre, at tingene bliver fulgt helt til dørs? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Som en del af Fourcom ApS bliver du en vigtig del af den daglige drift, hvor du er med til at sikre et effektivt flow fra indkøb til produktion og videre ud til vores kunder.

Dine primære opgaver

Du får en alsidig hverdag med ansvar for blandt andet:

  • Koordinering mellem indkøb og produktion, så de rette varer og materialer er tilgængelige, når de skal bruges

  • Oprettelse og vedligeholdelse af indkøb, herunder sikring af korrekt information og opfølgning

  • Oprettelse og administration af varenumre, så vores produkt- og indkøbsdata altid er strukturerede og opdaterede

  • Dialog og koordinering med leverandører omkring ordrer, leverancer, priser og eventuelle udfordringer

  • Håndtering og koordinering af retursager, fra oprettelse til afslutning

  • Tæt kommunikation mellem salg og produktion, hvor du er med til at sikre, at information og aftaler bliver omsat til handling

  • Generelle indkøbs- og koordineringsopgaver, hvor du bidrager til at skabe struktur og fremdrift i hverdagen

En rolle med mange kontaktflader

Du bliver en vigtig koordinerende funktion i organisationen og får kontakt med både leverandører, salg, produktion og kolleger på tværs af virksomheden.

Derfor søger vi dig, som kan lide at være den, der skaber overblik, følger op og får tingene til at hænge sammen. Du behøver ikke vide alt fra dag ét – det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig, struktureret og har lyst til at tage ansvar.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Arbejder struktureret og har et godt øje for detaljer

  • Er god til at koordinere og bevare overblikket, også når der er travlt

  • Har gode kommunikative evner og trives med mange forskellige kontaktflader

  • Er serviceminded og løsningsorienteret

  • Har flair for administrative systemer og IT

  • Tager ansvar og følger dine opgaver til dørs

  • Har erfaring med indkøb, administration, logistik eller koordinering – men det er ikke et krav

Vi tilbyder

Hos Fourcom ApS får du en alsidig rolle med mulighed for at få indblik i hele processen fra indkøb til produktion og salg. Du bliver en del af en virksomhed, hvor samarbejde, fleksibilitet og godt købmandskab er en vigtig del af hverdagen.

Stillingen er et barselsvikariat med opstart 01/11-2026 og forventes at løbe til 01/10-26.

Arbejdssted: Fourcom ApS 
Arbejdstid: min. 30 timer 
Ansøgningsfrist: hurtigst muligt 

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send os din ansøgning og CV på ms@fourcom.dk .

jobs.title: Asennustyönjohtaja / vastaava työnjohtaja
jobs.description:
_Me Parmacolla uskomme, että rakennusten tulisi olla yhtä joustavia kuin yhteisöt, joita ne palvelevat. Muutamme yhteiskuntaa dynaamisella arkkitehtuurilla – muunneltavilla, siirrettävillä ja kiertotalouteen perustuvilla rakennuksilla, jotka elävät käyttäjiensä mukana. Tule mukaan tekemään tilaa kestävälle tulevaisuudelle!_

Haemme kokenutta **asennustyönjohtajaa / vastaavaa työnjohtajaa** itsenäiseen ja vastuulliseen rooliin johtamaan rakennushankkeitamme Helsingin seudulla. Vastaat samanaikaisesti yhden tai useamman hankkeen päivittäisestä johtamisesta ja varmistat, että työt etenevät turvallisesti, laadukkaasti, aikataulussa ja suunnitelmien mukaisesti.

Rakennustemme moduulit valmistetaan tehtaillamme ja asennetaan sekä viimeistellään valmiiksi työmaalla. Johdat työmaata kokonaisvaltaisesti, vastaat työmaan viranomaisvelvoitteista, sovitat yhteen työvaiheita ja aliurakoitsijoiden työtä, koordinoit - toimituksia sekä laadit tarvittavat työmaasuunnitelmat ja -dokumentaation. Seuraat ja raportoit työn etenemistä, ratkaiset työmaalla syntyviä tilanteita sekä osallistut työmaakokouksiin, katselmuksiin, tarkastuksiin ja luovutuksiin. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä projektinjohdon, suunnittelun, hankinnan, asiakkaiden, aliurakoitsijoiden ja tehtaidemme kanssa.

Tehtävässä ei ole ennalta määriteltyä päivittäistä työaikaa, vaan suunnittelet ja rytmität työsi itsenäisesti hankkeiden tavoitteiden ja työmaiden vaiheiden mukaan. Tämä tuo työhön vapautta, mutta edellyttää myös valmiutta mukauttaa työpäivää työmaiden tilanteisiin.

Työskentelet pääasiassa Helsingin seudun rakennuskohteissa. Tehtävään kuuluu lisäksi satunnaisia käyntejä Parmacon tehtailla Hämeenlinnassa, Leppävirralla ja Pyhäjoella. Voimassa oleva B-ajokortti vaaditaan, mutta omaa autoa ei edellytetä.

**Menestyt tehtävässä hyvin, kun**

- Sinulla on soveltuva rakennusalan korkeakoulututkinto, esimerkiksi rakennusmestarin, rakennusinsinöörin tai diplomi-insinöörin tutkinto.

- Sinulla on vaativan luokan vastaavan työnjohtajan pätevyys tai valmiudet hakea sitä sekä osaamista toimia vastaavana työnjohtajajana.

- Työmaan eri työvaiheet ovat sinulle tuttuja ja hallitset tarvittavien työmaasuunnitelmien ja -dokumentaation laatimisen.

- Pystyt johtamaan ja priorisoimaan useita samanaikaisia hankkeita ja työvaiheita.

- Osaat johtaa aliurakoitsijoita ja tehdä sujuvaa yhteistyötä eri osapuolten kanssa.

- Sinulla on toimiva ja kattava rakennusalan yhteistyö- ja aliurakoitsijaverkosto.

- Toimit käytännönläheisesti ja ratkaisukeskeisesti sekä viet sovitut asiat määrätietoisesti maaliin.

- Turvallisuus ja laatu ohjaavat toimintaasi.

- Hallitset tietotekniset työvälineet ja viestit sujuvasti suomeksi.


Kokemus koulu-, päiväkoti- tai muista julkisista rakennushankkeista sekä moduuli-, elementti- tai teollisesta rakentamisesta katsotaan eduksi. Arvostamme myös erittäin vaativan luokan vastaavan työnjohtajan pätevyyttä, muuta kielitaitoa ja Dalux-osaamista.

**Mitä tarjoamme?**

- Itsenäisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän, jossa johdat työmaan toteutusta ja vaikutat suoraan hankkeen onnistumiseen.

- Monipuolisia, yhteisöille tärkeitä rakennushankkeita pääosin koulu- ja päiväkotisektorilla.

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi ja työmaidemme toimintatapoja.

- Osaavan projektinjohdon, suunnittelun, hankinnan ja tuotannon tuen.

- Kokemukseesi ja osaamiseesi perustuvan palkan sekä tehtävän hoitamiseen tarvittavat työvälineet.


**Haku ja lisätiedot**

Haastatteluihin edetään arviolta viikoilla 45–46. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa tehtävän esihenkilö, työpäällikkö Jussi Lavikainen, p. 040 145 5221.

jobs.title: Sähköautomaatioasentaja, Turku
jobs.description:
_Asiakkaamme on suomalainen Turussa sijaitseva teollisuuden kunnossapidon vahva ammattilainen ja yritys on perustettu vuonna 1995. Yritys tarjoaa asiakkailleen muun muassa tuotantokoneiden- ja laitteiden asennukset, korjaukset sekä huollot. Tavallisten kunnossapitopalveluiden lisäksi he tarjoavat kokonaisvaltaisia kunnossapidon palvelusopimuksia ja kiinteähintaisia tuotteistettuja palveluita. Yritys tarjoaa myös kiinteistöjen LVIS-palveluita._

Nyt heidän riveissään on paikka automaatioasentajalle. Työnkuva koostuu teollisuuden sähköautomaatiolaitteiden asennus-, kytkentä- ja huoltotöistä. Tämän lisäksi automaatioasentaja vastaa järjestelmien tarkastuksista ja niiden toimivuuden testauksesta. Työ on osaltaan liikkuvaa, joten valittavan henkilön tulee olla valmis liikkumaan myös eri asiakkaiden toimipisteisiin. Tämän vuoksi vaadimme hakijalta B-ajokorttia.

Hakijalta odotamme aikaisempaa työkokemusta teollisuuden kunnossapidosta, sähkö- tai automaatioalan koulutusta sekä kokemusta sähkö- ja automaatioalan asennuksista. Tulevan sähköautomaatioasentajan tulee olla oma-aloitteinen, itseohjautuva sekä motivoitunut ja aidosti kiinnostunut alasta. Työntekijältä vaaditaan voimassa olevia tulityö-, työturvallisuus- ja EA-kortteja.

Työt alkavat mahdollisimman pian heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Työtä tehdään arkisin päivävuorossa, työaikojen kuitenkin ollessa työskentelykohteista riippuen joustavia. Työkielenä käytetään suomea, joten suomen kielen taito on ehdoton.

TYÖKUUTIO!

Olemme asiakkaidemme taustavoima rekrytoinneissa sekä olemme työntekijöidemme tukena koko työsuhteen ajan. Tavoitteenamme on yhdistää työntekijät uusiin työpaikkoihin. Meillä on työmahdollisuuksia opiskelijoille, alan vaihtajille, kesätyöntekijöille sekä jo kokeneille osaajille! Voit lukea meistä sekä kauttamme tarjottavista työntekijöiden eduista lisää www.tyokuutio.fi.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer, Konecranes
jobs.description:
We are now looking for a Mechanical Engineer to join Konecranes' Shipyard Cranes team and contribute to some of the world's most demanding crane engineering projects.

Konecranes moves what matters. We are a global leader in material handling solutions, serving a broad range of customers across multiple industries. We consistently set the industry benchmark, from everyday improvements to the breakthroughs at moments that matter most, because we know we can always find a safer, more productive and sustainable way. That's why, with more than 16,000 professionals in over 50 countries, we are trusted every day to lift, handle and move what the world needs.

Konecranes is committed to ensuring that all employees and job applicants are treated fairly in an environment free from discrimination and where diversity, equity and inclusion are valued.

[https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/49cf9064-f425-4d1c-b5e9-ecfdc64d4c69/original.jpeg]

Would you be our new Mechanical Engineer?

As a Mechanical Engineer, you will join Konecranes' Shipyard Cranes team and work on some of the world's largest and most technically demanding crane projects.

Your responsibilities include structural analyses, strength calculations and mechanical design throughout both the tendering and project execution phases. You will perform strength analyses, mass, cross-sectional and machinery calculations, transportation and erection analyses, and support design decisions by interpreting standards, specifications and customer requirements.

Working closely with designers, project teams and customers, you will contribute to solving complex engineering challenges while gradually taking on broader technical responsibilities. The role offers a unique opportunity to develop towards future mechanical Chief Project Engineer responsibilities with support from experienced senior engineering professionals.

The position is full-time and employed through Biisoni. The role offers flexible working hours, a hybrid working model with approximately one office day per week in Hyvinkää, and international travel of around 30-60 days per year.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for an engineer with experience in strength analysis and steel structures. Your background may come from industrial machinery, mobile equipment, heavy industrial equipment, steel structures, or similar engineering environments.

To succeed in this role, you have a good understanding of structural mechanics, strength calculations, dynamic analysis and mechanical design as well as the ability to interpret 2D engineering drawings. A Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, with major in Machine Design, Steel Structures, Engineering Mechanics or similar is preferred, but candidates with relevant practical experience are also encouraged to apply.

Experience with Finnsap, NX, Simcenter, Ansys, or similar engineering tools is considered an advantage. Strong communication skills in English are required, while Finnish language skills are considered a plus. As a person, you are analytical, proactive and eager to learn. You enjoy solving technical challenges, taking ownership and developing your expertise over the long term.

Why us?

Konecranes' Shipyard Cranes business offers a highly specialised engineering environment where every project is unique. You will work on some of the worlds largest and most technically advanced shipyard cranes, learn from experienced experts and build expertise in demanding structural engineering and strength analysis. The role provides a clear development path towards broader engineering responsibility and future mechanical Chief Project Engineer responsibilities in an international project environment.

Have we got your interest?

If you are interested, we want to hear from you as soon as possible! Please submit your application via the link by 30.10.2026. We review applications and start interviews already during the application period.

The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. The employment relationship will be established with Biisoni. For more information about the position, please contact Saija Salter, Recruitment Consultant, via email at saija.salter@biisoni.fi [saija.salter@biisoni.fi].
