jobs.title: Vil du lede et driftsteknikerteam med varierte og spennende arbeidsdager?
jobs.description:
I Coop Øst er det stor aktivitet, og spesielt i vår avdeling for butikk- og eiendomsutvikling skjer det mye. Vår driftstekniker og innleide vaktmestere har ansvar for den daglige oppfølgingen våre 52 egeneiende eiendommer. For å møte veksten og den økte aktiviteten søker vi nå en teamleder.

Som teamleder vil du få ansvar for eget team med driftsteknikere/innleide vaktmestere, samtidig som du har ansvar for egen eiendomsportefølje på lik linje med de øvrige driftsteknikerne. Rollen passer for deg som trives med å kombinere praktisk og operativ eiendomsdrift med faglig oppfølging, planlegging, koordinering og teamlederansvar.

Butikk- og eiendomsutvikling i Coop Øst har ansvar for forvaltning og vedlikehold av våre butikker og eiendommer. Avdelingen teller 16 engasjerte ansatte med lang fartstid i bedriften, og det er 82 ansatte på hovedkontoret totalt. Per i dag forvalter Coop Øst ca. 287 000 m² eiendom med butikkdrift. Vi eier 52 eiendommer med butikkdrift (totalt 100 500 m²) som skal forvaltes og utvikles. Som teamleder for driftsteknikerne blir du en sentral bidragsyter i å sikre god struktur, effektiv ressursbruk og høy kvalitet i den operative eiendomsdriften.

Søknadsfrist: 20.10.2026
Søkere vurderes fortløpende.

Hva skal du gjøre?
Som teamleder vil du både jobbe med egen portefølje og ha et tydelig teamlederansvar for driftsteknikerne/innleide vaktmestere. Du vil følge opp teamet og bidra til god planlegging og koordinering, samtidig som du sikrer at oppgaver prioriteres og løses på en strukturert måte. Rollen innebærer praktisk arbeid ute på eiendommene og daglig drift og tilsyn. Du vil ha oppfølging av tekniske anlegg, følge opp eksterne leverandører og serviceavtaler, samt gi bistand ved ombygginger, oppgraderinger og prosjekter. I tillegg vil du være en tydelig faglig ressurs og koordinator for driftsteknikerne/innleide vaktmestere, bidra til god fremdrift i oppgavene og sørge for at avdelingen har oversikt over status, behov og prioriteringer. Du vil ha en viktig rolle i å bidra til sikker, kostnadseffektiv og forutsigbar drift av eiendommene, samtidig som du skaper gode rammer for teamet ditt.

Coop Øst har hovedkontor på Kolbotn og eget lager for verktøy og utstyrrett i nærheten. Du må påregne reisevirksomhet mellom våre ulike eiendommer. Dette er en selvstendig og mobil rolle hvor du primært vil jobbe ute med egen eiendomsportefølje og samtidig skal bidra til å planlegge, koordinere og følge opp arbeidsoppgavene i teamet.

Hva ønsker vi av deg?

  • Vi ønsker at du har yrkesfaglig bakgrunn, gjerne som tømrer, elektriker eller rørlegger eller er driftstekniker i dag. 
  • Det er en fordel med erfaring fra drift og vedlikehold av næringseiendom.
  • Førerkort klasse B er et krav. Førerkort klasse BE er påkrevd for stillingen. Kandidater som ikke har BE ved ansettelse må være villige til å gjennomføre og bestå førerprøven for klasse BE innen avtalt tid.
  • Det er viktig med gode samarbeidsevner og at du trives med en utadrettet og selvstendig arbeidshverdag.
  • I Coop Øst er vi opptatt av et godt arbeidsmiljø og det å være serviceinnstilt over dine kollegaer og våre samarbeidspartnere legger vi stor vekt på.
  • For god og grundig utførelsen av denne jobben er viktig å være strukturert og løsningsorientert


Hva kan du få hos oss?
Coop Øst er et fremoverlent samvirkelag hvor det skjer mye. Vi er opptatt av å utvikle våre ansatte og legger til rette for at du skal trives og få både den støtten og det faglige påfyllet som trengs hos oss. Du kommer inn i et godt onboardingsprogram og vil oppleve at hovedkontoret består av mange serviceinnstilte og hjelpsomme kollegaer. Vi tilbyr konkurransedyktig lønn, telefonordning, arbeidsbil, helseforsikring og tilgang til firmahytter får du også. Som medeier og ansatt i Coop Øst får du 6% ansattrabatt/kjøpeutbytte. Ikke minst vil du få mange engasjerte og skikkelig dyktige kollegaer og jobb i et solid selskap. Vi tror det er bra å jobbe hos oss og vi vil ta godt vare på deg i Coop Øst. 

Coop Øst bruker sertifiserte arbeidspsykologiske testverktøy fra Assessio i rekrutteringsprosessen.
Vi benytter SEMAC bakgrunnssjekk på aktuelle kandidater.

Hvis dette er noe for deg gleder vi oss til å se eller lese søknaden din:-)

Kundene våre gjenspeiler befolkingen og det vil vi at våre ansatte også skal gjøre. Vi er opptatt av mangfold og ønsker alle søkere velkommen, uansett bakgrunn, erfaring, funksjonsevne, kjønn, legning eller religion. Coop Øst ønsker å være en arbeidsgiver for alle.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Coop Øst SA er Norges største samvirkelag med en omsetning på 10,2 milliarder i 2025. Vi har ca. 4400 ansatte og 211 butikker i de 5 fylkene Østfold, Akershus, Oslo, Buskerud og Innlandet med hovedkontor på Kolbotn i Nordre Follo. Coop har 6 kjedekonsepter; Coop Prix, Coop Mega, EXTRA, Matkroken, Obs og Obs BYGG. Coop er den eneste aktøren innen detaljhandel som er eid av forbrukerne og baserer sin drift på delingsøkonomi og utbytte til alle medeiere. Coop er opptatt av bærekraft, og omtanke for mennesker, dyr og miljø blir stadig viktigere for oss. Derfor jobber vi kontinuerlig med å redusere vår klima- og miljøpåvirkning. Vi har blant annet en nullvisjon for kasting av mat og fokus på bærekraftige produkter. For å lese mer se www.coop.no/coop-og-barekraft

jobs.title: Join us in our mission to find new ways of protecting neurons from neurodegeneration!
jobs.description:
About the position

We are looking for a highly motivated researcher to join our team at the Department of Microbiology, at the Institute of Clinical Medicine at the University of Oslo. The position will be associated with the young research group “Mitonuclear DNA Maintenance and Transcriptional Control“ and will be working on the Research Council of Norway funded research project “MIND: Mitochondria-Initiated Neuronal Defense against Parkinson’s Disease”.

The position is for 2 years, from 1st of January 2027. Start date is negotiable.


More about the position

This position offers a unique opportunity to help uncover how DNA repair and mitochondrial transcription shape neuronal resilience in Parkinson’s disease. You will be the main experimental researcher of Work Package 2, where we develop and apply a human induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) based model of midbrain dopaminergic neurons and midbrain organoids. Using patient-derived iPSCs carrying an alpha-synuclein (SNCA) triplication and isogenic controls, you will investigate how loss of DNA repair enzymes alters mitochondrial transcription, alpha-syn aggregation, and neuronal survival.

The project explores a new idea in Parkinson’s disease (PD): that certain types of DNA repair deficiency can activate protective mitochondrial and transcriptional responses in neurons, rather than only causing damage. We focus on the DNA base excision repair (BER) enzymes and how their loss affects mitochondrial function, α-synuclein aggregation, and survival of dopaminergic neurons.

You will be employed at the Department of Microbiology, which is jointly affiliated with the University of Oslo and Oslo University Hospital. The institute hosts a strong but very social environment, with access to advanced core facilities. The research section in the department has 15 research groups and 6 project groups (https://www.ous-research.no/microbiology/) working in various fields, including brain cancer, microbiology, epigenetics causes of disease, as well as groups focusing on bioinformatics.

The department will be located in the new life science building from January 2027 located near Forskningsparken with easy access by public transport (metro, tram, and bus), bicycle routes. You will work in an international, interdisciplinary environment with close collaboration across research groups in Oslo and with our partners at the University of Edinburgh.


Why we are seeking a researcher

Parkinson’s disease is one of the fastest-growing neurodegenerative disorders worldwide, yet current treatments are not disease-modifying. The MIND project challenges the traditional view that mitochondrial DNA damage is purely detrimental and explores how specific DNA repair defects may activate protective transcriptional programs in neurons. We are seeking a researcher who can take a leading experimental role in WP2: to establish and characterize our human iPSC-derived midbrain dopaminergic neuron model and to dissect how DNA repair-dependent changes in mitochondrial and nuclear transcription contribute to neuroprotection against alpha-syn–induced stress.

You will work closely with the principal investigator Dr. Nicola Pietro Montaldo, Prof. Hilde Loge Nilsen (UiO/OUH), and Prof. Tilo Kunath (University of Edinburgh).

If you are excited by the idea of discovering new neuronal self-defense programs, reshaping how we think about DNA repair and mitochondrial stress in Parkinson’s disease, and contributing to future therapeutic strategies, we encourage you to apply.


Your main tasks will be

Culture of iPSCs and Dopaminergic neurons:

  • Establish differentiation protocol for human neuronal cultures
  • Differentiate cryopreserved human iPSC into mature dopaminergic neurons (up to ~day 45)
  • Differentiate cryopreserved human iPSC-derived midbrain progenitors into mature dopaminergic neurons (up to ~day 45)
  • Validate neuronal identity and midbrain/dopaminergic markers using immunocytochemistry and RT-qPCR

Model Parkinson’s disease in vitro:

  • Work with a defined panel of iPSC lines: A patient line with SNCA (α-synuclein) triplication (high α-syn levels and aggregation) Isogenic SNCA-corrected controls (reduced or no α-syn expression).Lines with BER knockout on the SNCA triplication background
  • Measure α-syn and phospho-α-syn (pSer129) levels and aggregation (Western blot, ELISA, immunofluorescence)
  • Use seed amplification assays to investigate spreading of misfolded α-syn species
  • Assess mitochondrial function and stress responses
  • Measure mitochondrial respiration (OCR), ATP production and responses to mitochondrial stressors such as MPP+
  • Analyze mitochondrial DNA integrity and basic nuclear DNA damage responses
  • Contribute to transcriptional and data-driven analyses
  • Prepare samples for RNA-seq and other omics readouts
  • Work with the PI and collaborators on basic analysis and interpretation of differential gene expression and pathway changes.

Functional readouts of neuronal health:

  •  Use microelectrode array (MEA) recordings (Maestro Pro Platform) to monitor neuronal network activity and relate this to α-syn load and mitochondrial status.

What you will gain:

  • Hands-on experience with human iPSC-derived dopaminergic neurons and state-of-the-art PD models
  • Training in mitochondrial biology, DNA repair, and transcriptional regulation in neurons
  • Access to advanced infrastructure (imaging, MEA, sequencing, high-performance computing)
  • Close collaboration with leading groups in DNA repair (Nilsen), PD/iPSC modeling (Kunath), and a growing national BER network (BER Norway)
  • Opportunities to co-author publications and present your work at national and international meetings.

What skills are important in this role?

 Required qualifications:

  • A PhD (or equivalent) in molecular biology, cell biology, immunology, neuroscience, biotechnology, or a closely related field
  • Documented experience with mammalian cell culture and standard sterile techniques, including primary cells, neuronal progenitor cells, and/or 3D/organoid cultures
  • Solid competence in core molecular and cell biology methods, such as: DNA / RNA extraction, PCR / qPCR / RT-qPCR, Western blotting, and immunohistochemistry / immunocytochemistry / immunofluorescence with associated fluorescence microscopy
  • Experience with multicolor flow cytometry and functional cellular or immune assays
  • Hands-on experience preparing high-quality samples for next-generation sequencing (NGS), ideally including single-cell or single-nucleus RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq / snRNA-seq) from complex tissues, together with standard quality-control metrics (e.g. Qubit, TapeStation)
  • Experience coordinating wet-lab work with bioinformatics and sequencing core facilities, and developing, optimizing, and documenting laboratory workflows
  • Experience with human iPSC-derived models, midbrain organoids, and/or neuronal differentiation (dopaminergic or other CNS lineages preferred
  • Good understanding of experimental design, protocol development and optimization, data documentation, reproducibility, and basic statistical analysis
  • Good written and oral communication skills in English
  • Ability to work independently at the bench while coordinating effectively with principal investigators, bioinformaticians, core facilities, and collaborators.

Desired qualifications:
It is an advantage if you have one or more of the following:

  • Background in DNA repair, transcription, or chromatin biology
  • Experience supervising or training junior researchers or students
  • Experience with neurodegeneration models, especially:
    •  Parkinson’s disease
    • α-synuclein biology (expression, aggregation, or toxicity assays)   
  • Experience with mitochondrial biology, e.g.: 
    • Measuring oxygen consumption rate (OCR) or related metabolic assays
    • Working with mitochondrial toxins
  • Familiarity with bioinformatics / scripting (R, Python, or similar)
  • Microelectrode array (MEA) or other electrophysiological recordings (an advantage, not a requirement)
  • Flexibility to work on weekends when necessary to support cell culture work.

Meeting the required criteria is essential; the desired qualifications and personal skills will be used to distinguish between otherwise well-qualified candidates.


Personal skills 

In this role, you should:

  • Be curious, motivated, and scientifically engaged, with a strong interest in neurodegeneration and molecular mechanisms
  • Work systematically and reliably, with attention to detail and reproducibility
  • Be proactive in troubleshooting and optimizing protocols
  • Communicate clearly and openly, sharing results and challenges with the team
  • Enjoy working in an interdisciplinary and international environment and collaborating across groups and institute.

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer / We can offer you / Why should you choose us?
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK from 640 000 to 730 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

The application must include:

In addition to the minimum information required by the Jobbnorge portal, applicants must upload a single PDF file containing the following documents in the order listed below.

  • Application letter including a summary of scientific work, interests and motivation
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV), including a dedicated description of relevant skills, qualifications, and competencies that demonstrate how the applicant meets the requirements of this call
  • A complete list of publications, highlighting the candidate's role in main publications relevant to the position.
  • Transcripts and certificates. 
  • Contact information for 2-3 references: Names, email and telephone number of 2-3 referees (describe relation to applicant).

This PDF will constitute the sole basis for the evaluation of the application.

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Fellow in Special Needs Education
jobs.description:
Job description

Applicants are invited for a three to four-year position as a Postdoctoral Fellow emphasizing research on special needs education for students with neurodevelopmental disorders. The position is to be based at the Department of Special Needs Education, Faculty of Educational Sciences, University of Oslo. 

In 2024, Norway implemented a change to the Education Act, adjusting the criteria used to allocate extra resources for children with special needs. This project will evaluate the impact of this legislative change on children with Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), focusing specifically on their transition from kindergarten to formal schooling, and their subsequent academic outcomes. 

To capture both pre- and post-reform conditions, the project will combine secondary and primary data. For the pre-reform period, the applicant will draw primarily on existing Norwegian data sources such as cohort studies and/or relevant national registries, which can be linked as appropriate to the research questions. The applicant will be responsible for identifying the most suitable data source(s) for the pre-reform period and applying for the necessary data access and approvals. The applicant will then collect new primary data to capture the post-reform period. 

Within this structure, the applicant has flexibility in developing the proposal to include the specific data source(s) and academic outcomes to be examined, in line with their own research interests. The significance and rationale for the selected data source(s) and outcomes should be well detailed and justified within the project description. The applicant is expected to outline plans for data collection, as well as the methodological and analytical approaches envisioned. The fellow will also be expected to apply for relevant ethical approvals, collect primary data, conduct data analysis, plan the scientific publications that are part of the fellowship, as well as be first-author on the agreed upon publications.


More about the position

The appointment is a full-time position for a period of three years, with 10 % of which is devoted to required duties. Other career-promoting work will consist of presentation of project data at national and international conferences, authorship on scientific publications, potential supervision of Master and PhD candidates, and the possibilities of completing certification in Higher Education Pedagogy. Given that the position includes own data collection, the candidate is expected to be located in Oslo.

Depending on the candidate’s competence and the teaching needs of the department, the fellowship period can be extended up to four years, with 25 % of which is devoted to required duties. Other career-promoting work will in this case for example consist of various teaching tasks and obligations.

The main purpose of the fellowship is to build a research profile and competence that qualifies the postdoctoral fellow to apply for a position as associate professor within their disciplines. The position may also provide other competence with relevance for the postdoctoral fellow's further career.

If the Postdoctoral Fellow does not already have educational qualifications that meet the requirements for an associate professor position, UiO shall facilitate the acquisition of such competence during the employment period.

A career plan shall be developed for the Postdoctoral Fellow, specifying the competencies the Postdoctoral Fellow should acquire. UiO is responsible for following up on the career plan and ensuring that the Postdoctoral Fellow has access to career guidance throughout the postdoctoral term.


Qualification requirements
  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in Special Needs Education, Psychology, or other relevant fields. The doctoral dissertation must have been submitted for evaluation by the application deadline. Appointment is dependent on the public defense of the doctoral thesis being approved
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English
  • Demonstrated knowledge about neurodevelopmental disabilities
  • Demonstrated knowledge in quantitative statistical analyses and data management. More specifically, strong quantitative skills and experience in applying quasi-experimental methods (e.g., difference-in-difference, regression discontinuity, interrupted time series) to evaluate policy or intervention effects
  • Demonstrated knowledge and experience with one of the following statistical programming softwares (Stata, R, Mplus or similar) is required
  • Strong scientific writing skills and a track record of peer-reviewed publication is required

The following qualifications will count in the assessment of the applicants:

  • Experience with longitudinal quantitative methods will be considered a strength and emphasized
  • Demonstrated knowledge in empirical data collection will be considered an advantage and emphasized
  • Experience with large datasets will be considered an advantage and emphasized
  • Previous research experience, especially related to neurodevelopmental conditions such as ADHD, special education, or developmental psychology is considered an advantage and emphasized
  • Mastery of Norwegian or another Scandinavian language is considered an advantage

Personal skills
  • Ability to work independently and take initiative
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills
  • Strong organizational and project management skills
  • Execution capability
  • Adaptability and flexibility
  • Good attention to detail and rigour

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


We offer
  • Salary NOK 595 000 – NOK 670 000 per annum depending on qualifications in position as Postdoctoral Research Fellow (position code 1352). From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund
  • A professionally stimulating work environment
  • Attractive welfare benefits
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes

How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter of maximum one page (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interest)
  • A three-page project description including background/theoretical relevance, research aims, and planned methodological and analytical approaches, in addition to a one-page progress plan. The relevance of the PhD to the project should also be documented. The reference list is not included in the page limit
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Copy of PhD Diploma or documentation of thesis submission. Applicants who have not yet defended their PhD dissertation need to include an advisor’s letter confirming specific expectations about when the degree will be received
  • Copies of educational certificates (academic transcripts only)
  • A complete list of publications
  • Up to three peer-reviewed academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered
  • List of reference persons: 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail, and phone number)

The application with attachments must be delivered in our electronic recruiting system Jobbnorge. Foreign applicants are advised to attach an explanation of their university’s grading system. Please note that all documents should be in English (or a Scandinavian language).

Incomplete applications will not be assessed.

In assessing the applications, special emphasis will be placed on the documented, academic qualifications, the project description, and the quality of the project as well as the candidate’s motivation and personal suitability. Interviews with the best qualified candidates will be arranged.

It is expected that the successful candidate will be able to complete the project during the period of employment.


Formal regulations

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and the guidelines and regulations for appointments to Postdoctoral Fellowships at the University of Oslo.

No one can be appointed for more than one Postdoctoral Fellow period at the University of Oslo.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 27 400 students and 6 900 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Department of Special Needs Education is one of the three departments at The Faculty of Educational Sciences.

The department focuses on basic and applied research and education of bachelor-, master- and doctoral level candidates within the field of special needs education in Norway. 

The department employs over 50 scientific staff in addition to about 20 administrative employees. The department has approximately 800 students distributed between bachelor- and master's degree studies in special needs education as well as PhD-studies.

jobs.title: Researcher on Global Maternal Health
jobs.description:
About the position 

Applications are invited for a three-year researcher position (80%) at the Institute of Health and Society as part of a Global Health research project, "Preventing Severe Hypertensive Adverse Events in Pregnancy and Childbirth" (PRESHA). The position is part of a new Norwegian Research Council-funded project (Research Projects for Scientific Renewal – Global Health) led by Associate Professor Andrea Solnes Miltenburg at the University of Oslo. Intended starting date for the position is Autumn 2026. 

The appointment is a part-time 80% position and is made for a period of up to three years. The researcher will work closely with Associate Professor Andrea Solnes Miltenburg.

The candidate is welcome to participate in building a long-term research program with particular emphasis on thematic areas fitting within a broader perspective on global women’s health across the life course.


More about the project

The PRESHA project is an ambitious project that aims to prevent maternal and perinatal death and disability due to pre-eclampsia in low-resource settings through improved prediction, prevention and clinical management. The project takes place in Mwanza, Tanzania. The official project period is from 2023-2028. The project partners are from Norway, Tanzania and the Netherlands. The project is unique in that it combines the introduction of biomarker PlGF/Sflt-1 for pre-eclampsia prediction with strengthening the organization of existing care processes. We will use a combination of disciplines and innovative methodological approaches to explore existing implementation challenges and co-create, implement and evaluate a package of interventions for prevention and management of pre-eclampsia that is adapted and relevant to the Tanzanian context.

For more information about the project, or further inquiries about the position please contact Associate Professor Andrea Solnes Miltenburg.


Your main tasks will be: 

The researcher will have a central role in the implementation phase of PRESHA, while also conducting analyses of cohort data. Key responsibilities include:

Research position

  • Lead the day-to-day coordination of the implementation phase in close collaboration with partners in Tanzania, the Netherlands and Norway.
  • Organize and support implementation of the PRESHA quality-of-care package (PRESHA-QoC), including training, supervision, co-creation workshops and audit cycles.
  • Coordinate the stepped-wedge implementation of biomarker-based risk prediction (PRESHA‑TRIAL) across participating facilities.
  • Oversee timelines, documentation, reporting, ethics renewals and regulatory requirements related to the implementation phase.
  • Facilitate communication between clinical teams, research staff, community partners and the international study group.
  • Contribute to data quality assurance, protocol adherence and monitoring of implementation processes.
  • Analyze cohort data related to the social determinants of health and their impact on outcomes related to hypertensive disorders of pregnancy.
  • Lead and co-author scientific publications in peer-reviewed journals.
  • Contribute to methodological innovation in implementation research.
  • Work closely with the PI and team on developing and writing research grant applications (e.g. for project extension, new related studies).

Engage in dissemination, policy briefs and knowledge translation activities towards Tanzanian and international stakeholders.


Qualification requirements 

Qualification requirements

  • A PhD (or equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree) in global health, public health, epidemiology, medical sciences, social sciences with strong health focus, or a closely related field. The doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Appointment is dependent on the public defense of the doctoral thesis being approved.
  • Documented experience with mixed-methods research (both quantitative and qualitative).
  • Strong skills in quantitative analysis, preferably including:
    • cohort or longitudinal data analysis
    • regression modelling
    • handling of routine health dataexperience with statistical software (e.g. Stata, R, or similar).
  • Experience with qualitative methods (e.g. interviews, focus groups, observations) in health research.
  • Demonstrated interest in or experience with implementation research, quality improvement or health systems research.
  • Familiarity with maternal health, hypertensive disorders in pregnancy, or related fields in global women’s health.
  • Familiarity with the thematic areas of the project and the complexity of maternal health is required.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English is required.

Desired qualifications

  • Knowledge of a Scandinavian language and/or Kiswahili would be an asset.
  • Previous experience working East Africa/sub-Saharan Africa and in multidisciplinary and international teams will be an advantage.
  • Experience with social determinants of health, food security, or equity-focused analyses in health research is particularly desirable.
  • Experience in grant writing or participation in funding applications is an advantage.
  • Demonstrating previous experience of working with mixed-methods research, implementation research and working in a multidisciplinary team in low-resource settings would be an advantage. 

Personal skills

We are looking for a candidate who:

  • Is highly motivated to pursue an academic career.
  • Can work independently and systematically, while being an engaged team player.
  • Has strong organizational and project management skills and can handle complex coordination tasks across partners and countries.
  • Has excellent written and verbal communication skills, and can communicate effectively with clinicians, researchers, students, community representatives and policymakers.
  • Can take initiative and demonstrate strong, equitable and shared leadership skills in an international, multidisciplinary environment, fostering co‑ownership among partners 
  • Is willing and able to spend longer periods in Tanzania (e.g. for fieldwork, coordination and collaboration).

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer: 
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • An academically stimulating working environment at the University of Oslo/Helsam and connectivity to an international network in Europe and sub-Saharan Africa.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.
  • Good welfare schemes.

  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK from 610 000 - to 720 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Application letter outlining your motivation and how you would contribute to the PRESHA project

  • Example of previous publications and research work of relevance for this position

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.

If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Institute of Health and Society is one of three institutes at the Faculty of Medicine at the University of Oslo. The Institute covers various disciplines and consists of six departments: General Practice, Health Sciences, Health Management and Health Economics, Medical Ethics, Community Medicine and Global Health and Public Health Science.

The Institute of Health and Society bases its work on a complex understanding of disease, health and health systems. jobs.title: Liikunnanohjaaja
jobs.description:
Kangasalla palkitseva ja kannustava työilmapiiri ovat työssä viihtymisen ja onnistumisen kulmakiviä. Hyvä työilmapiiri säteilee hyvää koko kaupunkiin. Meillä Kangasalla arvostetaan oman osaamisen ja työyhteisön kehittämistä, joten kaupunki tarjoaa paljon koulutusmahdollisuuksia. Meillä saa kokeilla, onnistua ja erehtyä. Kaikista kokeiluista opimme uutta. Me tuemme ja kannustamme sinua pitämään huolta itsestäsi niin työssä kuin vapaa-ajallakin. Työhyvinvoinnin tukemiseksi meillä on käytössä uintietuus Kangasalan uimahallissa, hyvinvointi- ja työmatkaetuus (Epassi) sekä hyvät ennaltaehkäisevät työterveyshuoltopalvelut. Kangasalan kaupungille on neljännen kerran myönnetty Hyvän mielen työpaikka -merkki, joka kuvaa tekemäämme työtä henkilöstömme mielen hyvinvoinnin saralla.

Avoinna oleva määräaikainen liikunnanohjaajan tehtävä ajalle 2.11.2026-31.7.2028 sijoittuu sivistyskeskukseen, hyvinvointi- ja vapaa-aikapalveluiden palvelualueelle. Hyvinvointi- ja vapaa-aikapalveluiden palvelualueeseen kuuluu kirjasto-, kulttuuri-, liikunta- ja nuorisopalvelut, hyvinvoinnin ja terveyden edistäminen sekä taiteen perusopetus ja kansalaisopistopalvelut.

Liikuntapalvelut edistää kaupunkilaisten kokonaisvaltaista hyvinvointia ja motivoi heitä liikunnalliseen elämäntapaan. Liikunnanohjaajan tehtäviin kuuluu liikunnanohjaus, liikuntaneuvonta, kouluyhteistyö, liikuntatilojen tilavarausten hallinnointi sekä erilaiset tapahtumat. Liikunnanohjaus tapahtuu eri toimintaympäristöissä sisältäen myös sosiaalisen median kanavat.

Hakijalta edellytetään liikunnanohjaajan tutkintoa (AMK), liikuntaneuvojan tutkintoa tai muuta vastaavaa soveltuvaa alan koulutusta. Työ vaatii itsenäistä työotetta sekä hyviä organisointi- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja. Työtehtävä edellyttää oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta.

Työaika on 38,25 h/vko. Palkkaus on KVTESin mukainen ja tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 2700,00 €/kk. Tehtävän täytössä noudatetaan kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa.

Työ- ja opiskelutodistukset tarkistetaan mahdollisessa haastattelutilaisuudessa. Tehtävään valittavan on esitettävä rikosrekisterilain 6 § 2 momentissa tarkoitettu rikostaustaote ennen tehtävän vastaanottamista.

Hakemukset pyydetään jättämään 21.10.2026 klo 15 mennessä. Rekrytointikeskustelut pyritään järjestämään viikolla 44.

Liity hyvän piiriin ja tule töihin Kangasalle!

Mikäli muutat Kangasalle kauempaa, autamme mielellämme vuokra-asunnon haussa.

jobs.title: AI Lead, Marine
jobs.description:
We are looking for an AI Lead for the Marine Business Unit to take ownership of Marine-specific AI development and turn business and engineering needs into practical solutions.

As part of the Marine Business Unit strategy, we are increasing our focus on artificial intelligence to improve competitiveness, efficiency, engineering processes, and ways of working. The role bridges technology, engineering and business, turning Marine challenges into AI-driven solutions and leading initiatives from idea to implementation.

Your role and the team

As our Marine AI Lead, you will drive the adoption and development of AI solutions across our Marine Business Unit. You will identify and prioritize high-value AI opportunities, translate business needs into practical development initiatives, and lead projects from concept to implementation. You will also own and develop the Marine AI roadmap and initiative pipeline, ensuring that the most valuable opportunities are identified, prioritized, and translated into practical solutions.

In this role, you will act as the bridge between business and technology, working closely with marine engineering experts, the Group AI team, and external partners. You will evaluate emerging AI technologies, guide technology choices, and ensure that AI solutions deliver tangible value to ship design, engineering, and business processes.

Initially, the role is highly hands-on, combining strategic ownership with practical experimentation, prototyping, and solution development. As our AI capabilities grow, the role may evolve into leading a broader Marine AI development function.

Success in this role means:

- Turning business and engineering challenges into practical AI solutions
- Driving and prioritizing a strong pipeline of AI initiatives
- Making informed technology and development decisions
- Improving engineering productivity and processes through AI
- Creating competitive advantage through Marine-specific AI applications

Our ideal candidate is a technically capable and business-minded professional who understands the potential of modern AI technologies, can translate Marine business challenges into concrete development initiatives, and drives those initiatives from concept to implementation.

This position can be based in Turku or Espoo. Please let us know your preferred location in your application.

What helps you succeed in this role

- Relevant educational background
- Strong understanding of AI, machine learning, and AIOps
- Hands-on experience in developing and implementing AI solutions
- Experience in maritime, shipbuilding, engineering, CAD/CAE, PLM, or other industrial environments is an advantage
- Ability to turn business and engineering needs into practical technical solutions
- Understanding of software development, system architectures, integrations, and data flows
- Strong project ownership, collaboration, and communication skills
- A curious, pragmatic, and business-oriented mindset

What we promise you

Interesting and challenging projects with a team that supports each other. Modern tools. Hybrid working flexibility to balance work and free time. Training and mentoring to help you grow, and our warm EloWe culture built on respect, equality, kindness, and support.

Learn more about us: [Visions of Tomorrow, Engineered Today - Elomatic](https://www.elomatic.com/)
Get to know your future colleagues: [Meet Us! videos](https://www.youtube.com/@ElomaticOy/shorts)

Please share your thoughts regarding salary expectations in your application. Our compensation aligns with trade union recommendations and reflects your future role, capabilities and skills, working experience and specialization. Additionally, we offer versatile employee benefits, including comprehensive insurance and support for sports and cultural activities.

We succeed together, we have passion to improve, we are trustworthy

If you share our values and are ready for this exciting opportunity, apply with your CV and cover letter in English or Finnish by October 11th at the latest. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds and working styles, because different perspectives make us stronger. We review applications continuously and are ready to start interviews during the application period.

For more information, feel free to contact us on Fridays between 8-11

Director, Digital Transformation: Nico Lehtinen, +358504530901 or nico.lehtinen@elomatic.com #_msocom_1

And remember to follow us on [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/elomaticoy/) and [LinkedIn!](https://www.linkedin.com/company/elomatic/)

___________________________________________________________________________

Building tomorrow. Elomatic is an international consulting and engineering company dedicated to creating solutions that improve the wellbeing of people and the environment. With over 50 years of experience, we are known as pioneers in the development of design methods. Our 1,300 professionals provide exceptional value across the entire life cycles of products, services, and digital solutions.

What we do

Elomatic specializes in

- Marine

- Industry, covering process and energy industries, machinery, and equipment manufacturing.

We offer a comprehensive range of services, including engineering and consulting, project management, technical analysis and visualization, as well as product and service development. Additionally, we deliver products and overall solutions that complement our core services.

jobs.title: Would you like to help shape the next chapter of Aimo Park’s commercial development?
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Commercial Director who will take a key position in Aimo Park Norway’s management team, with a clear mandate to strengthen the commercial organisation and drive further profitable growth.

The role:

As Commercial Director, you will have overall responsibility for New Business in Norway and lead the commercial sales team. You will identify new market opportunities, develop strong customer and partner relationships, and contribute to the development and commercialisation of new services, concepts and business models.

The role spans strategy and execution. You will develop the sales strategy, drive structured sales processes, identify new revenue opportunities and play a key role in major tenders, contract negotiations and commercial discussions. You will also work closely with colleagues across Operations, Finance, Legal, Technology and Marketing.

An important part of your mandate will be to further develop the commercial function - its people, processes and ways of working - ensuring that the organisation is equipped for continued growth.

You have:
  • a university degree in Business, Economics or equivalent
  • a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience with a proven track record in commercial roles
  • solid experience in B2B sales and business development
  • proven leadership experience and the ability to develop and lead a commercial team
  • experience in strategic sales and in translating strategy into tangible commercial results
  • strong commercial and financial acumen
  • experience with complex customer processes, contracts and negotiations
  • an analytical approach and the ability to use data and market insight to identify opportunities for growth and profitability
  • excellent communication skills in both Norwegian and English, written and spoken
It is an advantage if you have:
  • experience from real estate or other transaction- and contract-intensive businesses
  • relevant industry experience
  • experience in developing and commercialising new services, concepts or business models
  • experience with partnerships and the development of new revenue streams
Who are you?

We believe you are self-driven, curious and results-oriented, with the ability to see both the bigger picture and what it takes to turn opportunities into tangible results.

You are comfortable challenging established ways of working, while doing so constructively. You build trust, bring people with you and combine analytical strength with creativity and commercial instinct. Most importantly, you are motivated by creating and developing, rather than simply managing what already exists.

Why Aimo Park?

At Aimo Park, you get the strength and stability of an established market leader - combined with the opportunities of a market undergoing rapid transformation.

Digitalisation, changing customer expectations and evolving business models are reshaping both parking and mobility, creating significant new commercial opportunities.

You will have considerable influence, short decision-making paths and a genuine opportunity to help define how Aimo Park will grow and compete in the years ahead.

 

Location: Oslo
Application deadline: 8 November 2026

 

Aimo Park is partnering with Jefferson Wells for this recruitment. For further information about the position, please contact Senior Advisor Kristine Bugge Lie Owe at Jefferson Wells at Kristine.owe@jeffersonwells.no or +47 40 72 40 05.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Aimo Park is a leading provider of parking and mobility solutions in Norway - and a trusted partner to property owners across the country. With a strong market position, solid financial foundation and a continuous focus on developing new digital solutions and services, we have a strong platform for growth. Now, we are ready for the next step.

jobs.description:
About Stableton

Stableton is a globally leading, tech- and data-driven institutional investor in private blue-chip tech companies. We empower institutional investors, private banks, and wealth managers to benefit from the value creation of the world's most valuable technology companies through our unique unicorn index investment funds and institutional thematic investment mandates.

With our disruptive mindset, fast-paced culture, and track record of innovation, we are reshaping private market investing. With seven years of 100%+ annual growth, we are scaling globally, and we're just getting started.

Your Role

This is a part-time role supporting our sales team. You will take ownership of the data and material groundwork that makes client work run smoothly: keeping our CRM accurate, building and qualifying target lists, and preparing client-facing materials.

We are a tech-enabled firm and we expect you to work that way. Using AI tools to speed up repetitive work is part of how the role is done.

This is not an internship. It takes a few months to learn how we work, so we are looking for someone who wants to stay in the role and grow with it, not for short-term cover.

Your Responsibilities

  • Prepare and update client-facing materials and presentations
  • Support the sales team with analysis and document work
  • Support prospecting by building, researching, and qualifying target lists
  • Maintain and improve CRM data quality, including deduplication, enrichment, and consistent record keeping
  • Take on ad hoc requests across the team as they come up

Requirements

  • Currently in a Master's program at a leading university in Switzerland or Germany
  • Prior internship experience at a financial services or fintech firm
  • Available 40–50% alongside your studies, based in or near Zurich or Frankfurt
  • Ready to commit for at least six months, ideally twelve
  • Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with a CRM is an advantage
  • Fluent with AI tools and quick to figure out where they save time
  • Precise and structured. You care whether a record is correct, not just filled in
  • Comfortable working independently and asking when something is unclear
  • Fluent in English; German is a plus
  • Right to work in the chosen base location (Switzerland, Germany) at time of application; the firm is unable to provide visa sponsorship

Benefits

  • Real ownership of the CRM and prospecting groundwork, not shadowing
  • Insight into how an institutional private markets investor approaches client work
  • Close collaboration with a small, senior sales team
  • Flexible hours around your study schedule and a hybrid setup in Zurich or Frankfurt
  • A role you can grow into over at least six months
  • If it works well on both sides, we'd be glad to keep you on full-time after you graduate

Stableton is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Über die Stelle

Als Solution Engineer bei gateB übersetzt du komplexe Kundenanforderungen in tragfähige technische Lösungen. Du verbindest Beratung, Technologie und Umsetzung und begleitest unsere Kunden bei der Konzeption, Implementierung und Weiterentwicklung von CRM-, Marketing-Automation-, Daten- und AI-Lösungen. 

Du arbeitest an anspruchsvollen nationalen und internationalen Projekten. Dabei begleitest du unsere Kunden von der ersten Idee über erste Prototypen und Pilotlösungen bis zur produktiven Einführung. Du übernimmst technische Verantwortung, arbeitest eng mit Kunden, Consultants, Entwicklungsteams und Technologiepartnern zusammen und stellst sicher, dass die Lösungen termingerecht, qualitativ hochwertig und mit erkennbarem Kundennutzen umgesetzt werden.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Analyse von Geschäftsprozessen und Kundenanforderungen sowie Erarbeitung von Systemkonzepten und Lösungsdesigns im direkten Austausch mit Kunden und internen Projektteams
  • Konzeption von Workflows, Customer Journeys, Datenflüssen und Schnittstellen sowie Erstellung umsetzbarer Briefings für Entwicklung und Implementation
  • Technische Konzeption, Spezifikation und Umsetzung von CRM-, Marketing-Automation-, Daten- und AI-Lösungen auf Basis von Partnertechnologien wie BSI und Salesforce sowie von gateB-eigenen Lösungen
  • Konfiguration und Implementierung von Cloud- und Enterprise-Lösungen einschliesslich Reports, Systemmasken, Daten- und Metadatenmodellen, Benutzerverwaltungen und Geschäftslogiken
  • Erstellung von Proof-of-Concepts und Minimum Viable Products, Unterstützung bei Aufwandsschätzungen sowie Begleitung von Daten-, Content- und Systemmigrationen und Integrationen
  • Übernahme der technischen Verantwortung und der Funktion als primäre technische Ansprechperson in Implementierungsprojekten sowie Sicherstellung von Zeit, Budget, Qualität und Kundenzufriedenheit
  • Koordination interner Entwicklungsteams sowie von Projektmitarbeitenden bei Partnern und Kunden; Sicherstellung von Testing, Qualitätssicherung, technischer Dokumentation, Schulungen und System-Roll-outs
  • Proaktive Ressourcenplanung, frühzeitiges Erkennen von Engpässen und kostenbewusste Beratung in der Umsetzung
  • Unterstützung des Sales-Prozesses durch RFIs, RFPs und Sales-Demos sowie Beobachtung und Einordnung neuer Technologien und Partnerlösungen im Hinblick auf Machbarkeit und Kundennutzen
  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung deines Know-hows, aktiver Wissenstransfer ins Team und zu unseren Kunden sowie Mitgestaltung von Software-Partnerschaften im Bereich AI und Enterprise Software


Dein Profil

  • Hochschulabschluss in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang; alternativ eine technische Grundausbildung mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung
  • Ausgewiesene Erfahrung in der Konzeption, Implementation und Konfiguration von Enterprise-Software-Lösungen
  • Erfahrung mit CRM-, Marketing-Automation-, Daten- oder Content-Plattformen – idealerweise auf Dienstleisterseite
  • Praktische Erfahrung oder fundiertes Verständnis für die Anwendung von AI-Technologien und deren Integration in Geschäftsprozesse
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Kundenanforderungen, Systemdesign, Schnittstellen, Datenflüssen und Qualitätssicherung sowie Erfahrung mit Aufwandsschätzungen, technischer Dokumentation und interdisziplinärer Projektarbeit
  • Beratungs- und lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit mit tiefem technischem Verständnis, hoher technischer Affinität und Begeisterung für AI
  • Kundenorientierter, eigeninitiativ handelnder und lernfreudiger Umsetzer mit pragmatischer Arbeitsweise und Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen
  • Kommunikationsstark, zugänglich und souverän im Auftreten – mit der Fähigkeit, Vertrauen bei technischen und nicht-technischen Stakeholdern aufzubauen
  • Analytische, konzeptionelle und strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie Verbindlichkeit in Koordination, Priorisierung und Umsetzung
  • Flexibel, reisefreudig und offen für die Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen aus unterschiedlichen Kulturen
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse


Unser Angebot

  • Anspruchsvolle, abwechslungsreiche Rolle mit umfassender Eigenverantwortung und grossem Gestaltungsfreiraum
  • Spannende Projekte bei nationalen und internationalen Topkunden mit technisch hochstehenden Systemen
  • Möglichkeit, AI, digitale Transformation und Customer Experience bei Kunden wirksam zu verbinden
  • Interdisziplinäres Team mit flachen Hierarchien, offener Kommunikation und direktem Austausch mit der Unternehmensführung
  • Vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und aktive Förderung deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung
  • Freiheit, eigene Ideen einzubringen und gateB aktiv mitzugestalten
  • Internationale Zusammenarbeit und interkultureller Austausch
  • Moderner Arbeitsplatz in Steinhausen/Zug mit sehr guter Autobahn- und ÖV-Anbindung
  • Regelmässige Firmenevents, kostenfreie Getränke, Kaffee und frisches Obst sowie Zuschuss zum Mittagessen

4. Inclusive, flexible culture: join a collaborative team where diverse perspectives are valued and flexible working arrangements are supported
5. Build your network: connect with professionals across Deloitte's global network and participate in industry events.

1. Translate business needs into technical designs: Work with clients and internal stakeholders to understand requirements and turn them into architectures, data models and solution designs for Data & AI platforms.

5. Learn, innovate & share: Explore emerging technologies such as GenAI, LLMs, data mesh and the modern data stack, contribute to reusable assets, and share knowledge to grow the team's capabilities.

Your skills

Must-have

•    Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Business, Economics, Information Systems or a related field.
•    4-6 years of experience in data-related roles (data engineering, analytics, BI, data science, data governance, AI project delivery, or data strategy consulting).
•    Fluency in French and English (spoken and written).
•    Strong collaboration skills and structured communication with both technical and non-technical audiences.
•    Problem-solving mindset with a genuine interest in how data and AI can create business value.
•    Ability to create compelling presentations and tell stories with data for senior stakeholders.

Nice to have

•    Hands-on experience with SQL and at least one language used in data (Python, Scala, R…).
•    Experience building and maintaining data pipelines, integrations or data models.
•    Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and modern data stack tools.
•    Experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) or data orchestration/transformation tools (dbt, Airflow…).
•    Experience designing, developing or deploying AI/ML solutions in a production or pilot environment.
•    Familiarity with the AI lifecycle, and the ability to collaborate with data scientists and engineers on AI use cases.
•    Exposure to Generative AI, LLMs, or advanced analytics projects.
•    Relevant certifications (Azure, AWS, GCP, DAMA, TOGAF…).

Your future team

As a global leader in providing managed services to the financial industry, Deloitte is deeply committed to expanding its Operate offering in the banking space, a model where Deloitte takes ownership of running critical middle- and back-office processes on behalf of banking clients, combining operational excellence with innovative technology.

Our Banking Operate practice has already identified and validated a comprehensive portfolio of services to be launched, covering multiple banking value chains. We are now entering a decisive phase: translating this strategic vision into detailed, actionable specifications that will serve as the foundation for service delivery, technology enablement, and client onboarding.

We are seeking a Business Analyst to join our Banking Operate development team. In this role, you will be responsible for authoring Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Service Functional Descriptions (SFDs) across our target service catalogue. You will work hand-in-hand with subject matter experts, partners, and technology teams to transform high-level service concepts into structured, implementable
specifications, at pace.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of our banking managed services from the ground up, with a clear evolution path toward a Project Manager role to oversee the implementation and go-live of the services you will have helped design.

The advantages of joining us

• Career growth, your way Access top-notch training and career development. Start as the architect of our service specifications, then evolve into a project leadership role to drive implementation, with a clear progression path tailored to your ambitions.
• Global impact, local connections Work on strategic banking initiatives with international reach, collaborate with diverse teams of experts, and contribute to building a market-leading Operate offering from Luxembourg.
• Innovative work that matters Leverage the latest AI and LLM technologies to accelerate your work, tackle greenfield service design challenges, and directly contribute to a high-visibility growth initiative backed by firm leadership.
How you'll contribute to our success
• Author high-quality BRDs and SFDs for a portfolio of banking Operate services spanning multiple value chains (payments, securities, lending, investment management, cash management, trade finance, and more).

• Ensure consistency and standardisation across the full service catalogue, establishing reusable templates, taxonomies, and documentation standards.
• Identify dependencies, risks, and gaps early in the specification phase, proactively escalating and proposing solutions to keep the programme on track.
• Contribute to the definition of target operating models for each service, including process design, governance frameworks, technology requirements, and staffing considerations.
• Support the transition from design to delivery by preparing the ground for implementation, you will be positioned to take on project management responsibilities as services move into build and launch phases.
• Act as a central knowledge hub for banking Operate service design, maintaining a clear and organised repository of all specifications and supporting documentation.

Why this role is different

You'll be joining at the inception of a strategic growth programme, in a role that goes beyond traditional maintenance or support, where the services you design today will become the backbone of Deloitte's Banking Operate offering tomorrow. You'll have direct visibility with partners and leadership, and as the portfolio moves from design to delivery, you'll have the opportunity to step into a Project Manager role to oversee implementation, client onboarding, and operational go-live, ideal for someone passionate about banking operations, turning complexity into clarity, and being at the forefront of building something new.

• Securities (custody, settlement, corporate actions)
• Investment & Portfolio Management
• Credit & Lending (consumer, corporate, syndicated)
• Mortgage & Real Estate Finance
• Lombard & Collateral Management
• Trade Finance

• Strong understanding of banking processes, controls, and regulatory environment (e.g., PSD2, MiFID II, Basel, AML/KYC operations).
• Proficient in using AI tools and Large Language Models (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude) to enhance productivity, for research, drafting, analysis, and structuring of complex documentation.
• Strong data affinity, including awareness of data flows, data governance, and data quality principles within banking operations.
• Ability to translate high-level strategic intent into detailed, workable operational and technology specifications.
• Familiarity with target operating model design, process mapping (BPMN or equivalent), and service delivery frameworks.
• Proficiency in project management methodologies and tools; certifications (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, Agile) are an asset.

jobs.title: RESEARCHER IN ATOMISTIC MODELLING OF FERROELECTRIC DYNAMICS (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
How will you contribute?
Get ready to dive into the captivating realm of ferroelectrics, where surprises at the nanoscale await discovery! We are thrilled to announce a unique opportunity for a curious and skilled Postdoctoral Researcher to join our dynamic team.
Ferroelectrics continue to mesmerize at the nanoscale. By inducing electrostatic or mechanic frustration on them, we can unlock a rich tapestry of dipole structures, including skyrmions and vortex lattices. Such polar textures are a hot research topic and offer a dual promise. First, their origin and behaviour pose intriguing questions begging for answers. Second, they hold great potential for groundbreaking applications, from outstanding voltage amplifications to shaping the future of 6G technologies.
In the realm of ferroelectric ultrathin films, we are facing new challenges. Applying an electric bias transforms the dipole landscape, giving rise to confined nanoregions (bubbles) with a polarization opposite to their embedding matrix. These bubbles are electric versions of magnetic skyrmions, and are more than just a rarity; they constitute a novel quasiparticle in their own right. Recent experimental observations and successful manipulation attempts have set the stage. Yet, their dynamical behaviour remains a largely unexplored frontier. Lately our group at LIST predicted that electric bubbles will display Brownian motion and that this motion can be harnessed to produce bubble currents.
We offer you a postdoc position in the project “Bubblaced”, led by Hugo Aramberri (hugo.aramberri@list.lu), and focused on the modelling of electric bubble quasiparticles. You will join the ongoing work by Hugo Aramberri and Jorge Íñiguez-González (also involved in the project) on understanding these objects using second-principles atomistic simulation methods, focusing on their dynamics and possible ways to act on them. You will also benefit from interactions with other team members. Join us in exploring the fascinating world of electric bubbles!

Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 48 Months (14 +22+12 )
Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/
You will join the Environmental Health (EH) group within the Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity (SUSTAIN) Unit at LIST. SUSTAIN conducts cross-disciplinary research to support the transition toward a more sustainable, resilient, and healthy society, combining expertise in environmental sciences, circular economy, risk and safety assessment, and sustainable innovation.
The Environmental Health group conducts cutting-edge research at the intersection of environmental toxicology, human health, and regulatory science, integrating in vitro toxicology, systems toxicology, exposure science, and sustainability assessment to develop next-generation tools and methods that inform decision-making and support the development of safe and sustainable products and policies.
This PhD position is embedded in the AIM-PACE project, which aims at developing a new generation of safe-and-sustainable-by-design, bio-based and circular plastics by combining AI, microbial technology, computer modelling, and polymer science. The PhD candidate is expected to support the operationalisation of the Safe and Sustainable by Design (SSbD) framework, actively contribute to the Safety Assessment of the novel bio-based polymers and the integration of results for informed decision making along the life-cycle and innovation routes. Production of chemical safety data, primarily generated through in vitro New Approach Methodologies (NAMs), and computational modelling are expected to be key outcomes. The PhD candidate will combine experimental toxicology with computational approaches and scientific literature data to validate relevant case studies, supporting the identification of methodological gaps and challenges, and contributing to the advancement of SSbD approaches for bio-based materials.
The PhD will be co-supervised by Dr. Ivana Vinkovic (Institute for Medical Research and Occupational Health, Zagreb), a leading international expert in safety and toxicology assessment of advanced materials. Her research group performs cutting edge research at the nano-bio interface to identify opportunities and risks of nanomaterials and advanced materials at early stage of development, in a multidisciplinary environment covering chemistry, biochemistry, molecular biology, toxicology, risk assessment and regulatory science. In addition, it operates a high-impact testing platform for more tailored risk assessment and decision making which based on advanced biochemistry, immunology, toxicology, molecular and cell biology facilities. The academic supervisor will provide scientific guidance and mentorship throughout the doctoral research, support the development of the research plan, monitor progress, facilitate integration within the academic environment, and ensure compliance with the requirements of the PhD programme. The Faculty of Science, University of Zagreb, is one of the leading research and higher education institutions in Croatia, offering advanced training and research infrastructure in chemistry, biochemistry, nanotechnology, biosensors, environmental health, and biomedical sciences. The host group has expertise in Safe and Sustainable by Design (SSbD) approaches, nanomaterials, advanced analytical methods, and translational biomedical research.

How will you contribute?
As a PhD Student within the AIM-PACE project, your main responsibilities will include:
• Supporting the scoping analysis of the AIM-PACE scenarios and products, as part of the SSbD framework implementation.
• Conducting a comprehensive literature review and data collection on hazard profiles of existing substances/materials and use of computational modelling for data gap filling.
• Identifying, reviewing and using models and tools for hazard screening, exposure assessment and risk assessment in the context of SSbD.
• Application of new approach methodologies (NAMs), including in vitro and computational tools, for hazard, exposure and risk assessment of AIM-PACE materials.
• Collaborating with project partners in integrating safety output with sustainability, techno-economic and social indicators.
• Collaborating with the team of Dr. Ivana Vinkovic Vrček to explore research activities, scientific training, conferences, and dissemination activities, and complete all doctoral requirements according to University of Zagreb regulations.
• Contributing to the dissemination of results through peer-reviewed scientific publications, conference presentations, and technical reports.
• Actively participating in AIM-PACE consortium activities, including meetings, workshops, and stakeholder engagement.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The People Team at Notion exists to help build a generational company - one that enables people to do their best and most meaningful work. Hiring exceptional talent, at the right time and with care, is central to that mission.

We’re looking for a Recruiting Coordinator to partner closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to create a thoughtful, well-run, and genuinely human candidate experience. This role sits at the center of our hiring process and plays an important role in how candidates experience Notion.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:



CREATE A CANDIDATE EXPERIENCE THAT REFLECTS NOTION

You’ll be one of the first and most consistent touchpoints candidates have with Notion. From scheduling interviews to answering questions and resolving issues, you’ll help ensure every interaction feels organized, respectful, and intentional. You’ll collaborate closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to continually refine our processes—so candidates leave feeling excited about what we’re building, regardless of the outcome.



COORDINATE INTERVIEWS WITH CARE AND PRECISION

You’ll manage and schedule a high volume of interviews across primarily non-technical roles, balancing speed with attention to detail. You’ll anticipate needs, communicate clearly, and keep candidates and interviewers aligned - making the process feel smooth and predictable, even as things move quickly.



BUILD STRONG RECRUITING FOUNDATIONS

This role is designed for someone early in their recruiting career who wants to build durable fundamentals. Over time, you’ll gain exposure to how we plan, execute, and scale hiring at Notion. With support from the team, you could take on light sourcing work, process improvements, and additional ownership as your skills grow - creating a strong foundation for future growth in recruiting, operations, or people-focused roles.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 6–12 months of experience in recruiting coordination or interview scheduling, ideally in a high-volume environment

 - Strong organizational and prioritization skills - you’re proactive, reliable, and thoughtful about details

 - A steady, calm approach in fast-moving environments

 - Ability to navigate ambiguity with optimism

 - Clear, kind, and professional communication skills - you’ll represent Notion to a large and diverse group of candidates

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience supporting both technical and non-technical roles, including remote and in-person interview scheduling

 - Experience with Ashby, Workday, Slack
