Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj, kandidati su dužni priložiti: 1. životopis 2. dokaz o državljanstvu 3. dokaz o prijavljenom prebivalištu u RH 4. dokaz o stečenoj razini i vrsti obrazovanja 5. uvjerenje nadležnog suda da kandidat nije pod istragom i da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak za neko od kaznenih djela iz čl.106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od 6 mjeseci od dana raspisivanja natječaja 6. elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje

Navedene isprave odnosno prilozi dostavljaju se u neovjerenoj preslici i ne vraćaju se kandidatu nakon završenog natječajnog postupka. Prije sklapanja ugovora o radu odabrani kandidat dužan je sve navedene priloge odnosno isprave predočiti u izvorniku ili u preslici ovjerenoj od strane javnog bilježnika. Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19 i 84/21), članku 48. stavku 1.-3. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 i 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20) dužna je u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja i ovisno o kategoriji u koju ulazi sve potrebne dokaze (članak 103.st.1.Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja te priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju (čl.49.st.1. Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Prijavom na natječaj svaki kandidat daje privolu Osnovnoj školi Remete za obradu osobnih podataka u skladu s propisima kojima je propisana zaštita osobnih podataka za svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka i objave rezultata natječaja. Rok za podnošenje prijava kandidata je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj i o tome se ne radi posebna obavijest. Kandidat/kinja koji/a je pravodobno dostavio/la potpunu prijavu sa svim ispravama odnosno prilozima i ispunjava uvjete natječaja dužan/a je pristupiti procjeni odnosno testiranju prema odredbama Pravilnika. Odluku o vremenu, mjestu i načinu održavanja procjene vrednovanja kandidata/kinje Škola će objaviti na mrežnoj stranici Osnovne škole Remete http://www.os-remete-zg.skole.hr s napomenom da se kandidati/kinje neće posebno pozivati. Obavijest o ishodu natječajnog postupka, objavit će se na mrežnoj stranici Osnovne škole Remete http://www.os-remete-zg.skole.hr najkasnije u roku od osam dana od dana sklapanja ugovora s odabranim kandidatom. U slučaju da se na natječaj prijave kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom propisu, kandidati će se obavijestiti prema članku 17. stavku 4. Pravilnika. Prijave na natječaj s potrebnom dokumentacijom kandidati dostavljaju neposredno ili poštom na adresu: Osnovna škola Remete, Remete 99a, 10 000 Zagreb, s naznakom “za natječaj- Spremač/ica“.

jobs.title: SISTEM INŽENJER/KA
jobs.description:
OPIS POSLA

Kao Sistem inženjer, bit ćeš ključna osoba za osiguravanje stabilnosti, sigurnosti i optimalnih performansi naše IT infrastrukture. Tvoji glavni zadaci uključivat će:

  • Virtualizacija i serveri: Instalacija, konfiguracija i proaktivno održavanje Windows servera te upravljanje Hyper-V virtualizacijskom okolinom i virtualnim strojevima (VM).
  • Sigurnost podataka: Konfiguracija, nadzor i redovito testiranje sustava za sigurnosnu pohranu (backup) i oporavak podataka korištenjem Veeam rješenja.
  • Upravljanje domenom: Administracija Active Directoryja (upravljanje korisničkim računima, grupama, pravima pristupa i GPO politikama).
  • File serveri: Održavanje i strukturiranje mrežnih dijeljenih mapa (File servers), dodjeljivanje prava i praćenje dostupnosti.
  • Korisnička podrška i oprema: Instalacija, održavanje i rješavanje problema na radnim računalima (hardware i software) te konfiguracija mrežnih printera i ostale periferne opreme.
  • Nadzor sustava: Praćenje rada cjelokupnog informacijskog sustava i pravovremeno rješavanje tehničkih poteškoća.

UVJETI

  • Minimalno 1 godina radnog iskustva na istim ili sličnim poslovima.
  • Napredno poznavanje Microsoft Windows Server okruženja je prednost.
  • Praktično iskustvo s Hyper-V tehnologijom virtualizacije.
  • Iskustvo u radu s Veeam Backup & Replication alatima.
  • Odlično poznavanje Active Directory, DNS, DHCP servisa.
  • Sposobnost samostalnog rješavanja problema s računalima (Windows 10/11) i perifernom opremom (printeri, skeneri).
  • Poznavanje osnovnih mrežnih koncepata (LAN, WAN, TCP/IP, VPN).

ŠTO NUDIMO

  • Ugovor na neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rok.
  • Pristup najnovijim tehnologijama.

jobs.title: Founder Associate to the CTO
jobs.description:
The Role
As Founders Associate in our office in Zurich, you'll be the right hand of our CTO, Max. You run the daily business of the CTO office, own strategic projects from start to finish, drive the first round of our technical hiring, and bridge technology and business. This is a true zero-to-one mandate.
Whether you come from computer science or business, you combine strong tech understanding with real commercial thinking. You won't be writing production code, but you'll understand our product and infrastructure well, be a trusted counterpart for our engineers, and know what technical decisions mean for the business.

What You'll Do

  • CTO Office & Executive Support

    • Manage our CTO's priorities so his time goes to what matters most

    • Prepare briefing documents and agendas for important meetings and make sure every action item gets followed up

  • Technical Hiring

    • Run first-round calls with engineering candidates and coordinate the interview process with our team

  • Strategic Projects

    • Take full ownership of critical projects, from deep dives into emerging tech trends to board-level material

    • Evaluate and drive strategic technical partnerships that keep us at the forefront of AI infrastructure

  • Tech x Business

    • Translate technical topics into commercial decisions and clear stories for customers, partners and investors

    • Support pricing, product and go-to-market questions with a technical angle

    • Build the processes the CTO office and engineering team need to scale

What We're Looking For

  • Studies (preferably Master level) or a degree in computer science or a related technical field, OR in business, economics or management with a strong understanding of technology

  • Very good commercial understanding: you think in business impact, not just technology

  • Real curiosity for tech: you can follow and discuss AI and infrastructure topics with engineers

  • First practical experience in a fast-paced environment such as a startup, consulting or VC

  • Builder's mindset: you take high ownership and enjoy building processes from scratch

  • Hustle & execution: you're pragmatic and move fast without losing sight of quality – a "get shit done" mentality is essential

  • Organizational talent: you stay calm under pressure and work in a highly structured and precise way

  • Communication: excellent written and verbal English, German is a plus

Bonus Points

  • Exposure to AI, cloud or GPU infrastructure

  • You've built something yourself: a side project, student initiative or venture

Why us?

  • Outstanding team: Work with some of the best engineers in the world, coming from hedge funds, big tech, AI startups and top universities

  • Once in a lifetime opportunity: Early-stage company in the fastest-growing market in the world

  • Ownership: Shape how European AI companies access GPU compute

  • European mission: Build sovereign, GDPR-compliant AI infrastructure for the next generation of deep-tech

jobs.title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Technician
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Artificial Intelligence (AI) Technician based in Switzerland.

This is a remote opportunity for a technically skilled AI professional looking to make a tangible impact across business operations.
You will research, implement, and optimize AI, automation, and data-driven technologies across multiple functions.
The role combines AI/ML expertise with systems integration, process automation, analytics, and operational improvement.
You will identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve decision-making, and increase efficiency through technology.
You will work with a diverse range of platforms spanning finance, accounting, labor management, forecasting, and business intelligence.
The position offers a collaborative, cross-functional environment where innovation and practical problem-solving are highly valued.
You will also help teams adopt AI solutions effectively through technical support, training, documentation, and continuous optimization.


Accountabilities

  • Research, assess, and recommend emerging AI technologies and automation solutions that can create measurable business value.

  • Deploy and optimize AI models, automation tools, and integrated workflows across different business functions.

  • Integrate and optimize platforms for invoice automation, receipt management, cash-flow forecasting, labor optimization, bookkeeping, and financial reconciliation.

  • Connect POS and accounting systems using integration and automation platforms such as Zapier, Make, or Omnivore.

  • Develop and maintain internal AI-powered dashboards using tools such as Power BI or Looker Studio to provide insights into financial, labor, and operational performance.

  • Streamline financial data flows, including bank transaction imports and accounting processes.

  • Implement and evaluate reconciliation and intelligent bookkeeping solutions to improve accuracy and efficiency.

  • Monitor AI systems and automated workflows, troubleshooting issues and optimizing performance, accuracy, reliability, and scalability.

  • Partner with teams across finance, operations, customer support, marketing, and other functions to embed AI into day-to-day processes.

  • Ensure AI implementations align with relevant industry standards, ethical principles, security considerations, and organizational objectives.

  • Provide technical support, user training, and clear documentation for AI-powered applications and workflows.

  • Track developments in AI, automation, and data technologies and identify opportunities for ongoing innovation and improvement.

    • Requirements:

    • Proven experience working with AI/ML technologies, automation platforms, data processing, or systems integration.

    • Strong technical understanding of AI models, automation workflows, APIs, data flows, and business technology systems.

    • Experience implementing or integrating business applications, ideally across finance, accounting, operations, workforce management, or related functions.

    • Familiarity with tools such as Zapier, Make, Power BI, Looker Studio, or comparable automation and business intelligence platforms.

    • Experience working with accounting, POS, forecasting, reconciliation, or bookkeeping systems is highly valuable.

    • Ability to research emerging technologies, assess their practical applications, and translate business needs into effective technical solutions.

    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on accuracy, scalability, and measurable outcomes.

    • Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and continuously optimize AI and automation systems.

    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

    • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

    • A proactive, curious, and innovation-oriented mindset with a strong interest in the evolving AI and automation landscape.

      • Benefits:

      • Remote work / work-from-home flexibility.

      • Health insurance.

      • Additional leave.

      • Opportunities for pay raises.

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Accountant
jobs.description:
About the Role 

Imagine this. You join a fast-moving finance team where accuracy, speed, and good judgement really matter. As our Accounts Payable Accountant, you will take ownership of a high volume of supplier invoices, work extensively with purchase orders, resolve discrepancies, and make sure transactions move smoothly through our systems. This is a hands-on role for someone who already knows their way around accounts payable and is ready to contribute from day one. 

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations. 

What You’ll Do 

  • Process and book a high volume of supplier invoices accurately and on time 
  • Work extensively with purchase orders, checking invoices against POs and identifying and resolving discrepancies 
  • Review invoice details, approvals, supporting documentation, and accounting information before posting 
  • Handle questions, clarifications, and follow-ups related to supplier invoices and payments 
  • Investigate invoice discrepancies and work with internal teams and suppliers to get issues resolved quickly 
  • Work daily with Microsoft Dynamics and ExFlow to process and manage invoices 
  • Maintain accurate vendor and accounting records and ensure transactions are properly documented 
  • Support the wider finance team during periods of high workload and help keep accounts payable processes moving efficiently 
  • Contribute to improving accounts payable processes and identifying practical ways to make daily workflows more efficient 
  • Support month-end activities and other accounting tasks related to accounts payable when required 

Requirements

What You’ll Need 

  • Around 4 to 6 years of relevant professional experience in accounting, accounts payable, vendor accounting, or a similar finance role 
  • Practical experience processing and booking supplier invoices in a high-volume environment 
  • Strong experience working with purchase orders and PO-based invoice processes 
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics is required 
  • Experience with ExFlow is highly valued 
  • Accounting education or professional training in accounting or finance 
  • Previous professional accounting experience within a company in Switzerland 
  • Good understanding of Swiss accounting practices and day-to-day finance processes 
  • Strong attention to detail and confidence working with large volumes of financial data and documentation 
  • Fluent English is required 
  • German or French is a strong plus 
  • Higher education or a university degree is not required 
  • Previous aerospace or defense experience is not required 

Who You Are 

You are comfortable in a busy finance environment where there is always something that needs to get done. You know how to work independently, stay organized when invoice volumes increase, and spot when something does not add up. You are not afraid to ask questions, chase missing information, or dig into a discrepancy until it is resolved. You bring solid accounting experience, a practical mindset, and the reliability to take ownership of your work while collaborating closely with the wider team.

jobs.title: Junior Cloud Operations Engineer (all genders) CH
jobs.description:
Alle reden von Digitalisierung – Wir machen es. Als Hersteller von Europas #1 CRM/CX-Plattform entwickeln wir innovative Softwareprodukte in den Bereichen Kundenbeziehungsmanagement, Marketing Automation und Machine Learning. Unternehmen bei der Digitalisierung und der konsequenten Kundenzentrierung zu begleiten, ist unsere Leidenschaft. Wir lieben modernste Technologie, Handwerk und Innovation. Du auch? Dann bist du bei BSI goldrichtig!


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere SaaS-Plattform auf AWS, Azure und T-Systems zuverlässig und performant läuft und übernimmst dabei Verantwortung für eigene Bereiche und Themen

  • Du analysierst und behebst Störungen, führst Root-Cause-Analysen durch und bringst dich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Observability ein. Als Teil des Teams bist du Anlaufstelle für interne Teams, Kunden und Partner und übernimmst im Turnus die 2nd-Level-Support-Bereitschaft und Rufbereitschaft

  • Du entwickelst unser Monitoring mit Prometheus und Grafana aktiv weiter, erstellst aussagekräftige Dashboards und Alerts und sorgst dafür, dass potenzielle Probleme frühzeitig erkannt werden

  • Du automatisierst den Aufbau und die Verwaltung unserer Cloud-Infrastruktur mit Terraform und sorgst mit ArgoCD, Docker und CI/CD dafür, dass neue Anwendungen zuverlässig und automatisiert auf Kubernetes bereitgestellt werden

  • Du sorgst für sichere und widerstandsfähige Systeme, entwickelst Backup- und Disaster-Recovery-Konzepte weiter und stellst deren Praxistauglichkeit regelmässig auf die Probe

  • Du hältst unsere Runbooks und Betriebsdokumentation aktuell, optimierst wiederkehrende Abläufe und automatisierst, was nicht manuell erledigt werden muss.

Wir suchen Macher

jobs.title: AV Designer
jobs.description:
Big ideas in, flawless shows out. You're the calm voice in the control room – three steps ahead of everyone. Your next stage is at FLIK.

**The role**

FLIK is looking for an AV Designer who understands how live events work from planning to execution.

You combine technical understanding, practical production experience and strong problem-solving skills. You can design reliable technical setups, anticipate issues before production, and find solutions when plans change. You'll be the link between our Event Managers, Designers and Technical team. You'll translate 3D designs and client wishes into workable technical plans, challenge them when needed, and lead the team that brings them to life.

We deliver more than 2,000 IR hybrid events every year across the Nordics through our own platform VideoSync, ranging from simple audiocasts to cutting-edge Virtual AGMs.

**What you'll do**

- Plan technical setups for our studio, on-site and hybrid events

- Anticipate technical risks and solve problems before and during productions

- Prepare plans, budgets, equipment requirements and documentation

- Coordinate with internal teams, customers, freelancers and suppliers

- Participate hands-on in productions and technical operations

- Improve our studio architecture and ways of working

- Take ownership of technical production in our most important events

- Place customer needs first in your decisions


**Technical environment**

You'll work with technologies such as:

- vMix, Madmapper, Lightkey, Companion and other software-based AV tools

- AVoIP protocols such as NDI, Dante, ArtNet, OSC

- PTZ systems, audio systems, automation

- Production networking

- LED volumes, vision mixing

- WebRTC, RTMP and streaming platforms


You don't need to be an expert in everything. We're looking for strong general technical understanding and the ability to see how the pieces work together.

**Who you are**

- Have 5+ years of experience in live production, broadcasting, streaming, events or a similar technical environment

- Understand the whole production chain, not just your own technical area

- Can plan practical solutions based on real production experience

- Think ahead and spot potential problems early

- Take ownership and move things forward without guidance

- Have excellent communication and collaboration skills

- Can explain and justify technical choices to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Want to improve how we work, not just deliver the next production

- Are happy to get your hands dirty and participate in production

- Have fluent English and Finnish skills


**What we offer**

- A high degree of ownership in a flat, self-managed organisation

- A varied role combining planning, problem-solving and hands-on production

- The opportunity to influence our technical environment and processes

- A technically strong and supportive team

- Hybrid work model across our Ruoholahti premises, on-site or remote when applicable

- Opportunities to work across the Nordics and Europe


The position is full-time and permanent. The salary range for this position is €4,000–5,200/month + benefits. Our company benefits include high-end IT equipment, comprehensive health insurance, lunch/activity benefit and share option program opportunities, among others.

**About Inderes**

Inderes' mission is to connect listed companies and investors. Our customer base includes over 400 listed companies that rely on us for better investor communication.

Our Events business delivers over 2,000 online and hybrid events annually across the Nordics. We operate with a high degree of ownership, where teams are flat, decisions are made close to the problem, and roles evolve over time.

Inderes Playbook: https://group.inderes.com/files/documents/Inderes%20Playbook%20v4.pdf

**Application process**

Submit your CV and application via TeamTailor: https://careers.inderes.com/jobs/8455404-av-designer You may apply in Finnish or English.

We're more interested in how you approach technical problems than in polished applications. We'll aim to conduct preliminary Teams interviews, followed by in-person interviews for selected applicants.

The position will be filled when we find the right candidate.

jobs.title: Er du den fagperson, man kan regne med, når det bliver komplekst?
jobs.description:
Hos MerCare søger vi erfarne socialfaglige vikarer, der vil mere end bare tage en vagt.

Hos MerCare leder vi ikke efter flest muligt.

Vi leder efter de rigtige.

Vi arbejder med socialfaglige opgaver, hvor relation, stabilitet og faglighed gør en reel forskel.

Vi ved, at det ikke er ligegyldigt, hvem der træder ind ad døren – hvad enten det er på et bosted, i en institution, på en specialskole eller i en familie, hvor der er brug for en ekstra voksen.

Derfor matcher vi ikke bare mennesker med ledige timer.

Vi matcher faglighed, erfaring og menneske med den konkrete opgave. Er du den fagperson

Hvem er du?
Du har erfaring fra det socialpædagogiske område og ved, hvad det vil sige at være en del af en hverdag, hvor mennesker har brug for tydelige, stabile og fagligt stærke voksne.

Din erfaring kan fx være fra:
  • bosteder eller botilbud
  • institutioner
  • specialskoler
  • børne- og ungehjem
  • støtteopgaver i hjemmet
  • arbejde med børn, unge eller voksne med særlige behov

Du behøver ikke have prøvet alt.

Men du skal have faglig erfaring, dømmekraft og lyst til at gøre en forskel i praksis. Er du den fagperson

Det lægger vi vægt på
Hos MerCare leder vi efter medarbejdere, der:
  • kan skabe ro – også når situationen bliver presset
  • kan balancere relation og struktur
  • arbejder fagligt og reflekteret
  • tager ansvar for det, de siger ja til
  • kan samarbejde og indgå i en eksisterende praksis
  • møder mennesker med respekt og ordentlighed
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og søge sparring, når det er nødvendigt

Du skal ikke være perfekt.
Men du skal være ansvarlig. Er du den fagperson

Hvilke opgaver kan du få?
Vi matcher altid opgaven med den medarbejder, der har de rette kompetencer og den relevante erfaring.

Det kan blandt andet være:
  • støtte på bosteder, botilbud og institutioner
  • støtte i skole- og specialtilbud
  • 1:1-støtte i hjemmet, skolen eller fritiden
  • ledsagelse
  • aflastning i hjemmet
  • støtte omkring struktur og trivsel i hverdagen
  • længerevarende individuelle støtteforløb

Nogle opgaver kræver bred socialpædagogisk erfaring. Andre kræver en mere specialiseret profil.

Det er netop derfor, vi matcher grundigt. Er du den fagperson

Hos MerCare bliver du valgt til opgaven
Når du bliver en del af MerCare, bliver du ikke bare oprettet i et system og sendt videre.

Vi lærer dig at kende og spørger ind til din erfaring, dine kompetencer og de opgaver, du fungerer bedst i.

Vi tager kun nye medarbejdere ind, når vi kan se et fagligt og menneskeligt match.

For kvalitet må aldrig være tilfældig. Er du den fagperson

Det får du hos os
  • opgaver, der matcher din erfaring og dine kompetencer
  • tæt dialog og opfølgning
  • mulighed for både fleksible opgaver og længerevarende forløb
  • et bureau med rødder i socialpædagogisk praksis
  • mulighed for faglig udvikling og undervisning
  • en organisation, der tager ansvar, også når noget bliver svært Er du den fagperson

Praktisk information
  • Arbejdet foregår primært på Sjælland
  • Opgaver kan ligge dag, aften, nat og weekend
  • Relevant erfaring fra det socialpædagogiske område er et krav
  • Straffe- og børneattest skal kunne godkendes
  • Relevante referencer indhentes inden opstart
  • Dokumentation for uddannelse og kvalifikationer skal foreligge Er du den fagperson

Lyder MerCare som et sted for dig?
Hvis du kan genkende dig selv i det, vi beskriver, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Hos os handler det ikke om at være den, der kan mest.

Det handler om at være den medarbejder, der passer til opgaven – og som vi trygt kan sende ud.

Vi matcher ikke bare opgaver.

Vi matcher mennesker. Er du den fagperson

MerCare
Skabt af praksis – båret af ansvar.

jobs.description:

Salonkee ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden SaaS-Unternehmen im Beauty- und Wellness-Bereich in Europa. Wir digitalisieren den Salonalltag und ermöglichen Friseur- und Beauty-Salons, effizienter zu arbeiten – und wachsen dabei gemeinsam als Team in einem dynamischen, internationalen Umfeld.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Autonom und strategisch arbeiten: Du planst deine Aktivitäten selbstständig, setzt klare Ziele und findest smarte Wege, um Salonkee erfolgreich vor Ort zu etablieren.

jobs.description:
**Spare Part Planner, Waterjets**

An exciting opportunity has arisen as a **Spare Part Planner** with us at **Kongsberg Maritime** **in Kokkola**. You will be a Planner in our Global Customer Support division (GCS). The division is responsible for the customer support activities towards installed systems until phase out and removal.

You will be a key player in improvement of delivery time to our customers, mitigate risk upon delivery and other supply chain activities. We are looking for an analytical and hands-on planner to improve customer satisfaction by cooperating with our supply chain and sales team to ensure orders are delivered as planned.

_This is a great opportunity for either recent graduate or professional to join our Spare Parts team in Waterjets!_

**Key Accountabilities:**

- Be a link between procurement, production, and sales to ensure parts and orders are finished in time.

- Improve lead times for our orders

- Maintenance and continuous improvement of our delivery processes

- Represent GCS spares in weekly production meetings.


**Qualifications and experience:**

- Bachelors degree in Logistics, Finance or Engineering

- Oral and written communication skills in English, Finnish and Swedish is seen as an advantage.

- It is considered an advantage if you have experience with:


- Infor Baan ERP or Dynamics 365

- Excel, SQL


**You are able to:**

- Identify commercial opportunities and you have a positive impact on business growth and profitability

- Use a methodical and systematic approach and plan ahead

- Communicate in a clear, precise and structured way

- Co-operate well with others, share knowledge and support others in the pursuit of team goals

- Act on your own initiative, make things happen and accept responsibility for the results


**What we can offer you**

With us, you will be offered a competitive salary, good benefit package, flexible work hours, and good development opportunities in an international environment. In accordance with the remote work policy, you have the possibility for flexible remote work. By choosing us, you get to work in an inspiring and safe work-environment with sustainable and exciting solutions for the future.

**Work location** Kokkola

**Point of contact** For more information please contact Benjamin Gripenberg, Spare Parts Manager, Waterjets +358 442924246 on Wednesdays and Thursdays between 2:00 PM and 4:00 PM.

**Interested?** Please submit your application by 28th of October through our recruitment system.

**Our Global Customer Support** division is responsible for Kongsberg Maritimes services, upgrades and support in the aftermarket. Our 3400 employees are present in 35 different countries around the world. During the operational lifetime of more than 30.000 installations, we ensure cost-efficient delivery of services, upgrades and spare parts in order to secure availability and predictability to our customers.

**Kongsberg Maritime is a global leader in maritime technology.** We deliver advanced solutions to the merchant fleet, offshore, fishing, and naval vessels, setting new standards for safe, efficient, and sustainable operations - both for new builds and existing fleets. In close collaboration with customers and research environments, we develop technology that solves real challenges at sea. Today, more than **30,000 vessels** operate with our systems on board. AUTOMAALAREITA JA KORIPELTISEPPÄÄ

HS Kytkintien Automaalaamo Oy on vankalla ammattitaidolla toimiva, vakuutusyhtiöiden valtuuttama automaalaamo ja korikorjaamo. Palvelemme asiakkaitamme kattavasti kaikissa ajoneuvojen koritöissä, kolarikorjauksissa, hitsauksissa sekä vaativissa maalauspalveluissa. Vakituisen työpaikan vakaassa ja kasvavassa yrityksessä (työsopimukseen sovelletaan lakisääteistä 6 kk koeaikaa).

Täytämme paikat heti sopivien ammattilaisten löydyttyä, ja työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan nopeasti. Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi ja CV (ansioluettelosi) sähköpostitse liitteenä. Otamme yhteyttä sopiviin ehdokkaisiin haastattelua varten.

jobs.title: PhD position at the Center for Polariton-driven Light-Matter Interactions (POLIMA)
jobs.description:
The Center for Polariton-driven Light-Matter Interactions (POLIMA) at The Mads Clausen Institute, University of Southern Denmark, is seeking a talented and highly motivated PhD student to work on the development of new theoretical frameworks for describing light–matter interactions in advanced van der Walls heterostructures probed by polaritons generated through inelastic tunneling. The position is funded by a Villum Young Investigator grant awarded to Assistant Professor P. André D. Gonçalves, who will supervise the PhD research.

The position is available starting 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The successful candidate will develop new theoretical frameworks and computational methods to investigate the fundamental limits of polariton-mediated inelastic electron tunneling in tunnel junctions based on van der Waals heterostructures composed of atomically thin materials. The project will employ a broad range of analytical, semi-analytical, and numerical techniques to explore electrically driven polaritonic phenomena. A major focus will be on harnessing polariton-mediated inelastic electron tunneling as a tool to probe and manipulate light–matter interactions at the nanoscale, as well as to characterize the optoelectronic response of complex quantum materials.

We welcome candidates with a strong background in condensed-matter physics and/or quantum nanophotonics who are highly motivated and eager to pursue world-class research in theoretical quantum nano-optoelectronics. Experience with scientific programming is expected, while familiarity with numerical techniques is advantageous but not required. The ideal candidate will be enthusiastic about contributing to cutting-edge research in a dynamic and ambitious young research group, supported by the POLIMA Center and its extensive network of international collaborators.

POLIMA is a Center of Excellence funded by the Danish National Research Foundation (DNRF) for an initial period of 6 years (2023–2028), with the possibility of a 4-year extension. The center is led by Professor N. Asger Mortensen and currently consists of two Professors, three Assistant Professors, a Lab Manager, a Center Administrator, and approximately 10–15 PhD students, postdocs, and visiting scientists. Several POLIMA researchers have attracted prestigious personal grants, e.g., Villum Investigator, Villum Young Investigator, DFF Sapere Aude, Novo Nordisk’s Foundation RECRUIT and Data Science Investigator – Emerging, and Maria Skłodowska-Curie Fellowships. Read more on POLIMA’s website.

We offer a competitive and highly collaborative research environment with close interaction between experimental and theoretical activities. You will join a thriving community of researchers and benefit from a strong network of international collaborators. Our work environment is supportive, dynamic, and designed to foster creativity and the development of innovative projects.

 

We offer:

• A PhD student position in an ambitious and supportive, international research environment.

• A dedicated supervisor research team to support the academic development of the PhD student.

• Access to state-of-the-art equipment, facilities, and infrastructure.

• A competitive salary and social benefits (e.g., health coverage, parental leave, social security, etc.) (https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/international-staff/getting-settled)

POLIMA is located at the University of Southern Denmark in Odense – 1h15min by train from Copenhagen Airport. The University of Southern Denmark offers dedicated assistance and support with various practical, social, and legal aspects (housing, visa, administration, tax, etc.), especially for international candidates through our international staff office (ISO) and the administrative staff at POLIMA.

 

For further information and details about the position, application, and the research center, please contact Assistant Professor Paulo André Dias Gonçalves (padgo@mci.sdu.dk).

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk. 

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and an application must include: 

  • Motivated application. 

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Master’s and bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (copy of original and an official English translation).  

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • References may be included, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is 31 December, 2026, at 11:59 PM / 23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process. 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

The preferred start date is 1 March 2026 (may be adjusted by mutual agreement) or as soon as possible thereafter. 

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: King of the Road trenger flere med på laget!
jobs.description:
Noen velger yrke, andre velger livsstil.
 
Hos Scania Kløfta jobber vi ikke bare med lastebiler. Vi jobber med et varemerke som vekker stolthet. Scania er kjent langt utover verkstedgulvet, og det finnes folk som bærer griffen på både klær, vegger, og noen ganger til og med tatovert på kroppen. Men hos oss handler det først og fremst om noe annet: dyktige folk som er stolte av faget sitt.
Hver dag kommer lastebiler inn og ut av verkstedet vårt i Kløfta. Kundene våre forventer kvalitet, kompetanse og løsninger som holder dem på veien. Det ansvaret tar vi på alvor.
For å fortsette å levere på det nivået vi er kjent for, ønsker vi nå å styrke laget med flere mekanikere. Er dette kanskje deg?
 
Hvem ser vi etter?
Vi søker to nye mekanikere til oss. Du trenger ikke ha Scania-logoen tatovert, men du må ha interesse for faget.
Vi ønsker at du har relevant fagbrev og erfaring som mekaniker, enten fra tungbil, bil, anlegg, landbruk eller industri. Du liker å løse tekniske utfordringer, har interesse for moderne kjøretøy og ønsker å utvikle deg videre.
Du jobber strukturert, samarbeider godt med andre og tar stolthet i arbeidet du leverer.
 
Hva kan vi tilby deg?
Hos oss blir du en del av et sterkt fagmiljø med høy kompetanse og godt samhold. Du får jobbe i et moderne verksted med moderne utstyr, og du får muligheten til å utvikle deg gjennom kurs, opplæring og nye utfordringer.
Vi tilbyr konkurransedyktige betingelser, gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger og en trygg arbeidsgiver med et av bransjens sterkeste varemerker. Her blir du satset på - og her kan du bli lenge.
 
Er du klar?
Vil du bli en del av laget i Kløfta? Send oss gjerne en søknad allerede i dag. Vi behandler søknader fortløpende.
Har du spørsmål om stillingen, er du velkommen til å ta kontakt med Distriktssjef Jan Erik Dokken +4794985111.

jobs.title: Senior Support Specialist, Telecom, Location: Danmark - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Are you technically curious, service-minded, and motivated by helping customers resolve critical technical issues? Do you enjoy combining troubleshooting with coordination and clear communication? If so, this could be your next career opportunity. 

Your position 

As our new Senior Support Specialist, Telecom, you will support the daily operation of our customers communication Systems. You will take ownership of incoming requests, gather the necessary technical information, assess urgency and operational impact, and perform structured troubleshooting. When specialist assistance is required, you will coordinate the correct escalation and ensure that customers remain informed throughout the process.

You are not expected to be the specialist for every system. Your role is to establish a clear overview, perform the agreed initial checks, document findings and decisions, and ensure that each case is resolved.

Your place of work will be at our Global HQ located in Esbjerg in a full-time position. You must be willing and able to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation according to an agreed schedule.

Your tasks & responsibilities 
Your work will include receiving customer calls and service requests, monitoring tickets and alarms, carrying out remote troubleshooting, and coordinating technical responses. You will maintain technical records, contribute to service reporting and preventive-maintenance activities, and help improve service procedures and documentation.

Your main responsibilities will be to:

  • Manage service tickets from initial request through resolution.
  • Perform troubleshooting and monitor systems through Zabbix or comparable platforms
  • Keep customers informed and ensure that technical findings, communication, and agreed actions are documented accurately


Your profile & qualifications
 
You are service-minded, technically curious, and comfortable taking responsibility. You approach technical issues systematically and communicate clearly with customers and colleagues. You do not need to be a specialist in every system, but you are motivated to investigate issues, perform structured trouble shooting, and coordinate the right technical support.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you:

  • Have a technical background within telecom, networking or related field
  • Have practical experience with technical troubleshooting and fault handling
  • Strong Microsoft Office software knowledge
  • Are comfortable using ticketing systems and documenting technical findings, customer communication, and agreed actions
  • Communicate clearly in written and spoken English
  • Are willing and able to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation

Experience with telecom systems such as PABX, TETRA, VHF, AIS, CCTV, PAGA, LTE or Network infrastructure would also be beneficial. General knowledge with, Window, Linux, Proxmox, Zabbix, TOPdesk, or comparable systems, but your technical curiosity and willingness to learn are equally important.

Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too. 

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.  

Care to join the movement?
Change. With us.

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

Underviser søges til varmtvandstræning i Hammel og Hinnerup
jobs.description:
Underviser søges til varmtvandstræning i Favrskov Kommune

LOF Midtjylland søger en engageret underviser til varmtvandstræning i Hammel og Hinnerup i Favrskov Kommune. Vi ønsker at oprette nye hold, hvor deltagerne får mulighed for at arbejde med bevægelse, styrke, balance og mobilitet i skånsomme rammer.

Som underviser skal du kunne tilrettelægge undervisningen, så øvelserne kan tilpasses deltagernes forskellige behov og forudsætninger. Det er vigtigt for os, at deltagerne oplever både faglighed, tryghed og et godt fællesskab på holdet.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • har erfaring med bevægelse, træning, fysioterapi, idræt eller lignende

  • er tryg ved at undervise grupper

  • kan tilpasse øvelser til forskellige niveauer og fysiske forudsætninger

  • er imødekommende og god til at skabe en tryg stemning

  • har interesse for folkeoplysning og for at gøre bevægelse tilgængelig for flere

Erfaring med varmtvandstræning er en fordel, men det vigtigste er, at du har de rette faglige og personlige kompetencer.

Der er tale om timebaseret undervisning på et eller flere hold. Du ansættes som timelønnet underviser hos LOF Midtjylland og aflønnes efter gældende løncirkulære for folkeoplysningen. Vi planlægger holdene til forårssæsonen 2027.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send en mail til job@lof-midtjylland.dk og fortæl kort om dig selv, din erfaring og din motivation.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Anisette Bjerringholm på mail: Anisette@lof-midtjylland.dk eller tlf: 93394544.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Bh LOF Midtjylland

jobs.title: Sisustustyönjohtaja
jobs.description:
Riverco Oy on keskisuuri konepaja-, laivankorjaus- ja laivanrakennusalan yritys, joka on kansainvälisesti menestynyt ja alallaan tunnettu. Pääasiakkaitamme ovat muun muassa maailman johtavat risteilyvarustamot ja telakat.

Olemme osa erittäin vakavaraista ja 60 vuotta toiminutta monialaista yritysryhmää. Konserni toimii konepaja- ja laivanrakennusteollisuuden lisäksi sähkö- ja putkiurakoinnissa, kiinteistötoimialalla sekä kaupan alalla. Yrityksen toimipaikat sijaitsevat Turussa, Raisiossa, Paraisilla ja Nousiaisissa.

Tyypillisiä työkohteitamme ovat laivojen teknisten ja sisustusalueiden kokonaistoimitukset sekä laivojen tekniset järjestelmät. Toteutamme useille kansainvälisille varustamoille muun muassa vaativia muutos-, kunnossapito- ja huoltotöitä.

Osaavaan tiimiimme olisi nyt haussa kotimaassa ja ulkomailla toteutettaviin laivanrakennus- ja laivankorjausprojekteihin:

**SISUSTUSTYÖNJOHTAJA**

**Työnkuva**

Sisustustyönjohtajana vastaat laivojen sisustus- ja muutostöiden käytännön toteutuksesta työmaalla. Johdat ja ohjaat asentajia sekä aliurakoitsijoita ja huolehdit siitä, että työt etenevät suunnitelmien, aikataulujen ja laatutavoitteiden mukaisesti. Ennen projektia osallistut esivalmistuksen ohjaamiseen ja ostotoimintaan.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

- työmaan päivittäisen toiminnan ja työn etenemisen suunnittelu ja johtaminen

- oman henkilöstön ja aliurakoitsijoiden työnjohto sekä työn organisointi

- töiden aikatauluttaminen ja resurssien suunnittelu yhdessä projektiryhmän kanssa

- työpiirustusten ja muiden suunnitelmien läpikäynti sekä niiden toteutuksen valvonta

- materiaalien, työkalujen ja muiden työssä tarvittavien resurssien koordinointi

- työn laadun ja aikataulujen valvonta sekä tarvittavien muutosten koordinointi

- projektien valmisteluun, työmäärien arviointiin ja toteutuksen suunnitteluun osallistuminen


Työtehtävät vaihtelevat projektien mukaan, joten työ tarjoaa mahdollisuuden olla mukana sekä pienemmissä korjaus- ja muutostöissä että laajemmissa laivanrakennusprojekteissa.

Työskentelet osana ammattitaitoista projektiryhmää, mutta tehtävässä korostuu myös itsenäinen ote, päätöksentekokyky ja vastuunotto omasta työmaasta.

**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Arvostamme soveltuvaa teknistä koulutusta tai aikaisempaa kokemusta laivanrakennuksen tai rakennus- ja teollisuudenalan työnjohdosta. Erityisesti kokemus laivojen sisustustöistä, muutostöistä tai telakkaympäristöstä katsotaan eduksi.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää:

- käytännönläheistä ja järjestelmällistä työotetta

- hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja

- kykyä ohjata erilaisia työryhmiä

jobs.title: Job i Portugal med firmabolig - Kunderådgiver for Audi - Opstart den 1. november - Book en samtale i dag!
jobs.description:
Kundeservicerådgiver for Audi. Vi har opstart den 1. november med mulighed for firmabolig.

Er du klar til at tage springet og blive en del af en global digital organisation, der leverer support i verdensklasse?

Vi søger en kunderådgiver til en spændende rolle med Audi – en af Europas mest ikoniske bilproducenter. Stillingen er 100 % remote fra Portugal, og du bliver en nøglespiller i et internationalt team, der sikrer en ekstraordinær kunderejse for Audi’s brugere.

Hvad laver en Kundeservicerådgiver?

Som kundeservicerådgiver er du kundens direkte kontaktpunkt og hjælper med alt fra bilteknologi til digitale funktioner og serviceydelser. Du skaber en professionel oplevelse med struktur, empati og høj kvalitet i centrum.

Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.:

  • Besvarelse af henvendelser via telefon, e-mail og chat

  • Fejlsøgning af tekniske problemer og vejledning i bilsystemer

  • Registrering af kundeinteraktioner i CRM-systemet

  • Opdatering på Audi’s produkter og politikker

  • Aktiv deltagelse i teamets deling af best practices

Dine kvalifikationer:

Vi leder efter dig, hvis du:

  • Taler og skriver dansk + har et minimum B2-niveau i engelsk

  • Har erfaring med kundeservice – gerne fra bilbranchen

  • Har teknisk flair og interesse for digitale løsninger

  • Kan kommunikere tydeligt, løse problemer og skabe tillid

Du behøver ikke opfylde alle krav – vi opfordrer dig stadig til at søge!

Vi tilbyder:

  • Mulighed for firmabolig i Braga

  • Konkurrencedygtig grundløn plus bonusordning

  • Professionelle udviklingsmuligheder

  • Et samarbejdende og støttende arbejdsmiljø

  • Adgang til eksklusive rejsefordele og rabatter

  • Restaurantkort

  • Privat sundhedsforsikring

  • 14 lønudbetalinger om året

Fordele ved at arbejde i en international virksomhed i Portugal

  • Udvidelse af dine faglige kompetencer gennem globalt samarbejde

  • Forbedring af kommunikation og salgsteknikker i et internationalt miljø

  • Mulighed for karriereudvikling inden for kundeservice, salg og rejsebranchen

  • Adgang til et netværk af internationale kolleger og brancheeksperter

  • Erfaring med moderne digitale værktøjer til kundehåndtering

Dette er en unik mulighed for at kombinere en stærk erhvervserfaring med en fleksibel arbejdsmodel.

Fordele ved at arbejde fra Portugal

  • Mildt klima året rundt – Portugal har et behageligt middelhavsklima med varme somre og milde vintre, hvilket gør det til en attraktiv destination for dem, der ønsker at bo og arbejde i et solrigt land

  • Lavere leveomkostninger – Sammenlignet med mange andre europæiske lande er leveomkostningerne i Portugal relativt lave, hvilket giver mulighed for en høj livskvalitet til en rimelig pris.

  • Høj livskvalitet – Portugal er kendt for sin afslappede livsstil, gode mad og venlige lokalbefolkning, hvilket skaber et positivt og behageligt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Internationale karrieremuligheder – Arbejde i Portugal giver mulighed for at udvikle internationale færdigheder og samarbejde med kolleger fra forskellige nationaliteter, hvilket kan være en fordel for din fremtidige karriere.

  • God infrastruktur og moderne faciliteter – Portugal har en stærk digital infrastruktur, moderne kontorfaciliteter og gode transportmuligheder, hvilket sikrer en behagelig arbejdsdag.

  • Adgang til smukke strande og natur – Portugal tilbyder nem adgang til fantastiske strande, naturskønne områder og en rig kulturarv, som kan opleves både i fritiden og weekenderne.

  • Attraktiv skattepolitik for udlændinge – For internationale medarbejdere findes der skattefordele, der kan gøre det økonomisk fordelagtigt at arbejde i Portugal.

  • Voksende erhvervsliv og økonomi – Portugal har en blomstrende erhvervssektor, hvor flere internationale virksomheder etablerer sig, hvilket skaber gode jobmuligheder og karriereveje.

  • Stærkt netværk af expats og internationale virksomheder – Mange internationale virksomheder har kontorer i Portugal, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig i et globalt arbejdsmiljø.

Arbejdet i Portugal giver både professionel og personlig udvikling samt mulighed for at opleve en spændende livsstil med stor kulturel og økonomisk værdi.

Er du interesseret? Kontakt os på Rene@jobhuntworldwide.com eller Cathrine@jobhuntworldwide.com for at høre mere, vi vender retur indenfor 24 timer.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Mission Execution
jobs.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Software Engineer, Mission Execution, you'll build the software backbone that carries mission plans from the planner to the field. You'll own the infrastructure that executes missions on autonomous robots and multi-agent systems. You'll work closely with the Mission Planning engineer, simulation engineers and product teams to make sure our systems are reliable, testable, and predictable in live operations.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build the mission execution infrastructure that turns planned missions into reliable, real-time behavior across fleets of autonomous systems.

  • Develop scalable backend services and APIs for mission guidance, orchestration, agents communication, and execution.

  • Set and defend a high quality bar: CI/CD pipelines, testing, code review standards, observability, and release discipline.

  • Write production-grade C++ and Python that runs in real-time and resource-constrained environments.

  • Partner with Mission Planning, and product teams to ensure algorithms are integrated cleanly, tested thoroughly, and deployable in the field.

  • Analyze logs and telemetry from tests and live operations to find failure modes and drive systemic fixes.

Candidate Requirements

  • Education: M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Technical skills: Strong coding in C++ and Python, with solid software engineering fundamentals (system design, concurrency, testing, debugging).

  • Experience building and shipping production software: Ideally with distributed or real-time systems.

  • Nice to have: Experience in robotics, embedded software, or video game development (game engines, simulation, deterministic replay, tooling). Experience in aerospace or defense. Familiarity with simulation frameworks.

  • Mindset: Strong communication skills, Rigor, ownership, and a strong instinct for quality.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

jobs.title: Computer Vision Engineer - Tracker
jobs.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

About the Role

As a Computer Vision Engineer in the Computer Vision Tracker team, you will join us at a very early stage, giving you a unique opportunity to heavily influence the technical direction of the team. Operating out of Lausanne, Paris, or Zurich, you will focus on creating a global 3D Object Tracking pipeline, at the intersection between the Computer Vision, Sensor Fusion and GNC teams.

 

Responsibilities

  • Computer Vision Algorithm Development: Research and implement state-of-the-art Computer Vision approaches to Object Tracking in multiple modalities and scenarios, combining classical and geometrical methods with AI detection models developed in-house.

  • Multi-Sensor Fusion: Fuse data from multiple sensors (Cameras, IMU, Radar, etc.) to provide high-precision target estimation and robust tracking through challenging conditions.

  • Edge Optimization for Low-Compute Deployment: Optimize and embed tracking algorithms on heterogeneous platforms with limited compute resources, ensuring real-time performance alongside other software bricks running on the drone.

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with the GNC, Sensor Fusion, and AI teams to integrate your tracking pipelines into a seamless, production-ready environment.

  • Research & Innovation: Stay at the absolute forefront of scientific trends in computer vision, tracking algorithms, and sensor fusion to introduce cutting-edge methodologies to the product.

  • Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by managing or mentoring junior engineers.

 

Candidate Requirements

  • Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in a STEM field (e.g., Computer Science, Robotics, Engineering, Mathematics).

  • Embedded Algorithmic Expertise: Proven track record in the research, development, and productization of Computer Vision & Sensor-Fusion algorithms in hardware-constrained environments.

  • Technical Competence: Strong proficiency in C++ and Python for real-time systems. Experience with optimizing code for edge deployment.

 

Nice to have

  • Highly structured, analytical, task-aligned, and research-oriented.

  • Excellent communication and influence skills, with the ability to effectively translate and present complex algorithmic trade-offs to downstream users and senior stakeholders.

As Executive Assistant at Cradle, you'll keep two of our founding executives moving. Between customer visits, investor meetings, hiring and travel across Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, there's a lot to keep track of, and your job is to make sure nothing gets dropped. You'll own their calendars, inboxes and travel, and take care of the personal admin that would otherwise eat into their time. Requirements

Cradle evaluates all candidates based on merit, regardless of sex, gender, ethnicity, socio-economic background, or any other aspect of identity. We maintain zero tolerance for discrimination and actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

These outputs are not used to make or meaningfully influence hiring decisions — all candidates are evaluated through a thorough, human-led review by our recruiting team.

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner

  • Du vil lære av andre og dele egne kunnskaper
  • Du kan å smile :-)

Vi tilbyr

  • Et dynamisk og trivelig miljø
  • En varm velkomst i Remiks-familien

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Multi-modal microscopy and tomography of virus-infected organoids
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in the development of multimodal microscopy for studying viral infection in organoids, available at the Department of Physics of the University of Oslo (UiO).

The starting date is no later than 1 April 2027.

The fellowship period is three years.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

The place of work is the Department of Physics in Blindern, Oslo.


Background of project

Investigating viral interactions within host cells at the single-particle level poses significant challenges due to the resolution limitations of conventional microscopy, particularly in complex organoid tissue sections and lack of multi-modality approach. To overcome these obstacles, it is necessary to develop and apply multi-modal optical microscopy methods, such as fluorescence based super-resolution microscopy and label-free optical diffraction tomography and quantitative phase microscopy. Another important aspect of this project is to perform advance image analysis on correlative datasets to extract the underlying knowledge. The technical aspect of this project aims to integrate two cutting-edge microscopy platforms, photonic chip-based multimodal microscopy and quantitative phase microscopy (QPM)/optical diffraction tomography. These instruments will be used to study viral infections in organoid models (such as gut and brain). Post-imaging, we will conduct advanced image analysis, develop different models for correlative imaging and on label-free images. As part of MSCA-DN the candidate must be open to travel and collaborate with other partners in this project, especially with other DC such as DC 1, DC 6 DC 8 and DC 10.


Job description

At the University of Oslo in Norway, we are looking for a Doctoral Candidate (DC 5) to work on WP 3. The main responsibilities of the DC 5 will be:

  • To develop and adapt a multi-modal optical microscopy platform with focus on two modalities, a) photonic chip-based super-resolution optical microscopy and b) optical diffraction tomography & quantitative phase microscopy.
  • To perform correlative fluorescence optical microscopy with 3D quantitative phase tomography to facilitate virtual specificity
  • To generate correlated datasets for analysis of microenvironmental changes during HIV-1 and VEEV infection. To use organoid sections, intact organoids and cells models in this study.
  • Apply advanced image analysis including AI assisted segmentation, classification and correlation
  • Support and collaborate with other doctoral candidates related to imaging, analysis and training.

The doctoral candidate will be guided during this research project by Prof. Balpreet Singh Ahluwalia and Prof. Dag Kristian Dysthe. You can apply for this position until 30 October 2026. Applications submitted after this date will not be considered.


How to apply

Technical information:

Position location: Oslo, Norway
Application deadline: October 30, 2026
Project start date: April 1st, 2027
Duration: 3 years

Please follow this link to apply for this position and for more detailed instructions on the application: 
Doctoral Candidate 5 Vacancy — MERIT


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in physics or engineering or related field in biomedical engineering and biophysics. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system. Master dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date,
  • Solid, hands-on experience with experimental optical instrumentation, including the development, alignment, operation and/or application of optical microscopy systems,
  • Strong background in image analysis or similar scientific data analysis using Python or MATLAB,
  • An interest in working in a multidisciplinary research group.

Desired qualifications:

  • Background in adapting or development of optical microscopy platforms such as fluorescence based super-resolution microscopy, diffraction tomography or quantitative phase microscopy systems,
  • Machine learning or AI-assisted analysis of microscopy or other high-dimensional imaging datasets,
  • Image reconstruction and computational microscopy, including algorithms for super-resolution microscopy, phase retrieval, quantitative phase imaging, or optical diffraction tomography,
  • Advanced image analysis, including image registration, segmentation, feature extraction, classification, and correlative/multimodal image analysis.
  • Experience in bioimaging and handling of biological samples,
  • As the target applications involve organoids and viruses, it is beneficial if the candidate have experience working with various biological specimen such as tissue sections or organoid samples,
  • Willingness to collaborate within an international research network and undertake research visits, secondments and training activities at partner institutions.

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


General MERIT eligibility criteria
  • Candidates must not have been awarded a doctorate previously
  • Applicants must not have resided or carried out their main activity in the country or recruiting institution for more than 12 months in the 3 years immediately prior to the date of recruitment, 1 April 2027. See https://marie-sklodowska-curie-actions.ec.europa.eu/actions/doctoral-networks
  • Candidates must meet the entry requirements for admission to the PhD-program of the institution to which they apply, see below for more details.

Language requirements

  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements: https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8
     

In addition to the eligibility criteria above, candidates admitted to the PhD programme at the University of Oslo must fulfill the grade requirements, see www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc7. The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system,
  • The average grade point for courses included in the master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system,
  • The master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system.

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 


What are we looking for in you?

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Molecular fingerprinting in organoids using Raman and AF micro-spectroscopy
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in molecular fingerprinting in organoids using Raman and autofluorescence micro-spectroscopy, available at the Department of Physics of the University of Oslo (UiO).

The starting date is no later than 1 April 2027.

The fellowship period is three years.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

The place of work is the Department of Physics in Blindern, Oslo.


Background of project

This doctoral project will develop and apply advanced label-free optical spectroscopy approaches to investigate molecular and metabolic changes in organoid models of viral infection. The project will combine Raman micro-spectroscopy and UV–visible autofluorescence (AF) spectroscopy, providing complementary information on the biochemical and metabolic state of biological samples without requiring external fluorescent labels. Raman micro-spectroscopy, primarily using 785 nm excitation, will obtain molecular fingerprints associated with lipids, proteins, nucleic acids and metabolites. Complementary UV–visible autofluorescence spectroscopy in the 350–500 nm spectral range will probe endogenous fluorescence signatures associated with cellular metabolism and biochemical composition. The project will investigate both free-space spectroscopy and waveguide-enhanced spectroscopic approaches, including waveguide-enhanced Raman and waveguide-based autofluorescence spectroscopy, with the aim of improving sensitivity to subtle molecular changes.

Photonic waveguides provide strong and spatially extended light–matter interaction through the evanescent optical field, offering opportunities to enhance Raman signals and AF-signals and improve sensitivity compared with conventional free-space measurements. Particular emphasis will be placed on identifying spectral signatures associated with early molecular alterations and metabolic reprogramming that may precede observable structural changes. AI-assisted spectral analysis will be explored to analyse the high-dimensional Raman and autofluorescence datasets. Machine-learning approaches will be used to identify spectral features and molecular signatures associated with infection, distinguish different biological states, and correlate spectroscopic changes with disease progression. The project will use organoid models of HIV-1 and Venezuelan equine encephalitis virus (VEEV) infection.

As part of MSCA-DN the candidate must be open to travel and collaborate with other partners in this project, especially with other doctoral candidates (DC): DC 5, DC 9-10 and DC 12.


Job description

At the University of Oslo in Norway, we are looking for a Doctoral Candidate (DC 6) to work on WP 3. The main responsibilities of the DC 6 will be:

  • To develop and adapt Raman and autofluorescence spectroscopy platform,

  • To apply these spectroscopy tools for organoid sections, analytes and virus,
  • To generate spectral signatures (Raman and AF- library) associated with early molecular alterations and metabolic reprogramming during HIV-1 and VEEV infection,
  • Apply advanced image analysis including AI assisted spectral analysis for high-dimensional Raman and AF- signals,
  • Support and collaborate with other doctoral candidates related to spectroscopy, analysis and training.

The doctoral candidate will be guided during this research project by Prof. Balpreet Singh Ahluwalia and Associated Professor Elisabeth Wetzer. You can apply for this position until 30 October 2026. Applications submitted after this date will not be considered.

  • A strong background in optics, photonics, spectroscopy, or related experimental techniques. Hands-on experimental experience with the development, operation or application of optical spectroscopic instrumentation, such as Raman spectroscopy.
  • Experience with data analysis and scientific programming, for example using Python, MATLAB or equivalent tools.
  • Familiarity with image/spectral analysis tools such as MATLAB, Python and basic AI tools
  • Willingness to undertake research visits, secondments and training activities at partner institutions within the MSCA Doctoral Network and to collaborate closely with other doctoral candidates.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant (m/f/d)

Luxembourg
Line of Service Advisory
Industry/Sector Banking and Capital Markets
Specialism Fraud, Investigations & Regulatory Enforcement (FIRE)
Management Level Senior Associate

Job Description & Summary

PwC Luxembourg is hiring a Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant (m/f/d). What if it was you?

Your Mission:

In today's increasingly complex regulatory and financial environment, combating financial crime is a critical priority for all organisations. At our firm, the Financial Crime Compliance team acts as a strategic advisor to management and clients, proactively identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks related to money laundering, terrorist financing, sanctions breaches, fraud, and other financial crimes.

As a Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in delivering expert guidance, designing robust compliance frameworks, and supporting clients in implementing effective controls to safeguard their operations and reputation.
Be a part of our team where you will:

Client Risk Assessment and Advisory

• Conduct comprehensive financial crime risk assessments, covering AML, sanctions, fraud, and bribery/corruption risks;
• Advise clients on regulatory requirements and best practices under Luxembourg law, EU directives, FATF recommendations, and global standards;
• Assist in designing and implementing financial crime compliance frameworks tailored to client risk profiles.

Customer Due Diligence and Enhanced Due Diligence

• Review and analyze KYC documentation for new clients during onboarding;
• Perform ongoing due diligence and periodic reviews of existing client files;
• Conduct reputational checks and adverse media screening on clients and beneficial owners.

Transaction Monitoring and Investigations

• Design and implement transaction monitoring systems to detect suspicious activities across multiple risk typologies;
• Analyze transactional data to identify unusual patterns indicative of money laundering, fraud, or sanctions breaches;
• Support clients in investigating alerts and preparing Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) for competent authorities.

Sanctions and Screening Controls

• Implement and oversee sanctions screening processes, ensuring compliance with EU, UN, and OFAC lists;

Der Montagehelfer / Montagemitarbeiter ist verantwortlich für die Durchführung von Montage- und Installationsarbeiten an Produkten und Lösungen der ViaCon Group, insbesondere im Bereich BA 1, unter Einhaltung technischer Vorgaben, geltender Sicherheitsvorschriften und projektbezogener Zeitpläne.

Zu den Aufgaben gehören die Vorbereitung und Handhabung von Materialien, Werkzeugen und Bauteilen, die Durchführung von Montagearbeiten vor Ort im In- und Ausland sowie – sofern erforderlich – das Arbeiten nach technischen Zeichnungen und Anweisungen. Der Montagehelfer / Montagemitarbeiter trägt zu einer termingerechten, sicheren und qualitativ hochwertigen Umsetzung der Projekte bei und arbeitet eng mit dem Montageteam sowie relevanten internen Schnittstellen zusammen.

Hauptaufgaben:

- Unterstützung bei Wartungs-, Service- und Reparaturarbeiten
- Sicherstellung von Sauberkeit, Ordnung und Einhaltung der Sicherheitsvorschriften
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Monteuren und dem zuständigen Team

Wichtige Anforderungen:

- Erfahrung im Bereich Montage ist erforderlich

jobs.description:
