Kdo jsme?
Auto Dobrovolný je rodinná firma s více než 30letou tradicí a třemi provozovnami ve Velkém Meziříčí, Jihlavě a Znojmě. Zastupujeme značky Škoda, Opel, MG a LEAP motor a poskytujeme stabilní zázemí pro tým přibližně 90 zaměstnanců.

Co vás u nás čeká?
Převezmete odpovědnost za ekonomický úsek a kompletní účetnictví společnosti. Součástí role bude také vedení a metodická podpora týmu 4 účetních.
Čeká vás zejména:

-    kompletní vedení účetnictví včetně DPH a DPPO,
-    odpovědnost za měsíční a roční účetní uzávěrky,
-    vedení a koordinace účetního týmu,
-    příprava podkladů pro auditora a daňového poradce a komunikace s úřady,
-    evidence dlouhodobého majetku, odpisů a inventarizací,
-    tvorba ekonomických přehledů, reportů a analýz pro vedení,
-    nastavování a optimalizace účetních a ekonomických procesů,
-    pokročilá práce v Excelu.

Budete u důležité změny
Aktuálně implementujeme nový účetní systém a hledáme člověka, který projekt aktivně převezme a pomůže nastavit procesy pro každodenní fungování.
Oceníme proto technickou zdatnost, procesní myšlení a chuť hledat praktická řešení. S interními procesy a systémem Softapp vás postupně seznámíme, abyste plynule převzal/a veškerou agendu.

Koho hledáme?

-    minimálně 5 let praxe na pozici hlavní nebo samostatné účetní,
-    výbornou znalost českých účetních a daňových předpisů,
-    zkušenost s účetními uzávěrkami,
-    velmi dobrou znalost MS Excel a účetních systémů,
-    schopnost vést tým, organizovat práci a nastavovat procesy,
-    samostatnost, pečlivost a zodpovědnost,
-    řidičský průkaz sk. B.
Výhodou bude zkušenost s implementací či digitalizací účetních systémů a komunikací s auditory nebo daňovými poradci.

Co Vám nabídneme?
-    stabilní práci v rodinné firmě s dlouholetou tradicí,
-    flexibilní pracovní dobu,
-    podnikovou jídelnu s příspěvkem na stravu,
-    5 sick days ročně,
-    vstupenky na sportovní a kulturní akce,
-    výhodný nákup nového vozu a slevy na servis,
-    možnost ovlivnit nastavení ekonomických procesů a fungování firmy.
Chcete mít ekonomiku firmy ve svých rukou a vidět výsledky své práce? Pošlete nám svůj životopis – rádi vás poznáme.

jobs.title: Cloud Security Lead
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



Join us at the forefront of AI and cloud-native security as we work to secure one of the most innovative developer platforms in the world. As the Cloud Security Lead, you will shape the cloud and infrastructure security program that protects millions of developers, enables safe AI-assisted development, and ensures organizations can confidently bring our platform into enterprise environments.

In this role, you will own cloud security across GCP (primary) and supplemental environments in AWS and Azure, as well as containerized systems, SaaS platforms, and our multi-tenant AI infrastructure. You’ll improve our security posture through strong architecture, posture management, secure-by-default development practices, and close partnership with Engineering, Compliance, Security Architecture, and Platform teams.

This is a highly impactful, hands-on leadership role—perfect for someone who wants to solve complex security challenges at scale while influencing product, engineering, and go-to-market teams.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:


CLOUD SECURITY ENGINEERING

 - Lead configuration hardening across GCP, with additional oversight of workloads and integrations running in AWS and Azure.

 - Own and optimize CSPM platforms across multi-cloud environments—establishing configuration baselines, guardrails, and remediation workflows.

 - Secure critical SaaS platforms, ensuring proper configurations, access controls, and engineering integrations.

 - Lead infrastructure vulnerability management across multi-cloud systems, containers, registries, and platform services.

 - Enhance security across containerized and Kubernetes (GKE/EKS/AKS) workloads, including runtime protections, network policies, and workload identity.

 - Assess secure logging configurations across cloud/SaaS providers, ensuring audit logs, retention, and routing meet monitoring and architecture needs.
   


SECURE DEVELOPMENT & ARCHITECTURE ENABLEMENT

 - Partner with engineering teams to make services secure by default, embedding security into development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments.
   


CROSS-FUNCTIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Collaborate with Security Monitoring, Compliance/GRC, Architecture, DevOps, Platform Engineering, and ML Infrastructure.

 - Participate in communicating security advisories, best practices, and updates to Replit’s customers.

 - Support incident investigations as a cloud security subject-matter expert.




REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:

 - 7+ years of experience in cloud engineering, with 3+ years in a senior or lead role.

 - Hands-on experience with CSPM tools (Wiz, Lacework, Prisma, Orca, SCC, etc.).

 - Deep expertise in GCP security (IAM, VPC, KMS, GKE, Cloud Logging).

 - Experience securing and governing SaaS platforms and identity integrations.

 - Operational experience with infrastructure vulnerability management across cloud and container environments.

 - Working knowledge of AWS and/or Azure security services and configurations.

 - Experience with container and Kubernetes security across GKE, EKS, or AKS.

 - Strong IaC security experience with Terraform, Pulumi, or similar tooling.

 - Familiarity with compliance standards (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS).




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Experience supporting engineering teams in building secure-first, cloud-native or PaaS environments.

 - Background securing AI/ML pipelines, model-serving infrastructure, or developer platform services.

 - Experience in high-growth technology or cloud-native product companies.

 - Experience with securing AI/agentic systems and sensitive data pipelines.

 - Automation/scripting with Python.

 - Relevant certifications (e.g., GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer, AWS/Azure security certs).
   
   


WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Problem-solving mindset — Ability to break down complex security and operational challenges into clear engineering solutions.

 - Autonomy — Comfortable leading initiatives, collaborating effectively,  and driving outcomes with minimal oversight.

 - Communication excellence — Able to translate deep technical concepts for engineers, executives, and enterprise customers.

 - Continuous learning — Passion for staying current with AI security, cloud-native advances, and emerging threats.

 - Automation-first approach — Belief in reducing operational toil and building scalable, self-healing systems.



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

jobs.description:
Virtualizācijas risinājumu inženieris/-e

Kāpēc Pasts?


Pasts ir ceļā uz izaugsmi – modernizējam, digitalizējam un meklējam jaunus risinājumus. Mēs ticam, ka kopā varam vairāk, tāpēc meklējam Tevi – atvērtu, atbildīgu un mērķtiecīgu personību, kas nebaidās no jauniem izaicinājumiem un vēlas augt kopā ar mums.

Meklējam Tevi – virtualizācijas risinājumu inženieri, kurš rūpēsies par datu centru fiziskās un virtuālās infrastruktūras attīstību, uzturēšanu un optimizāciju, nodrošinot drošu un nepārtrauktu sistēmu darbību, kā arī rezerves kopiju pieejamību un uzticamību.


Darba vieta

Ziemeļu iela 10, Lidosta ‘’Rīga’’, Mārupes novads, LV – 1000


Darba pienākumi

  • Nodrošināt datu centra serveru, datu masīvu un tīkla iekārtu uzstādīšanu, konfigurēšanu un uzturēšanu;
  • Administrēt virtualizācijas platformas (VMware vSphere, HCI Nutanix) un uzturēt augstas pieejamības (HA/Failover) klāsterus;
  • Veidot, konfigurēt, migrēt un pārvaldīt virtuālās mašīnas, nodrošinot to stabilu darbību;
  • Plānot datu centra resursu (CPU, RAM, krātuve) kapacitāti un veikt regulāru sistēmu monitoringu un optimizāciju;
  • Analizēt un optimizēt virtuālās infrastruktūras veiktspēju, identificējot un novēršot šaurās vietas;
  • Izstrādāt un uzturēt automatizācijas skriptus (PowerShell/PowerCLI) infrastruktūras pārvaldības uzdevumiem;
  • Administrēt datu glabātuves (SAN/NAS), veikt LUN izveidi un piešķiršanu sistēmām;
  • Uzturēt Disaster Recovery risinājumus, nodrošināt rezerves kopēšanas sistēmu (Veeam) darbību un veikt atjaunošanas testus;
  • Sagatavot un uzturēt tehnisko dokumentāciju par datu centra un virtualizācijas infrastruktūru.<

jobs.title: Butiksassistent deltid søges til genbrugsbutik i København
jobs.description:
Deltidssmedarbejder søges til genbrugsbutikken Genbro – er du vores nye kollega?

Elsker du at yde god service, tage ansvar og skabe en indbydende butiksoplevelse?

Genbro på Nørrebrogade søger en butiksassistent til en deltidsstilling med variabel timetal. Du bliver en del af et engageret team i en travl og hyggelig genbrugsbutik med højt tempo og masser af godt humør.

Om jobbet

Hos Genbro får du en vigtig rolle i butikkens drift. Dine arbejdsopgaver vil bl.a. være:

    •    Kassebetjening og kundeservice

    •    Trimning og opfyldning af hylder

    •    Holde orden i hele butikken, så den altid fremstår pæn og indbydende

    •    Lettere rengøringsopgaver

    •    Hjælpe kunderne med et smil og skabe en god oplevelse

    •    Ad hoc opgaver

Du bliver en del af et team, der støtter hinanden og arbejder sammen for at give kunderne en fremragende service.

Vi forventer, at du er:

    •    Smilende, udadvendt og glad for kundekontakt

    •    Positiv og initiativrig     

    •    Mødestabil, fleksibel og pligtopfyldende

    •    I stand til at arbejde selvstændigt og bevare overblikket, når der er travlt

    •    En der bidrager til den gode stemning med godt humør

Har du erfaring fra butik, er det en fordel - men ikke et krav.

Vi lærer dig alt, du skal vide om genbrug og vores koncept.

Om dig

    •    Du kan arbejde eftermiddage og weekender

    •    Du møder til tiden og overholder aftaler

    •    Du trives i en butik, hvor der er fart på

    •    Du elsker service og salg – og at gøre en forskel for kunden

    •    Du arbejder dine opgaver helt i mål og tager naturligt ansvar

    •    Kan arbejde hver 3. weekend

Vi foretrækker at du kan tiltræde hurtigst muligt men vi venter også gerne på den rette kandidat.

Vi afholder løbende jobsamtaler og vi anbefaler derfor alle interesserede i at søge stillingen hurtigst muligt.

Lyder det som et match?

Send din ansøgning og CV til butiksassistent@genbro.dk

jobs.title: Staff Renewals Operations Manager
Regulatory Counsel - Malta
jobs.description:
At Immense Group, we are guided by our core values of passion, boldness, and integrity. We strive to create an environment where our people thrive, driven by a love for innovation and a commitment to delivering exceptional player experiences. If you’re passionate about regulation, we’d love for you to join our team as a Regulatory Counsel. This is an exciting opportunity for a professional looking to make a significant impact in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

A taste of what you’ll do

The Regulatory Counsel is a mid-level role within the Regulatory function, responsible for providing independent regulatory advice and analysis to the business across multiple gambling jurisdictions.

The Regulatory Counsel takes ownership of a defined portfolio of regulatory matters, providing clear and practical advice on the application of gambling laws, licence conditions, and regulatory requirements.

The role involves independent management of licensing and regulatory submissions, proactive identification of regulatory risks, and substantive input into the development of policies, frameworks, and business initiatives. The Regulatory Counsel will develop relationships with internal stakeholders and regulators, contributing meaningfully to the delivery of the team’s objectives.

Accountabilities:

Regulatory Advisory & Interpretation

    Monitor, analyse and interpret regulatory developments across multiple gambling jurisdictions, assessing their impact on the business.
    Provide clear, practical, and independent regulatory advice to internal stakeholders across product, marketing, payments, operations, and technology.
    Conduct substantive legal research and regulatory analysis on applicable laws, licence conditions, and regulatory frameworks.
    Manage regulatory queries from the business, providing timely and well-reasoned responses with limited supervision.
    Provide regulatory input on customer-facing terms and conditions, complaints, and related matters.
    Identify and escalate novel, complex, or high-risk regulatory issues to the Senior Regulatory Counsel as appropriate.

Regulatory Strategy & Business Enablement

    Lead regulatory impact assessments in connection with new products, features, market entries, and strategic initiatives.
    Identify, assess, and advise on regulatory risks, contributing to risk assessments and mitigation strategies.
    Drive cross-functional engagement to support the embedding of regulatory requirements across the business.
    Provide substantive regulatory guidance on AML/CFT, sanctions, responsible gambling, data protection, and other key regulatory areas.
    Support the Senior Regulatory Counsel in providing regulatory input into the business’s strategic planning and commercial activities.

Licensing & Regulatory Operations

    Manage the preparation, submission, and ongoing maintenance of gaming licence applications across multiple jurisdictions, taking ownership of assigned portfolios.
    Oversee and ensure compliance with regulatory reporting obligations, including timely and accurate submissions to licensing authorities.
    Maintain and develop regulatory registers, licences, approvals, and associated documentation.
    Manage and develop relationships with regulators and competent authorities, escalating significant regulatory interactions to the Senior Regulatory Counsel.
    Prepare and coordinate responses to regulatory inquiries, inspections, enforcement actions, and information requests.

Regulatory Framework & Policy Development

    Assist in the development and maintenance of assigned regulatory policies, standards, and frameworks, ensuring alignment with applicable laws and licence conditions.
    Provide substantive regulatory input into AML, responsible gambling, consumer protection, and other regulatory policy areas.
    Develop and deliver regulatory training and awareness materials to Compliance and operational teams.
    Identify gaps in existing policies and frameworks and propose improvements proactively.

Governance, Assurance & Collaboration

    Provide meaningful regulatory input into compliance monitoring activities, internal reviews, and audit processes.
    Collaborate closely with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Technology, and operational teams to ensure consistent interpretation and application of regulatory requirements across the business.
    Lead or contribute to regulatory workstreams within internal projects, change program, and cross-functional initiatives.
    Support junior members of the Regulatory team, providing guidance and reviewing their work where required.

Documentation & General

    Maintain accurate and up-to-date regulatory documentation, records, and internal registers.
    Contribute to the continuous improvement of the Regulatory function’s processes and ways of working.
    Perform other duties reasonably aligned with the role.

Qualifications

    Qualified lawyer with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law (LLB or equivalent).

Required Skills

    3–4 years post-qualification experience in regulatory, legal, or advisory roles, ideally within iGaming, fintech, financial services, or other regulated industries.
    Demonstrated experience in multi-jurisdictional gambling regulation and licensing, including the preparation and management of licence applications and regulatory submissions.
    Experience providing independent regulatory advice to internal business stakeholders.
    Exposure to AML/CFT, responsible gambling, and consumer protection regulatory requirements is required.
    Strong legal research, analysis, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address regulatory issues independently.
    Ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements and translate them into clear, practical, and commercially sound advice.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present regulatory analysis to non-legal audiences.
    Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage a varied and demanding workload, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines.
    High level of professionalism, integrity, and attention to detail.
    Fluency in English is required; proficiency in an additional language (Danish, Finnish, or Swedish) is advantageous.

Preferred Skills

    Confident and credible in providing independent regulatory advice, with the judgement to know when to escalate.
    Commercially aware and solution-oriented, with a pragmatic approach to regulatory challenges.
    Proactive, intellectually curious, and committed to developing deep expertise in international gambling regulation.
    Collaborative and effective in building relationships with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.

Employee benefits

jobs.title: Ph.D.-scholarship in numerical optimisation of wind assisted propulsion systems
jobs.description:
Western Norway University of Applied Sciences, has a vacancy for PhD Research Fellow in numerical optimisation of wind assisted propulsion systems

Western Norway University of Applied Sciences (Høgskulen på Vestlandet, HVL) has an open Ph.D. position with a project period of 4 years at the Department of Mechanical Engineering and Maritime Studies. The Ph.D. candidate will be part of an interdisciplinary project involving three research groups on energy and environmental technology, on wind, water and waves and on data science. 

Due to the nature of the work to be carried out in the project, the candidate will be a part of the Ph.D.-programme Computer Science: Software Engineering, Sensor Networks and Engineering Computing. (https://www.hvl.no/en/research/phd-programmes/phd-programme-in-computer-science/). The research programme in Computer Science currently includes 20 professors and associate professors, more than 30 PhD and post-doctoral fellows, and a large number of master’s students.

This programme is located at the Faculty of Technology, Environmental and Social Sciences at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences. PhD research fellows receive an annual work expense funding which can be used for conference participation, research visits, and equipment.

Workplace will be at HVL Campus Bergen.


Tasks and areas of responsibility:

Wind Assisted Propulsion Systems (WAPS) are moving from demonstration to commercial scale. Rotor sails and rigid wing sails are currently installed on tankers, bulkers, and Ro-Ro vessels, and a growing number of wind-cargo ships are being purpose-built for sail propulsion. Sails reduce the ship’s onboard energy demand, and with it fuel consumption and emissions.


This PhD project will develop simulation and optimisation methods for modern sail design based on the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) and Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) as part of the optimisation loop. The developed method will be applied to optimise both existing sail technologies and novel concepts depending on ship size, route, and operation in order to determine fuel and emission savings.
 

The project will extend an existing Julia LBM in-house code, with established HPC LBM frameworks as references, benchmarks, and potential building blocks combined with Bayesian optimisation.

As part of the required duties (25% of the position), the candidate will join the team focusing on regional development at the faculty and the department. This might include:


• Promote more externally funded research projects in collaboration between our research environment and the shipping industry.
• Interact with regional, national and international partners, and work to promote cooperation between the department and the surrounding society (e.g., bachelor and master theses).
• Mobilization to promote research-based innovation in the shipping industry in collaboration with our participation in the project FORREGION Vestland.
• Supporting the department in our work related to lifelong learning in the shipping industry, with emphasis on strengthening the portfolio of flexible and decentralized education.


Qualifications (requirements):

•Admission to the PhD programme requires that the applicant holds a master’s degree in computer science or a closely related field, such as a master’s degree in informatics, software engineering, communication systems, engineering computing, scientific computing, or computational engineering.
•Candidates from other natural sciences or engineering disciplines holding a master’s degree with a strong emphasis on ICT and computing, for example mechanical, marine or aerospace engineering, applied mathematics or computational physics, may also qualify for admission to the PhD programme.
•Admission into the programme requires that the applicant has obtained strong grades for both the master’s thesis and the course work of the master’s degree. Specifically, admission into the programme normally requires that the applicant has obtained:
- a grade of B (Norwegian/ECTS scale) or better on the master’s thesis,
- an average grade higher than C (Norwegian/ECTS scale) on the coursework associated with the master’s degree
•Documented programming skills beyond scripting in Julia, or in a language Julia can call (Python, C, C++, Fortran).

The PhD research fellow must enrol in the PhD programme in Computer Science: Software Engineering, Sensor Networks and Engineering Computing at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences, and must meet the formal admission requirements for admission into the PhD programme. The position is announced for a period of 4 years with 25% of the 4-year period will be designated to duties such as teaching, development and administrative tasks.

The PhD candidate will be assigned two academic supervisors at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences. An application for enrolment should first be submitted after an appointment is made and the supervisors will help with this procedure. The candidate must be enrolled as a PhD student within 3 months from the start of the employment.


Favoured qualifications (not requirements):

- Master’s thesis in computational fluid dynamics, ideally applied to wings, foils, rotors, or similar configurations.
- Knowledge of and experience with Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM), Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) and/or Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD)
- Knowledge of and experience with optimisation methods.

 

Personal abilities:

- Ability to contribute towards a good work environment and in teamwork.
- Excellent communication skills, ability to communicate well in both written and spoken English. Proficiency, written and spoken, in a Scandinavian language is an advantage.
- The candidate must be diligent and display the ability to work independently, supplemented with regular guidance, and is expected to carry out high-quality research and to publish the results in international workshops, conferences, and journals.

 

Candidates who have submitted a master’s thesis and who have not yet been awarded a master’s degree may also qualify for the position, provided that the master`s degree is awarded within four weeks of the deadline for applications to this position. Proof of successfully finishing the master’s degree along with the grade for the thesis and the final average grade must be submitted to HVL as soon as possible. Applicants already holding a Ph.D. are not eligible for this position.


In addition to the required educational and scientific background, the following criteria will be evaluated: competence and grades on completed course work, quality of the master's thesis, publications (if any), research and teaching experience, practical software engineering skills and experience. A possible outline of a research plan for a potential PhD project will also be taken into account.

The PhD candidate will be assigned two academic supervisor(s) at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences. The necessary application to join the Ph.D. programme Computer Science: Software Engineering, Sensor Networks and Engineering Computing must be submitted and accepted within 3 months of starting in the position. The supervisors will help with this procedure.


Western Norway University of Applied Sciences is subjected to the regulation for export control system. The regulation might be applied in the processing of the applications.


For more information, contact: Associate Prof. Norbert Lümmen: Norbert.Lummen@hvl.no 


Application procedure:

Applications will be evaluated by an expert panel of three members.

Applicants are asked to submit their application and CV online. Please use the link “Apply for this job” (“Søk stillingen”).

The following documentation must be uploaded as an attachment to the online application:


•A brief cover letter including a description of research interests and motivation for working within the current project. The cover letter should include a detailed justification of your qualifications in relation to the listed requirements.
•CV (summarizing education, positions and a complete list of academic publications)
•Master thesis
•Transcripts and diplomas of bachelor’s and master’s degrees. If you have not yet completed your master’s degree, please submit a statement from your institution confirming the expected date of award of your master’s degree.
•Diplomas and certificatesAt least one letter of recommendation preferably from a previous academic supervisor.
•Names and contact details of 2 references. One of these should be the main supervisor of the master’s thesis.

At least one letter of recommendation preferably from a previous academic supervisor.

In case the applicant already has publications, a complete list of these and copies of up to five selected publications should be uploaded. Applicants should indicate which of these publications or parts of these publications should be given special consideration in the evaluation.

If the documents submitted are not in a Scandinavian language or in English, the applicants must submit certified translations of these. The transcripts must specify the topics, the course works, and the grades at the bachelor`s and master`s degree levels. It is required that the applicant encloses a recognition document showing that their degree is equivalent to a Norwegian bachelor’s degree, master’s degree, or PhD. You can read more about applying for recognition of foreign higher education here.

The Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir) offers an automatic recognition document for certain degrees from selected countries. If the applicant’s degree is covered by the automatic recognition, it will be sufficient to attach this document. Read more about automatic recognition here.

As the HK-dir application process may take some time it is recommended to apply to HK-dir as soon as possible. If you have not received a recognition document from HK- dir within the  application deadline, please enclose documentation from HK-dir showing that they have received your application.

The applicants are responsible for ensuring that all the documentation is submitted before the closing date. Om arbeidsgiveren:

Høgskulen på Vestlandet (HVL) er en av de største høgskolene i landet, med om lag 1 800 tilsette og 16 000 studenter fordelt på fem campus i Førde, Sogndal, Bergen, Stord og Haugesund. Hvert år uteksaminerer vi 3000 kandidater som er med på å løse viktige samfunnsoppgaver.


HVL har sterke og innovative fagmiljø innen helse- og sosialvitskap, ingeniør- og maritime utdanningar, lærer-, kultur- og idrettsfag, natur- og samfunnsvitskap, og økonomi og ledelse. HVL skal være tett på arbeidslivet, regionen og studentene. Den overordnet ambisjonen vår er å bli et universitet med en tydelig profesjons- og arbeidslivsrettet profil.


HVL sin visjon er "Kunnskap som bygger menneske og samfunn". Strategiske ambisjoner og mål har særlig oppmerksom på berekraftig samfunnsutvikling, velferd og innovasjon, forankret i våre verdier - inkludere, utfordre og samhandle - som kjennetegner identiteten og kulturen hos oss.


 Fakultetet for teknologi, miljø- og samfunnsvitskap har et bredt utdanningstilbud både på bachelor og masternivå innenfor ingeniør- og naturfag, økonomiske og administrative fag, maritime fag, samfunnsvitskap og humaniora, i tillegg til phd-utdanninger i datateknologi, ansvarlig innovasjon og regional utvikling og i nautiske operasjoner.

Fakultet har fem institutt med om lag 500 tilsette og 5700 studenter. Fakultetet blir ledet av dekan som har det overordnet ansvaret for den faglige og administrative virksomheten ved fakultetet og som rapporterer til rektor. Hoveddelen av fakultetet sin virksomhet er i Haugesund, Bergen, Sogndal og Førde, men fakultetet har også aktivitet ved campus Stord.


Institutt for maskin- og maritime studium har om lag 900 studentar og 80 tilsette i Bergen og Haugesund. Instituttet har ansvaret for fagtilbud innen maritime utdanninger, maskinfag, marinteknikk, bærekraftig produksjon og sirkulærøkonomi og energi- og havteknologi. Havrommet er en fellesnemnar - sammen med fagfelt som samhandling mellom mennesker, organisasjon og teknologi (inkludert system), framtidas utfordringer i blant annet grønn omstilling, og økt digitalisering og autonomi i maritim og marin sektor. Instituttet har syv bachelorprogram, to masterprogram og ph.d.-i Nautiske operasjoner. Det er flere mulige veier til gjennomgående utdanninger fra bachelor til ph.d. i instituttet.

jobs.description:
Klar på et 4 dages aftenhold hos en virksomhed i stor vækst? Ansøg stillingen idag!

For vores samarbejdspartner i 8830 Tjele søger Randstad produktionsmedarbejdere til en spændende og alsidig fuldtidsansættelse hos en virksomhed i stor vækst.

Om stillingen:
Kan du se dig selv i en produktionsvirksomhed med ansvar for at overvåge, omstille og betjene produktionsanlæg iht. teglstensproduktion? I så fald vil denne stilling være lige noget for dig. Et andet ord for stillingen kunne derfor være operatør, da man har et større ansvar ved produktionsanlæg. Du vil få grundig sidemandsoplæring og det rette introforløb, så du kan bestride arbejdsopgaverne. Dertil en yderst konkurrencedygtig løn.

Aftenholdstider ligger fra 13.55-23.05 4 dage om ugen fra Mandag til Torsdag

Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er ikke afgørende - men vi ser gerne at du har en håndværksmæssig baggrund eller erfaring. Heroveni er det et plus hvis du har erfaring med betjening af produktionsanlæg og generel procesforståelse. Dette kunne være tidligere arbejde som proces-/industrioperatør og eller smed/mekaniker, med indsigt i fejlfinding og reparation af anlæg. Derudover er det en fordel, hvis du har et truckkort, men det er ikke et krav for at søge stillingen.

Arbejdsopgaverne er:
• Overvågning og betjening af anlæg
• Omstilling ved produktionsskift
• Kvalitetssikring af anlæg
• Fejlfinding og reparation af anlæg

Vi forventer:
• Du har enten en baggrund og eller erfaring indenfor de ovennævnte områder
• Du er ansvarlig og mødestabil
• Du er selvkørende og selvstændig men kan arbejde i teams

Vi tilbyder:
• Overenskomstmæssige forhold
• Mulighed for faglig udvikling og større ansvar i dine opgaver
• Fastansættelse ved en virksomhed i vækst
• Konkurrencedygtig løn

Ansøg:
Hvis du synes, at ovenstående lyder spændende ser vi frem til at modtage dit CV. Såfremt du ønsker at vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Asmus Dam på tlf. 48808201. Vi afholder løbende samtaler, og alle henvendelser behandles fortroligt. Vi ansætter snarest mulig.

Om randstad:
Randstad er verdens største HR-udbyder og ‘partner for talent’. Vi giver lige muligheder til alle uanset baggrund og hjælper kandidater med at forblive relevante på et hastigt skiftende arbejdsmarked. Vi tror på et inkluderende arbejdsmarked, hvor alle kan være sig selv og føle sig velkomne.

Vores markedsindsigt og store kendskab til arbejdsmarkedet hjælper virksomheder med at opbygge en kvalificeret, mangfoldig og fleksibel arbejdsstyrke, og vi støtter mennesker og virksomheder i at nå deres fulde potentiale. Det er det, vi er her for, og det er det, der motiverer os hver dag.

Randstad DK er en del af den internationale Randstad Group. Vi formidler dagligt arbejde til over 600.000 mennesker verden over og er førende inden for rekruttering, karriererådgivning og fleksibel arbejdskraft i Danmark, med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Aalborg og Kolding.

jobs.title: Underviser i robotteknologi til Absalons ingeniør-uddannelser - genopslag
jobs.description:
Click for version in English

Vil du være med til at opbygge en ny engelsksproget diplomingeniøruddannelse i robotteknologi? Brænder du for at udvikle en ny uddannelse i tæt samarbejde med dygtige og engagerede kolleger, studerende og lokale virksomheder? Så kan det være dig, vi står og mangler til vores studerende på diplomingeniøruddannelserne og ved efter- og videreuddannelsen i Automation og Drift.

På Absalon får du mulighed for at kombinere din erfaring fra robot-, automations- eller maskinområdet med undervisning. Samtidig sætter du dit faglige aftryk på uddannelsens indhold, laboratorier og samarbejde med industrien.

Absalon etablerer i september 2027 en ny engelsksproget diplomingeniøruddannelse i robotteknologi. Uddannelsen har fokus på integration af robot- og automationsløsninger og en forståelse for helheden i det produktionssystem, hvor løsningen skal indgå. Diplomingeniøruddannelse i robotteknologi indgår i tæt sammenhæng med diplomingeniøruddannelsen i maskinteknologi samt efter- og videreuddannelsen på akademiniveau i Automation og Drift.

På ingeniøruddannelserne er det vores ambition at uddanne de bedste ingeniører i Danmark. Vi målretter vores uddannelse til arbejdsmarkedet ved at samarbejde tæt med den danske automations-, maskin- og procesindustri samt virksomheder og andre aktører i Biotekbyen Kalundborg og i Campus Kalundborgsamarbejdet. Læs meget mere her. https://www.biotekbyen.dk/

Din profil
Vi søger en underviser, der brænder for at uddanne inden for grænseområdet mellem robotteknologi, automation, produktionsstyring og maskinteknologi. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du kan genkende dig selv i nedenstående:

Dygtig og motiverende underviser, der er engageret i de studerende. Du bidrager sammen med dine kolleger til at skabe et aktivt, fagligt og socialt studiemiljø. Det er vigtigt, at du kan bidrage positivt til den nære faglige relation, vi har mellem undervisere og studerende.

Medvirker til at få det faglige, det praktiske og samarbejdet til at fungere godt. Vi er mere end en arbejdsplads, og du skal ligesom os, være drevet af et stærkt kammeratskab og en fælles faglig interesse. Du sparrer med din kolleger omkring din undervisning, og sammen finder vi løsninger på praktiske opgaver.

Du har desuden nemt ved at indgå i dialog med virksomheder, både i forhold til muligheder for efter- og videreuddannelse og hvad angår samarbejde med studerende på diplomingeniøruddannelserne.

Du har lyst til at indgå i et arbejdsfællesskab og være med til at etablere en ny uddannelse. Vi opbygger og udvikler løbende vores ingeniøruddannelser, og meget skal gøres for første gang. Du får en central rolle i beskrivelsen og opbygningen af den nye uddannelse i robotteknologi og automation. Du skal bl.a. være med til at indrette og skaffe det rette udstyr til kommende robot- og automationslaboratorier.

Din ingeniørfaglighed kommer i spil når du skal undervise, vejlede og sparrer med kolleger inden for dele af følgende områder:
  • Integration og programmering af industrirobotter, f.eks. Universal robots, ABB, KUKA, FANUC
  • Industri 4.0
  • Siemens TIA-portal
  • Industrielle netværk
  • Vision-systemer og sensorteknologi
  • Sikkerhedssystemer og cyber security
  • CE-mærkning og gældende standarder for fagområdet
  • Integration af AI i robot- og automationsløsninger
  • PLC-, HMI- og SCADA-løsninger
  • CAD og 3D print

Derudover forventer vi os, at du:
  • har en baggrund som ingeniør, det kan f.eks. være robot-/automationsingeniør, produktionsingeniør, elektroingeniør, maskiningeniør eller lignende
  • har relevant erhvervserfaring inden for ingeniørfaget
  • kan undervise på engelsk og gerne også på dansk
  • gerne er lektorbedømt
  • har indsigt i industriens behov for ingeniørkompetencer inden for robot og automationsområdet. Det er ikke et krav, men vil det være en fordel.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Som underviser på diplomingeniøruddannelserne og ved Automation og Drift har du en række forskellige opgaver i løbet af en arbejdsuge.

Opbygge en uddannelse. Du har interesse i at spille en central rolle i etablering af ny uddannelse inden for robotteknologi og eventuelt have en koordinerende rolle i beskrivelse af uddannelsen, udarbejdelse af studieordning, etablering af studenter-, og virksomhedsnetværk samt indkøb af udstyr og indretning af laboratorium. Har du erfaring med og interesse i enkelte administrative opgaver vil det være en fordel.

Undervise og projektvejlede studerende. Du skal primært undervise og vejlede vores studerende både teoretisk og laboratorie- og projektbaseret inden for dine fagområder. Du skal selv tilrettelægge, gennemføre og evaluere undervisningen. Du skal også være med til løbende at udvikle vores undervisning.

Undervise på efter- og videreuddannelse (EVU) og på grunduddannelse. Du skal undervise studerende på fuldtidsstudium såvel som kursister med et fuldtidsarbejde ved siden af deres uddannelse på EVU. Til undervisningen på EVU kan der også være opgaver med opsøgende kontakt til virksomheder og præsentation af uddannelsesudbud.

Fagligt samarbejde som en del af hverdagen. Du bliver en del af et fagligt fællesskab, hvor du sparrer og samarbejder med dine kolleger. Sammen sørger I f.eks. for at tilrettelægge gode undervisningsforløb, udvikle undervisningsmaterialer, og måske er der et arrangement tilknyttet centret, som skal stables på benene.

Undervisningen på de forskellige uddannelsesudbud vil fortrinsvis være på vores Campus Kalundborg, men på EVU-området kan der forekomme undervisning på Absalons campus i Roskilde. Du skal være forberedt på, at noget undervisning kan foregå i weekend eller på aftener.

Dine kolleger
Du bliver ansat i Centre for Engineering and Science, som driver uddannelserne Bioanalytiker, Radiograf, Diplomingeniør i bioteknologi, Diplomingeniør i maskinteknologi samt efter- og videreuddannelserne Diplomuddannelse i bioteknologi, Procesteknologi og kemi, Akademiuddannelse i Automation og Drift samt Akademiuddannelse i Innovation, produkt og produktion.

Du bliver en del af et team med uddannelsesleder, adjunkter og lektorer. På vores ingeniøruddannelser i Kalundborg er vi ca. 20 ansatte undervisere. Vi arbejder på at skabe den bedste ingeniøruddannelse i tæt samarbejde med biotekindustrien i Nordvestsjælland, samt vores engagerede studerende. Vi værdsætter høj faglighed og løser opgaver, samt udfordringer i fællesskab, hvor vi alle er bevidste om vigtigheden af at bidrage til fællesskabet og til centrets samlede målsætning.

Vi holder til i nybygget campusbygning fra 2021 og i nabobygningen Helix Lab. Absalon er desuden med i Campus Kalundborginitiativet, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen med fem andre uddannelsesinstitutioner, og fra 2028 vil vi være en del af et nyt fælles Campus Kalundborg-byggeri.

Der kan blive tale om ansættelse som lektor Du bedes tilkendegive i din ansøgning, hvilken type ansættelse du søger.

Sådan ansøger du
Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • For dig der er nyuddannet og ansættes som adjunkt, vil en forventet startløn være 41.232,- kr. inkl. pension.For dig der er en erfaren underviser og ansættes som lektor, vil en forventet startløn være 53.537,- kr. inkl. pension.Der er mulighed for at forhandle et kvalifikationstillæg på baggrund af kvalifikationer og erfaring.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid med ansættelse pr. 1. januar 2027, meget gerne før
  • Hvis du har nogen spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte uddannelsesleder Jesper Stensbo Knudsen, jesk@pha.dk, 7248 3224
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her: https://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon/ledige-stillinger, eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest den 15. november 2026
  • Vi forventer at afholde samtaler løbende, dog senest i uge 47 og 48.

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

For stillingen gælder det, at du ansættes som adjunkt eller lektor alt efter dine kvalifikationer.
På Absalon er adjunkturet en 4-årig uddannelsesstilling. Det understøtter vi gennem Absalons lektorkvalificeringsforløb, som alle nyansatte adjunkter deltager i, og hvor alle får tilknyttet en vejleder. For at blive ansat som lektor forudsætter det en positiv lektorbedømmelse inden for stillingstrukturens anvendelsesområde.

Ved ansættelse af lektorer, der er lektorbedømt før 2013-stillingsstrukturen, sker ansættelse på hidtidige centralt fastsatte løn- og ansættelsesvilkår. Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer, afvejet med stillingens konkrete indhold, kan fornyet lektorbedømmelse efter den aktuelle stillingsstruktur (fast-track ordningen) eventuelt aftales. Læs mere her i kap. 5: https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2020/673

Du kan læse mere om rammerne for ansættelse som adjunkt eller lektor i vores stillingsstruktur her: https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2021/1458

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

jobs.title: Global Mental Health Researcher
jobs.description:
DIGNITY is looking for a Global Mental Health Researcher to join our International Programmes Department. This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated, early-career researcher, who wants to generate new and impactful knowledge, strengthen mental health and psychosocial support (MHPSS) programming, and contribute to better outcomes for people affected by torture and other forms of violence and adversity.

DIGNITY is an international human rights and development organization with a significant research capacity that works to prevent torture and violence, rehabilitate survivors, and enable justice and accountability. Our International Programmes Department works closely with local civil society partners, researchers and public institutions in countries affected by conflict, violence and political repression. Research plays a central role in our work by fostering innovation and critical reflection and generating evidence that strengthens programmes, informs policy and contributes to improved practice and impact.

About the position

As Global Mental Health Researcher, you will join our newly established International Research and Learning Unit together with an interdisciplinary team of senior researchers and monitoring and evaluation experts and analysts. Your tasks will be i) to contribute to developing DIGNITY’s international research agenda on Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS) and ii) to offer technical advice to our rehabilitation programmes. You will be working with DIGNITY’s senior researchers, project managers and technical experts and collaborate closely with our partners in Asia, Africa, MENA and Eastern Europe. As an early-career researcher, we expect you to take on and develop the following tasks and responsibilities with a strong commitment to learn and grow as a researcher and advisor at DIGNITY.

Primary responsibilities
  1. To develop and conduct MHPSS research with guidance from DIGNITY Senior Researchers
  2. To support ongoing research in collaboration with DIGNITY’s Senior Researchers
  3. To offer advise on development and evaluation of DIGNITY’s MHPSS projects and programming in low- and middle-income countries

Specific tasks include:

  • To develop and conduct research projects and contribute to the formulation of grant applications focused on mental health and well-being of populations affected by violence and other forms of adversity, in line with DIGNITY’s strategy and mandate
  • To support ongoing research through qualitative and quantitative data analysis, coauthoring manuscripts and reports, and collaboration on grant applications
  • To contribute to the strengthening of DIGNITY’s MHPSS research agenda, networks and profile
  • To produce peer reviewed publications and other impactful research outputs
  • To provide technical advising for MHPSS projects
  • To contribute to the capacity building to partners and public authorities in DIGNITY programme contexts
  • To provide programmatic input to project documents, funding applications, policy and advocacy
About you

You hold a PhD in Psychology, Public Health or another relevant interdisciplinary field.

In addition, we expect that you have:

  • Competencies and experiences in applied research
  • Abilities and interest in to translating technical expertise into actionable knowledge for non-experts
  • Familiarity with evidence-based manualized MHPSS(e.g. PM+)
  • Experience with quantitative and qualitative research methods
  • Basic understanding of project management methodologies and tools
  • Ability to handle multiple priorities, tasks and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Good collaboration and communication skills and strong commitments to work in teams and to co-produce knowledge and learning
  • Ability to work in a multi-cultural environment
  • Experiences with and/or strong interests in trauma-informed approaches to vulnerable and at-risk populations
  • Experiences with and/or strong interests in intersectional, decolonial, rights-based and/or survivor-centred approaches an advantage
  • Proficiency in Arabic, French, Ukrainian or Russian is an advantage
We offer
  • A meaningful research position in an internationally recognised human rights and development organisation.
  • An opportunity to contribute to globally relevant research that improves the lives of torture survivors and other populations affected by violence.
  • A collaborative and highly professional international research environment.
  • Close collaboration with experienced researchers, programme colleagues and local partners across multiple countries.
  • Flexible working arrangements and a strong emphasis on work-life balance.
  • Opportunities for international collaboration, learning and professional development.
Terms of employment

The position is permanent and based in DIGNITY’s International Programmes Department in the International Research and Learning Unit with reference to the Head of International Research and Learning.

Your place of employment is Copenhagen at our HQ at Bryggervangen 55, 2100 Copenhagen Ø.

We expect you to have a civil registry address in Denmark during the full employment.

Expected entry is 1 February 2027.

Your working hours are 37 hours per week, with the expectation that additional work may take place. It will be possible to take time off after having additional working hours within our flexible work schedule.

The position includes approximately 40 days of international travel annually.

Salary and terms of employment will follow the applicable Danish collective agreement and will be based on qualifications and relevant experience. The salary level is based on skills and relevant experience and within a range of DKK 42.-47.000 (gross, monthly) + pension (18.07%).

More info

Further information regarding the position can be obtained by contacting Head of International Research and Learning Tomas Max Martin at tm@dignity.dk.

The position will be filled following an academic assessment. As part of the hiring process, the shortlisted candidates’ research qualifications will be assessed with focus on research publications, grants, academic paper presentations, convening of panels, academic networks, research dissemination and communication, real-world and policy impact.

An application consisting of:

  • A CV
  • a motivational letter
  • documentation of completed PhD degree
  • a complete publication list
  • three selected peer reviewed articles (for co-authored publications, applicants should briefly describe their own contribution to each of the three selected publications), and
  • a short academic portfolio (maximum three pages) describing the applicant's contribution to selected research projects and publications, methodological expertise, experience with research funding, international research collaboration and networks, research dissemination, teaching experience and examples of contributions to policy, practice or programming (with links to documents where appropriate).

should be submitted via the link no later than 25 October 2026.

Shortlisted candidates will be assessed in the first half of November, and all applicants will be notified whether their application has been accepted for assessment.

We expect to hold the first round of interviews in November 2026 (week 48) and the second round of interviews end of November/start December 2026 (week 49), and both will take place in Copenhagen.

You can read about DIGNITY's processing of your personal data in our privacy policy, which you can find here: Privacy policy - DIGNITY - Danish Institute Against Torture.

DIGNITY is an international human rights and development organisation that has worked for a world free of torture and violence since 1982. We prevent torture and violence, treat traumatized victims and document serious human rights violations so that those responsible can be prosecuted. You can read more about our organisation and work at www.dignity.dk. DIGNITY regards diversity as a strength and therefore encourages all qualified persons to apply for the position regardless of ethnic background, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion or age.

jobs.title: Service Engineer
jobs.description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.


Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt.

Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

jobs.description:
Experienced Employee Wanted for Pig Production in 9640 Farsø

Would you like to become part of a workplace where respect, teamwork, and professionalism are fundamental values? Here, colleagues support one another, treat each other with respect, and work together to achieve the best results for both people and animals.

For this well-managed farm, which has been under the same ownership for 25 years, we are looking for an experienced employee to join the nursery unit.

You will become part of an international team of skilled and dedicated colleagues, where job satisfaction, responsibility, and teamwork are highly valued.

Why Are We Looking for a New Employee?

To create a better work-life balance, we would like to expand our team. Adding another colleague will allow tasks to be distributed more efficiently, creating greater flexibility, improved planning, and a more sustainable working environment for everyone on the farm.

About the Farm

The farm consists of:

  • 1,300 sows
  • Gilts (replacement breeding stock)
  • Nursery pigs
  • Production of 30 kg pigs for sale

The farm specializes in pig production and focuses on maintaining high standards of animal welfare, productivity, and efficient herd management. The facilities are well maintained and designed to support a modern and professional working environment.

 

Job Responsibilities

Your primary tasks will include:

  • Daily inspection of pigs
  • Sorting animals
  • Selecting pigs for sale
  • Vaccinations
  • Monitoring animal health and welfare
  • Other tasks within the nursery unit

We Expect That You

  • Have experience in pig production
  • Can communicate in English
  • Are reliable and responsible
  • Have a positive attitude and good teamwork skills
  • Enjoy working in an international environment
  • Can work independently and take responsibility

A driver's license is not required.

Working Hours

  • Monday to Friday: 07:00 – 15:00
  • Two daily breaks of 30 minutes each
  • Work every second weekend

Accommodation

Accommodation is available just 1 km from the farm.

The house has been newly renovated and is offered at a reasonable rental rate.

Employment

We are willing to wait for the right candidate.

Contact

Does this sound like the job for you?

Tetiana Fulytko

HR Consultant

+45 96 35 13 11

jobs.title: Are you curious how your favorite ice cream is produced – and interested in developing training that can help others understand as well?
jobs.description:
Are you curious how your favorite ice cream is produced – and interested in developing training that can help others understand as well?

At Gram Equipment, we are looking for a student worker to our Gram Equipment Academy team, where we develop high-quality online training on our ice cream processing equipment – for internal as well as external use.

Your primary responsibility will be to translate our existing trainings into German learning experiences, review and update existing trainings and contribute to the development of new training.

You will have the opportunity to get in-depth knowledge about how the specific machine contributes to the production of ice cream, and turn it into training, that is understandable for machine operators from customer sites all around the world.


This will require that you focus on:
  • German translation. Your main focus will be to transform existing English training into clear, engaging and technically accurate German content.
  • Project management.: You will get full responsibility for managing your own projects according to the goals, we set together, and we will have short weekly follow ups to coordinate your progress.
  • Stakeholder collaboration. You will have to coordinate and meet with colleagues from across the organization to gather knowledge and feedback that ensures that the training includes all important aspects and addresses the needs of both customers and your colleagues.
  • Follow and bring new ideas to the existing process for developing training. The process stretches from gathering knowledge, through writing a script and finding visuals, to developing the training using text, pictures, videos and other interactive elements.
  • Content creation. You will have to use creativity and writing skills to produce engaging and effective online training for our customers, using our authoring tool Genially. Templates and previous trainings are available for support and inspiration.
  • Quality Assurance. Ensure that the training is correct, of high quality and that the user experience is consistent.
  • Support the continuous development of Gram Equipment Academy.


Though you will have to work independently, we consider it a team effort to be able to provide training, so support and sparring are always within arm’s length. In general, our team is characterized by an optimistic atmosphere and an informal, humoristic tone.


We do not have any specific requirements for your education. However, we are working with technically complex ice cream processing equipment, so it will be an advantage if you either have some technical understanding of machines and processes – or at least a strong curiosity and willingness to learn.


You must also have an interest in and capabilities for developing the learning material and ensuring its quality.


In addition, we do require the following:
  • Personality: A self-driven team player with an optimistic and proactive work attitude and strong interpersonal communication skills – since you must be able to collaborate with colleagues from across the organization.
  • Creative thinking: We appreciate input that drives change and that has the potential to improve our content, as well as the way we work.
  • Language: Our company language is English. So, you must be able to communicate in English, both spoken and written, including the mediation of technical aspects. In addition, German language skills are essential, and you must be able to write clear German and handle technical terminology with precision.
  • Skills: Some technical understanding of equipment, graphic capabilities and a visual eye for the detail.
  • Work approach: Self-driven, proactive, flexible, structured, and quality-focused.


We expect the average working hours to be 10 to 15 per week, preferably in the office for the purpose of collaboration, but also for the social aspect. The date of employment and your hour distribution will be adapted to your studies.


The position is located at our main office in Kolding, where you will find an informal atmosphere between good and dedicated colleagues.


Application:

Please send your application and CV as soon as possible. Feel free to add any other relevant attachments showing your past work. If you have any questions for the position, please do not hesitate to reach out to Learning & Development Specialist, Cristian Buita on +45 20 82 02 64 or CRBU@gram-equipment.com, or Business Developer Teamlead, Line Andersen on +45 53 66 74 21 or LSAN@gram-equipment.com.


Gram Equipment A/S offers

Gram Equipment A/S is the global leading supplier of advanced equipment and process installations for industrial ice production. With an extensive global network of subsidiaries, agents, sales- and service offices and around 600 employees worldwide, Gram Equipment has the optimal base for fulfilling our customers’ demands.

The company is constantly striving to extend the portfolio of innovative solutions. We aim to ensure that our customers always can react fast to the demands from their customers and consumers worldwide.

Our vision: We ensure our customers’ success in the ice cream industry by providing innovative solutions and services, while seeking to minimize the environmental impact of our solutions and footprint.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Position in Software Engineering: Program Analysis and Repository Mining
jobs.description:
A 2-year postdoctoral researcher position is available at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) in the Software Engineering section of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI). The successful candidate will contribute to the VILLUM Experiment project “Is Correctness Necessary? An Experiment in Test-Free Program Repair.” The project investigates whether software bugs can be repaired using information found in the code itself, without relying on test suites or specifications. The position is available from February 1, 2027. 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Project Description

Generating code is becoming cheap; establishing whether it is correct is not. Large language models can now produce and modify software at remarkable speed, and practices such as “vibe coding” are widening the gap between code generation and validation. Requiring a carefully designed test suite or specification for every generated fragment is unlikely to scale. Yet most automated repair techniques depend on exactly such a correctness oracle: without a failing test or specification, they have neither a clear repair target nor a way to assess a proposed change.

This project challenges that dependency by investigating whether software bugs can be repaired using evidence already present in the code. It will combine program analysis with patterns mined from existing software to explore whether multiple, independent sources of evidence can guide repair when tests or specifications are unavailable. The approach will be studied across different programming languages and evaluated on both real-world bugs and code modified by AI coding assistants. The broader aim is to determine when code contains enough information to support its own repair and when knowledge of the intended behavior remains essential.

 

What we offer 

We offer a dynamic and supportive research environment within an internationally recognized institute. You will join an open, collaborative team that values teamwork, professional diligence, and innovation. The Software Engineering section provides flexible work conditions and strong support for individual development, including mentorship and opportunities to expand your skills and responsibilities.

As part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, our section is involved in a variety of national and European research projects and enjoys a robust network of academic and industrial partners. This position provides an opportunity to engage with these collaborations and work on real-world challenges. We encourage and support our postdocs to publish their research in renowned journals and conferences, and to engage in knowledge exchange with colleagues and external research and industrial partners. The working language is English, and we pride ourselves on a diverse, inclusive, and inspiring workplace that fosters personal and professional growth.

 

What we expect 

The appointed researcher will investigate whether software defects can be repaired without relying on test suites or specifications. The candidate will contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of a framework that combines program analysis with patterns mined from existing software. The work will involve experiments with real-world bugs and code modified by AI coding assistants across multiple programming languages. We are looking for a highly motivated candidate who meets the following qualifications and characteristics:

  • A PhD (completed or close to completion) in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Programming Languages, Artificial Intelligence, or a closely related field.

  • Research experience or a strong interest in one or more of the following areas: program analysis, mining software repositories, automated software engineering, software testing, or software repair.

  • An interest in software reliability challenges arising from AI-generated and AI-modified code.

  • Experience with empirical evaluation, software repositories, or bug benchmarks is an advantage.

  • Experience with one or more of C, Java, and Python is an advantage.

  • Proficiency in written and spoken English, with good communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a research team.

  • A strong research record or demonstrated research potential through publications or other relevant research outputs.

 

Workplace description 

The postdoc will be employed in the Software Engineering section at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI), SDU. MMMI is an internationally recognized research institute within the Faculty of Engineering, known for its contributions to software engineering, robotics, and artificial intelligence. The Software Engineering section encompasses a range of research areas in software development, data analytics, and intelligent systems, and it plays a key role in several ongoing European projects.

Our workplace is truly international and collaborative. Researchers in the section come from diverse backgrounds and work closely together on cross-disciplinary projects. We benefit from state-of-the-art facilities and a strong administrative and technical support structure. The institute maintains close collaboration with other departments and centers at SDU, as well as with industry partners, providing a vibrant environment where theoretical research meets practical application. The position will be located on SDU’s Odense campus, which offers an attractive setting and a rich campus life in the city of Odense, Denmark’s hub for robotics and technology development.

 

Further information 

For further information, please contact Associate Professor Abhishek Tiwari (abti@mmmi.sdu.dk) or Assistant Professor Jyoti Prakash (jyp@mmmi.sdu.dk)

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position. 

  • A research statement may be included.

  • References/reference letters may also be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is from February 1, 2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: Kreativ og fagligt stærk kantinemedarbejder i rollen som stedfortræder
jobs.description:
Vi søger en kantinemedarbejder til kantinen på Campus Holbæk, der brænder for arbejdet i en kantine. Vi søger dig, der har lyst til at være en del af et udviklende, solidarisk og omsorgsfuldt arbejdsmiljø, hvor medarbejdergruppen lægger vægt på trivsel og samhørighed.

På Professionshøjskolen Absalon har vi et ønske om at have levende campusmiljøer og sætte vores studerende i centrum. Dette kommer især til udtryk i vores kantiner, hvor vores studerende hver dag har mulighed for at købe et sundt og velsmagende måltid mad. Vi er løbende i dialog med de studerende rundt om buffeten i kantinen. Dette gør vi for at sikre, at de måltider, som vi serverer for de studerende, falder i deres smag og giver dem lyst til at samles i vores kantinemiljøer.

Din profil
Du skal som stedfortræder i kantinen være fagligt stærk og bidrage med ny inspiration i en travl hverdag, blandt andet i forhold til produktudvikling, smag og sanser. Derudover skal du have lyst til at være i et miljø med mange studerende, og du skal kunne træde ind og fungere i en koordinerende rolle, når kantinelederen ikke er til stede. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du kan genkende dig selv i følgende profil:

Bæredygtigt fokus. Du har erfaring med at være i en kantine, hvor der er fokus på økologi, bæredygtighed og reduktion af madspild. Dit engagement for bæredygtighed i køkkenet kommer blandt andet til udtryk ved, at du har lyst og evne til at dele dine gode ideer og samtidig suger til dig, når du selv har mulighed for at opnå ny viden.

Overblik og omstillingsparat. I en hverdag med mange opgaver, der skal planlægges og følges op på, kan du træffe kvalificerede beslutninger, omsætte dem til handling og samtidig bevare overblikket. Du går struktureret til dine opgaver og løser dem med præcision og omhyggelighed. Du er ansvarsbevidst, serviceminded og engageret, både i forhold til opgaver og samarbejde. Blæser forandringens vinde, går du gerne forrest med en positiv tilgang.

Gode samarbejdsevner. Du evner at arbejde sammen med mange forskellige mennesker på tværs af faggrupper. Du har også evnen og lysten til en hverdag, der rummer det brede arbejdsmarked, hvilket f.eks. omfatter kolleger, der er ansat i virksomhedspraktik.

Erfaring med LEAN. Du har erfaring med LEAN som arbejdsredskab, og du har med egne øjne set eksempler på, hvordan det ved hjælp af LEAN er muligt at frigive tid og ressourcer til andre vigtige gøremål i en travl hverdag.

Derudover forventer vi, at du:
  • taler og skriver dansk og engelsk
  • har kendskab til Office-pakken på brugerniveau
  • har erfaring fra lignende stillinger i en kantine eller køkken.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Som kantinemedarbejder kommer du til at arbejde med følgende opgaver:

Udvikling i dagligdagen. I en travl hverdag får du en vigtig rolle, når vi skal udvikle arbejdsgange eller finde på nye spændende måder at anvende appelsinskræller eller broccolistokke på i forsøget på at opnå et endnu mere bæredygtigt fokus.

Deltage i kantinens drift. Du skal være med til at producere kolde og varme retter såvel som brød, kager og meget andet, som vi sælger i kantinen. Du skal også være med til at planlægge menuen og bestille varer hjem, samt være med til at modtage varerne, når disse leveres. Derudover skal du i løbet af en dag ekspedere i kantinens salgsområde og foretage egenkontrol.

Sørge for kursister og gæster. På vores campus har vi en del kurser og konferencer for interne såvel som eksterne virksomheder og organisationer. Du har i forbindelse med kurser og konferencer en vigtig rolle i forhold til, at kursister og gæster får den rette forplejning på det rigtige tidspunkt, så de føler, at servicen er i top.

Stedfortræder for leder. Du skal drive køkkenet i samarbejde med dine kolleger og bevare overblikket, når der er mange bolde i luften. Som stedfortræder forventes det, at du kan bestille varer, sikre en velfungerende kantinedrift og træffe beslutninger på lederens vegne, når det er nødvendigt.

Dine kolleger
Kantinen på Campus Holbæk er et team bestående af en ansvarlig kok/kantinemedarbejder og en kantinemedarbejder. Du refererer til vores kantineleder på Campus Kalundborg, hvor der også kan forekomme vagter. Hos os går vi op i kvalitet, at der er en uformel omgangstone, og at det skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde.

Alle campusser i Absalon har tilknyttet en eller flere kantiner, hvor studerende og ansatte hver dag har mulighed for at købe et sundt og velsmagende måltid. Dine kolleger har et stort fokus på, at deres arbejde ikke kun er madproduktion og salg - kantinen er det uformelle samlingspunkt på campus og altid et rart sted at være. Vi arbejder i teams, og selvom vi er spredt på forskellige campusser, samarbejder vi på tværs og går op i at skabe holdånd og fællesskab, uanset om du arbejder i Holbæk, Slagelse, Vordingborg eller på en af de øvrige campusser.

Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • Afhængigt af din uddannelsesbaggrund og anciennitet vil en forventet løn ligge mellem 29.000 kr. og 32.000 kr. pr. måned ekskl. pension. Hertil kommer et pensionsbidrag på 15%, 16% eller 18,4% afhængigt af din uddannelsesbaggrund. Din løn bliver sammensat af basisløn, funktionstillæg og evt. kvalifikationstillæg.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid, og vi vil gerne have, at du begynder den 1. december 2026 eller snarest derefter.
  • Hvis du har nogle spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte kantineleder Søren Loui Frydensberg, der kan træffes dagligt fra kl. 13.00 - 15.00 på tlf.: 7248 2253 eller mail skre@pha.dk.
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her: https://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest den 19. oktober 2026.
  • Vi forventer at holde 1. ansættelsessamtale den 23. oktober 2026 og 2. ansættelsessamtale den 26. oktober 2026.

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.
